name: finite_colimit
statement: lemma finite_colimit [Fintype ι] (p : ι → W) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ F) : ∃ q ∈ F, ∀ i, q ≤ p i
proof:
:=
  DirectedOn.fintype_colimit isTrans_ge (Order.PFilter.nonempty F) F.directed p hp

name: finite_colimit_domain
statement:
lemma finite_colimit_domain [Fintype ι] (v : ι → F.Model) :
    ∃ q ∈ F, ∀ i, q ⊩↓ ↑(v i)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ i, ∃ p ∈ F, p ⊩↓ ↑(v i) := fun i ↦ (v i).mem_filter
  choose p hp using this
  have : ∃ q ∈ F, ∀ i, q ≤ p i := F.finite_colimit p fun i ↦ (hp i).1
  rcases this with ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩
  refine ⟨q, hq, fun i ↦ domain_antimonotone (hqp i) (hp i).2⟩

name: SSubset.iff
statement: lemma SSubset.iff {x y : V} : x ⊊ y ↔ x ⊆ y ∧ ∃ z ∈ y, z ∉ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ss, eq⟩
    refine ⟨ss, ?_⟩
    contrapose eq
    push Not at *
    apply subset_antisymm ss eq
  · rintro ⟨ss, ⟨z, hzy, hzx⟩⟩
    refine ⟨ss, ?_⟩
    rintro rfl
    contradiction

:= by

  ext y
  simp [hx.not_mem, he.not_mem]

name: pairing_exists
statement: lemma pairing_exists : ∀ x y : V, ∃ z : V, ∀ w, w ∈ z ↔ w = x ∨ w = y

name: kpair.
statement:
@[grind =, simp] lemma kpair.π₂_kpair (x y : V) :
    π₂ ⟨x, y⟩ₖ = y
proof:
:= calc
  π₂ ⟨x, y⟩ₖ = ⋃ˢ {z ∈ {x, y} ; z = x → ({x, y} : V) = {x}} := by simp [π₂, kpair]
  _              = ⋃ˢ {y} := by
    congr; ext z
    suffices (z = x ∨ z = y) ∧ (z = x → y = x) ↔ z = y by simpa [mem_ext_iff (x := {x, y})]
    grind
  _              = y := by simp

name: kpair_inj
statement:
lemma kpair_inj {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} :
    ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ₖ = ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ₖ → x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  constructor
  · calc x₁ = kpair.π₁ ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ₖ := by simp
    _       = kpair.π₁ ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ₖ := by rw [h]
    _       = x₂                 := by simp
  · calc y₁ = kpair.π₂ ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ₖ := by simp
    _       = kpair.π₂ ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ₖ := by rw [h]
    _       = y₂                 := by simp

name: omega_existsUnique
statement: lemma omega_existsUnique : ∃! ω : V, ∀ x, x ∈ ω ↔ ∀ I : V, IsInductive I → x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rcases isInductive_exists (V := V) with ⟨I, hI⟩
  let ω : V := {x ∈ I ; ∀ J : V, IsInductive J → x ∈ J}
  have : ∀ x, x ∈ ω ↔ ∀ I : V, IsInductive I → x ∈ I := by
    intro x; constructor
    · intro hx J hJ
      have hx : x ∈ I ∧ ∀ J : V, IsInductive J → x ∈ J := by simpa [ω] using hx
      exact hx.2 J hJ
    · intro h
      suffices x ∈ I ∧ ∀ J : V, IsInductive J → x ∈ J by simpa [ω]
      exact ⟨h I hI, h⟩
  apply ExistsUnique.intro ω this
  intros; ext; simp_all

name: naturalNumber_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma naturalNumber_induction (P : V → Prop) (hP : ℒₛₑₜ-predicate P)
    (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ x ∈ (ω : V), P x → P (succ x)) : ∀ x ∈ (ω : V), P x
proof:
:= by
  let p : V := {x ∈ ω ; P x}
  have : IsInductive p := by
    constructor
    · simpa [p]
    · intro x hx
      have hx : x ∈ (ω : V) ∧ P x := by simpa [p] using hx
      suffices SetTheory.succ x ∈ ω ∧ P (SetTheory.succ x) by simpa [p]
      refine ⟨ω_succ_closed hx.1, succ x hx.1 hx.2⟩
  have : ω ⊆ p := this.ω_subset
  intro x hx
  have : x ∈ (ω : V) ∧ P x := by simpa [p] using this x hx
  exact this.2

name: foundation
statement: lemma foundation : ∀ x : V, [IsNonempty x] → ∃ y ∈ x, ∀ z ∈ x, z ∉ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa [models_iff, Axiom.foundation] using Theory.models V 𝗭 Zermelo.axiom_of_foundation

name: foundation'
statement: lemma foundation' (x : V) [IsNonempty x] : ∃ y ∈ x, x ∩ y = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rcases foundation x with ⟨y, hyx, H⟩
  exact ⟨y, hyx, by ext z; simpa using H z⟩

name: mem_asymm

proof:
:= by
  intro hxy hyx
  have : y ∉ x ∨ x ∉ y := by simpa using foundation ({x, y} : V)
  rcases this with (_ | _) <;> simp_all

name: mem_asymm

proof:
:= by

name: replacement_exists_eval
statement:
lemma replacement_exists_eval (φ : SetTheorySemiformula V 2) (X : V) (h : (∀ x : V, ∃! y : V, φ.Eval ![x, y] id)) :
    ∃ Y : V, ∀ y : V, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, φ.Eval ![x, y] id
proof:
:= by
  /- `φ` can have finitely many free variables of type `V`, these are interpreted by `id : V → V` as finitely many parameters in `V`.
  `f` enumerates the parameters of `φ`. -/
  let f := φ.enumerateFVar
  /- While `φ` has free variables of type `V`, `ψ` has free variables of type `ℕ`.
  Since `f` enumerates the parameters, it is intended to be the valuation of the free variables of `ψ`. -/
  let ψ := (Rew.rewriteMap φ.idxOfFVar) ▹ φ

  have whole := by simpa [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_univCl, Axiom.replacementSchema] using Theory.models V 𝗭𝗙 (ZermeloFraenkel.axiom_of_replacement ψ)

  have cond : ∀ x, ∃! y : V, ψ.Eval ![x, y] f := by
    simpa [ψ, f, Semiformula.eval_rewriteMap]

  simpa [ψ, f, Semiformula.eval_rewriteMap, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using whole f cond X

name: replacement_rel_exists
statement:
lemma replacement_rel_exists (X : V) (R : V → V → Prop) (h : ∀ x, ∃! y, R x y) (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    ∃ Y : V, ∀ y, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR with ⟨φ, hR⟩
  
  have hR {x y : V} := by simpa using hR.iff ![x, y]
  have cond : ∀ x : V, ∃! y : V, φ.Eval ![x, y] id := by simpa [← hR] using h
  simpa [hR] using replacement_exists_eval φ X cond

name: replacement_rel_existsUnique
statement:
lemma replacement_rel_existsUnique (X : V) (R : V → V → Prop) (h : ∀ x, ∃! y, R x y) (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    ∃! Y : V, ∀ y : V, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases replacement_rel_exists X R h hR with ⟨s, hs⟩
  apply ExistsUnique.intro s hs
  intro u hu
  ext; simp_all

name: replacement_existsUnique
statement:
lemma replacement_existsUnique (X : V) (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    ∃! Y : V, ∀ y, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, y = F x
proof:
:= by
  let R (x y : V) : Prop := Function.Graph F y x
  have h : ∀ (x : V), ∃! y, R x y := by
    intro x
    simp only [Function.Graph, existsUnique_eq, R]
  exact replacement_rel_existsUnique X R h (by definability)

name: replacement_exists
statement:
lemma replacement_exists (X : V) (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    ∃ Y : V, ∀ y, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, y = F x

name: replacement_rel_existsUnique_of_mem_existsUnique
statement:
lemma replacement_rel_existsUnique_of_mem_existsUnique (X : V) (R : V → V → Prop) (h : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, R x y) (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    ∃! Y : V, ∀ y, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y
proof:
:= by
  /- Proof sketch: Define `R' x y` to hold iff `x ∈ X` and `R x y`, or `x ∉ X` and `y = ∅`.
  Show that `∀ x, ∃! y, R' x y` holds, by case subdivision on whether `x ∈ X` or not.
  Obtain `Y` from replacement.
  Then, for any `y`, we have that `y ∈ Y` iff `∃ x ∈ X, R x y`, iff `∃ x ∈ X, R' x y`.
  -/
  let R' (x y : V) : Prop := x ∈ X ∧ R x y ∨ x ∉ X ∧ y = ∅
  have cond : ∀ x, ∃! y, R' x y := by
    intro x
    refine Classical.byCases (p := x ∈ X) ?_ ?_ <;> (intro hx; simp_all [R'])
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := replacement_rel_exists X R' cond (by definability)
  use Y
  aesop

name: replacement_rel_exists_of_mem_existsUnique
statement:
lemma replacement_rel_exists_of_mem_existsUnique (X : V) (R : V → V → Prop) (h : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, R x y) (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    ∃ Y : V, ∀ y, y ∈ Y ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y

name: replRel_spec
statement:
@[simp] lemma replRel_spec {X y : V} {R : V → V → Prop} {h : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, R x y} (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    y ∈ replRelOverSet X R h hR ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y
proof: := Classical.choose!_spec (replacement_rel_existsUnique_of_mem_existsUnique X R h hR) y

name: repl_spec
statement:
@[simp] lemma repl_spec {X y : V} {F : V → V} (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    y ∈ repl F hF X ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, y = F x

name: replRelOverSet_spec
statement:
@[simp] lemma replRelOverSet_spec {X y : V} {R : V → V → Prop} {h : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, R x y} (hR : ℒₛₑₜ-relation R) :
    y ∈ replRelOverSet X R h ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, R x y
proof: := Classical.choose!_spec (replacement_rel_existsUnique_of_mem_existsUnique X R h hR) y

name: result_defined

proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp [Blueprint.resultDef] at h
    ext y
    simpa [result, c.map_defined.iff] using h y
  · intro h

proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_sUnion_iff]
  refine ⟨{x, y}, ⟨⟨x, y⟩ₖ, h, by simp [kpair]⟩, by simp⟩

statement: lemma mem_domain_iff {R x : V} : x ∈ domain R ↔ ∃ y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R

statement: lemma mem_domain_of_kpair_mem {R x y : V} (h : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R) : x ∈ domain R

statement: @[simp] lemma domain_empty : domain (∅ : V) = ∅

name: domain_prod
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_prod (x y : V) [IsNonempty y] : domain (x ×ˢ y) = x
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  suffices z ∈ x → ∃ x, x ∈ y by simpa [mem_domain_iff]
  intro _
  exact IsNonempty.nonempty

name: domain_subset_of_subset_prod
statement: lemma domain_subset_of_subset_prod {R X Y : V} (h : R ⊆ X ×ˢ Y) : domain R ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have : ∃ y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R := by simpa [mem_domain_iff] using hx
  rcases this with ⟨y, hy⟩
  have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := by simpa using h _ hy
  exact this.1

statement:
@[simp]
lemma domain_union {R₁ R₂ : V} : domain (R₁ ∪ R₂) = domain R₁ ∪ domain R₂
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor <;> (simp_all only [mem_union_iff, mem_domain_iff]; grind)

name: domain_inter_subset
statement: lemma domain_inter_subset {R₁ R₂ : V} : domain (R₁ ∩ R₂) ⊆ domain R₁ ∩ domain R₂
proof:
:= by
  intro p; simp only [mem_domain_iff, mem_inter_iff]; grind

statement: @[simp, grind .] lemma domain_insert {x y R : V} : domain (insert (⟨x, y⟩ₖ) R) = insert x (domain R)
proof:
:= by
  ext z; simp only [mem_domain_iff, mem_insert, kpair_iff]; grind

proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_sUnion_iff]
  refine ⟨{x, y}, ⟨⟨x, y⟩ₖ, h, by simp [kpair]⟩, by simp⟩

statement: lemma mem_range_of_kpair_mem {R x y : V} (h : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R) : y ∈ range R

statement: @[simp] lemma range_empty : range (∅ : V) = ∅

statement: @[simp] lemma range_prod (x y : V) [IsNonempty x] : range (x ×ˢ y) = y
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  suffices z ∈ y → ∃ v, v ∈ x by simpa [mem_range_iff]
  intro _
  exact IsNonempty.nonempty

name: range_subset_of_subset_prod
statement: lemma range_subset_of_subset_prod {R X Y : V} (h : R ⊆ X ×ˢ Y) : range R ⊆ Y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : ∃ x, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R := by simpa [mem_range_iff] using hy
  rcases this with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := by simpa using h _ hx
  exact this.2

name: range_union
statement:
@[simp]
lemma range_union {R₁ R₂ : V} : range (R₁ ∪ R₂) = range R₁ ∪ range R₂
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor <;> (simp_all only [mem_union_iff, mem_range_iff]; grind)

name: range_inter_subset
statement: lemma range_inter_subset {R₁ R₂ : V} : range (R₁ ∩ R₂) ⊆ range R₁ ∩ range R₂
proof:
:= by
  intro p; simp only [mem_range_iff, mem_inter_iff]; grind

statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma range_insert {x y R : V} : range (insert (⟨x, y⟩ₖ) R) = insert y (range R)

:= by
  ext z; simp only [mem_range_iff, mem_insert, kpair_iff]; grind

statement: lemma function_def {Y X : V} : Y ^ X = function Y X

name: mem_function_iff
statement: lemma mem_function_iff {f Y X : V} : f ∈ Y ^ X ↔ f ⊆ X ×ˢ Y ∧ ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f

name: mem_function.intro
statement: lemma mem_function.intro {f X Y : V} (prod : f ⊆ X ×ˢ Y) (total : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f) : f ∈ Y ^ X

name: subset_prod_of_mem_function
statement: lemma subset_prod_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : f ⊆ X ×ˢ Y

name: mem_of_mem_functions
statement: lemma mem_of_mem_functions {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) (hx : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f) : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using subset_prod_of_mem_function h _ hx

name: function_subset_power_prod
statement: lemma function_subset_power_prod (X Y : V) : Y ^ X ⊆ ℘ (X ×ˢ Y)
proof: := fun f hf ↦ by simpa using subset_prod_of_mem_function hf

name: exists_unique_of_mem_function
statement: lemma exists_unique_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃! y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f

name: exists_of_mem_function
statement: lemma exists_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ Y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases (exists_unique_of_mem_function h x hx).exists with ⟨y, hy⟩
  have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := mem_of_mem_functions h hy
  exact ⟨y, this.2, hy⟩

name: domain_eq_of_mem_function
statement: lemma domain_eq_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : domain f = X
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  suffices (∃ y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f) ↔ x ∈ X by simpa [mem_domain_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hxy⟩
    have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := mem_of_mem_functions h hxy
    exact this.1
  · intro hx
    rcases exists_of_mem_function h x hx with ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy.2⟩

name: range_subset_of_mem_function
statement: lemma range_subset_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : range f ⊆ Y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have : ∃ x, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f := by simpa [mem_range_iff] using hy
  rcases this with ⟨x, hxy⟩
  have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := mem_of_mem_functions h hxy
  exact this.2

name: mem_function_range_of_mem_function
statement: lemma mem_function_range_of_mem_function {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : f ∈ range f ^ X
proof:
:= by
  have : f ⊆ X ×ˢ range f := by
    intro p hp
    have : ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ Y, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ := by
      simpa [mem_prod_iff] using subset_prod_of_mem_function h _ hp
    rcases this with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa [hx, mem_range_iff] using ⟨x, hp⟩
  apply mem_function.intro this
  intro x hx
  rcases exists_unique_of_mem_function h x hx |>.exists with ⟨y, hf⟩
  apply ExistsUnique.intro y hf
  intro y' hf'
  have : y' = y := exists_unique_of_mem_function h x hx |>.unique hf' hf
  assumption

name: mem_function_of_mem_function_of_subset
statement: lemma mem_function_of_mem_function_of_subset {f X Y₁ Y₂ : V} (h : f ∈ Y₁ ^ X) (hY : Y₁ ⊆ Y₂) : f ∈ Y₂ ^ X
proof:
:= by
  have : f ⊆ X ×ˢ Y₂ := calc
    f ⊆ X ×ˢ Y₁ := subset_prod_of_mem_function h
    _ ⊆ X ×ˢ Y₂ := prod_subset_prod_of_subset (by rfl) hY
  apply mem_function.intro this
  intro x hx
  rcases exists_unique_of_mem_function h x hx |>.exists with ⟨y, hf⟩
  apply ExistsUnique.intro y hf
  intro y' hf'
  have : y' = y := exists_unique_of_mem_function h x hx |>.unique hf' hf
  assumption

name: function_subset_function_of_subset
statement: lemma function_subset_function_of_subset {Y₁ Y₂ : V} (hY : Y₁ ⊆ Y₂) (X : V) : Y₁ ^ X ⊆ Y₂ ^ X

name: empty_function_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma empty_function_empty : (∅ : V) ^ (∅ : V) = {∅}

name: isFunction_def
statement: lemma isFunction_def {f : V} : IsFunction f ↔ ∃ X Y : V, f ∈ Y ^ X

name: isFunction_iff
statement: lemma isFunction_iff {f : V} : IsFunction f ↔ f ∈ range f ^ domain f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨X, Y, hf⟩
    simpa [domain_eq_of_mem_function hf] using mem_function_range_of_mem_function hf
  · intro h
    exact ⟨_, _, h⟩

name: of_mem
statement: lemma of_mem {f X Y : V} (h : f ∈ Y ^ X) : IsFunction f

name: mem_function
statement: lemma mem_function (f : V) [hf : IsFunction f] : f ∈ range f ^ domain f

name: mem_eq_kpair
statement: lemma mem_eq_kpair {f : V} [hf : IsFunction f] {p : V} (hpf : p ∈ f) : ∃ x y, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨X, Y, hfXY⟩
  have hsubset := (mem_function_iff.mp hfXY).1
  apply hsubset at hpf
  simp only [mem_prod_iff] at hpf
  rcases hpf with ⟨x, hxX, y, hyY, hpxy⟩
  exact ⟨x, y, hpxy⟩

name: ofSubset
statement: @[grind ->] lemma ofSubset (f g : V) [hf : IsFunction f] : g ⊆ f → IsFunction g
proof:
:= by
  intro hgf
  apply isFunction_iff.mpr
  apply mem_function.intro
  · intro p hp
    have hpf : p ∈ f := hgf _ hp
    rcases show ∃ x ∈ domain f, ∃ y ∈ range f, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ from by
        simpa [mem_prod_iff] using subset_prod_of_mem_function hf.mem_function _ hpf with
      ⟨x, -, y, -, rfl⟩
    have hxg : x ∈ domain g := mem_domain_of_kpair_mem hp
    have hyg : y ∈ range g := mem_range_of_kpair_mem hp
    simpa [mem_prod_iff] using And.intro hxg hyg
  · intro x hx
    rcases mem_domain_iff.mp hx with ⟨y, hxy⟩
    refine ExistsUnique.intro y hxy ?_
    intro y' hxy'
    have hyf : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f := hgf _ hxy
    have hy'f : ⟨x, y'⟩ₖ ∈ f := hgf _ hxy'
    have hux : ∃! z, ⟨x, z⟩ₖ ∈ f := exists_unique_of_mem_function hf.mem_function x (mem_domain_of_kpair_mem hyf)
    exact hux.unique hy'f hyf

name: unique
statement: lemma unique {f : V} [hf : IsFunction f] {x y₁ y₂} (h₁ : ⟨x, y₁⟩ₖ ∈ f) (h₂ : ⟨x, y₂⟩ₖ ∈ f) : y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃! y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f := exists_unique_of_mem_function (isFunction_iff.mp hf) x (mem_domain_of_kpair_mem h₁)
  exact this.unique h₁ h₂

name: insert
statement: protected theorem insert (f x y : V) (hx : x ∉ domain f) [hf : IsFunction f] : IsFunction (insert ⟨x, y⟩ₖ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨insert x (domain f), insert y (range f), ?_⟩
  apply mem_function.intro
  · have : f ⊆ domain f ×ˢ range f := subset_prod_of_mem_function hf.mem_function
    exact insert_kpair_subset_insert_prod_insert_of_subset_prod this x y
  · intro z hz
    rcases show z = x ∨ z ∈ domain f by simpa using hz with (rfl | hz)
    · apply ExistsUnique.intro y (by simp)
      rintro y' H'
      rcases show y' = y ∨ ⟨z, y'⟩ₖ ∈ f by simpa using H' with (rfl | H')
      · rfl
      have : z ∈ domain f := mem_domain_of_kpair_mem H'
      contradiction
    · rcases mem_domain_iff.mp hz with ⟨v, hzv⟩
      have : v ∈ range f := mem_range_of_kpair_mem hzv
      apply ExistsUnique.intro v (by simp [hzv])
      rintro w Hw
      rcases show z = x ∧ w = y ∨ ⟨z, w⟩ₖ ∈ f by simpa using Hw with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | Hw)
      · have : z ∈ domain f := mem_domain_of_kpair_mem hzv
        contradiction
      exact hf.unique Hw hzv

name: function_eq_of_subset
statement: lemma function_eq_of_subset {X Y f g : V} (hf : f ∈ Y ^ X) (hg : g ∈ Y ^ X) (h : f ⊆ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFunction f := IsFunction.of_mem hf
  have : IsFunction g := IsFunction.of_mem hg
  apply subset_antisymm h
  intro p hp
  rcases show ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ Y, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ from by
    simpa [mem_prod_iff] using subset_prod_of_mem_function hg _ hp with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  rcases show ∃ y' ∈ Y, ⟨x, y'⟩ₖ ∈ f from exists_of_mem_function hf x hx with ⟨y', hy', Hf⟩
  have : ⟨x, y'⟩ₖ ∈ g := h _ Hf
  rcases show y = y' from IsFunction.unique hp (h _ Hf)
  assumption

name: function_ext
statement:
lemma function_ext {X Y f g : V} (hf : f ∈ Y ^ X) (hg : g ∈ Y ^ X)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ Y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f → ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply function_eq_of_subset hf hg
  intro p hp
  rcases show ∃ x ∈ X, ∃ y ∈ Y, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ from by
    simpa [mem_prod_iff] using subset_prod_of_mem_function hf _ hp with ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact h x hx y hy hp

name: two_val_function_mem_iff_not
statement: @[grind <=] lemma two_val_function_mem_iff_not {X f x : V} (hf : f ∈ (2 ^ X : V)) (hx : x ∈ X) : ⟨x, 0⟩ₖ ∈ f ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∉ f
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFunction f := IsFunction.of_mem hf
  constructor
  · intro h0 h1
    have : (0 : V) = 1 := IsFunction.unique h0 h1
    simp_all
  · intro h1
    rcases exists_of_mem_function hf x hx with ⟨i, hi, hf⟩
    rcases show i = 0 ∨ i = 1 by simpa using hi with (rfl | rfl)
    · assumption
    · contradiction

name: Injective.empty
statement: lemma Injective.empty : Injective (∅ : V)
proof: := fun x₁ x₂ y ↦ by simp

name: mem_identity_iff
statement: lemma mem_identity_iff {X p : V} : p ∈ identity X ↔ ∃ x ∈ X, p = ⟨x, x⟩ₖ
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x ∈ X, p = ⟨x, x⟩ₖ → p ∈ X ×ˢ X by simpa [identity]
  rintro x hx rfl
  simp [hx]

name: kpair_mem_identity_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma kpair_mem_identity_iff {X x : V} : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ identity X ↔ x ∈ X ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_identity_iff, kpair_iff, exists_eq_right_right', and_congr_left_iff]
  grind

name: identity_mem_function
statement: @[simp] lemma identity_mem_function (X : V) : identity X ∈ X ^ X
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_function.intro ?_ ?_
  · intro p hp
    have : ∃ x ∈ X, p = ⟨x, x⟩ₖ := by simpa [mem_identity_iff] using hp
    rcases this with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp_all
  · intro x hx
    apply ExistsUnique.intro x (by simp [hx])
    simp only [kpair_mem_identity_iff, and_imp]
    grind

name: identity_injective
statement: @[simp] lemma identity_injective (X : V) : Injective (identity X)
proof:
:= by
  intro x₁ x₂ y h₁ h₂
  rcases show x₁ ∈ X ∧ x₁ = y by simpa using h₁ with ⟨hx₁, rfl⟩
  rcases show x₂ ∈ X ∧ x₂ = x₁ by simpa using h₂ with ⟨hx₂, rfl⟩
  rfl

name: mem_compose_iff
statement: lemma mem_compose_iff {R S p : V} : p ∈ compose R S ↔ ∃ x y z, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R ∧ ⟨y, z⟩ₖ ∈ S ∧ p = ⟨x, z⟩ₖ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compose, exists_and_left, mem_sep_iff, and_iff_right_iff_imp, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  rintro x y hxy z hyz rfl
  simp [mem_domain_of_kpair_mem hxy, mem_range_of_kpair_mem hyz]

name: kpair_mem_compose_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma kpair_mem_compose_iff {R S x z : V} :
    ⟨x, z⟩ₖ ∈ compose R S ↔ ∃ y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R ∧ ⟨y, z⟩ₖ ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_compose_iff, kpair_iff, exists_and_left, exists_eq_right_right']
  grind

name: compose_subset_prod
statement: lemma compose_subset_prod {X Y Z R S : V} (hR : R ⊆ X ×ˢ Y) (hS : S ⊆ Y ×ˢ Z) : compose R S ⊆ X ×ˢ Z
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases mem_compose_iff.mp hp with ⟨x, y, z, hxy, hyz, rfl⟩
  have : x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ Y := by simpa using hR _ hxy
  have : y ∈ Y ∧ z ∈ Z := by simpa using hS _ hyz
  simp_all

name: compose_function
statement: lemma compose_function {X Y Z f g : V} (hf : f ∈ Y ^ X) (hg : g ∈ Z ^ Y) : compose f g ∈ Z ^ X
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFunction f := IsFunction.of_mem hf
  have : IsFunction g := IsFunction.of_mem hg
  apply mem_function.intro ?_ ?_
  · exact compose_subset_prod (subset_prod_of_mem_function hf) (subset_prod_of_mem_function hg)
  · intro x hx
    have : ∃ y ∈ Y, ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f := exists_of_mem_function hf x hx
    rcases this with ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have : ∃ z ∈ Z, ⟨y, z⟩ₖ ∈ g := exists_of_mem_function hg y hy
    rcases this with ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩
    apply ExistsUnique.intro z (by simpa using ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩)
    intro z' hz'
    have : ∃ y', ⟨x, y'⟩ₖ ∈ f ∧ ⟨y', z'⟩ₖ ∈ g := by simpa using hz'
    rcases this with ⟨y', hxy', hy'z'⟩
    rcases IsFunction.unique hxy hxy'
    rcases IsFunction.unique hyz hy'z'
    rfl

name: compose_injective
statement: lemma compose_injective {R S : V} (hR : Injective R) (hS : Injective S) : Injective (compose R S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x₁ x₂ z h₁ h₂
  have : ∃ y₁, ⟨x₁, y₁⟩ₖ ∈ R ∧ ⟨y₁, z⟩ₖ ∈ S := by simpa using h₁
  rcases this with ⟨y₁, hx₁y₁, hy₁z⟩
  have : ∃ y₂, ⟨x₂, y₂⟩ₖ ∈ R ∧ ⟨y₂, z⟩ₖ ∈ S := by simpa using h₂
  rcases this with ⟨y₂, hx₂y₂, hy₂z⟩
  have : y₁ = y₂ := hS y₁ y₂ z hy₁z hy₂z
  rcases this
  exact hR x₁ x₂ y₁ hx₁y₁ hx₂y₂

name: value_mem_range
statement: lemma value_mem_range {f x : V} {X Y : V} (hf : f ∈ Y ^ X) (hx : x ∈ X) : f ‘ x ∈ range f
proof:
:= by
  simp_all only [mem_function_iff, value, mem_range_iff]
  obtain ⟨hfleft, hfright⟩ := hf
  specialize hfright x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ExistsUnique.exists hfright
  have h1 {w : V} : ⟨x, w⟩ₖ ∈ f → w = y := by
    intro h; exact hfright.unique h hy
  have h2 : y = {z ∈ ⋃ˢ range f ; ∃ y, z ∈ y ∧ ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ f} := by
    ext z
    simp only [mem_sep_iff, mem_sUnion_iff, mem_range_iff]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> grind
  grind

name: domain_restrict_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_restrict_eq (R A : V) : domain (R ↾ A) = domain R ∩ A
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  apply Iff.intro <;> intro h
  · simp_all only [mem_domain_iff, mem_inter_iff, restrict]
    aesop
  · simp_all only [mem_domain_iff, mem_inter_iff, restrict]
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hzA⟩ := h
    use y
    simp_all only [kpair_mem_iff, true_and, mem_range_iff]
    use z

name: mem_restrict_iff
statement:
lemma mem_restrict_iff {R A p : V} :
    p ∈ (R ↾ A) ↔ p ∈ R ∧ ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases show p ∈ R ∧ p ∈ A ×ˢ range R by simpa [restrict] using hp with ⟨hpR, hpP⟩
    rcases show ∃ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ range R, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ by simpa [mem_prod_iff] using hpP with
      ⟨x, hxA, y, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hpR, x, hxA, y, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpR, x, hxA, y, rfl⟩
    have hyR : y ∈ range R := mem_range_of_kpair_mem hpR
    have hpP : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ A ×ˢ range R := by simpa [mem_prod_iff] using ⟨hxA, hyR⟩
    simpa [restrict] using And.intro hpR hpP

name: restrict_subset
statement: @[simp] lemma restrict_subset (f A : V) : f ↾ A ⊆ f
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact (mem_restrict_iff.mp hp).1

name: IsFunction.restrict_eq_self
statement: lemma IsFunction.restrict_eq_self (f A : V) [hf : IsFunction f] (hA : domain f ⊆ A) : f ↾ A = f
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    exact (mem_restrict_iff.mp hp).1
  · intro p hp
    rcases show ∃ x ∈ domain f, ∃ y ∈ range f, p = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ from by
        simpa [mem_prod_iff] using subset_prod_of_mem_function hf.mem_function p hp with
      ⟨x, hxd, y, -, rfl⟩
    exact mem_restrict_iff.mpr ⟨hp, x, hA x hxd, y, rfl⟩

name: kpair_mem_restrict_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma kpair_mem_restrict_iff {R A x y : V} :
    ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ (R ↾ A) ↔ ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∈ R ∧ x ∈ A

name: restrict_restrict_eq_restrict_inter
statement: lemma restrict_restrict_eq_restrict_inter (R A B : V) : (R ↾ A) ↾ B = R ↾ (A ∩ B)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [mem_restrict_iff, mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hpR, x, hxA, y, rfl⟩, x', hx'B, y', hxy⟩
    rcases kpair_inj hxy with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hpR, x, ⟨hxA, hx'B⟩, y, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hpR, x, hxAB, y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hpR, x, hxAB.1, y, rfl⟩, x, hxAB.2, y, rfl⟩

name: restrict_restrict_of_subset
statement: @[simp] lemma restrict_restrict_of_subset {R A B : V} (h : B ⊆ A) : (R ↾ A) ↾ B = R ↾ B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [inter_eq_right_of_subset h] using restrict_restrict_eq_restrict_inter R A B

name: restrict_insert_kpair_eq_restrict_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma restrict_insert_kpair_eq_restrict_of_not_mem
    {f x y A : V} (hxA : x ∉ A) :
    (insert ⟨x, y⟩ₖ f) ↾ A = f ↾ A
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases mem_restrict_iff.mp hp with ⟨hp', a, haA, b, rfl⟩
    rcases show ⟨a, b⟩ₖ = ⟨x, y⟩ₖ ∨ ⟨a, b⟩ₖ ∈ f by simpa using hp' with (hxy | hf)
    · rcases kpair_inj hxy with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (hxA haA).elim
    · exact mem_restrict_iff.mpr ⟨hf, a, haA, b, rfl⟩
  · intro hp
    rcases mem_restrict_iff.mp hp with ⟨hf, a, haA, b, rfl⟩
    exact mem_restrict_iff.mpr ⟨by simp [hf], a, haA, b, rfl⟩

name: cardLE_of_subset
statement: lemma cardLE_of_subset {X Y : V} (h : X ⊆ Y) : X ≤# Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨identity X, mem_function_of_mem_function_of_subset (identity_mem_function X) h, by simp⟩

name: cardLE_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma cardLE_empty (X : V) : ∅ ≤# X

name: CardLE.refl
statement: @[simp, refl] lemma CardLE.refl (X : V) : X ≤# X

name: CardLE.trans
statement: @[trans] lemma CardLE.trans {X Y Z : V} : X ≤# Y → Y ≤# Z → X ≤# Z
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨f, hf, f_inj⟩
  rintro ⟨g, hg, g_inj⟩
  refine ⟨compose f g, compose_function hf hg, compose_injective f_inj g_inj⟩

name: CardEQ.le
statement: lemma CardEQ.le {X Y : V} (h : X ≋ Y) : X ≤# Y

name: CardEQ.ge
statement: lemma CardEQ.ge {X Y : V} (h : X ≋ Y) : Y ≤# X

name: CardEQ.refl
statement: @[simp, refl] lemma CardEQ.refl (X : V) : X ≋ X

name: CardEQ.symm
statement: @[symm] lemma CardEQ.symm {X Y : V} : X ≋ Y → Y ≋ X

name: CardEQ.trans
statement: @[trans] lemma CardEQ.trans {X Y Z : V} : X ≋ Y → Y ≋ Z → X ≋ Z
proof:
:= fun eXY eYZ ↦
  ⟨eXY.le.trans eYZ.le, eYZ.ge.trans eXY.ge⟩

name: cardLT_power
statement: lemma cardLT_power (X : V) : X <# ℘ X
proof:
:= by
  have : X ≤# ℘ X := by
    let F : V := {p ∈ X ×ˢ ℘ X ; ∃ x ∈ X, p = ⟨x, {x}⟩ₖ}
    have : F ∈ ℘ X ^ X := by
      apply mem_function.intro
      · simp [F]
      · intro x hx
        apply ExistsUnique.intro {x} (by simp [F, hx])
        intro y hy
        have : y ⊆ X ∧ y = {x} := by simpa [hx, F] using hy
        simp [this]
    have : Injective F := by
      intro x₁ x₂ s h₁ h₂
      rcases show (x₁ ∈ X ∧ s ⊆ X) ∧ x₁ ∈ X ∧ s = {x₁} by simpa [F] using h₁ with ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
      have : (x₂ ∈ X ∧ x₁ ∈ X) ∧ x₁ ∈ X ∧ x₂ = x₁ := by simpa [F] using h₂
      simp [this.2.2]
    refine ⟨F, by assumption, by assumption⟩
  have : ¬℘ X ≤# X := by
    rintro ⟨F, hF, injF⟩
    have : IsFunction F := IsFunction.of_mem hF
    let D : V := {x ∈ X ; ∃ s ∈ ℘ X, ⟨s, x⟩ₖ ∈ F ∧ x ∉ s}
    have : ∃ d ∈ X, ⟨D, d⟩ₖ ∈ F := exists_of_mem_function hF D (by simp [D])
    rcases this with ⟨d, hd, Hd⟩
    have : d ∈ D ↔ d ∉ D := calc
      d ∈ D ↔ ∃ s ⊆ X, ⟨s, d⟩ₖ ∈ F ∧ d ∉ s := by simp [hd, D]
      _     ↔ d ∉ D := ?_
    · grind
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨S, hS, hSF, hdS⟩
      rcases show D = S from injF _ _ _ Hd hSF
      assumption
    · intro h
      refine ⟨D, by simpa [hd] using mem_of_mem_functions hF Hd, Hd, h⟩
  refine ⟨by assumption, by assumption⟩

name: two_pow_cardEQ_power
statement: lemma two_pow_cardEQ_power (X : V) : 2 ^ X ≋ ℘ X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · let F : V := {p ∈ (2 ^ X) ×ˢ ℘ X ; ∃ f s, p = ⟨f, s⟩ₖ ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f}
    refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply mem_function.intro
      · simp [F]
      · intro f hf
        let s : V := {x ∈ X ; ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f}
        have ss_s : s ⊆ X := by simp [s]
        have mem_s : ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f := by
          simp only [mem_sep_iff, and_iff_right_iff_imp, s]
          intro x hx
          exact mem_of_mem_functions hf hx |>.1
        apply ExistsUnique.intro s ?_ ?_
        · simp [F, hf, ss_s, mem_s]
        · intro t ht
          ext x
          have ht : (f ∈ ((2 : V) ^ X) ∧ t ⊆ X) ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ t ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f := by simpa [F] using ht
          simp [ht, mem_s]
    · intro f₁ f₂ s h₁ h₂
      have : (f₁ ∈ (2 ^ X : V) ∧ s ⊆ X) ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f₁ := by simpa [F] using h₁
      rcases this with ⟨⟨f₁func, hs⟩, H₁⟩
      have : (f₂ ∈ (2 ^ X : V) ∧ s ⊆ X) ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f₂ := by simpa [F] using h₂
      rcases this with ⟨⟨f₂func, _⟩, H₂⟩
      apply function_ext f₁func f₂func
      intro x hx i hi
      rcases show i = 0 ∨ i = 1 by simpa using hi with (rfl | rfl)
      · contrapose
        suffices ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f₂ → ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f₁ by grind
        grind
      · grind
  · let F : V := {p ∈ ℘ X ×ˢ (2 ^ X) ; ∃ f s, p = ⟨s, f⟩ₖ ∧ ∀ x, ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f ↔ x ∈ s}
    refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply mem_function.intro
      · simp [F]
      · intro s hs
        have hs : s ⊆ X := by simpa using hs
        let f : V := {p ∈ X ×ˢ 2 ; ∃ x, (x ∈ s → p = ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ) ∧ (x ∉ s → p = ⟨x, 0⟩ₖ)}
        have kp1_mem_f : ∀ x, ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f ↔ x ∈ s := by
          intro x
          have : x ∈ s → x ∈ X := fun hx ↦ hs _ hx
          simp only [mem_sep_iff, kpair_mem_iff, mem_two_iff, one_ne_zero, or_true, and_true,
            kpair_iff, and_false, imp_false, not_not, f]; grind
        have f_func : f ∈ (2 ^ X : V) := by
          apply mem_function.intro (by simp [f])
          intro x hx
          by_cases hxS : x ∈ s
          · apply ExistsUnique.intro 1
            · simp only [mem_sep_iff, kpair_mem_iff, hx, mem_two_iff, one_ne_zero, or_true, and_self,
              kpair_iff, and_true, and_false, imp_false, not_not, true_and, f]; grind
            · intro i hi
              simp [f, hx] at hi
              grind only
          · apply ExistsUnique.intro 0
            · simp only [mem_sep_iff, kpair_mem_iff, hx, mem_two_iff, zero_ne_one, or_false,
              and_self, kpair_iff, and_false, imp_false, and_true, true_and, f]; grind
            · intro i hi
              simp [f, hx] at hi
              grind only
        apply ExistsUnique.intro f ?_ ?_
        · simp [F, hs, kp1_mem_f, f_func]
        · intro g hg
          have : (s ⊆ X ∧ g ∈ (2 ^ X : V)) ∧ ∀ x, ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ g ↔ x ∈ s := by simpa [F] using hg
          rcases this with ⟨⟨_, g_func⟩, Hg⟩
          apply function_ext g_func f_func
          intro x hx i hi
          rcases show i = 0 ∨ i = 1 by simpa using hi with (rfl | rfl)
          · suffices ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f → ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ g by grind
            grind
          · grind
    · intro s₁ s₂ f h₁ h₂
      have : (s₁ ⊆ X ∧ f ∈ (2 ^ X : V)) ∧ ∀ x, ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f ↔ x ∈ s₁ := by simpa [F] using h₁
      have : (s₂ ⊆ X ∧ f ∈ (2 ^ X : V)) ∧ ∀ x, ⟨x, 1⟩ₖ ∈ f ↔ x ∈ s₂ := by simpa [F] using h₂
      ext z; grind

name: isTransitive_def
statement: lemma isTransitive_def {x : V} : IsTransitive x ↔ ∀ y ∈ x, y ⊆ x

name: mem_trans
statement: lemma mem_trans {x y z : V} (H : IsTransitive z) (hxy : x ∈ y) (hyz : y ∈ z) : x ∈ z

name: succ
statement: lemma succ {x : V} (h : IsTransitive x) : IsTransitive (succ x)
proof:
:= ⟨by
  intro y hy
  rcases show y = x ∨ y ∈ x by simpa [mem_succ_iff] using hy with (rfl | hy)
  · simp
  · exact subset_trans (h.transitive y hy) (by simp)⟩

name: nat
statement: @[simp] lemma nat : x ∈ (ω : V) → IsTransitive x
proof:
:= by
  apply naturalNumber_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simp [zero_def]
  case succ =>
    intro x hx ih
    exact ih.succ

name: union
statement: lemma union {x y : V} [hx : IsTransitive x] [hy : IsTransitive y] : IsTransitive (x ∪ y)
proof:
:= ⟨by
  simp only [mem_union_iff]
  rintro z (hzx | hzy)
  · exact subset_trans (hx.transitive z hzx) (by simp)
  · exact subset_trans (hy.transitive z hzy) (by simp)⟩

name: sUnion
statement: lemma sUnion {X : V} (h : ∀ x ∈ X, IsTransitive x) : IsTransitive (⋃ˢ X)
proof:
:= ⟨by
  intro x hx
  have : ∃ y ∈ X, x ∈ y := by simpa [mem_sUnion_iff] using hx
  rcases this with ⟨y, hyX, hxy⟩
  exact subset_trans ((h y hyX).transitive x hxy) (subset_sUnion_of_mem hyX)⟩

name: sInter
statement: lemma sInter {X : V} (h : ∀ x ∈ X, IsTransitive x) : IsTransitive (⋂ˢ X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_isNonempty X with (rfl | hX)
  · simp
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro y hy
  apply subset_sInter_iff_of_nonempty.mpr
  intro z hzX
  have : y ∈ z := mem_sInter_iff_of_nonempty.mp hy z hzX
  exact (h z hzX).transitive y this

name: IsTransitive.
statement: @[simp] lemma IsTransitive.ω : IsTransitive (ω : V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction x using naturalNumber_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simp [zero_def]
  case succ x hx' ih =>
    intro z hz
    rcases show z = x ∨ z ∈ x by simpa using hz with (rfl | hz)
    · exact hx'
    · exact ih hx' z hz

name: isOrdinal_iff
statement:
lemma isOrdinal_iff {x : V} :
    IsOrdinal x ↔ IsTransitive x ∧ ∀ y ∈ x, ∀ z ∈ x, y ∈ z ∨ y = z ∨ z ∈ y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨⟨h.transitive⟩, h.trichotomy⟩, fun h ↦ { transitive := h.1.transitive, trichotomy := h.2 }⟩

name: of_mem
statement:
lemma of_mem [h : IsOrdinal α] (lt : β ∈ α) : IsOrdinal β where
  transitive γ hzy δ hvz
proof:
:= by
    have hzx : γ ∈ α := h.transitive _ lt _ hzy
    have hvx : δ ∈ α := h.transitive _ hzx _ hvz
    rcases show β ∈ δ ∨ β = δ ∨ δ ∈ β from h.trichotomy _ lt _ hvx with (hzv | rfl | hvz)
    · have : β ∉ δ := mem_asymm₃ hvz hzy
      contradiction
    · have : γ ∉ β := mem_asymm hvz
      contradiction
    · assumption
  trichotomy γ hzy δ hvy := by
    have hzx : γ ∈ α := h.transitive _ lt _ hzy
    have hvx : δ ∈ α := h.transitive _ lt _ hvy
    exact h.trichotomy γ hzx δ hvx

name: nat
statement: protected lemma nat : α ∈ (ω : V) → IsOrdinal (α : V)
proof:
:= by
  apply naturalNumber_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp [zero_def]
  case succ => intro α hα H; exact H.succ

name: mem_of_ssubset
statement: lemma mem_of_ssubset [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] : α ⊊ β → α ∈ β
proof:
:= by
  intro ss
  have : ∃ γ, (γ ∈ β ∧ γ ∉ α) ∧ ∀ δ ∈ β, δ ∉ α → δ ∉ γ := by
    have : IsNonempty (β \ α) := (isNonempty_sdiff_of_ssubset ss)
    simpa using foundation (β \ α)
  rcases this with ⟨γ, ⟨hγβ, hγα⟩, Hγ⟩
  have Hγα : γ ⊆ α := by
    intro ξ hξγ
    have hξβ : ξ ∈ β := hβ.transitive γ hγβ _ hξγ
    by_contra! hξα
    have : ξ ∉ γ := Hγ ξ hξβ hξα
    contradiction
  have Hαγ : α ⊆ γ := by
    intro ξ hξα
    have : ξ ∈ β := ss.subset _ hξα
    have : ξ ∈ γ ∨ (ξ = γ ∨ γ ∈ ξ) := hβ.trichotomy ξ this γ hγβ
    rcases this with (hξγ | C)
    · exact hξγ
    · have : γ ∈ α := by
        rcases C with (rfl | h)
        · assumption
        · exact hα.transitive _ hξα _ h
      contradiction
  have : α = γ := subset_antisymm Hαγ Hγα
  rcases this
  assumption

name: ssubset_iff
statement: @[grind =] lemma ssubset_iff [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] : α ⊊ β ↔ α ∈ β

name: subset_iff
statement: @[grind =] lemma subset_iff [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] : α ⊆ β ↔ α = β ∨ α ∈ β
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ss
    by_cases eq : α = β
    · simp_all
    · right; exact mem_of_ssubset ⟨ss, eq⟩
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · simp
    · exact hβ.transitive α h

name: mem_iff_subset_and_not_subset
statement:
@[grind =_] lemma mem_iff_subset_and_not_subset [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] :
    α ∈ β ↔ α ⊆ β ∧ ¬β ⊆ α
proof:
:= calc
  α ∈ β ↔ α ⊊ β          := ssubset_iff.symm
  _     ↔ α ⊆ β ∧ α ≠ β  := by rfl
  _     ↔ α ⊆ β ∧ ¬β ⊆ α := by grind

name: subset_or_supset
statement: lemma subset_or_supset [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] : α ⊆ β ∨ β ⊆ α
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! Aαβ
  let C : V := {α' ∈ succ α ; ∃ β, IsOrdinal β ∧ ¬α' ⊆ β ∧ ¬β ⊆ α'}
  have hαC : α ∈ C := by
    simp only [mem_sep_iff, mem_succ_iff, mem_irrefl, or_false, true_and, C]
    exact ⟨β, hβ, Aαβ⟩
  have : ∃ α₀, (α₀ ∈ succ α ∧ ∃ β, IsOrdinal β ∧ ¬α₀ ⊆ β ∧ ¬β ⊆ α₀) ∧ ∀ γ ∈ C, γ ∉ α₀ := by
    have : IsNonempty C := ⟨α, hαC⟩
    simpa [C] using foundation C
  rcases this with ⟨α₀, ⟨hα₀sα, β₀, ordβ₀, Hα₀β₀⟩, Hα₀⟩
  have ordα₀ : IsOrdinal α₀ := by
    rcases mem_succ_iff.mp hα₀sα with (rfl | hα₀α)
    · assumption
    · exact hα.of_mem hα₀α
  let γ₀ := α₀ ∪ β₀
  have : IsOrdinal γ₀ := isOrdinal_iff.mpr ⟨IsTransitive.union, by
    intro ξ hξγ₀ ζ hζγ₀
    rcases show ξ ∈ α₀ ∨ ξ ∈ β₀ by simpa [γ₀] using hξγ₀ with (hξα₀ | hξβ₀)
    · have : IsOrdinal ξ := of_mem hξα₀
      rcases show ζ ∈ α₀ ∨ ζ ∈ β₀ by simpa [γ₀] using hζγ₀ with (hζα₀ | hζβ₀)
      · exact ordα₀.trichotomy ξ hξα₀ ζ hζα₀
      · have : IsOrdinal ζ := of_mem hζβ₀
        have : ξ ⊆ ζ ∨ ζ ⊆ ξ := by
          by_contra! A
          have : ξ ∈ C := mem_sep_iff.mpr ⟨hα.succ.transitive α₀ hα₀sα ξ hξα₀, ζ, of_mem hζβ₀, A⟩
          exact Hα₀ ξ this hξα₀
        grind
    · have : IsOrdinal ξ := of_mem hξβ₀
      rcases show ζ ∈ α₀ ∨ ζ ∈ β₀ by simpa [γ₀] using hζγ₀ with (hζα₀ | hζβ₀)
      · have : IsOrdinal ζ := of_mem hζα₀
        have : ξ ⊆ ζ ∨ ζ ⊆ ξ := by
          by_contra! A
          have : ζ ∈ C := mem_sep_iff.mpr ⟨hα.succ.transitive α₀ hα₀sα ζ hζα₀, ξ, inferInstance, by grind⟩
          exact Hα₀ _ this hζα₀
        grind
      · have : ζ ∈ ξ ∨ ζ = ξ ∨ ξ ∈ ζ := ordβ₀.trichotomy ζ hζβ₀ ξ hξβ₀
        grind⟩
  have : γ₀ = α₀ ∨ γ₀ = β₀ := by
    by_contra! A
    have : α₀ ∈ γ₀ := ssubset_iff.mp ⟨by simp [γ₀], by grind⟩
    have hα₀β₀ : α₀ ∈ β₀ := by simpa [γ₀] using this
    have : β₀ ∈ γ₀ := ssubset_iff.mp ⟨by simp [γ₀], by grind⟩
    have hβ₀α₀ : β₀ ∈ α₀ := by simpa [γ₀] using this
    exact mem_asymm hα₀β₀ hβ₀α₀
  rcases this with (e | e)
  · have : β₀ ⊆ α₀ := by simpa [γ₀] using e
    grind
  · have : α₀ ⊆ β₀ := by simpa [γ₀] using e
    grind

name: mem_trichotomy
statement: lemma mem_trichotomy [hα : IsOrdinal α] [hβ : IsOrdinal β] : α ∈ β ∨ α = β ∨ β ∈ α
proof:
:= by
  have : α ⊆ β ∨ β ⊆ α := subset_or_supset α β
  grind

name: of_transitive_of_isOrdinal
statement:
lemma of_transitive_of_isOrdinal (tr : IsTransitive α) (H : ∀ β ∈ α, IsOrdinal β) : IsOrdinal α where
  trichotomy ξ hξα ζ hζα
proof:
:=
    have : IsOrdinal ξ := H ξ hξα
    have : IsOrdinal ζ := H ζ hζα
    mem_trichotomy ξ ζ

name: sUnion
statement: protected lemma sUnion {X : V} (h : ∀ α ∈ X, IsOrdinal α) : IsOrdinal (⋃ˢ X)
proof:
:=
  of_transitive_of_isOrdinal (IsTransitive.sUnion fun α hαX ↦ (h α hαX).toIsTransitive)
    fun β hβ ↦ by
      have : ∃ γ ∈ X, β ∈ γ := by simpa [mem_sUnion_iff] using hβ
      rcases this with ⟨γ, hγX, hβγ⟩
      have : IsOrdinal γ := h γ hγX
      exact of_mem hβγ

name: sInter
statement: protected lemma sInter {X : V} (h : ∀ α ∈ X, IsOrdinal α) : IsOrdinal (⋂ˢ X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_isNonempty X with (rfl | hX)
  · simp
  · apply of_transitive_of_isOrdinal (IsTransitive.sInter fun α hαX ↦ (h α hαX).toIsTransitive)
    rcases hX.nonempty with ⟨α₀, hα₀X⟩
    have : IsOrdinal α₀ := h α₀ hα₀X
    intro α hα
    have : ∀ y ∈ X, α ∈ y := by simpa using hα
    have : α ∈ α₀ := this α₀ hα₀X
    exact of_mem this

name: sInter_mem
statement: lemma sInter_mem {X : V} [IsNonempty X] (h : ∀ α ∈ X, IsOrdinal α) : ⋂ˢ X ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hXX
  have : IsOrdinal (⋂ˢ X) := IsOrdinal.sInter h
  have : ⋂ˢ X ∈ ⋂ˢ X := mem_sInter_iff_of_nonempty.mpr fun α hαX ↦ by
    have : IsOrdinal α := h α hαX
    have : ⋂ˢ X ⊆ α := sInter_subset_of_mem_of_nonempty hαX
    rcases subset_iff.mp this with (rfl | hXα)
    · contradiction
    · assumption
  simp_all

name: empty_mem_iff_nonempty
statement: lemma empty_mem_iff_nonempty [IsOrdinal α] : ∅ ∈ α ↔ IsNonempty α
proof:
:= by
  have : ∅ = α ∨ ∅ ∈ α := subset_iff.mp (show ∅ ⊆ α by simp)
  rcases this with (rfl | h)
  · simp
  · simp only [h, true_iff]
    exact ⟨∅, h⟩

statement: @[simp] lemma succ_val (α : Ordinal V) : α.succ.val = succ α.val

statement: @[simp] lemma lt_succ (α : Ordinal V) : α < α.succ

name: minimal_prop_of_exists_aux
statement:
private lemma minimal_prop_of_exists_aux (H : ∃ β < α, P β) :
    α.minimal P < α ∧ P (α.minimal P) ∧ ∀ ξ < α, P ξ → α.minimal P ≤ ξ
proof:
:= by
  let X := {x ∈ ↑α ; P x}
  have : IsNonempty X := by
    rcases H with ⟨β, hαβ, Pβ⟩
    exact ⟨β, by simp [X, lt_def.mp hαβ, Pβ]⟩
  have : ⋂ˢ X ∈ X := IsOrdinal.sInter_mem (X := X) fun β hβ ↦ by
    have : β ∈ α.val ∧ P β := by simpa [X] using hβ
    exact IsOrdinal.of_mem this.1
  have : ⋂ˢ X ∈ α.val ∧ P (⋂ˢ X) := by simpa [X] using this
  refine ⟨this.1, by simpa using this.2, ?_⟩
  intro ξ hξα Pξ
  suffices ⋂ˢ X ⊆ ξ from le_def.mpr (by simpa using this)
  apply sInter_subset_of_mem_of_nonempty
  simp [X, Pξ, lt_def.mp hξα]

statement: lemma minimal_lt_of_exists (H : ∃ β < α, P β) : α.minimal P < α

name: minimal_prop_of_exists
statement: lemma minimal_prop_of_exists (H : ∃ β < α, P β) : P (α.minimal P)

name: minimal_le_of_exists_aux
statement: lemma minimal_le_of_exists_aux (H : ∃ β < α, P β) : ∀ ξ < α, P ξ → α.minimal P ≤ ξ

name: minimal_le_of_exists
statement: lemma minimal_le_of_exists (H : ∃ β < α, P β) : ∀ ξ : Ordinal V, P ξ → α.minimal P ≤ ξ
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ Pξ
  rcases show ξ < α ∨ α ≤ ξ from lt_or_ge ξ α with (lt | le)
  · exact minimal_le_of_exists_aux H ξ lt Pξ
  · calc
      α.minimal P hP ≤ α := le_of_lt <| minimal_lt_of_exists H
      _              ≤ ξ := le

name: exists_minimal
statement:
lemma exists_minimal (P : V → Prop) (hP : ℒₛₑₜ-predicate P) (h : ∃ α : Ordinal V, P α) :
    ∃ β : Ordinal V, P β ∧ ∀ ξ : Ordinal V, P ξ → β ≤ ξ
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨α, hα⟩
  have exs : ∃ β < α.succ, P β := ⟨α, by simp, hα⟩
  refine ⟨α.succ.minimal P, Ordinal.minimal_prop_of_exists exs, Ordinal.minimal_le_of_exists exs⟩

name: transfinite_induction
statement:
lemma transfinite_induction (P : V → Prop) (hP : ℒₛₑₜ-predicate P)
    (ih : ∀ α : Ordinal V, (∀ β < α, P β) → P α) : ∀ α : Ordinal V, P α
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! exs
  have : ∃ β : Ordinal V, ¬P ↑β ∧ ∀ (ξ : Ordinal V), ¬P ↑ξ → β ≤ ξ :=
    exists_minimal (fun x ↦ ¬P x) (by definability) exs
  rcases this with ⟨β, Pβ, H⟩
  have : P β := ih β fun ξ hξβ ↦ by
    by_contra! Pξ
    have : β ≤ ξ := H ξ Pξ
    exact not_lt_of_ge this hξβ
  contradiction

name: left_existsUnique
statement: lemma left_existsUnique (x : V) : ∃! s : V, ∀ z, z ∈ s ↔ R z x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ y, ∀ z, z ∈ y ↔ R z x := leftSet x
  rcases this with ⟨y, hy⟩
  apply ExistsUnique.intro y hy
  intro y' hy'
  ext; simp_all

@[simp] lemma liftp_iff {P : α → Prop} {f : UniverseFunctor α} :

proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩

  · intro h
    refine ⟨
      ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' f, small_preimage_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective f.set⟩, ?_⟩
    ext p
    simp; tauto

name: choice_existsUnique
statement:
lemma choice_existsUnique {𝓧 X : Universe}
    (he : empty ∉ 𝓧)
    (pairwise_disjoint : ∀ X ∈ 𝓧, ∀ Y ∈ 𝓧, (∃ z, z ∈ X ∧ z ∈ Y) → X = Y)
    (hX : X ∈ 𝓧) : ∃! x, x ∈ 𝓧.choice ∧ x ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  apply ExistsUnique.intro X.choice₁
  · exact ⟨mem_image.mpr ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩,
      choice₁_mem_self <| isNonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr <| by rintro rfl; contradiction⟩
  · rintro y ⟨hy, hyx⟩
    rcases mem_image.mp hy with ⟨Y, hY, rfl⟩
    have : X = Y :=
      pairwise_disjoint X hX Y hY ⟨Y.choice₁, hyx,
        choice₁_mem_self <| isNonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr <| by rintro rfl; contradiction⟩
    rcases this
    rfl

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro z
    simp; tauto
  · intro hzx
    refine ⟨equivShrink _ ⟨z, by simpa⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [Universe.ext_iff]; tauto

name: IsAttempt.definable
statement:
lemma IsAttempt.definable [V↓[ℒₛₑₜ] ⊧* 𝗭] {F : V → V} (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    ℒₛₑₜ-relation (IsAttempt F)

name: isAttempt_coherent
statement:
lemma isAttempt_coherent (F : V → V) {α β : Ordinal V} {f g : V} [IsFunction f] [IsFunction g]
    (hf : IsAttempt F α f) (hg : IsAttempt F β g) :
    ∀ γ : Ordinal V, γ.val ⊆ α.val ∧ γ.val ⊆ β.val → f ↾ γ.val = g ↾ γ.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨_, _, _, testf⟩
  rcases hg with ⟨_, _, _, testg⟩
  refine transfinite_induction (P := fun x ↦ x ⊆ α.val ∧ x ⊆ β.val → f ↾ x = g ↾ x) (by definability) ?_
  rintro γ ihγ ⟨hγα, hγβ⟩
  ext p
  simp only [mem_restrict_iff, and_congr_left_iff, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  intro x hxγ y rfl
  have : IsOrdinal x := IsOrdinal.of_mem hxγ
  let xo : Ordinal V := IsOrdinal.toOrdinal x
  have hxα : x ∈ α.val := hγα x hxγ
  have hxβ : x ∈ β.val := hγβ x hxγ
  have hxoα : xo.val ⊆ α.val := α.ordinal.toIsTransitive.transitive x hxα
  have hxoβ : xo.val ⊆ β.val := β.ordinal.toIsTransitive.transitive x hxβ
  have : f ↾ xo = g ↾ xo := ihγ xo hxγ ⟨hxoα, hxoβ⟩
  simp_all only [IsOrdinal.toOrdinal_val, xo]

name: isAttempt_unique
statement:
lemma isAttempt_unique {F : V → V} {α : Ordinal V} {f g : V} [IsFunction f] [IsFunction g]
    (hf : IsAttempt F α f) (hg : IsAttempt F α g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hfα : f ↾ α.val = f := IsFunction.restrict_eq_self f α.val (subset_of_eq hf.2.2.1)
  have hgα : g ↾ α.val = g := IsFunction.restrict_eq_self g α.val (subset_of_eq hg.2.2.1)
  simpa [hfα, hgα] using isAttempt_coherent F hf hg α ⟨subset_refl α.val, subset_refl α.val⟩

name: isAttempt_restrict_eq_of_le
statement:
lemma isAttempt_restrict_eq_of_le
    (F : V → V)
    {α β : Ordinal V} {f g : V} [IsFunction f] [IsFunction g]
    (hβα : β ≤ α)
    (hf : IsAttempt F α f)
    (hg : IsAttempt F β g) :
    f ↾ β.val = g
proof:
:= by
  have hsubset : domain g ⊆ β.val := subset_of_eq hg.2.2.1
  exact isAttempt_coherent F hf hg β ⟨hβα, subset_refl β.val⟩ ▸ IsFunction.restrict_eq_self g β.val hsubset

name: existsUnique_of_exists
statement:
lemma existsUnique_of_exists (F : V → V) (α : V) (hex : Exists F α) :
    ∃! f : V, IsAttempt F α f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hex
  have : IsFunction f := hf.2.1
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  have : IsFunction g := hg.2.1
  have hα : IsOrdinal α := hf.1
  let αo : Ordinal V := IsOrdinal.toOrdinal α
  apply (IsAttempt.isAttempt_unique (α := αo) hf hg).symm

name: attemptOrEmpty_existsUnique
statement:
lemma attemptOrEmpty_existsUnique (F : V → V) (α : V) : ∃! y,
    (IsAttempt.Exists F α ∧ IsAttempt F α y) ∨
    (¬IsAttempt.Exists F α ∧ y = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hexists : IsAttempt.Exists F α
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, huniq⟩ := IsAttempt.existsUnique_of_exists F α hexists
    refine ⟨f, Or.inl ⟨hexists, hf⟩, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    simp only [hexists, true_and, not_true_eq_false, false_and, or_false] at hy
    exact huniq y hy
  · refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique ⟨∅, Or.inr ⟨hexists, rfl⟩⟩ (by aesop)

name: kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt_iff
statement:
lemma kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt_iff {F : V → V} {α : V} {x y : V} :
    ⟨x, y⟩ₖ = pairValueAttempt F α ↔ x = α ∧ y = F (attemptOrEmpty F α)

name: eq_of_kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt
statement: lemma eq_of_kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt {F : V → V} {α : V} {x y : V} (h : ⟨x, y⟩ₖ = pairValueAttempt F α) : x = α

name: mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff
    (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F)
    (α : V) (p : V) :
    p ∈ replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α ↔ ∃ β ∈ α, p = pairValueAttempt F β

name: kpair_mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma kpair_mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff
    (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F)
    {α : Ordinal V} {β y : V} :
    ⟨β, y⟩ₖ ∈ replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α ↔ β ∈ α.val ∧ ⟨β, y⟩ₖ = pairValueAttempt F β
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · obtain ⟨β, hβα, h⟩ := h
    rw [eq_of_kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt h] at *
    exact ⟨hβα, h⟩
  · use β

name: domain_replAttemptOrEmpty_eq
statement:
lemma domain_replAttemptOrEmpty_eq (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) (α : Ordinal V) :
    domain (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α) = α.val
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_domain_iff, mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · obtain ⟨y, β, hβα, hβ⟩ := h
    exact eq_of_kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt hβ ▸ hβα
  · use F (attemptOrEmpty F z)
    use z
    simp_all only [true_and, pairValueAttempt, true_and]

name: replAttemptOrEmpty_aux
statement:
lemma replAttemptOrEmpty_aux
    (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    (α : Ordinal V) → IsAttempt F α (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α)
proof:
:= by
  let motive (α : V) : Prop := IsAttempt F α (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α)

  have := IsAttempt.definable hF
  have : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ replAttemptOrEmpty F hF := by
    unfold replAttemptOrEmpty
    definability
  have motive_definable : ℒₛₑₜ-predicate motive := by
    unfold motive
    definability
  refine transfinite_induction motive motive_definable ?_
  intro α ih
  have hα := Ordinal.ordinal α

  have hrestrict : ((β : V) → (hβα : β ∈ α.val) → IsAttempt F β ((replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α) ↾ β)) := by
    intro β hβα
    have hβ : IsOrdinal β := IsOrdinal.of_mem hβα
    let βo : Ordinal V := IsOrdinal.toOrdinal β
    have haux := ih βo hβα

    suffices h : (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α) ↾ β = replAttemptOrEmpty F hF β from h ▸ haux
    ext p
    simp only [mem_restrict_iff, mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff]
    constructor <;> intro h
    · rcases h with ⟨⟨γ, hγα, hγ⟩, ⟨x, hxβ, y, rfl⟩⟩
      use x
      refine And.intro hxβ ?_
      exact (eq_of_kpair_eq_pairValueAttempt hγ).symm ▸ hγ
    · obtain ⟨γ, hγβ, hγ⟩ := h
      refine And.intro ?_ ?_
      · use γ
        exact And.intro (IsTransitive.mem_trans IsOrdinal.toIsTransitive hγβ hβα) hγ
      · exact ⟨γ, hγβ, F (attemptOrEmpty F γ), hγ⟩
  refine ⟨hα, inferInstance, domain_replAttemptOrEmpty_eq F hF α, ?_⟩
  intro β hβα y
  have hβ : IsOrdinal β := IsOrdinal.of_mem hβα
  let βo : Ordinal V := IsOrdinal.toOrdinal β

  suffices h : ⟨β, y⟩ₖ ∈ replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α.val ↔ ∃ f, y = F f ∧ IsAttempt F β f from by
    constructor <;> intro h₂
    · obtain ⟨f, rfl, hf⟩ := h.mp h₂
      have : IsFunction f := hf.2.1
      have : IsFunction ((replAttemptOrEmpty F hF (↑α)) ↾ ↑βo) := inferInstance
      simp only [IsAttempt.isAttempt_unique hf (hrestrict βo hβα), IsOrdinal.toOrdinal_val, βo]
    · apply h.mpr
      use (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF (↑α)) ↾ β
      simp only [h₂, true_and]
      exact hrestrict βo hβα
  have hexists : IsAttempt.Exists F β := ⟨replAttemptOrEmpty F hF β, ih βo hβα⟩
  simp_all only [mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff, pairValueAttempt, kpair_iff, ↓existsAndEq, true_and,
    motive]
  have hattempt : IsAttempt F β (attemptOrEmpty F β) := by
    simp_all [attemptOrEmpty, Classical.choose!_spec]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · use attemptOrEmpty F β
  · obtain ⟨f, hfleft, hfright⟩ := h
    have heq := IsOrdinal.toOrdinal_val β
    rw [← heq] at *
    have := hfright.2.1
    have := hattempt.2.1
    exact (IsAttempt.isAttempt_unique hfright hattempt) ▸ hfleft

name: attempt_function_exists
statement:
lemma attempt_function_exists
    (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) :
    (α : Ordinal V) → IsAttempt.Exists F α
proof:
:=
  fun α ↦ ⟨replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α, replAttemptOrEmpty_aux F hF α⟩

name: attemptOrEmpty_eq_replAttemptOrEmpty
statement:
lemma attemptOrEmpty_eq_replAttemptOrEmpty
    (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) (α : Ordinal V) :
    attemptOrEmpty F α = replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : IsAttempt F α (attemptOrEmpty F α) := by
    simp [attemptOrEmpty, Classical.choose!_spec, attempt_function_exists F hF α]
  have h₂ := replAttemptOrEmpty_aux F hF α
  have : IsFunction (attemptOrEmpty F α) := h₁.2.1
  have : IsFunction (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF α) := h₂.2.1
  exact IsAttempt.isAttempt_unique h₁ h₂

name: transfiniteRec_spec
statement:
lemma transfiniteRec_spec (F : V → V) (hF : ℒₛₑₜ-function₁ F) (α : Ordinal V) :
    transfiniteRec F hF α = F (repl (fun β ↦ ⟨β, transfiniteRec F hF β⟩ₖ) (by definability) α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices
      ∀ p, (∃ β ∈ (α : V), p = pairValueAttempt F β) ↔
      ∃ x ∈ (α : V), p = ⟨x, if IsOrdinal x then F (replAttemptOrEmpty F hF x) else ∅⟩ₖ by
    simp only [transfiniteRec, if_pos α.ordinal]
    congr 1
    ext p
    simp only [mem_replAttemptOrEmpty_iff, repl_spec]
    exact this p
  intro p
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨β, hβα, rfl⟩
  · have hβ : IsOrdinal β := IsOrdinal.of_mem hβα
    exact ⟨β, hβα, by
      simpa [transfiniteRec, pairValueAttempt, hβ] using
        congrArg F (attemptOrEmpty_eq_replAttemptOrEmpty F hF (IsOrdinal.toOrdinal β))⟩
  · have hβ : IsOrdinal β := IsOrdinal.of_mem hβα
    exact ⟨β, hβα, by
      simpa [transfiniteRec, pairValueAttempt, hβ] using
        congrArg F (attemptOrEmpty_eq_replAttemptOrEmpty F hF (IsOrdinal.toOrdinal β)).symm⟩

name: map_inj
statement:
private lemma map_inj {n₁ n₂} {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformulaᵢ L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | ⊥, φ => by cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel]
  | rel r v, φ => by
    cases φ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel]
    case hRel =>
      rintro rfl; simp; rintro rfl h; simp
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
  | φ ⋏ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ ⋎ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | φ 🡒 ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel]
    intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
  | ∀¹ φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
  | ∃¹ φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;> simp [rew_rel, Rew.q_map]
    intro h; exact map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
      (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h

private lemma consequence_of_aux (T : SetTheory) [𝗘𝗤 _ ⪯ T] (φ : SetTheorySentence)

           [SetStructure M]

statement: theorem formalized_unprovable_gödel  : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅.con 🡒 ∼𝔅 𝐆
proof:
:= by
  suffices T₀ ⊢ ∼𝔅 ⊥ 🡒 ∼𝔅 𝐆 from this
  have h₁ : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅 𝐆 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅 𝐆) := D3
  have h₂ : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅 𝐆 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅 𝐆 🡒 ⊥) := 𝔅.mono' $ by cl_prover [gödel_spec (T₀ := T₀)]
  have h₃ : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅 (𝔅 𝐆 🡒 ⊥) 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅 𝐆) 🡒 𝔅 ⊥ := D2

  have h₃ : T₀ ⊢ 𝐆 🡘 ∼𝔅 𝐆 := gödel_spec
  cl_prover [h₁, h₂, h₃];

name: boxBot_monotone
statement: lemma boxBot_monotone [T₀ ⪯ T] [𝔅.HBL] : n ≤ m → T ⊢ 𝔅^[n] ⊥ 🡒 𝔅^[m] ⊥
proof:
:= by
  revert m
  suffices ∀ k, T ⊢ 𝔅^[n] ⊥ 🡒 𝔅^[n + k] ⊥ by
    intro m hnm
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hnm] using this (m - n)
  intro k
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ih =>
    simp only [← add_assoc, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    have b₀ : T ⊢ 𝔅^[n] ⊥ 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅^[n] ⊥) := by
      match n with
      | 0 => simp;
      | n + 1 =>
        have : T ⊢ 𝔅 ((𝔅)^[n] ⊥) 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅 ((𝔅)^[n] ⊥)) := Entailment.WeakerThan.pbl $ 𝔅.D3;
        simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply'] using this
    have b₁ : T ⊢ 𝔅 (𝔅^[n] ⊥) 🡒 𝔅 (𝔅^[n + k] ⊥) := Entailment.WeakerThan.pbl $ 𝔅.mono ih;
    cl_prover [b₀, b₁]

lemma height_lt_pos_of_boxBot (hSound : ∀ {σ}, T₀ ⊢ 𝔅 σ → T ⊢ σ)
  {n : ℕ} (pos : 0 < n) (h : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅^[n] ⊥) : 𝔅.height < n
proof:
:= by
  have e : n.pred.succ = n := Eq.symm <| (Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add pos).mp rfl
  have : T₀ ⊢ 𝔅 (𝔅^[n.pred] ⊥) := by rwa [←Function.iterate_succ_apply' (f := 𝔅), e];
  have : 𝔅.height ≤ n.pred := height_le_of_boxBot $ hSound this
  have : 𝔅.height < n := by
    rw [←e]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt this <| ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr <| by simp
  exact this

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : ∃ m ≤ n, T ⊢ (↑𝔅)^[m] ⊥ := ENat.exists_of_find_le _ n h
    rcases this with ⟨m, hmn, hm⟩
    exact boxBot_monotone hmn ⨀ hm
  · exact height_le_of_boxBot

proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ z', z₂ = z' * u * u := by rcases h with ⟨u', rfl⟩; exact ⟨u', by simp [mul_comm _ u', mul_assoc]; simp [sq]⟩

name: ext_rem
statement: lemma ext_rem {i j z : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) (ppj : PPow2 j) (hij : i < j) : ext i (z % j) = ext i z
proof:
:= by
  have := div_add_mod z j
  have : i^2 ∣ j := ppi.pow2.sq.dvd_of_le ppj.pow2 (PPow2.sq_le_of_lt ppi ppj hij)
  calc
    ext i (z % j) = ext i (j * (z / j) + (z % j)) := by symm; exact ext_add_of_dvd_sq_left ppi.pos (Dvd.dvd.mul_right this (z / j))
    _               = ext i z                          := by simp [div_add_mod]

name: Exponential.Seq
statement:
lemma Exponential.Seqₛ.iff (y X Y : V) :
  Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y ↔
  ∀ u ≤ y, u ≠ 2 → PPow2 u →
    ((∃ ext_u_X ≤ X, ext_u_X = ext u X ∧ 2 * ext_u_X = ext (u^2) X)     ∧ (∃ ext_u_Y ≤ Y, ext_u_Y = ext u Y ∧ ext_u_Y^2 = ext (u^2) Y)) ∨
    ((∃ ext_u_X ≤ X, ext_u_X = ext u X ∧ 2 * ext_u_X + 1 = ext (u^2) X) ∧ (∃ ext_u_Y ≤ Y, ext_u_Y = ext u Y ∧ 2 * ext_u_Y^2 = ext (u^2) Y))
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro H u hu ne2 ppu
      rcases H u hu ne2 ppu with (H | H)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨ext u X, by simp [H.1]⟩, ⟨ext u Y, by simp [H.2]⟩⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨ext u X, by simp [H.1]⟩, ⟨ext u Y, by simp [H.2]⟩⟩,
   by intro H u hu ne2 ppu
      rcases H u hu ne2 ppu with (⟨⟨_, _, rfl, hx⟩, ⟨_, _, rfl, hy⟩⟩ | ⟨⟨_, _, rfl, hx⟩, ⟨_, _, rfl, hy⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨by simp [hx], by simp [hy]⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨by simp [hx], by simp [hy]⟩⟩

name: Exponential.graph_iff
statement:
lemma Exponential.graph_iff (x y : V) :
    Exponential x y ↔
    (x = 0 ∧ y = 1) ∨ ∃ X ≤ y^4, ∃ Y ≤ y^4,
      (1 = ext 4 X ∧ 2 = ext 4 Y) ∧
      Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y ∧
      (∃ u ≤ y^2, u ≠ 2 ∧ PPow2 u ∧ x = ext u X ∧ y = ext u Y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro (H | ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, hX, hY⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inl H
      · exact Or.inr ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, ⟨H₀.1.symm, H₀.2.symm⟩, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, hX.symm, hY.symm⟩⟩,
   by rintro (H | ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, hX, hY⟩⟩)
      · exact Or.inl H
      · exact Or.inr ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, ⟨H₀.1.symm, H₀.2.symm⟩, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, hX.symm, hY.symm⟩⟩⟩
