statement: lemma two_lt_three : (2 : V) < 3

name: three_lt_four
statement: lemma three_lt_four : (3 : V) < 4

name: two_lt_four
statement: lemma two_lt_four : (2 : V) < 4

name: seq
statement: lemma seq₀_zero_two : Seq₀ (seqX₀ : V) (seqY₀ : V)
proof: := by simp [seqX₀, seqY₀, Seq₀, ext, two_lt_four]

name: Seq
statement:
lemma Seq₀.rem {X Y i : V} (h : Seq₀ X Y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (hi : 4 < i) :
    Seq₀ (X % i) (Y % i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Seq₀, ext_rem, ext_rem] <;> try simp [ppi, hi]
  exact h

name: Seq
statement:
lemma Seqₛ.rem {y y' X Y i : V} (h : Seqₛ y X Y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (hi : y'^2 < i) (hy : y' ≤ y) :
    Seqₛ y' (X % i) (Y % i)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj ne2 ppj
  have : j^2 < i := lt_of_le_of_lt (sq_le_sq.mpr hj) hi
  have : j < i := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans hj $ by simp) hi
  rcases h j (le_trans hj hy) ne2 ppj with (H | H)
  · left; simpa [Seqₛ.Even, ext_rem, ppj, ppj.sq, ppi, *] using H
  · right; simpa [Seqₛ.Odd, ext_rem, ppj, ppj.sq, ppi, *] using H

name: seq
statement: lemma seqₛ_one_zero_two : Seqₛ (1 : V) (seqX₀ : V) (seqY₀ : V)
proof:
:= by
  intro u leu; rcases le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp leu with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp

name: append_lt
statement: lemma append_lt (i X : V) {z} (hz : z < i) : append i X z < i^2
proof:
:= calc
  append i X z = (X % i) + z * i := rfl
  _            < (1 + z) * i       := by simpa [add_mul] using mod_lt _ (pos_of_gt hz)
  _            ≤ i^2               := by simpa [sq, add_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (lt_iff_succ_le.mp hz) (by simp)

name: ext_append_last
statement:
lemma ext_append_last (i X : V) {z} (hz : z < i) :
    ext i (append i X z) = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [ext, append, div_add_mul_self, show 0 < i from pos_of_gt hz, hz]

name: ext_append_of_lt
statement:
lemma ext_append_of_lt {i j : V} (hi : PPow2 i) (hj : PPow2 j) (hij : i < j) (X z : V) :
    ext i (append j X z) = ext i X
proof:
:= by
  have : i^2 ∣ j := Pow2.dvd_of_le hi.pow2.sq hj.pow2 (PPow2.sq_le_of_lt hi hj hij)
  calc
    ext i (append j X z) = ext i ((X % j) + z * j)       := rfl
    _                    = ext i (X % j)                 := ext_add_of_dvd_sq_right hi.pos (Dvd.dvd.mul_left this z)
    _                    = ext i (j * (X / j) + (X % j)) := by rw [add_comm]; refine Eq.symm <| ext_add_of_dvd_sq_right hi.pos (Dvd.dvd.mul_right this _)
    _                    = ext i X                         := by simp [div_add_mod]

name: Seq
statement:
lemma Seq₀.append {X Y i x y : V} (H : Seq₀ X Y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (hi : 4 < i) :
    Seq₀ (append i X x) (append i Y y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Seq₀, ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt] <;> try simp [ppi, hi]
  exact H

name: Seq
statement:
lemma Seqₛ.append {z x y X Y i : V} (h : Seqₛ z X Y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (hz : z < i) :
    Seqₛ z (append (i^2) X x) (append (i^2) Y y)
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj ne2 ppj
  have : j < i^2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_lt hj hz) (by simp)
  have : j^2 < i^2 := sq_lt_sq.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hj hz)
  rcases h j hj ne2 ppj with (H | H)
  · simp only [Even, Odd]
    left; rw [ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt] <;> try simp [ppi.sq, ppj.sq, *]
    exact H
  · simp only [Even, Odd]
    right; rw [ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt, ext_append_of_lt] <;> try simp [ppi.sq, ppj.sq, *]
    exact H

name: exponential_zero_one
statement: @[simp] lemma exponential_zero_one : Exponential (0 : V) 1

name: exponential_one_two
statement: @[simp] lemma exponential_one_two : Exponential (1 : V) 2
proof:
:=
  Or.inr ⟨
    4, by simp [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, two_pow_two_eq_four],
    2 * 4, by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, two_pow_two_eq_four, sq (4 : V)] using le_of_lt two_lt_four,
    by simp [Seq₀, ext, two_lt_four],
    by simpa [Seqₛ] using fun i hi ne2 ppi ↦ False.elim <| not_le.mpr (ppi.two_lt ne2) hi,
    ⟨4, by simp [two_pow_two_eq_four], by simp, by simp [ext, two_lt_four]⟩⟩

name: pow2_ext_of_seq
statement:
lemma pow2_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : Pow2 (ext i Y)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ei : i = 4
    · rcases ei with rfl; simp [h₀.2]
    · have ppsq : Pow2 (ext (√i) Y) :=
        IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · have : ext i Y = (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using heven.2
        simp [this, ppsq]
      · have : ext i Y = 2*(ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hodd.2
        simp [this, ppsq]

name: range_pow2
statement: lemma range_pow2 {x y : V} (h : Exponential x y) : Pow2 y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  · simp
  · exact pow2_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ H₀ Hₛ ne2 hu ppu

name: le_sq_ext_of_seq
statement:
lemma le_sq_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : i ≤ (ext i Y)^2
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ei : i = 4
    · rcases ei with rfl; simp [h₀.2, two_pow_two_eq_four]
    · have IH : √i ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^2 :=
        IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · have : ext i Y = (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using heven.2
        have : √i ≤ ext i Y := by simpa [this] using IH
        simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using sq_le_sq.mpr this
      · have : ext i Y = 2*(ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hodd.2
        have : 2 * √i ≤ ext i Y := by simpa [this] using mul_le_mul_left (a := 2) IH
        have : √i ≤ ext i Y := le_trans (le_mul_of_pos_left $ by simp) this
        simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using sq_le_sq.mpr this

name: two_mul_ext_le_of_seq
statement:
lemma two_mul_ext_le_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : 2 * ext i Y ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ei : i = 4
    · rcases ei with rfl; simp [h₀.2, two_mul_two_eq_four]
    · have IH : 2 * ext (√i) Y ≤ √i :=
        IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · have : ext i Y = (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using heven.2
        calc
          2 * ext i Y ≤ 2 * (2 * ext i Y)  := le_mul_of_pos_left (by simp)
          _           = (2 * ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simp [this, sq, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
          _           ≤ (√i)^2             := sq_le_sq.mpr IH
          _           = i                  := ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2
      · have : ext i Y = 2*(ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hodd.2
        calc
          2 * ext i Y = (2 * ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simp [this, sq, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
          _           ≤ (√i)^2             := sq_le_sq.mpr IH
          _           = i                  := ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2

name: exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_even
statement: lemma exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_even {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x) y → ∃ y', y = y'^2 ∧ Exponential x y'
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, hseq₀, hseqₛ, i, hi, ne2, ppi, hXx, hYy⟩)
  · exact ⟨1, by simp [show x = 0 from by simpa using hx]⟩
  by_cases ne4 : i = 4
  · rcases ne4 with rfl
    have ex : 1 = 2 * x := by simpa [hseq₀.1] using hXx
    have : (2 : V) ∣ 1 := by rw [ex]; simp
    have : ¬(2 : V) ∣ 1 := not_dvd_of_lt (by simp) one_lt_two
    contradiction
  have : Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) :=
    hseqₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
  rcases this with (⟨hXi, hYi⟩ | ⟨hXi, _⟩)
  · have hXx : x = ext (√i) X := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2, hXx] using hXi
    have hYy : y = (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2, hYy] using hYi
    let X' := X % i
    let Y' := Y % i
    have bX' : X' ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, ←hYy] using le_trans (le_of_lt <| by simp [X', ppi.pos]) hi
    have bY' : Y' ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, ←hYy] using le_trans (le_of_lt <| by simp [Y', ppi.pos]) hi
    have hseqₛ' : Seqₛ (ext (√i) Y) X' Y' :=
      hseqₛ.rem ppi (sq_lt_of_lt_sqrt $ ext_lt Y (ppi.sqrt ne2).pos) (by simp [hYy])
    have hseqₘ' : Seqₘ x (ext (√i) Y) X' Y' :=
      ⟨√i, sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ by simp [←hYy, hi], ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4, ppi.sqrt ne2,
       by have : √i < i := sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt
          simp [X', Y', this, ext_rem, ppi, ppi.sqrt ne2, hXx]⟩
    have : Exponential x (ext (√i) Y) :=
      Or.inr ⟨X', bX', Y', bY', hseq₀.rem ppi (ppi.four_lt ne2 ne4), hseqₛ', hseqₘ'⟩
    exact ⟨ext (√i) Y, hYy, this⟩
  · have : 2 ∣ ext i X := by simp [hXx]
    have : ¬2 ∣ ext i X := by
      simp [show ext i X = 2 * ext (√i) X + 1 from by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hXi,
        ←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    contradiction

name: bit_zero
statement: lemma bit_zero {x y : V} : Exponential x y → Exponential (2 * x) (y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, hseq₀, hseqₛ, i, hi, ne2, ppi, hXx, hYy⟩)
  · rcases hx with rfl; simp
  have hxsqi : 2 * x < i ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp [←hXx, ppi.pos]) (two_mul_le_sq ppi.two_le)
  have hysqi : y ^ 2 < i ^ 2 := sq_lt_sq.mpr $ by simp [←hYy, ppi.pos]
  have hiisq : i < i^2 := lt_square_of_lt ppi.one_lt
  let X' := append (i^2) X (2 * x)
  let Y' := append (i^2) Y (y ^ 2)
  have bX' : X' ≤ (y^2)^4 := by
    have : X' < i^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq] using append_lt (i^2) X hxsqi
    exact le_trans (le_of_lt this) (pow_le_pow_left' hi 4)
  have bY' : Y' ≤ (y^2)^4 := by
    have : Y' < i^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq] using append_lt (i^2) Y hysqi
    exact le_trans (le_of_lt this) (pow_le_pow_left' hi 4)
  have hseq₀' : Seq₀ X' Y' := hseq₀.append ppi.sq (ppi.sq.four_lt ppi.sq_ne_two (ppi.sq_ne_four ne2))
  have hseqₛ' : Seqₛ (y ^ 2) X' Y' := by
    intro j hj jne2 ppj
    by_cases hjy : j ≤ y
    · have : Seqₛ y X' Y' := hseqₛ.append ppi (by simp [←hYy, ppi.pos])
      exact this j hjy jne2 ppj
    · have : i = j := by
        have : Pow2 y := by simpa [hYy] using pow2_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ hseq₀ hseqₛ ne2 hi ppi
        exact PPow2.sq_uniq this ppi ppj
          ⟨by simp [←hYy, ppi.pos], hi⟩ ⟨by simpa using hjy, hj⟩
      rcases this with rfl
      left
      suffices ext (i ^ 2) X' = 2 * ext i X' ∧ ext (i ^ 2) Y' = ext i Y' ^ 2 by simpa [Seqₛ.Even]
      constructor
      · calc
          ext (i ^ 2) X' = 2 * x        := ext_append_last _ _ hxsqi
          _              = 2 * ext i X  := by simp [hXx]
          _              = 2 * ext i X' := by rw [ext_append_of_lt ppi ppi.sq hiisq]
      · calc
          ext (i ^ 2) Y' = y^2          := ext_append_last _ _ hysqi
          _              = ext i Y ^ 2  := by simp [hYy]
          _              = ext i Y' ^ 2 := by rw [ext_append_of_lt ppi ppi.sq hiisq]
  have hseqₘ' : Seqₘ (2 * x) (y ^ 2) X' Y' :=
    ⟨i ^ 2, sq_le_sq.mpr hi, ppi.sq_ne_two, ppi.sq,
     by rw [ext_append_last, ext_append_last] <;> simp [hxsqi, hysqi]⟩
  exact Or.inr <| ⟨X', bX', Y', bY', hseq₀', hseqₛ', hseqₘ'⟩

name: exponential_even
statement: lemma exponential_even {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x) y ↔ ∃ y', y = y'^2 ∧ Exponential x y'
proof:
:=
  ⟨exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_even, by rintro ⟨y, rfl, h⟩; exact bit_zero h⟩

name: exponential_even_sq
statement: lemma exponential_even_sq {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x) (y ^ 2) ↔ Exponential x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      rcases exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_even h with ⟨y', e, h⟩
      simpa [show y = y' from by simpa using e] using h,
   bit_zero⟩

name: exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_odd
statement: lemma exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_odd {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x + 1) y → ∃ y', y = 2 * y'^2 ∧ Exponential x y'
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, hseq₀, hseqₛ, i, hi, ne2, ppi, hXx, hYy⟩)
  · simp at hx
  by_cases ne4 : i = 4
  · rcases ne4 with rfl
    have ex : x = 0 := by simpa [hseq₀.1] using hXx
    have ey : y = 2 := by simpa [hseq₀.2] using Eq.symm hYy
    exact ⟨1, by simp [ex, ey]⟩
  have : Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) :=
    hseqₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
  rcases this with (⟨hXi, _⟩ | ⟨hXi, hYi⟩)
  · have hXx : 2 * x + 1 = 2 * ext (√i) X := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2, hXx] using hXi
    have : 2 ∣ 2 * x + 1 := by rw [hXx]; simp
    have : ¬2 ∣ 2 * x + 1 := by simp [←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    contradiction
  · have hXx : x = ext (√i) X := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2, hXx] using hXi
    have hYy : y = 2 * (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2, hYy] using hYi
    let X' := X % i
    let Y' := Y % i
    have bsqi : √i ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^2 := le_sq_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ hseq₀ hseqₛ (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
    have bi : i ≤ ext (√i) Y^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using sq_le_sq.mpr bsqi
    have bX' : X' ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^4 := le_trans (le_of_lt $ by simp [X', ppi.pos]) bi
    have bY' : Y' ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^4 := le_trans (le_of_lt $ by simp [Y', ppi.pos]) bi
    have hseqₛ' : Seqₛ (ext (√i) Y) X' Y' :=
      hseqₛ.rem ppi (sq_lt_of_lt_sqrt $ ext_lt Y (ppi.sqrt ne2).pos) (le_trans (le_sq _)
        (by simp [hYy]))
    have hseqₘ' : Seqₘ x (ext (√i) Y) X' Y' :=
      ⟨√i, bsqi, ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4, ppi.sqrt ne2,
       by have : √i < i := sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt
          simp [X', Y', this, ext_rem, ppi, ppi.sqrt ne2, hXx]⟩
    have : Exponential x (ext (√i) Y) :=
      Or.inr ⟨X', bX', Y', bY', hseq₀.rem ppi (ppi.four_lt ne2 ne4), hseqₛ', hseqₘ'⟩
    exact ⟨ext (√i) Y, hYy, this⟩

name: bit_one
statement: lemma bit_one {x y : V} : Exponential x y → Exponential (2 * x + 1) (2 * y ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, hseq₀, hseqₛ, i, hi, ne2, ppi, hXx, hYy⟩)
  · rcases hx with rfl; simp
  have hxsqi : 2 * x + 1 < i ^ 2 := calc
    2 * x + 1 < 2 * i + 1 := by simp [←hXx, ppi.pos]
    _         ≤ i ^ 2     := lt_iff_succ_le.mp (two_mul_lt_sq $ ppi.two_lt ne2)
  have hysqi : 2 * y ^ 2 < i ^ 2 := by
    have : 2 * ext i Y ≤ i := two_mul_ext_le_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ hseq₀ hseqₛ ne2 hi ppi
    suffices 2 * (2 * y ^ 2) < 2 * i ^ 2 from lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left this
    calc
      2 * (2 * y ^ 2) = (2 * y)^2 := by simp [sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm y 2]
      _               ≤ i^2       := sq_le_sq.mpr (by simpa [hYy] using this)
      _               < 2 * i^2   := lt_mul_of_one_lt_left ppi.sq.pos one_lt_two
  have hiisq : i < i^2 := lt_square_of_lt ppi.one_lt
  let X' := append (i^2) X (2 * x + 1)
  let Y' := append (i^2) Y (2 * (y^2))
  have bX' : X' ≤ (2 * y ^ 2)^4 := by
    have : X' < i^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq] using append_lt (i^2) X hxsqi
    exact le_trans (le_of_lt this) (pow_le_pow_left' (le_trans hi $ by simp) 4)
  have bY' : Y' ≤ (2 * y ^ 2)^4 := by
    have : Y' < i^4 := by simpa [pow_four_eq_sq_sq] using append_lt (i^2) Y hysqi
    exact le_trans (le_of_lt this) (pow_le_pow_left' (le_trans hi $ by simp) 4)
  have hseq₀' : Seq₀ X' Y' := hseq₀.append ppi.sq (ppi.sq.four_lt ppi.sq_ne_two (ppi.sq_ne_four ne2))
  have hseqₛ' : Seqₛ (2 * y ^ 2) X' Y' := by
    intro j hj jne2 ppj
    by_cases hjy : j ≤ y
    · have : Seqₛ y X' Y' := hseqₛ.append ppi (by simp [←hYy, ppi.pos])
      exact this j hjy jne2 ppj
    · have : i = j := by
        have : Pow2 y := by simpa [hYy] using pow2_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ hseq₀ hseqₛ ne2 hi ppi
        exact PPow2.two_mul_sq_uniq this ppi ppj
          ⟨by simp [←hYy, ppi.pos], le_trans hi (by simp)⟩ ⟨by simpa using hjy, hj⟩
      rcases this with rfl
      right
      suffices ext (i ^ 2) X' = 2 * ext i X' + 1 ∧ ext (i ^ 2) Y' = 2 * ext i Y' ^ 2 by simpa [Seqₛ.Odd]
      constructor
      · calc
          ext (i ^ 2) X' = 2 * x + 1        := ext_append_last _ _ hxsqi
          _              = 2 * ext i X + 1  := by simp [hXx]
          _              = 2 * ext i X' + 1 := by rw [ext_append_of_lt ppi ppi.sq hiisq]
      · calc
          ext (i ^ 2) Y' = 2 * y^2          := ext_append_last _ _ hysqi
          _              = 2 * ext i Y ^ 2  := by simp [hYy]
          _              = 2 * ext i Y' ^ 2 := by rw [ext_append_of_lt ppi ppi.sq hiisq]
  have hseqₘ' : Seqₘ (2 * x + 1) (2 * y ^ 2) X' Y' :=
    ⟨i ^ 2, sq_le_sq.mpr (le_trans hi $ by simp), ppi.sq_ne_two, ppi.sq,
     by rw [ext_append_last, ext_append_last] <;> try simp [hxsqi, hysqi]⟩
  exact Or.inr <| ⟨X', bX', Y', bY', hseq₀', hseqₛ', hseqₘ'⟩

name: exponential_odd
statement: lemma exponential_odd {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x + 1) y ↔ ∃ y', y = 2 * y' ^ 2 ∧ Exponential x y'
proof:
:=
  ⟨exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_odd, by rintro ⟨y, rfl, h⟩; exact bit_one h⟩

name: exponential_odd_two_mul_sq
statement: lemma exponential_odd_two_mul_sq {x y : V} : Exponential (2 * x + 1) (2 * y ^ 2) ↔ Exponential x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      rcases exponential_exists_sq_of_exponential_odd h with ⟨y', e, h⟩
      simpa [show y = y' from by simpa using e] using h,
   bit_one⟩

name: two_le_ext_of_seq
statement:
lemma two_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : 2 ≤ ext i Y
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ei : i = 4
    · rcases ei with rfl; simp [h₀.2]
    · have IH : 2 ≤ ext (√i) Y :=
        IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ei) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · calc
          2 ≤ ext (√i) Y     := IH
          _ ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simp
          _ = ext i Y        := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using Eq.symm heven.2
      · calc
          2 ≤ ext (√i) Y         := IH
          _ ≤ (ext (√i) Y)^2     := by simp
          _ ≤ 2 * (ext (√i) Y)^2 := by simp
          _ = ext i Y            := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using Eq.symm hodd.2

name: ext_le_ext_of_seq
statement:
lemma ext_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : ext i X < ext i Y
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ne4 : i = 4
    · rcases ne4 with rfl; simp [h₀.1, h₀.2]
    · have IH : ext (√i) X < ext (√i) Y :=
        IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      have twole : 2 ≤ ext (√i) Y := two_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ h₀ hₛ (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · calc
          ext i X = 2 * ext (√i) X := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using heven.1
          _       < 2 * ext (√i) Y := by simpa using IH
          _       ≤ ext (√i) Y^2   := two_mul_le_sq twole
          _       = ext i Y        := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using Eq.symm heven.2
      ·
        calc
          ext i X = 2 * ext (√i) X + 1 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hodd.1
          _       < 2 * ext (√i) Y + 1 := by simpa using IH
          _       ≤ 2 * ext (√i) Y^2   :=
            lt_iff_succ_le.mp <| (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ <| by simp).mpr
              <| lt_self_pow₀ (one_lt_iff_two_le.mpr twole) (by simp)
          _       = ext i Y            := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using Eq.symm hodd.2

name: range_pos
statement: lemma range_pos {x y : V} (h : Exponential x y) : 0 < y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  · simp
  · have : 2 ≤ ext u Y := two_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ H₀ Hₛ ne2 hu ppu
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) this

name: lt
statement: lemma lt {x y : V} (h : Exponential x y) : x < y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, bX, Y, bY, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
  · simp
  · exact ext_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ H₀ Hₛ ne2 hu ppu

name: not_exponential_of_le
statement: lemma not_exponential_of_le {x y : V} (h : x ≤ y) : ¬Exponential y x
proof:
:= by
  intro hxy; exact not_le.mpr (lt hxy) h

name: one_not_even
statement: @[simp] lemma one_not_even (a : V) : 1 ≠ 2 * a
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : (2 : V) ∣ 1 := by rw [h]; simp
  have : ¬(2 : V) ∣ 1 := not_dvd_of_lt (by simp) one_lt_two
  contradiction

name: exponential_two_four
statement: @[simp] lemma exponential_two_four : Exponential (2 : V) 4
proof:
:= by
  simpa [two_pow_two_eq_four] using (show Exponential (1 : V) 2 from by simp).bit_zero

name: exponential_succ
statement: lemma exponential_succ {x y : V} : Exponential (x + 1) y ↔ ∃ z, y = 2 * z ∧ Exponential x z
proof:
:= by
  suffices x < y → (Exponential (x + 1) y ↔ ∃ z ≤ y, y = 2 * z ∧ Exponential x z) by
    by_cases hxy : x < y
    · simp only [this hxy]
      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨z, _, rfl, hz⟩; exact ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩,
             by rintro ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩; exact ⟨z, by simpa using hz⟩⟩
    · suffices ∀ z, y = 2 * z → ¬Exponential x z by
        simpa [not_exponential_of_le (show y ≤ x + 1 from le_add_right (by simpa using hxy))]
      rintro z rfl
      exact not_exponential_of_le (le_trans le_two_mul_left $  by simpa using hxy)
  · revert x
    induction y using ISigma0.order_induction
    · definability
    case ind y IH =>
      intro x hxy
      rcases even_or_odd x with ⟨x, (rfl | rfl)⟩
      · constructor
        · intro H
          rcases exponential_odd.mp H with ⟨y, rfl, H'⟩
          exact ⟨y^2, by simp, rfl, H'.bit_zero⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl, H⟩
          rcases exponential_even.mp H with ⟨y, rfl, H'⟩
          exact H'.bit_one
      · constructor
        · intro H
          have : Exponential (2 * (x + 1)) y := by simpa [mul_add, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using H
          rcases exponential_even.mp this with ⟨y, rfl, H'⟩
          have : 1 < y := by
            simpa using (show 1 < y^2 from lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp) hxy)
          have : Exponential (x + 1) y ↔ ∃ z ≤ y, y = 2 * z ∧ Exponential x z :=
            IH y (lt_square_of_lt $ this) (lt_trans (by simp) H'.lt)
          rcases this.mp H' with ⟨y, _, rfl, H''⟩
          exact ⟨2 * y ^ 2, by simp [sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm y 2],
            by simp [sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm y 2], H''.bit_one⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, _, rfl, H⟩
          rcases exponential_odd.mp H with ⟨y, rfl, H'⟩
          by_cases ne1 : y = 1
          · rcases ne1 with rfl
            rcases (show x = 0 from by simpa using H'.lt)
            simp [one_add_one_eq_two, two_mul_two_eq_four]
          have : y < y^2 := lt_square_of_lt $ one_lt_iff_two_le.mpr $ H'.range_pow2.two_le ne1
          have : Exponential (x + 1) (2 * y) ↔ ∃ z ≤ 2 * y, 2 * y = 2 * z ∧ Exponential x z :=
            IH (2 * y) (by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le this le_two_mul_left)
              (lt_of_lt_of_le H'.lt $ by simp)
          have : Exponential (x + 1) (2 * y) := this.mpr ⟨y, by simp, rfl, H'⟩
          simpa [sq, mul_add, add_assoc, mul_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_left_comm y 2] using this.bit_zero

name: exponential_succ_mul_two
statement: lemma exponential_succ_mul_two {x y : V} : Exponential (x + 1) (2 * y) ↔ Exponential x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; rcases exponential_succ.mp h with ⟨y', e, h⟩; simpa [show y = y' from by simpa using e] using h,
   by intro h; exact exponential_succ.mpr ⟨y, rfl, h⟩⟩

name: one_le_ext_of_seq
statement:
lemma one_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ {y X Y : V} (h₀ : Exponential.Seq₀ X Y) (hₛ : Exponential.Seqₛ y X Y)
    {i} (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (hi : i ≤ y^2) (ppi : PPow2 i) : 1 ≤ ext i X
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind i IH =>
    by_cases ne4 : i = 4
    · rcases ne4 with rfl; simp [h₀.1]
    · have IH : 1 ≤ ext (√i) X :=
      IH (√i) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt ppi.one_lt) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (le_trans (by simp) hi) (ppi.sqrt ne2)
      rcases show Seqₛ.Even X Y (√i) ∨ Seqₛ.Odd X Y (√i) from
        hₛ (√i) (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ hi) (ppi.sqrt_ne_two ne2 ne4) (ppi.sqrt ne2) with (heven | hodd)
      · have : ext i X = 2 * ext (√i) X := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using heven.1
        exact le_trans IH (by simp [this])
      · have : ext i X = 2 * ext (√i) X + 1 := by simpa [ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ne2] using hodd.1
        simp [this]

name: zero_uniq
statement: lemma zero_uniq {y : V} (h : Exponential 0 y) : y = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, hX, _⟩⟩)
  · rfl
  · have : 1 ≤ ext u X  := one_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ H₀ Hₛ ne2 hu ppu
    simp [hX] at this

name: zero_uniq_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_uniq_iff {y : V} : Exponential 0 y ↔ y = 1

name: succ_lt_s
statement: lemma succ_lt_s {y : V} (h : Exponential (x + 1) y) : 2 ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨X, _, Y, _, H₀, Hₛ, ⟨u, hu, ne2, ppu, _, hY⟩⟩)
  · simp at h
  · simpa [hY] using two_le_ext_of_seq₀_of_seqₛ H₀ Hₛ ne2 hu ppu

name: uniq
statement: protected lemma uniq {x y₁ y₂ : V} : Exponential x y₁ → Exponential x y₂ → y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  wlog h : y₁ ≤ y₂
  · exact Eq.symm <| this h₂ h₁ (show y₂ ≤ y₁ from le_of_not_ge h)
  revert x h y₁
  suffices ∀ x < y₂, ∀ y₁ ≤ y₂, Exponential x y₁ → Exponential x y₂ → y₁ = y₂ by
    intro x y₁ h₁ h₂ hy; exact this x h₂.lt y₁ hy h₁ h₂
  induction y₂ using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind y₂ IH =>
    intro x _ y₁ h h₁ h₂
    rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    · simp [h₁.zero_uniq, h₂.zero_uniq]
    · rcases exponential_succ.mp h₁ with ⟨y₁, rfl, h₁'⟩
      rcases exponential_succ.mp h₂ with ⟨y₂, rfl, h₂'⟩
      have : y₁ = y₂ := IH y₂ (lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt_left h₂'.range_pos one_lt_two)
        x h₂'.lt y₁ (by simpa using h) h₁' h₂'
      simp [this]

name: inj
statement: protected lemma inj {x₁ x₂ y : V} : Exponential x₁ y → Exponential x₂ y → x₁ = x₂
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  revert x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂
  suffices ∀ x₁ < y, ∀ x₂ < y, Exponential x₁ y → Exponential x₂ y → x₁ = x₂ by
    intro x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂; exact this x₁ h₁.lt x₂ h₂.lt h₁ h₂
  induction y using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind y IH =>
    intro x₁ _ x₂ _ h₁ h₂
    rcases zero_or_succ x₁ with (rfl | ⟨x₁, rfl⟩) <;> rcases zero_or_succ x₂ with (rfl | ⟨x₂, rfl⟩)
    · rfl
    · rcases h₁.zero_uniq
      rcases exponential_succ.mp h₂ with ⟨z, hz⟩
      simp at hz
    · rcases h₂.zero_uniq
      rcases exponential_succ.mp h₁ with ⟨z, hz⟩
      simp at hz
    · rcases exponential_succ.mp h₁ with ⟨y, rfl, hy₁⟩
      have hy₂ : Exponential x₂ y := h₂.of_succ_two_mul
      have : x₁ = x₂ :=
        IH y (lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt_left hy₁.range_pos one_lt_two)
          x₁ hy₁.lt x₂ hy₂.lt hy₁ hy₂
      simp [this]

name: exponential_elim
statement: lemma exponential_elim {x y : V} : Exponential x y ↔ (x = 0 ∧ y = 1) ∨ ∃ x', ∃ y', x = x' + 1 ∧ y = 2 * y' ∧ Exponential x' y'
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨x', rfl⟩)
      · simp [h.zero_uniq]
      · right; rcases exponential_succ.mp h with ⟨y', rfl, H⟩
        exact ⟨x', y', rfl, rfl, H⟩,
   by rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, y, rfl, rfl, h⟩)
      · simp
      · exact h.succ⟩

name: monotone
statement: lemma monotone {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} : Exponential x₁ y₁ → Exponential x₂ y₂ → x₁ < x₂ → y₁ < y₂
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x₁ < y₁, ∀ y₂ ≤ y₁, ∀ x₂ < y₂, Exponential x₁ y₁ → Exponential x₂ y₂ → x₂ ≤ x₁ by
    intro h₁ h₂
    suffices y₂ ≤ y₁ → x₂ ≤ x₁ by contrapose; simpa
    intro hy
    exact this x₁ h₁.lt y₂ hy x₂ h₂.lt h₁ h₂
  induction y₁ using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind y₁ IH =>
    intro x₁ _ y₂ hy x₂ _ h₁ h₂
    rcases zero_or_succ x₁ with (rfl | ⟨x₁, rfl⟩) <;> rcases zero_or_succ x₂ with (rfl | ⟨x₂, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · rcases show y₁ = 1 from h₁.zero_uniq
      rcases le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hy with (rfl | rfl)
      · have := h₂.range_pos; simp at this
      · exact False.elim <| not_lt.mpr h₂.succ_lt_s one_lt_two
    · simp
    · rcases exponential_succ.mp h₁ with ⟨y₁, rfl, h₁'⟩
      rcases exponential_succ.mp h₂ with ⟨y₂, rfl, h₂'⟩
      have : x₂ ≤ x₁ := IH y₁ (lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt_left h₁'.range_pos one_lt_two)
        x₁ h₁'.lt y₂ (le_of_mul_le_mul_left hy (by simp)) x₂ h₂'.lt h₁' h₂'
      simpa using this

name: monotone_le
statement: lemma monotone_le {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} (h₁ : Exponential x₁ y₁) (h₂ : Exponential x₂ y₂) : x₁ ≤ x₂ → y₁ ≤ y₂
proof:
:= by
  rintro (rfl | h)
  · exact (h₁.uniq h₂).le
  · exact le_of_lt (monotone h₁ h₂ h)

name: monotone_iff
statement: lemma monotone_iff {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} (h₁ : Exponential x₁ y₁) (h₂ : Exponential x₂ y₂) : x₁ < x₂ ↔ y₁ < y₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact monotone h₁ h₂
  · contrapose; simpa using monotone_le h₂ h₁

name: monotone_le_iff
statement: lemma monotone_le_iff {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} (h₁ : Exponential x₁ y₁) (h₂ : Exponential x₂ y₂) : x₁ ≤ x₂ ↔ y₁ ≤ y₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact monotone_le h₁ h₂
  · contrapose; simpa using monotone h₂ h₁

name: add_mul
statement: lemma add_mul {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : V} (h₁ : Exponential x₁ y₁) (h₂ : Exponential x₂ y₂) : Exponential (x₁ + x₂) (y₁ * y₂)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hy : y₁ ≥ y₂
  · simpa [add_comm, mul_comm] using this h₂ h₁ (le_of_not_ge hy)
  revert y₂
  suffices ∀ y₂ ≤ y₁, Exponential x₂ y₂ → Exponential (x₁ + x₂) (y₁ * y₂) by
    intro y₂ h₂ hy; exact this y₂ hy h₂
  induction x₂ using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    intro y₂ _ h₂
    simpa [show y₂ = 1 from h₂.zero_uniq] using h₁
  case succ x₂ IH =>
    intro y₂ hy h₂
    rcases exponential_succ.mp h₂ with ⟨y₂, rfl, H₂⟩
    have : Exponential (x₁ + x₂) (y₁ * y₂) := IH y₂ (le_trans (by simp) hy) H₂
    simpa [←add_assoc, mul_left_comm y₁ 2 y₂] using this.succ

name: range_exists
statement: lemma range_exists (x : V) : ∃ y, Exponential x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  case succ x IH =>
    rcases IH with ⟨y, IH⟩
    exact ⟨2 * y, IH.succ⟩

name: range_exists_unique
statement: lemma range_exists_unique (x : V) : ∃! y, Exponential x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases range_exists x with ⟨y, h⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro y h (by intro y' h'; exact h'.uniq h)

name: exponential_exp
statement: lemma exponential_exp (a : V) : Exponential a (Exp.exp a)

name: exponential_graph
statement: lemma exponential_graph {a b : V} : a = Exp.exp b ↔ Exponential b a

name: exp_of_exponential
statement: lemma exp_of_exponential {a b : V} (h : Exponential a b) : Exp.exp a = b

name: exp_inj
statement: lemma exp_inj : Function.Injective (Exp.exp : V → V)

name: exp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_zero : Exp.exp (0 : V) = 1

name: exp_one
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_one : Exp.exp (1 : V) = 2

name: exp_succ
statement: lemma exp_succ (a : V) : Exp.exp (a + 1) = 2 * Exp.exp a

name: exp_even
statement: lemma exp_even (a : V) : Exp.exp (2 * a) = (Exp.exp a)^2

name: lt_exp
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_exp (a : V) : a < Exp.exp a

name: exp_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_pos (a : V) : 0 < Exp.exp a

name: one_le_exp
statement: @[simp] lemma one_le_exp (a : V) : 1 ≤ Exp.exp a

name: exp_pow2
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_pow2 (a : V) : Pow2 (Exp.exp a)

name: exp_monotone
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_monotone {a b : V} : Exp.exp a < Exp.exp b ↔ a < b

name: exp_monotone_le
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_monotone_le {a b : V} : Exp.exp a ≤ Exp.exp b ↔ a ≤ b

name: nat_cast_exp
statement: lemma nat_cast_exp (n : ℕ) : (Exp.exp n : ℕ) = Exp.exp (n : V)
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih
  · simp
  · simp [exp_succ, ih]

name: exp_nat_eq_two_pow
statement: lemma exp_nat_eq_two_pow (n : ℕ) : Exp.exp n = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => grind [exp_succ]

name: mem_absolute
statement: lemma mem_absolute (i a : ℕ) : i ∈ a ↔ (i : V) ∈ (a : V)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Defined.shigmaZero_absolute V bit_defined bit_defined ![i, a]

name: mem_iff_bit
statement: lemma mem_iff_bit {i a : V} : i ∈ a ↔ Bit i a

name: not_mem_of_lt_exp

proof: := fun H ↦ by have := lt_of_le_of_lt (exp_le_of_mem H) h; simp at this

name: HierarchySymbol.Definable.ball_mem
proof:
:= by
  have : Γ-[m + 1].Definable (fun v ↦ ∀ x < f v, x ∈ f v → P v x) :=
    .ball_lt hf (.imp (HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂ (P := (· ∈ ·)) (.var 0) (hf.retraction Fin.succ)) h)
  exact this.of_iff <| by intro v; exact ⟨fun h x _ hxv ↦ h x hxv, fun h x hx ↦ h x (lt_of_mem hx) hx⟩

name: HierarchySymbol.Definable.bexs_mem
proof:
:= by
  have : Γ-[m + 1].Definable (fun v ↦ ∃ x < f v, x ∈ f v ∧ P v x) :=
    .bexs_lt hf (.and (HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂ (P := (· ∈ ·)) (.var 0) (hf.retraction _)) h)
  exact this.of_iff <| by
    intro v; exact ⟨by rintro ⟨x, hx, hxv⟩; exact ⟨x, lt_of_mem hx, hx, hxv⟩, by rintro ⟨x, _, hx, hvx⟩; exact ⟨x, hx, hvx⟩⟩

name: eval_ballIn
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_ballIn {t : ArithmeticSemiterm ξ n} {φ : ArithmeticSemiformula ξ (n + 1)} {bv : Fin n → V} {fv : ξ → V} :
    (ballIn t φ).Eval (M := V) bv fv ↔ ∀ x ∈ t.val bv fv, φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    (∀ x < t.val bv fv, x ∈ t.val bv fv → φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv) ↔
    ∀ x ∈ t.val bv fv, φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv by simpa [ballIn]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx; exact h x (lt_of_mem hx) hx
  · intro h x _ hx; exact h x hx

name: eval_bexsIn
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_bexsIn {t : ArithmeticSemiterm ξ n} {φ : ArithmeticSemiformula ξ (n + 1)} {bv : Fin n → V} {fv : ξ → V} :
    (bexsIn t φ).Eval (M := V) bv fv ↔ ∃ x ∈ t.val bv fv, φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    (∃ x < t.val bv fv, x ∈ t.val bv fv ∧ φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv) ↔
    ∃ x ∈ t.val bv fv, φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv by simpa [bexsIn]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, _, hx, h⟩; exact ⟨x, hx, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, h⟩; exact ⟨x, lt_of_mem hx, hx, h⟩

name: mem_iff_mul_exp_add_exp_add
statement: lemma mem_iff_mul_exp_add_exp_add {i a : V} : i ∈ a ↔ ∃ k, ∃ r < Exp.exp i, a = k * Exp.exp (i + 1) + Exp.exp i + r
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mem_iff_bit, exp_succ] using! lenbit_iff_add_mul (exp_pow2 i) (a := a)

name: not_mem_iff_mul_exp_add

proof:

  simpa [mem_iff_bit, exp_succ] using! not_lenbit_iff_add_mul (exp_pow2 i) (a := a)

statement: lemma insert_eq {i a : V} : insert i a = bitInsert i a

name: singleton_eq_insert

name: mem_bitInsert_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_bitInsert_iff {i j a : V} :
    i ∈ insert j a ↔ i = j ∨ i ∈ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : j ∈ a <;> simp [h, insert_eq, bitInsert]
  · by_cases e : i = j <;> simp [h, e]
  · simpa [exp_inj.eq_iff] using!
      lenbit_add_pow2_iff_of_not_lenbit (exp_pow2 i) (exp_pow2 j) h

name: mem_bitRemove_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_bitRemove_iff {i j a : V} :
    i ∈ bitRemove j a ↔ i ≠ j ∧ i ∈ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : j ∈ a
  · simpa [h, bitRemove, exp_inj.eq_iff] using!
      lenbit_sub_pow2_iff_of_lenbit (exp_pow2 i) (exp_pow2 j) h
  · simp only [bitRemove, h, ↓reduceIte, ne_eq, iff_and_self]
    rintro _ rfl; contradiction

name: not_mem_bitRemove_self
statement: @[simp] lemma not_mem_bitRemove_self (i a : V) : i ∉ bitRemove i a

name: insert_graph
statement:
lemma insert_graph (b i a : V) :
    b = insert i a ↔ (i ∈ a ∧ b = a) ∨ (i ∉ a ∧ ∃ e ≤ b, e = Exp.exp i ∧ b = a + e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; by_cases hi : i ∈ a <;> simp [hi, insert, bitInsert],
   by by_cases hi : i ∈ a <;> simp only [hi, true_and, not_true_eq_false, false_and,
        or_false, insert, bitInsert, ↓reduceIte, imp_self,
        not_false_eq_true, true_and, false_or, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
      rintro x _ rfl rfl; rfl ⟩

name: insert_le_of_le_of_le
statement: lemma insert_le_of_le_of_le {i j a b : V} (hij : i ≤ j) (hab : a ≤ b) : insert i a ≤ b + Exp.exp j
proof:
:= by
  suffices (if i ∈ a then a else a + Exp.exp i) ≤ b + Exp.exp j by simpa [insert, bitInsert]
  by_cases hi : i ∈ a
  · simpa [hi] using le_trans hab (by simp)
  · simpa [hi] using add_le_add hab (exp_monotone_le.mpr hij)

name: insert_absolute
statement:
lemma insert_absolute (x s : ℕ) :
    ((insert x s : ℕ) : V) = insert (x : V) (s : V)
proof:
:= by
  have := DefinedFunction.shigmaZero_absolute_func V (k := 2) (f := fun v ↦ insert (v 0) (v 1)) (f' := fun v ↦ insert (v 0) (v 1))
      (φ := insertDef) insert_defined insert_defined ![x, s]
  simpa using this

statement: lemma bitRemove_lt_of_mem {i a : V} (h : i ∈ a) : bitRemove i a < a

name: mem_insert
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_insert (i a : V) : i ∈ insert i a

statement: lemma insert_eq_self_of_mem {i a : V} (h : i ∈ a) : insert i a = a

name: log_mem_of_pos
statement: lemma log_mem_of_pos {a : V} (h : 0 < a) : log a ∈ a
proof:
:=
  mem_iff_mul_exp_add_exp_add.mpr
    ⟨0, a - Exp.exp (log a),
      (tsub_lt_iff_left (exp_log_le_self h)).mpr (by rw [←two_mul]; exact lt_two_mul_exponential_log h),
      by simpa using Eq.symm <| add_tsub_self_of_le (exp_log_le_self h)⟩

name: le_log_of_mem
statement: lemma le_log_of_mem {i a : V} (h : i ∈ a) : i ≤ log a

name: succ_mem_iff_mem_div_two
statement: lemma succ_mem_iff_mem_div_two {i a : V} : i + 1 ∈ a ↔ i ∈ a / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_iff_bit, Bit, LenBit.iff_rem, exp_succ, Arithmetic.div_mul]

name: lt_length_of_mem
statement: lemma lt_length_of_mem {i a : V} (h : i ∈ a) : i < ‖a‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa [length_of_pos (pos_of_nonempty h), ←le_iff_lt_succ] using le_log_of_mem h

name: lt_exp_iff
statement: lemma lt_exp_iff {a i : V} : a < Exp.exp i ↔ ∀ j ∈ a, j < i
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h j hj ↦ exp_monotone.mp <| lt_of_le_of_lt (exp_le_of_mem hj) h,
   by suffices Exp.exp i ≤ a → ∃ x ∈ a, i ≤ x by contrapose; simpa
      intro h
      have pos : 0 < a := lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) h
      exact ⟨log a, log_mem_of_pos pos, (exp_le_iff_le_log pos).mp h⟩⟩

name: subset_iff
statement: lemma subset_iff {a b : V} : a ⊆ b ↔ (∀ x ∈ a, x ∈ b)

name: subset_refl
statement: @[refl, simp] lemma subset_refl (a : V) : a ⊆ a

name: subset_trans
statement: @[trans] lemma subset_trans {a b c : V} (hab : a ⊆ b) (hbc : b ⊆ c) : a ⊆ c
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx; exact hbc (hab hx)

name: mem_exp_add_succ_sub_one
statement: lemma mem_exp_add_succ_sub_one (i j : V) : i ∈ Exp.exp (i + j + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Exp.exp (i + j + 1) - 1 = (Exp.exp j - 1) * Exp.exp (i + 1) + Exp.exp i + (Exp.exp i - 1) := calc
    Exp.exp (i + j + 1) - 1 = Exp.exp j * Exp.exp (i + 1) - 1                             := by simp [exp_add, ←mul_assoc, mul_comm]
    _                   = Exp.exp j * Exp.exp (i + 1) - Exp.exp (i + 1) + Exp.exp (i + 1) - 1 := by rw [sub_add_self_of_le]; exact le_mul_of_pos_left (exp_pos j)
    _                   = (Exp.exp j - 1) * Exp.exp (i + 1) + Exp.exp (i + 1) - 1         := by simp [sub_mul]
    _                   = (Exp.exp j - 1) * Exp.exp (i + 1) + (Exp.exp i + Exp.exp i) - 1     := by simp [←two_mul, ←exp_succ i]
    _                   = (Exp.exp j - 1) * Exp.exp (i + 1) + (Exp.exp i + Exp.exp i - 1)     := by rw [add_tsub_assoc_of_le]; simp [←two_mul, ←pos_iff_one_le]
    _                   = (Exp.exp j - 1) * Exp.exp (i + 1) + Exp.exp i + (Exp.exp i - 1)     := by simp [add_assoc, add_tsub_assoc_of_le]
  exact mem_iff_mul_exp_add_exp_add.mpr ⟨Exp.exp j - 1, Exp.exp i - 1, (tsub_lt_iff_left (by simp)).mpr $ by simp, this⟩

name: le_under
statement: @[simp] lemma le_under (a : V) : a ≤ under a
proof:
:=
  le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by simp [under, show Exp.exp a - 1 + 1 = Exp.exp a from sub_add_self_of_le (by simp)])

name: mem_under_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_under_iff {i j : V} : i ∈ under j ↔ i < j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : Exp.exp i < Exp.exp j := calc
      Exp.exp i ≤ Exp.exp j - 1 := exp_le_of_mem h
      _     < Exp.exp j     := pred_lt_self_of_pos (exp_pos j)
    exact exp_monotone.mp this
  · intro lt
    have := lt_iff_succ_le.mp lt
    let k := j - (i + 1)
    have : j = i + k + 1 := calc
      j = i + (j - i)         := by rw [add_tsub_self_of_le (le_of_lt lt)]
      _ = i + (j - i - 1 + 1) := by rw [sub_add_self_of_le <| le_tsub_of_add_le_left <| lt_iff_succ_le.mp lt]
      _ = i + k + 1           := by simp [add_assoc, ←Arithmetic.sub_sub, k]
    rw [this]; exact mem_exp_add_succ_sub_one i k

name: not_mem_under_self
statement: @[simp] lemma not_mem_under_self (i : V) : i ∉ under i

name: under_graph
statement: private lemma under_graph (x y : V) : y = under x ↔ y + 1 = Exp.exp x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl; simp [under, sub_add_self_of_le]
  · intro h
    have := congr_arg (· - 1) h
    simpa [under] using this

name: eq_zero_of_subset_zero
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_subset_zero {a : V} : a ⊆ 0 → a = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h; by_contra A
  have : log a ∈ (0 : V) := h (log_mem_of_pos (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr A))
  simp_all

name: subset_div_two
statement: lemma subset_div_two {a b : V} : a ⊆ b → a / 2 ⊆ b / 2
proof:
:= by
  intro ss i hi
  have : i + 1 ∈ a := succ_mem_iff_mem_div_two.mpr hi
  exact succ_mem_iff_mem_div_two.mp <| ss this

name: zero_mem_iff
statement: lemma zero_mem_iff {a : V} : 0 ∉ a ↔ 2 ∣ a

name: zero_not_mem
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_not_mem (a : V) : 0 ∉ 2 * a

name: zero_mem_double_add_one
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_mem_double_add_one (a : V) : 0 ∈ 2 * a + 1

name: succ_mem_two_mul_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma succ_mem_two_mul_iff {i a : V} : i + 1 ∈ 2 * a ↔ i ∈ a
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_iff_bit, Bit, LenBit, exp_succ, div_cancel_left]

name: succ_mem_two_mul_succ_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma succ_mem_two_mul_succ_iff {i a : V} : i + 1 ∈ 2 * a + 1 ↔ i ∈ a
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_iff_bit, Bit, LenBit, exp_succ, Arithmetic.div_mul]

name: le_of_subset
statement: lemma le_of_subset {a b : V} (h : a ⊆ b) : a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  induction b using pi1_polynomial_induction generalizing a
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simp [eq_zero_of_subset_zero h]
  case even b _ IH =>
    have IH : a / 2 ≤ b := IH (by simpa using subset_div_two h)
    have : 2 * (a / 2) = a :=
      mul_div_self_of_dvd.mpr (zero_mem_iff.mp $ by intro ha; have : 0 ∈ 2 * b := h ha; simp_all)
    simpa [this] using mul_le_mul_left (a := 2) IH
  case odd b IH =>
    have IH : a / 2 ≤ b := IH (by simpa [div_mul_add' b 2 one_lt_two] using subset_div_two h)
    exact le_trans (le_two_mul_div_two_add_one a) (by simpa using IH)

name: mem_ext
statement: lemma mem_ext {a b : V} (h : ∀ i, i ∈ a ↔ i ∈ b) : a = b
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_of_subset fun i hi ↦ (h i).mp hi) (le_of_subset fun i hi ↦ (h i).mpr hi)

name: mem_ext_iff
statement: lemma mem_ext_iff {a b : V} : a = b ↔ ∀ i, i ∈ a ↔ i ∈ b

statement: lemma pos_iff_nonempty {s : V} : 0 < s ↔ s ≠ ∅

name: nonempty_of_pos
statement: lemma nonempty_of_pos {a : V} (h : 0 < a) : ∃ i, i ∈ a
proof:
:= by

  have : a = 0 := mem_ext (by simpa using A)
  simp [this] at h

name: eq_empty_or_nonempty
statement: lemma eq_empty_or_nonempty (a : V) : a = ∅ ∨ ∃ i, i ∈ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp [emptyset_def]
  · right; exact nonempty_of_pos pos

name: nonempty_iff
statement: lemma nonempty_iff {s : V} : s ≠ ∅ ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with ⟨rfl, hy⟩
  · simp
  · simpa [show s ≠ ∅ from by rintro rfl; simp_all]

name: isempty_iff
statement: lemma isempty_iff {s : V} : s = ∅ ↔ ∀ x, x ∉ s

name: empty_subset
statement: @[simp] lemma empty_subset (s : V) : ∅ ⊆ s

name: lt_of_lt_log
statement: lemma lt_of_lt_log {a b : V} (pos : 0 < b) (h : ∀ i ∈ a, i < log b) : a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | apos)
  · exact pos
  by_contra A
  exact not_lt_of_ge (log_monotone <| show b ≤ a by simpa using A) (h (log a) (log_mem_of_pos apos))

name: under_inj
statement: @[simp] lemma under_inj {i j : V} : under i = under j ↔ i = j
proof:
:= ⟨fun h ↦ by
  by_contra ne
  wlog lt : i < j
  · exact this (Eq.symm h) (Ne.symm ne) (lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa using lt) (Ne.symm ne))
  have : i ∉ under i := by simp
  have : i ∈ under i := by rw [h]; simp [mem_under_iff, lt]
  contradiction, by rintro rfl; simp⟩

name: under_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma under_zero : under (0 : V) = ∅

name: under_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma under_succ (i : V) : under (i + 1) = insert i (under i)

name: insert_remove
statement: lemma insert_remove {i a : V} (h : i ∈ a) : insert i (bitRemove i a) = a
proof:
:= mem_ext <| by
  suffices ∀ j, j = i ∨ j ≠ i ∧ j ∈ a ↔ j ∈ a by simpa
  intro j
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨_, hj⟩) <;> assumption
  · intro hj; simp [hj, eq_or_ne j i]

name: finset_comprehension_aux
statement:
lemma finset_comprehension_aux (Γ : Polarity) {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[m]-Predicate P) (a : V) :
  haveI : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁
proof:
:= mod_ISigma_of_le (show 1 ≤ m from Fact.out)
  ∃ s < Exp.exp a, ∀ i < a, i ∈ s ↔ P i := by
  have : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁ := mod_ISigma_of_le (show 1 ≤ m from Fact.out)
  have : ∃ s < Exp.exp a, ∀ i < a, P i → i ∈ s :=
    ⟨under a, pred_lt_self_of_pos (by simp), fun i hi _ ↦ by simpa [mem_under_iff] using hi⟩
  rcases this with ⟨s, hsn, hs⟩
  have : Γ.alt-[m]-Predicate (fun s : V ↦ ∀ i < a, P i → i ∈ s) := by
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.ball_blt
    · simp
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.imp
    · simpa using HierarchySymbol.Definable.bcomp₁ (by definability)
    · simpa using HierarchySymbol.Definable.bcomp₂ (by definability) (by definability)
  have : ∃ t, (∀ i < a, P i → i ∈ t) ∧ ∀ t' < t, ∃ x < a, P x ∧ x ∉ (t' : V) := by
    simpa using InductionOnHierarchy.least_number Γ.alt m this hs
  rcases this with ⟨t, ht, t_minimal⟩
  have t_le_s : t ≤ s := not_lt.mp (by
    intro lt
    rcases t_minimal s lt with ⟨i, hin, hi, his⟩
    exact his (hs i hin hi))
  have : ∀ i < a, i ∈ t → P i := by
    intro i _ hit
    by_contra Hi
    have : ∃ j < a, P j ∧ (j ∈ t → j = i) := by
      simpa [not_imp_not] using t_minimal (bitRemove i t) (bitRemove_lt_of_mem hit)
    rcases this with ⟨j, hjn, Hj, hm⟩
    rcases hm (ht j hjn Hj); contradiction
  exact ⟨t, lt_of_le_of_lt t_le_s hsn, fun i hi ↦ ⟨this i hi, ht i hi⟩⟩

name: finset_comprehension
statement:
theorem finset_comprehension {Γ} {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[m]-Predicate P) (a : V) :
    haveI : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁
proof:
:= mod_ISigma_of_le (show 1 ≤ m from Fact.out)
    ∃ s < Exp.exp a, ∀ i < a, i ∈ s ↔ P i :=
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => finset_comprehension_aux 𝚺 hP a
  | 𝚷 => finset_comprehension_aux 𝚷 hP a
  | 𝚫 => finset_comprehension_aux 𝚺 hP.of_delta a

name: finset_comprehension_exists_unique
statement:
theorem finset_comprehension_exists_unique {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[m]-Predicate P) (a : V) :
    haveI : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁
proof:
:= mod_ISigma_of_le (show 1 ≤ m from Fact.out)
    ∃! s, s < Exp.exp a ∧ ∀ i < a, i ∈ s ↔ P i := by
  have : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁ := mod_ISigma_of_le (show 1 ≤ m from Fact.out)
  rcases finset_comprehension hP a with ⟨s, hs, Hs⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro s ⟨hs, Hs⟩ (by
    intro t ⟨ht, Ht⟩
    apply mem_ext
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      have hin : i < a := exp_monotone.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (exp_le_of_mem hi) ht)
      exact (Hs i hin).mpr ((Ht i hin).mp hi)
    · intro hi
      have hin : i < a := exp_monotone.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (exp_le_of_mem hi) hs)
      exact (Ht i hin).mpr ((Hs i hin).mp hi))

name: finset_comprehension
statement:
theorem finset_comprehension₁ {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P) (a : V) :
    ∃ s < Exp.exp a, ∀ i < a, i ∈ s ↔ P i

name: finset_comprehension
statement:
theorem finset_comprehension₁! {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P) (a : V) :
    ∃! s, s < Exp.exp a ∧ (∀ i < a, i ∈ s ↔ P i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases finset_comprehension₁ hP a with ⟨s, hs, Ha⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro s ⟨hs, Ha⟩
    (by
      rintro b ⟨hb, Hb⟩
      apply mem_ext
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have : x < a := exp_monotone.mp <| LE.le.trans_lt (exp_le_of_mem hx) hb
        exact (Ha x this).mpr <| (Hb x this).mp hx
      · intro hx
        have : x < a := exp_monotone.mp <| LE.le.trans_lt (exp_le_of_mem hx) hs
        exact (Hb x this).mpr <| (Ha x this).mp hx)

name: finite_comprehension
statement:
theorem finite_comprehension₁! {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P) (fin : ∃ m, ∀ i, P i → i < m)  :
    ∃! s : V, ∀ i, i ∈ s ↔ P i
proof:
:= by
  rcases fin with ⟨m, mh⟩
  rcases finset_comprehension₁ hP m with ⟨s, hs, Hs⟩
  have H : ∀ i, i ∈ s ↔ P i :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨
      fun h ↦ (Hs i (exp_monotone.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (exp_le_of_mem h) hs))).mp h,
      fun h ↦ (Hs i (mh i h)).mpr h⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro s H (fun s' H' ↦ mem_ext <| fun i ↦ by simp [H, H'])

name: one_lt
statement: lemma one_lt (hm : SPPow2 m) {i : V} (hi : LenBit i m) : 1 < i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  rcases (le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp (show i ≤ 1 from by simpa using A)) with (rfl | rfl)
  · simp at hi
  · exact hm.1 hi

lemma sqrt (hm : SPPow2 m) {i : V} (hi : LenBit i m) (pi : Pow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) :

lemma sq_sqrt_eq (hm : SPPow2 m) {i : V} (hi : LenBit i m) (pi : Pow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) :

name: of_sqrt
statement:
lemma of_sqrt (hm : SPPow2 m) {i : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (him : i ≤ m) (hsqi : (√i)^2 = i) (hi : LenBit (√i) m) :
    LenBit i m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ne1 : i = 1
  · rcases ne1; simpa using hi
  · have ne2 : i ≠ 2 := by
      rintro rfl; simp [sqrt_two] at hsqi
    have : 2 < i := lt_of_le_of_ne
      (one_lt_iff_two_le.mp <| lt_of_le_of_ne (pos_iff_one_le.mp pi.pos) <| Ne.symm ne1) (Ne.symm ne2)
    exact (hm.lenbit_iff him pi this).mpr ⟨hsqi, hi⟩

name: two
statement: @[simp] lemma two : SPPow2 (2 : V)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [LenBit.one], by simp, by
    intro i hi pi
    rcases le_two_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two.mp hi with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp⟩

name: not_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma not_zero : ¬SPPow2 (0 : V)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, h, _⟩; simp at h

name: not_one
statement: @[simp] lemma not_one : ¬SPPow2 (1 : V)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, h, _⟩; simp [LenBit.iff_rem] at h

name: sq_le_of_lt
statement: lemma sq_le_of_lt (hm : SPPow2 m) {i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (hi : LenBit i m) (hj : LenBit j m) : i < j → i^2 ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  intro hij
  suffices ∀ i < j, Pow2 i → Pow2 j → LenBit i m → LenBit j m → i^2 ≤ j from this i hij pi pj hi hj
  clear i pi hi hij pj hj
  induction j using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind j IH =>
    intro i hij pi pj  hi hj
    by_cases jne2 : j = 2
    · rcases jne2 with rfl
      have : 2 ≤ i := one_lt_iff_two_le.mp (hm.one_lt hi)
      exact False.elim ((not_lt.mpr this) hij)
    · by_cases ine2 : i = 2
      · rcases ine2 with rfl
        simpa [sq, two_mul_two_eq_four] using pj.four_le hij
      · have : √i < √j := by
          by_contra A
          have : j ≤ i := by
            simpa [hm.sq_sqrt_eq hi pi ine2, hm.sq_sqrt_eq hj pj jne2] using
              sq_le_sq.mpr (show √j ≤ √i from by simpa using A)
          exact False.elim ((not_lt.mpr this) (by simpa using hij))
        have : i ≤ √j := by
          simpa [hm.sq_sqrt_eq hi pi ine2] using
            IH (√j) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt (hm.one_lt hj)) (√i) this
              (pi.sqrt (hm.sq_sqrt_eq hi pi ine2)) (pj.sqrt (hm.sq_sqrt_eq hj pj jne2)) (hm.sqrt hi pi ine2) (hm.sqrt hj pj jne2)
        simpa [hm.sq_sqrt_eq hj pj jne2] using sq_le_sq.mpr this

name: last_uniq
statement:
lemma last_uniq (hm : SPPow2 m) {i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (hi : LenBit i m) (hj : LenBit j m)
    (hsqi : m < i^2) (hsqj : m < j^2) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ne
  wlog hij : i < j
  · exact this hm pj pi hj hi hsqj hsqi (Ne.symm ne) (lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa using hij) (Ne.symm ne))
  have : i^2 ≤ m := le_trans  (hm.sq_le_of_lt pi pj hi hj hij) hj.le
  have ltsqi : 2 < i^2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (one_lt_iff_two_le.mp $ by simpa using hm.one_lt hi) (by simp)
  have : LenBit (i^2) m ↔ LenBit i m := by simpa using hm.lenbit_iff this pi.sq ltsqi
  have : LenBit (i^2) m := this.mpr hi
  have : ¬m < i^2 := by simpa using this.le
  contradiction

name: pow2
statement: lemma pow2 {i : V} (h : PPow2 i) : Pow2 i

name: pos
statement: lemma pos {i : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) : 0 < i

name: one_lt
statement: lemma one_lt {i : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) : 1 < i
proof:
:= by
  rcases ppi with ⟨_, m, _, sppm, lb⟩; exact sppm.one_lt lb

name: sq_sqrt_eq
statement: lemma sq_sqrt_eq {i : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) : (√i)^2 = i
proof:
:= by
  rcases ppi with ⟨pi, m, _, sppm, lb⟩
  exact ((sppm.lenbit_iff lb.le pi (lt_of_le_of_ne (one_lt_iff_two_le.mp $ sppm.one_lt lb) (Ne.symm ne2))).mp lb).1

name: sqrt
statement: lemma sqrt {i : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) : PPow2 (√i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ppi with ⟨pi, m, _, sppm, him⟩
  have : LenBit i m ↔ (√i)^2 = i ∧ LenBit (√i) m :=
    sppm.lenbit_iff him.le pi (lt_of_le_of_ne (one_lt_iff_two_le.mp $ sppm.one_lt him) (Ne.symm ne2))
  rcases this.mp him with ⟨e, H⟩
  have psqi : Pow2 (√i) := Pow2.sq_iff.mp (by simp [e, pi])
  have one_lt_sqi : 1 < √i := one_lt_sq_iff.mp (by simpa [e] using sppm.one_lt him)
  have : SPPow2 (m % (2 * √i)) :=
    ⟨ by simpa [LenBit.mod] using sppm.not_lenbit_one,
      (LenBit.mod_pow2 (by simp) (by simp [psqi]) (by simp [one_lt_sqi])).mpr sppm.lenbit_two,
      by  intro j hj pj lt2
          have hjsi : j < 2 * √i := lt_of_le_of_lt hj <| mod_lt _ <| by simp [psqi.pos]
          have hjm : LenBit j m ↔ (√j) ^ 2 = j ∧ LenBit (√j) m := sppm.lenbit_iff (le_trans hj (by simp)) pj lt2
          have : LenBit j (m % (2 * √i)) ↔ LenBit j m := LenBit.mod_pow2 pj (by simp [psqi]) (by simp [hjsi])
          calc
            LenBit j (m % (2 * √i)) ↔ LenBit j m                                := LenBit.mod_pow2 pj
                                                                                     (by simp [psqi]) (by simp [hjsi])
            _                       ↔ (√j) ^ 2 = j ∧ LenBit (√j) m              := sppm.lenbit_iff (le_trans hj (by simp)) pj lt2
            _                       ↔ (√j) ^ 2 = j ∧ LenBit (√j) (m % (2 * √i)) := and_congr_right
                                                                                   <| fun hsqj ↦ Iff.symm
                                                                                     <| LenBit.mod_pow2 (pj.sqrt hsqj)
                                                                                       (by simp [psqi])
                                                                                       (lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp) hjsi) ⟩
  exact ⟨psqi, m % (2 * √i), mod_lt _ (by simp [psqi.pos]), this, by simp [H]⟩

name: exists_spp
statement: lemma exists_spp {i : V} (h : PPow2 i) : ∃ m < 2 * i, SPPow2 m ∧ LenBit i m

name: sq
statement: protected lemma sq {i : V} (ppi : PPow2 i) : PPow2 (i^2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases ppi.exists_spp with ⟨m, hm, sppm, hi⟩
  have sppm' : SPPow2 (m + i^2) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [LenBit.add_pow2] <;> simp [ppi.pow2, sppm.not_lenbit_one, sppm.one_lt hi]
    · have : i ≠ 1 := by rintro rfl; exact sppm.not_lenbit_one hi
      have : 2 < i^2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (ppi.pow2.sq.two_le <| by simp [this]) (by simp)
      rw [LenBit.add_pow2] <;> simp [ppi.pow2, sppm.lenbit_two, this]
    · intro j hj pj lt2
      have hsqi : i < i^2 := lt_square_of_lt ppi.one_lt
      have hmi : m < i^2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hm <| two_mul_le_sq <| one_lt_iff_two_le.mp <| sppm.one_lt hi
      calc
        LenBit j (m + i^2) ↔ j = i^2 ∨ LenBit j m                   := LenBit.add_pow2_iff_of_lt pj (by simpa using ppi.pow2) hmi
        _                  ↔ (√j) ^ 2 = j ∧ LenBit (√j) (m + i ^ 2) := ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro (rfl | hj)
        · simp only [sqrt_sq, true_and]; rw [LenBit.add_pow2] <;> simp [hi, ppi.pow2, hsqi]
        · have : (√j)^2 = j := sppm.sq_sqrt_eq hj pj (ne_of_gt lt2)
          rw [LenBit.add_pow2_iff_of_lt] <;> try simp [ppi.pow2, pj.sqrt this, hmi]
          simp [sppm.sqrt hj pj (ne_of_gt lt2), this]
      · rintro ⟨ej, lb⟩
        have hsqj : √j < i^2 := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := 2) (by calc
          2 * √j ≤ (√j)^2  := two_mul_le_sq
                                  (one_lt_iff_two_le.mp <| one_lt_sq_iff.mp <| by
                                    rw [ej]; exact lt_trans one_lt_two lt2)
          _      ≤ j       := by simp
          _      ≤ m + i^2 := hj
          _      < 2 * i^2 := by simp [two_mul, hmi])
        have hsqj : LenBit (√j) m := (LenBit.add_pow2 (pj.sqrt ej) ppi.pow2.sq hsqj).mp lb
        by_cases hjm : j ≤ m
        · exact Or.inr <| sppm.of_sqrt pj hjm ej hsqj
        · have : i = √j := sppm.last_uniq ppi.pow2 (pj.sqrt ej) hi hsqj hmi (by simpa [ej] using hjm)
          left; simp [this, ej]
  by_cases ne1 : i = 1
  · rcases ne1; simpa using ppi
  have : m < i^2 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hm
      (two_mul_le_sq $ one_lt_iff_two_le.mp $ lt_of_le_of_ne (pos_iff_one_le.mp $ ppi.pos) (Ne.symm ne1))
  exact ⟨ppi.pow2.sq, m + i^2,
    by simp [two_mul, this],
    sppm', LenBit.add_self this⟩

name: elim
statement: lemma elim {i : V} : PPow2 i ↔ i = 2 ∨ ∃ b, i = b^2 ∧ PPow2 b

  by_cases ei : i = 2
  · rcases ei with rfl; simp
  · simp only [ei, false_or]
    constructor
    · rintro ppi
      exact ⟨√i, Eq.symm <| ppi.sq_sqrt_eq ei, ppi.sqrt ei⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl, ppj⟩
      exact ppj.sq

:= by
  by_cases ha : 2 < i
  · simp [ha, ←elim]
  · have : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by simpa [le_two_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two] using ha
    rcases this with (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp

  rcases le_three_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two_or_three.mp this with (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp at ne hi
  · have : PPow2 (1 : V) := by simpa [sqrt_three] using hi.sqrt (by simp)
    simp at this

:= by

  exact not_le.mpr this hi.two_le

name: sqrt_ne_two
statement: lemma sqrt_ne_two {i : V} (hi : PPow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) (ne4 : i ≠ 4) : √i ≠ 2

statement: lemma sq_ne_four {i : V} (hi : PPow2 i) (ne2 : i ≠ 2) : i^2 ≠ 4

name: sq_le_of_lt
statement: lemma sq_le_of_lt {i j : V} (hi : PPow2 i) (hj : PPow2 j) : i < j → i^2 ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  intro hij
  suffices ∀ i < j, PPow2 i → PPow2 j → i^2 ≤ j from this i hij hi hj
  clear hi hij hj
  induction j using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind j IH =>
    intro i hij hi hj
    by_cases ej : j = 2
    · have : 2 ≤ i := by simpa [one_add_one_eq_two] using lt_iff_succ_le.mp hi.one_lt
      exact False.elim ((not_lt.mpr this) (by simpa [ej] using hij))
    · by_cases ei : i = 2
      · rcases ei with rfl
        simpa [sq, two_mul_two_eq_four] using hj.four_le ej
      · have : √i < √j := by
          by_contra A
          have : j ≤ i := by simpa [hi.sq_sqrt_eq ei, hj.sq_sqrt_eq ej] using sq_le_sq.mpr (show √j ≤ √i from by simpa using A)
          exact False.elim ((not_lt.mpr this) (by simpa using hij))
        have : i ≤ √j := by
          simpa [hi.sq_sqrt_eq ei] using
            IH (√j) (sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt hj.one_lt) (√i) this (hi.sqrt ei) (hj.sqrt ej)
        simpa [hj.sq_sqrt_eq ej] using sq_le_sq.mpr this

name: sq_uniq
statement:
lemma sq_uniq {y i j : V} (py : Pow2 y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (ppj : PPow2 j)
    (hi : y < i ∧ i ≤ y^2) (hj : y < j ∧ j ≤ y^2) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ne
  wlog hij : i < j
  · exact this py ppj ppi hj hi (Ne.symm ne) (Ne.lt_of_le' ne (by simpa using hij))
  have : y^2 < y^2 := calc
    y^2 < i^2 := sq_lt_sq.mpr hi.1
    _   ≤ j   := sq_le_of_lt ppi ppj hij
    _   ≤ y^2 := hj.2
  simp_all

name: two_mul_sq_uniq
statement:
lemma two_mul_sq_uniq {y i j : V} (py : Pow2 y) (ppi : PPow2 i) (ppj : PPow2 j)
    (hi : y < i ∧ i ≤ 2 * y^2) (hj : y < j ∧ j ≤ 2 * y^2) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ne
  wlog hij : i < j
  · exact this py ppj ppi hj hi (Ne.symm ne) (Ne.lt_of_le' ne (by simpa using hij))
  have : i^2 < (2 * y)^2 := calc
    i^2 ≤ j                 := sq_le_of_lt ppi ppj hij
    _   ≤ 2 * y^2           := hj.2
    _   = 2 * (y * y)       := by simp [sq]
    _   < 2 * (2 * (y * y)) := lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt_left (by simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.mp py.pos) (by simp)
    _   = (2 * y)^2         := by simp [sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  have : i < 2 * y := sq_lt_sq.mp this
  have : y < y := lt_of_lt_of_le hi.1 ((ppi.pow2.le_iff_lt_two py).mpr this)
  simp_all

name: Pow2.dvd
statement: lemma Pow2.dvd {a : V} (h : Pow2 a) {r} (hr : r ≤ a) : 1 < r → r ∣ a → 2 ∣ r

name: pow2_one
statement: @[simp] lemma pow2_one : Pow2 (1 : V)
proof:
:= ⟨by simp, by
  intro r hr hhr hd
  rcases show r = 0 ∨ r = 1 from le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hr with (rfl | rfl)
  · simp
  · simp at hhr⟩

name: not_pow2_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma not_pow2_zero : ¬Pow2 (0 : V)
proof:
:= by
  intro h; have := h.pos; simp at this
