statement: lemma Pow2.two_dvd {a : V} (h : Pow2 a) (lt : 1 < a) : 2 ∣ a

name: Pow2.two_dvd'
statement: lemma Pow2.two_dvd' {a : V} (h : Pow2 a) (lt : a ≠ 1) : 2 ∣ a
proof:
:=
  h.dvd (le_refl _) (by
    by_contra A
    rcases show a = 0 ∨ a = 1 by simpa [le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one] using A
      with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp at h lt)
    (by simp)

name: Pow2.of_dvd
statement: lemma Pow2.of_dvd {a b : V} (h : b ∣ a) : Pow2 a → Pow2 b
proof:
:= by
  intro ha
  have : 0 < b := by
    by_contra e
    have : a = 0 := by simpa [show b = 0 from by simpa using e] using h
    rcases this with rfl
    simpa using ha.pos
  exact ⟨this, fun r hr ltr hb ↦
    ha.dvd (show r ≤ a from le_trans hr (le_of_dvd ha.pos h)) ltr (dvd_trans hb h)⟩

name: pow2_mul_two
statement: lemma pow2_mul_two {a : V} : Pow2 (2 * a) ↔ Pow2 a
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro H
      have : ∀ r ≤ a, 1 < r → r ∣ a → 2 ∣ r := by
        intro r hr ltr dvd
        exact H.dvd (show r ≤ 2 * a from le_trans hr (le_mul_of_one_le_left (by simp) one_le_two)) ltr (Dvd.dvd.mul_left dvd 2)
      exact ⟨by simpa using H.pos, this⟩,
   by intro H
      exact ⟨by simpa using H.pos, by
        intro r _ hr hd
        rcases two_prime.left_dvd_or_dvd_right_of_dvd_mul hd with (hd | hd)
        · exact hd
        · exact H.dvd (show r ≤ a from le_of_dvd H.pos hd) hr hd⟩⟩

name: pow2_mul_four
statement: lemma pow2_mul_four {a : V} : Pow2 (4 * a) ↔ Pow2 a

name: Pow2.elim
statement: lemma Pow2.elim {p : V} : Pow2 p ↔ p = 1 ∨ ∃ q, p = 2 * q ∧ Pow2 q
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro H
      by_cases hp : 1 < p
      · have : 2 ∣ p := H.two_dvd hp
        rcases this with ⟨q, rfl⟩
        right; exact ⟨q, rfl, pow2_mul_two.mp H⟩
      · have : p = 1 := le_antisymm (by simpa using hp) (pos_iff_one_le.mp H.pos)
        left; exact this,
   by rintro (rfl | ⟨q, rfl, hq⟩) <;> simp [pow2_one, pow2_mul_two, *]⟩

name: pow2_two
statement: @[simp] lemma pow2_two : Pow2 (2 : V)

name: Pow2.div_two
statement: lemma Pow2.div_two {p : V} (h : Pow2 p) (ne : p ≠ 1) : Pow2 (p / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Pow2.elim.mp h with (rfl | ⟨q, rfl, pq⟩)
  · simp at ne
  simpa

name: Pow2.two_mul_div_two
statement: lemma Pow2.two_mul_div_two {p : V} (h : Pow2 p) (ne : p ≠ 1) : 2 * (p / 2) = p
proof:
:= by
  rcases Pow2.elim.mp h with (rfl | ⟨q, rfl, _⟩)
  · simp at ne
  simp

name: Pow2.div_two_mul_two
statement: lemma Pow2.div_two_mul_two {p : V} (h : Pow2 p) (ne : p ≠ 1) : (p / 2) * 2 = p

name: Pow2.elim'
statement: lemma Pow2.elim' {p : V} : Pow2 p ↔ p = 1 ∨ 1 < p ∧ ∃ q, p = 2 * q ∧ Pow2 q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : 1 < p
  · simpa [hp] using Pow2.elim
  · have : p = 0 ∨ p = 1 := le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp (show p ≤ 1 from by simpa using hp)
    rcases this with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp

name: LenBit.le
statement: lemma LenBit.le {i a : V} (h : LenBit i a) : i ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A; simp [LenBit, show a < i from by simpa using A] at h

name: not_lenbit_of_lt
statement: lemma not_lenbit_of_lt {i a : V} (h : a < i) : ¬LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  intro A; exact not_le.mpr h A.le

name: LenBit.zero
statement: @[simp] lemma LenBit.zero (a : V) : ¬LenBit 0 a

name: LenBit.on_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma LenBit.on_zero (a : V) : ¬LenBit a 0

name: LenBit.one
statement: lemma LenBit.one (a : V) : LenBit 1 a ↔ ¬2 ∣ a

name: LenBit.iff_rem
statement: lemma LenBit.iff_rem {i a : V} : LenBit i a ↔ (a / i) % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LenBit]
  rcases mod_two (a / i) with (h | h) <;> simp [h, ←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]

name: not_lenbit_iff_rem
statement: lemma not_lenbit_iff_rem {i a : V} : ¬LenBit i a ↔ (a / i) % 2 = 0

name: LenBit.self
statement: @[simp] lemma LenBit.self {a : V} (pos : 0 < a) : LenBit a a

name: LenBit.mod
statement: lemma LenBit.mod {i a k : V} (h : 2 * i ∣ k) : LenBit i (a % k) ↔ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 ≤ i := Arithmetic.zero_le i
  rcases (eq_or_lt_of_le this) with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  rcases h with ⟨k', hk'⟩
  calc
    LenBit i (a % k) ↔ ((a % k) / i) % 2 = 1                          := LenBit.iff_rem
    _                ↔ ((2 * k') * (a / k) + a % k / i) % 2 = 1       := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _                ↔ (((2 * k') * (a / k) * i + a % k) / i) % 2 = 1 := by simp [div_mul_add_self, pos]
    _                ↔ ((k * (a / k) + a % k) / i) % 2 = 1            := iff_of_eq (by
                                                                                      congr 3
                                                                                      simp [mul_right_comm _ (a / k),
                                                                                        mul_right_comm 2 k' i, ←hk'])
    _                ↔ LenBit i a                                     := by simp [div_add_mod a k, LenBit.iff_rem]

name: LenBit.mod_two_mul_self
statement: @[simp] lemma LenBit.mod_two_mul_self {a i : V} : LenBit i (a % (2 * i)) ↔ LenBit i a

name: LenBit.add
statement: lemma LenBit.add {i a b : V} (h : 2 * i ∣ b) : LenBit i (a + b) ↔ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 ≤ i := Arithmetic.zero_le i
  rcases (eq_or_lt_of_le this) with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  rcases h with ⟨b', hb'⟩
  have hb' : b = 2 * b' * i := by simp [hb', mul_right_comm]
  calc
    LenBit i (a + b) ↔ ((a + b) / i) % 2 = 1    := LenBit.iff_rem
    _                ↔ (a / i + 2 * b') % 2 = 1 := by rw [hb', div_add_mul_self _ _ pos]
    _                ↔ LenBit i a               := by simp [LenBit.iff_rem]

name: LenBit.add_self
statement: lemma LenBit.add_self {i a : V} (h : a < i) : LenBit i (a + i)
proof:
:= by
  have pos : 0 < i := by exact pos_of_gt h
  simp [LenBit.iff_rem, div_add_self_right _ pos, h]

name: LenBit.add_self_of_not_lenbit
statement: lemma LenBit.add_self_of_not_lenbit {a i : V} (pos : 0 < i) (h : ¬LenBit i a) : LenBit i (a + i)
proof:
:= by
  have : a / i % 2 = 0 := by simpa [LenBit.iff_rem] using h
  simp only [iff_rem, pos, div_add_self_right]
  rw [mod_add] <;> simp [this]

name: LenBit.add_self_of_lenbit
statement: lemma LenBit.add_self_of_lenbit {a i : V} (pos : 0 < i) (h : LenBit i a) : ¬LenBit i (a + i)
proof:
:= by
  have : a / i % 2 = 1 := by simpa [LenBit.iff_rem] using h
  simp only [iff_rem, pos, div_add_self_right, mod_two_not_one_iff]
  rw [mod_add] <;> simp [this, one_add_one_eq_two]

name: LenBit.sub_self_of_lenbit
statement: lemma LenBit.sub_self_of_lenbit {a i : V} (pos : 0 < i) (h : LenBit i a) : ¬LenBit i (a - i)
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  have : ¬LenBit i a := by simpa [sub_add_self_of_le h.le] using LenBit.add_self_of_lenbit pos h'
  contradiction

name: mul
statement: lemma mul {a b : V} (ha : Pow2 a) (hb : Pow2 b) : Pow2 (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b
  · simpa [mul_comm] using this hb ha (LT.lt.le (by simpa using hab))
  suffices ∀ b : V, ∀ a ≤ b, Pow2 a → Pow2 b → Pow2 (a * b) by
    exact this b a hab ha hb
  intro b
  induction b using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind IH a b IH =>
    intro a hab ha hb
    have : a = 1 ∨ 1 < a ∧ ∃ a', a = 2 * a' ∧ Pow2 a' := Pow2.elim'.mp ha
    rcases this with (rfl | ⟨lta, a, rfl, ha⟩)
    · simpa using hb
    · have : b = 1 ∨ 1 < b ∧ ∃ b', b = 2 * b' ∧ Pow2 b' := Pow2.elim'.mp hb
      rcases this with (rfl | ⟨ltb, b, rfl, hb⟩)
      · simpa using ha
      · have ltb : b < 2 * b := lt_two_mul_self (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| by rintro rfl; simp at ltb)
        have hab : a ≤ b := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hab (by simp)
        have : Pow2 (a * b) := IH b ltb a hab (by assumption) (by assumption)
        suffices Pow2 (4 * a * b) by
          have : (2 * a) * (2 * b) = 4 * a * b := by simp [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm a 2 b, ←two_mul_two_eq_four]
          simpa [this]
        simpa [mul_assoc, pow2_mul_four] using this

name: mul_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_iff {a b : V} : Pow2 (a * b) ↔ Pow2 a ∧ Pow2 b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.of_dvd (by simp), h.of_dvd (by simp)⟩, by rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩; exact ha.mul hb⟩

name: sq_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma sq_iff {a : V} : Pow2 (a^2) ↔ Pow2 a

name: sq
statement: lemma sq {a : V} : Pow2 a → Pow2 (a^2)

name: dvd_of_le
statement: lemma dvd_of_le {a b : V} (ha : Pow2 a) (hb : Pow2 b) : a ≤ b → a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  suffices  ∀ b : V, ∀ a ≤ b, Pow2 a → Pow2 b → a ∣ b by
    intro hab; exact this b a hab ha hb
  intro b; induction b using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind b IH =>
    intro a hab ha hb
    have : b = 1 ∨ 1 < b ∧ ∃ b', b = 2 * b' ∧ Pow2 b' := Pow2.elim'.mp hb
    rcases this with (rfl | ⟨ltb, b, rfl, hb⟩)
    · rcases le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hab with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
      · simp at ha
    · have : a = 1 ∨ 1 < a ∧ ∃ a', a = 2 * a' ∧ Pow2 a' := Pow2.elim'.mp ha
      rcases this with (rfl | ⟨lta, a, rfl, ha⟩)
      · simp
      · have ltb : b < 2 * b := lt_two_mul_self (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr $ by rintro rfl; simp at ltb)
        have hab : a ≤ b := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hab (by simp)
        exact mul_dvd_mul_left 2 <| IH b ltb a hab (by assumption) (by assumption)

name: le_iff_dvd
statement: lemma le_iff_dvd {a b : V} (ha : Pow2 a) (hb : Pow2 b) : a ≤ b ↔ a ∣ b

name: two_le
statement: lemma two_le {a : V} (pa : Pow2 a) (ne1 : a ≠ 1) : 2 ≤ a

name: le_iff_lt_two
statement: lemma le_iff_lt_two {a b : V} (ha : Pow2 a) (hb : Pow2 b) : a ≤ b ↔ a < 2 * b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (lt_two_mul_self hb.pos)
  · intro h
    by_cases ea : a = 1
    · rcases ea with rfl
      simpa [←pos_iff_one_le] using hb.pos
    · suffices a ∣ b from le_of_dvd hb.pos this
      have : a / 2 ∣ b := by
        have : 2 * (a / 2) ∣ 2 * b := by
          simpa [ha.two_mul_div_two ea] using dvd_of_le ha (by simpa using hb) (LT.lt.le h)
        exact (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (by simp)).mp this
      rcases this with ⟨b', rfl⟩
      have hb' : Pow2 b' := (show Pow2 (a / 2) ∧ Pow2 b' by simpa using hb).2
      have : 2 ∣ b' := hb'.two_dvd' (by rintro rfl; simp [ha.two_mul_div_two ea] at h)
      rcases this with ⟨b'', rfl⟩
      simp [←mul_assoc, ha.div_two_mul_two ea]

name: lt_iff_two_mul_le
statement: lemma lt_iff_two_mul_le {a b : V} (ha : Pow2 a) (hb : Pow2 b) : a < b ↔ 2 * a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases eb : b = 1
  · simp [eb, ←lt_two_iff_le_one]
  · rw [←hb.two_mul_div_two eb]; simp [le_iff_lt_two ha (hb.div_two eb)]

name: sq_or_dsq
statement: lemma sq_or_dsq {a : V} (pa : Pow2 a) : ∃ b, a = b^2 ∨ a = 2 * b^2
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ b ≤ a, a = b^2 ∨ a = 2 * b^2 by
    rcases this with ⟨b, _, h⟩
    exact ⟨b, h⟩
  induction a using ISigma0.order_induction
  · definability
  case ind a IH =>
    rcases Pow2.elim'.mp pa with (rfl | ⟨ha, a, rfl, pa'⟩)
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · have : 0 < a := by simpa [←pos_iff_one_le] using one_lt_iff_two_le.mp ha
      rcases IH a (lt_mul_of_one_lt_left this one_lt_two) pa' with ⟨b, _, (rfl | rfl)⟩
      · exact ⟨b, le_trans (by simp) le_two_mul_left, by right; rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2 * b, by simpa using le_trans (by simp) le_two_mul_left,
        by left; simp [_root_.sq, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]⟩

name: sqrt
statement: lemma sqrt {a : V} (h : Pow2 a) (hsq : (√a)^2 = a) : Pow2 (√a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←hsq] at h; simpa using h

name: not_three
statement: @[simp] lemma not_three : ¬Pow2 (3 : V)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : (2 : V) ∣ 3 := h.two_dvd (by simp [←two_add_one_eq_three])
  simp [←two_add_one_eq_three, ←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at this

name: four_le
statement: lemma four_le {i : V} (hi : Pow2 i) (lt : 2 < i) : 4 ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  have : i ≤ 3 := by simpa [←three_add_one_eq_four, ←le_iff_lt_succ] using A
  rcases le_three_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two_or_three.mp this with (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp at lt hi

name: mul_add_lt_of_mul_lt_of_pos
statement:
lemma mul_add_lt_of_mul_lt_of_pos {a b p q : V} (hp : Pow2 p) (hq : Pow2 q)
    (h : a * p < q) (hb : b < p) (hbq : b < q) : a * p + b < q
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp [hbq]
  have : p ∣ q :=
    dvd_of_le hp hq (le_of_lt <| lt_of_le_of_lt (le_mul_of_pos_left pos) h)
  rcases this with ⟨q, rfl⟩
  have : a < q := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (a := p) (by simpa [mul_comm] using h)
  calc
    a * p + b < (a + 1) * p := by simp [add_mul, hb]
    _         ≤ p * q       := by simpa [mul_comm p q] using mul_le_mul_right (lt_iff_succ_le.mp this)

name: LenBit.mod_pow2
statement: lemma LenBit.mod_pow2 {a i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (h : i < j) : LenBit i (a % j) ↔ LenBit i a

name: LenBit.add_pow2
statement: lemma LenBit.add_pow2 {a i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (h : i < j) : LenBit i (a + j) ↔ LenBit i a

name: LenBit.add_pow2_iff_of_lt
statement: lemma LenBit.add_pow2_iff_of_lt {a i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (h : a < j) : LenBit i (a + j) ↔ i = j ∨ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  rcases show i < j ∨ i = j ∨ i > j from lt_trichotomy i j with (hij | rfl | hij)
  · simp [LenBit.add_pow2 pi pj hij, hij.ne]
  · simp [LenBit.add_self h]
  · have : a + j < i := calc
      a + j < 2 * j  := by simp [two_mul, h]
      _     ≤ i      := (pj.lt_iff_two_mul_le pi).mp hij
    simp [not_lenbit_of_lt this, not_lenbit_of_lt (show a < i from lt_trans h hij), hij.ne.symm]

name: lenbit_iff_add_mul
statement:
lemma lenbit_iff_add_mul {i a : V} (hi : Pow2 i) :
    LenBit i a ↔ ∃ k, ∃ r < i, a = k * (2 * i) + i + r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : 2 * ((a / i) / 2) + 1 = a / i := by simpa [LenBit.iff_rem.mp h] using div_add_mod (a / i) 2
    have : a = ((a / i) / 2) * (2 * i) + i + (a % i) := calc
      a = i * (a / i) + (a % i)                  := Eq.symm <| div_add_mod a i
      _ = i * (2 * ((a / i) / 2) + 1) + (a % i) := by simp [this]
      _ = ((a / i) / 2) * (2 * i) + i + (a % i) := by simp [mul_add, ←mul_assoc, mul_comm i 2, mul_comm (2 * i)]
    exact ⟨(a / i) / 2, a % i, by simp [hi.pos], this⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, r, h, rfl⟩
    simp [LenBit.iff_rem, ←mul_assoc, add_assoc, div_mul_add_self, hi.pos, h]

name: not_lenbit_iff_add_mul
statement:
lemma not_lenbit_iff_add_mul {i a : V} (hi : Pow2 i) :
    ¬LenBit i a ↔ ∃ k, ∃ r < i, a = k * (2 * i) + r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : 2 * ((a / i) / 2) = a / i := by simpa [not_lenbit_iff_rem.mp h] using div_add_mod (a / i) 2
    have : a = ((a / i) / 2) * (2 * i) + (a % i) := calc
      a = i * (a / i) + (a % i)              := Eq.symm <| div_add_mod a i
      _ = i * (2 * ((a / i) / 2)) + (a % i) := by simp [this]
      _ = ((a / i) / 2) * (2 * i) + (a % i) := by simp [←mul_assoc, mul_comm i 2, mul_comm (2 * i)]
    exact ⟨(a / i) / 2, a % i, by simp [hi.pos], this⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, r, h, rfl⟩
    simp [not_lenbit_iff_rem, ←mul_assoc, div_mul_add_self, hi.pos, h]

name: lenbit_mul_add
statement:
lemma lenbit_mul_add {i j a r : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (hr : r < j) :
    LenBit (i * j) (a * j + r) ↔ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : LenBit i a
  · suffices LenBit (i * j) (a * j + r) by simpa [h]
    rcases (lenbit_iff_add_mul pi).mp h with ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
    have : b * j + r < i * j :=
      pj.mul_add_lt_of_mul_lt_of_pos
        (by simp [pi, pj]) ((mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ pj.pos).mpr hb)
        hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hr $ le_mul_of_pos_left $ pi.pos)
    exact
      (lenbit_iff_add_mul (by simp [pi, pj])).mpr
        ⟨a, b * j + r, this, by simp [add_mul, add_assoc, mul_assoc]⟩
  · suffices ¬LenBit (i * j) (a * j + r) by simpa [h]
    rcases (not_lenbit_iff_add_mul pi).mp h with ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
    have : b * j + r < i * j :=
      pj.mul_add_lt_of_mul_lt_of_pos
        (by simp [pi, pj]) ((mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ pj.pos).mpr hb)
        hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hr $ le_mul_of_pos_left $ pi.pos)
    exact
      (not_lenbit_iff_add_mul (by simp [pi, pj])).mpr
        ⟨a, b * j + r, this, by simp [add_mul, add_assoc, mul_assoc]⟩

name: lenbit_add_pow2_iff_of_not_lenbit
statement:
lemma lenbit_add_pow2_iff_of_not_lenbit {a i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (h : ¬LenBit j a) :
    LenBit i (a + j) ↔ i = j ∨ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  rcases show i < j ∨ i = j ∨ i > j from lt_trichotomy i j with (hij | rfl | hij)
  · simp [LenBit.add_pow2 pi pj hij, hij.ne]
  · simp [LenBit.add_self_of_not_lenbit pi.pos, h]
  · suffices LenBit i (a + j) ↔ LenBit i a by simpa [ne_of_gt hij]
    have : 2 * j ∣ i := Pow2.dvd_of_le (by simp [pj]) pi <| (pj.lt_iff_two_mul_le pi).mp hij
    rcases this with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases (not_lenbit_iff_add_mul pj).mp h with ⟨a, r, hr, rfl⟩
    have pi' : Pow2 i := And.right (by simpa using pi)
    have pj' : Pow2 j := And.left (by simpa using pi)
    calc
      LenBit (2 * j * i) (a * (2 * j) + r + j) ↔ LenBit (i * (2 * j)) (a * (2 * j) + (r + j)) := by
        simp [mul_comm (2 * j), add_assoc]
      _                                        ↔ LenBit i a                                   :=
        lenbit_mul_add pi' (by simpa using pj') (by simp [two_mul, hr])
      _                                        ↔ LenBit (i * (2 * j)) (a * (2 * j) + r)       :=
        Iff.symm <| lenbit_mul_add pi' (by simpa using pj') (lt_of_lt_of_le hr $ by simp)
      _                                        ↔ LenBit (2 * j * i) (a * (2 * j) + r)         := by
        simp [mul_comm]

name: lenbit_sub_pow2_iff_of_lenbit
statement:
lemma lenbit_sub_pow2_iff_of_lenbit {a i j : V} (pi : Pow2 i) (pj : Pow2 j) (h : LenBit j a) :
    LenBit i (a - j) ↔ i ≠ j ∧ LenBit i a
proof:
:= by
  generalize ha' : a - j = a'
  have h' : ¬LenBit j a' := by simpa [←ha'] using LenBit.sub_self_of_lenbit pj.pos h
  have : a = a' + j := by simp [←ha', sub_add_self_of_le h.le]
  rcases this with rfl
  have e : LenBit i (a' + j) ↔ i = j ∨ LenBit i a' := lenbit_add_pow2_iff_of_not_lenbit pi pj h'
  suffices LenBit i a' → ¬i = j by simpa [e, and_or_left]
  rintro _ rfl; contradiction

name: log_exists_unique_pos
statement: lemma log_exists_unique_pos {y : V} (hy : 0 < y) : ∃! x, x < y ∧ ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y'
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ x < y, ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y' := by
    induction y using sigma0_polynomial_induction
    · definability
    case zero => simp at hy
    case even y _ IH =>
      rcases (IH (by simpa using hy) : ∃ x < y, ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y') with ⟨x, hxy, y', gey, H, lty⟩
      exact ⟨x + 1, lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp [hxy]) (succ_le_double_of_pos (pos_of_gt hxy)),
        2 * y', by simpa using gey, Exponential.exponential_succ_mul_two.mpr H, by simpa using lty⟩
    case odd y IH =>
      rcases (Arithmetic.zero_le y : 0 ≤ y) with (rfl | pos)
      · simp
      · rcases (IH pos : ∃ x < y, ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y') with ⟨x, hxy, y', gey, H, lty⟩
        exact ⟨x + 1, by simpa using lt_of_lt_of_le hxy (by simp),
          2 * y', le_trans (by simpa using gey) le_self_add, Exponential.exponential_succ_mul_two.mpr H, two_mul_add_one_lt_two_mul_of_lt lty⟩
  rcases this with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro x hx (fun x' ↦ by
    intro hx'
    by_contra A
    wlog lt : x < x'
    · exact this hy x' hx' x hx (Ne.symm A) (lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa using lt) A)
    rcases hx with ⟨_, z, _, H, hyz⟩
    rcases hx' with ⟨_, z', hzy', H', _⟩
    have : z < z' := Exponential.monotone H H' lt
    have : y < y := calc
      y < 2 * z := hyz
      _ ≤ z'    := (Pow2.lt_iff_two_mul_le H.range_pow2 H'.range_pow2).mp this
      _ ≤ y     := hzy'
    simp at this)

name: log_exists_unique
statement: lemma log_exists_unique (y : V) : ∃! x, (y = 0 → x = 0) ∧ (0 < y → x < y ∧ ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y')
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · rcases hy; simp
  · simp [hy, pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy, log_exists_unique_pos]

name: log_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma log_zero : log (0 : V) = 0

name: log_pos
statement: lemma log_pos {y : V} (pos : 0 < y) : ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential (log y) y' ∧ y < 2 * y'

name: log_lt_self_of_pos
statement: lemma log_lt_self_of_pos {y : V} (pos : 0 < y) : log y < y

name: log_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma log_le_self (a : V) : log a ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · exact le_of_lt <| log_lt_self_of_pos pos

name: log_graph
statement: lemma log_graph {x y : V} : x = log y ↔ (y = 0 → x = 0) ∧ (0 < y → x < y ∧ ∃ y' ≤ y, Exponential x y' ∧ y < 2 * y')

name: log_eq_of_pos
statement: lemma log_eq_of_pos {x y : V} (pos : 0 < y) {y'} (H : Exponential x y') (hy' : y' ≤ y) (hy : y < 2 * y') : log y = x
proof:
:=
  (log_exists_unique_pos pos).unique ⟨log_lt_self_of_pos pos, log_pos pos⟩ ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le H.lt hy', y', hy', H, hy⟩

name: log_one
statement: @[simp] lemma log_one : log (1 : V) = 0

name: log_two
statement: @[simp] lemma log_two : log (2 : V) = 1

name: log_two_mul_of_pos
statement: lemma log_two_mul_of_pos {y : V} (pos : 0 < y) : log (2 * y) = log y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases log_pos pos with ⟨y', hy', H, hy⟩
  exact log_eq_of_pos (by simpa using pos) (Exponential.exponential_succ_mul_two.mpr H) (by simpa using hy') (by simpa using hy)

name: log_two_mul_add_one_of_pos
statement: lemma log_two_mul_add_one_of_pos {y : V} (pos : 0 < y) : log (2 * y + 1) = log y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases log_pos pos with ⟨y', hy', H, hy⟩
  exact log_eq_of_pos (by simp) (Exponential.exponential_succ_mul_two.mpr H)
    (le_trans (by simpa using hy') le_self_add) (two_mul_add_one_lt_two_mul_of_lt hy)

name: Exponential.log_eq_of_exp
statement: lemma Exponential.log_eq_of_exp {x y : V} (H : Exponential x y) : log y = x
proof:
:=
  log_eq_of_pos H.range_pos H (by { rfl }) (lt_mul_of_pos_of_one_lt_left H.range_pos one_lt_two)

name: exponential_of_pow2
statement: lemma exponential_of_pow2 {p : V} (pp : Pow2 p) : Exponential (log p) p
proof:
:= by
  rcases log_pos pp.pos with ⟨q, hq, H, hp⟩
  suffices p = q by simpa [this] using H
  by_contra ne
  have : q < p := lt_of_le_of_ne hq (Ne.symm ne)
  have : 2 * q < 2 * q := calc
    2 * q ≤ p     := (Pow2.lt_iff_two_mul_le H.range_pow2 pp).mp this
    _     < 2 * q := hp
  simp at this

name: log_mul_pow2_add_of_lt
statement: lemma log_mul_pow2_add_of_lt {a p b : V} (pos : 0 < a) (pp : Pow2 p) (hb : b < p) : log (a * p + b) = log a + log p
proof:
:= by
  rcases log_pos pos with ⟨a', ha', Ha, ha⟩
  rcases log_pos pp.pos with ⟨p', hp', Hp, hp⟩
  exact log_eq_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le (mul_pos pos pp.pos) le_self_add)
    (Exponential.add_mul Ha Hp) (le_trans (mul_le_mul' ha' hp') le_self_add) (by
      rcases Hp.uniq (exponential_of_pow2 pp)
      calc
        a * p + b < a * p + p    := by simp [hb]
        _         = (a + 1) * p  := by simp [add_mul]
        _         ≤ 2 * (a' * p) := by simpa [←mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_right (lt_iff_succ_le.mp ha))

name: log_mul_pow2
statement: lemma log_mul_pow2 {a p : V} (pos : 0 < a) (pp : Pow2 p) : log (a * p) = log a + log p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using log_mul_pow2_add_of_lt pos pp pp.pos

name: log_monotone
statement: lemma log_monotone {a b : V} (h : a ≤ b) : log a ≤ log b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | posa)
  · simp
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | posb)
  · have := lt_of_lt_of_le posa h; simp_all
  rcases log_pos posa with ⟨a', ha', Ha, _⟩
  rcases log_pos posb with ⟨b', _, Hb, hb⟩
  by_contra lt
  have : b' < a' := (Exponential.monotone_iff Hb Ha).mp (by simpa using lt)
  have : b < b := calc
    b < 2 * b' := hb
    _ ≤ a'     := (Pow2.lt_iff_two_mul_le Hb.range_pow2 Ha.range_pow2).mp this
    _ ≤ a      := ha'
    _ ≤ b      := h
  simp_all

name: length_eq_binaryLength
statement: lemma length_eq_binaryLength (a : V) : ‖a‖ = if 0 < a then log a + 1 else 0

name: length_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma length_zero : ‖(0 : V)‖ = 0

name: length_of_pos
statement: lemma length_of_pos {a : V} (pos : 0 < a) : ‖a‖ = log a + 1

name: length_le
statement: @[simp] lemma length_le (a : V) : ‖a‖ ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · simp [pos, length_of_pos, ←lt_iff_succ_le, log_lt_self_of_pos]

name: length_graph
statement: lemma length_graph {i a : V} : i = ‖a‖ ↔ (0 < a → ∃ k ≤ a, k = log a ∧ i = k + 1) ∧ (a = 0 → i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · simp [length_of_pos, pos, pos_iff_ne_zero.mp pos]

name: length_one
statement: @[simp] lemma length_one : ‖(1 : V)‖ = 1

name: Exponential.length_eq
statement: lemma Exponential.length_eq {x y : V} (H : Exponential x y) : ‖y‖ = x + 1

name: length_two_mul_of_pos
statement: lemma length_two_mul_of_pos {a : V} (pos : 0 < a) : ‖2 * a‖ = ‖a‖ + 1

name: length_two_mul_add_one
statement: lemma length_two_mul_add_one (a : V) : ‖2 * a + 1‖ = ‖a‖ + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · simp [pos, length_of_pos, log_two_mul_add_one_of_pos]

name: length_mul_pow2_add_of_lt
statement: lemma length_mul_pow2_add_of_lt {a p b : V} (pos : 0 < a) (pp : Pow2 p) (hb : b < p) : ‖a * p + b‖ = ‖a‖ + log p
proof:
:= by
  simp [length_of_pos, pos, pp.pos, log_mul_pow2_add_of_lt pos pp hb, add_right_comm (log a) (log p) 1]

name: length_mul_pow2
statement: lemma length_mul_pow2 {a p : V} (pos : 0 < a) (pp : Pow2 p) : ‖a * p‖ = ‖a‖ + log p
proof:
:= by
  simp [length_of_pos, pos, pp.pos, log_mul_pow2 pos pp, add_right_comm (log a) (log p) 1]

name: length_monotone
statement: lemma length_monotone {a b : V} (h : a ≤ b) : ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | posa)
  · simp
  · simpa [length_of_pos posa, length_of_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le posa h)]
    using log_monotone h

name: pos_of_lt_length
statement: lemma pos_of_lt_length {a b : V} (h : a < ‖b‖) : 0 < b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A; rcases (show b = 0 from by simpa using A); simp_all

name: length_pos_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma length_pos_iff {a : V} : 0 < ‖a‖ ↔ 0 < a
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; by_contra A; rcases (show a = 0 from by simpa using A); simp_all,
   by intro h; exact pos_iff_one_le.mpr (by simpa using length_monotone (pos_iff_one_le.mp h))⟩

name: length_eq_zero_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma length_eq_zero_iff {a : V} : ‖a‖ = 0 ↔ a = 0

name: le_log_of_lt_length
statement: lemma le_log_of_lt_length {a b : V} (h : a < ‖b‖) : a ≤ log b
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < b := pos_of_lt_length h
  exact le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by simpa [length_of_pos this] using h)

name: exponential_log_le_self
statement: lemma exponential_log_le_self {a b : V} (pos : 0 < a) (h : Exponential (log a) b) : b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases log_pos pos with ⟨_, _, H, _⟩; rcases H.uniq h
  assumption

name: lt_exponential_log_self
statement: lemma lt_exponential_log_self {a b : V} (h : Exponential (log a) b) : a < 2 * b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp at h; simp [h]
  rcases log_pos pos with ⟨_, _, H, _⟩; rcases H.uniq h
  assumption

name: lt_exp_len_self
statement: lemma lt_exp_len_self {a b : V} (h : Exponential ‖a‖ b) : a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp at h; simp [h]
  have : Exponential (log a + 1) b := by simpa [length_of_pos pos] using h
  rcases Exponential.exponential_succ.mp this with ⟨b, rfl, H⟩
  exact lt_exponential_log_self H

name: le_iff_le_log_of_exp
statement: lemma le_iff_le_log_of_exp {x y a : V} (H : Exponential x y) (pos : 0 < a) : y ≤ a ↔ x ≤ log a
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rcases H.log_eq_of_exp; exact log_monotone,
   fun h ↦ by rcases log_pos pos with ⟨a', ha', Haa', _⟩; exact le_trans (Exponential.monotone_le H Haa' h) ha'⟩

name: le_iff_lt_length_of_exp
statement: lemma le_iff_lt_length_of_exp {x y a : V} (H : Exponential x y) : y ≤ a ↔ x < ‖a‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.mp H.range_pos
  simp [le_iff_le_log_of_exp H pos, length_of_pos pos, ←le_iff_lt_succ]

name: Exponential.lt_iff_log_lt
statement: lemma Exponential.lt_iff_log_lt {x y a : V} (H : Exponential x y) (pos : 0 < a) : a < y ↔ log a < x
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mp (by simpa using le_iff_le_log_of_exp H pos)

name: Exponential.lt_iff_len_le
statement: lemma Exponential.lt_iff_len_le {x y a : V} (H : Exponential x y) : a < y ↔ ‖a‖ ≤ x

name: Exponential.le_of_lt_length
statement: lemma Exponential.le_of_lt_length {x y a : V} (H : Exponential x y) : x < ‖a‖ → y ≤ a

name: Exponential.le_log
statement: lemma Exponential.le_log {x y : V} (H : Exponential x y) : x ≤ log y

name: Exponential.lt_length
statement: lemma Exponential.lt_length {x y : V} (H : Exponential x y) : x < ‖y‖

name: lt_exponential_length
statement: lemma lt_exponential_length {a b : V} (h : Exponential ‖a‖ b) : a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp at h; simp [h]
  have : Exponential (log a + 1) b := by simpa [length_of_pos pos] using h
  rcases Exponential.exponential_succ.mp this with ⟨b, rfl, H⟩
  exact lt_exponential_log_self H

name: sq_len_le_three_mul
statement: lemma sq_len_le_three_mul (a : V) : ‖a‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using sigma0_polynomial_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case even a pos IH =>
    calc
      ‖2 * a‖ ^ 2 = (‖a‖ + 1) ^ 2         := by rw [length_two_mul_of_pos pos]
      _           = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖a‖ + 1 := by simp [sq, add_mul_self_eq]
      _           ≤ 3 * a + 2 * ‖a‖ + 1   := by simpa using IH
      _           ≤ 3 * a + 2 * a + 1     := by simp
      _           ≤ 3 * a + 2 * a + a     := by simp [←pos_iff_one_le, pos]
      _           = 3 * (2 * a)           := by simp_all only [←two_add_one_eq_three, two_mul, add_mul, add_assoc, one_mul]
  case odd a IH =>
    rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
    · simp [←two_add_one_eq_three]
    calc
      ‖2 * a + 1‖ ^ 2 = (‖a‖ + 1) ^ 2         := by rw [length_two_mul_add_one a]
      _               = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖a‖ + 1 := by simp [sq, add_mul_self_eq]
      _               ≤ 3 * a + 2 * ‖a‖ + 1   := by simpa using IH
      _               ≤ 3 * a + 2 * a + 1     := by simp
      _               ≤ 3 * a + 2 * a + a     := by simp [←pos_iff_one_le, pos]
      _               = 3 * (2 * a)           := by simp_all only [←two_add_one_eq_three, two_mul, add_mul, add_assoc, one_mul]
      _               ≤ 3 * (2 * a + 1)       := by simp

name: brange_exists_unique
statement: lemma brange_exists_unique (a : V) : ∀ x < ‖a‖, ∃! y, Exponential x y
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x < ‖a‖, ∃ y ≤ a, Exponential x y by
    intro x hx; rcases this x hx with ⟨_, _, H⟩
    exact ExistsUnique.intro _ H (fun y' H' ↦ H'.uniq H)
  intro x
  induction x using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    intro ha
    have : 0 < a := pos_of_lt_length ha
    exact ⟨1, pos_iff_one_le.mp this, by simp⟩
  case succ x IH =>
    intro hx
    rcases (IH (lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp) hx) : ∃ y ≤ a, Exponential x y) with ⟨y, hy, H⟩
    have : 0 < a := by by_contra A; rcases (show a = 0 from by simpa using A); simp_all
    have : 2 * y ≤ a := (le_iff_le_log_of_exp H.succ this).mpr (le_log_of_lt_length hx)
    exact ⟨2 * y, this, H.succ⟩

name: bexp_exists_unique
statement: lemma bexp_exists_unique (a x : V) : ∃! y, (x < ‖a‖ → Exponential x y) ∧ (‖a‖ ≤ x → y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x < ‖a‖
  · simpa [hx, show ¬‖a‖ ≤ x from by simpa using hx, log_exists_unique_pos]
    using brange_exists_unique a x hx
  · simp [hx, show ‖a‖ ≤ x from by simpa using hx]

name: exp_bexp_of_lt
statement: lemma exp_bexp_of_lt {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : Exponential x (bexp a x)

name: bexp_eq_zero_of_le
statement: lemma bexp_eq_zero_of_le {a x : V} (h : ‖a‖ ≤ x) : bexp a x = 0

name: bexp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_zero (x : V): bexp 0 x = 0

name: exp_bexp_of_lt_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma exp_bexp_of_lt_iff {a x : V} : Exponential x (bexp a x) ↔ x < ‖a‖
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; by_contra A
      have : bexp a x = 0 := bexp_eq_zero_of_le (not_lt.mp A)
      simp [this] at h
      have := h.range_pos; simp_all,
   exp_bexp_of_lt⟩

name: bexp_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_le_self (a x : V) : bexp a x ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases show x < ‖a‖ ∨ ‖a‖ ≤ x from lt_or_ge _ _ with (lt | le)
  · have : 0 < a := pos_of_lt_length lt
    exact (le_iff_le_log_of_exp (exp_bexp_of_lt lt) this).mpr (le_log_of_lt_length lt)
  · simp [bexp_eq_zero_of_le le]

name: bexp_graph
statement: lemma bexp_graph {y a x : V} : y = bexp a x ↔ ∃ l ≤ a, l = ‖a‖ ∧ (x < l → Exponential x y) ∧ (l ≤ x → y = 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; exact ⟨‖a‖, by simp, rfl, exp_bexp_of_lt, bexp_eq_zero_of_le⟩, by
    rintro ⟨_, _, rfl, hlt, hle⟩
    rcases show x < ‖a‖ ∨ ‖a‖ ≤ x from lt_or_ge _ _ with (lt | le)
    · exact (hlt lt).uniq (exp_bexp_of_lt lt)
    · rcases hle le; simp [bexp_eq_zero_of_le le]⟩

name: bexp_monotone_iff
statement: lemma bexp_monotone_iff {a i j : V} (hi : i < ‖a‖) (hj : j < ‖a‖) : bexp a i < bexp a j ↔ i < j

name: bexp_monotone_le_iff
statement: lemma bexp_monotone_le_iff {a i j : V} (hi : i < ‖a‖) (hj : j < ‖a‖) : bexp a i ≤ bexp a j ↔ i ≤ j

name: bexp_eq_of_lt_length
statement: lemma bexp_eq_of_lt_length {i a a' : V} (ha : i < ‖a‖) (ha' : i < ‖a'‖) : bexp a i = bexp a' i
proof:
:= by
  have H : Exponential i (bexp a i) := by simp [ha]
  have H' : Exponential i (bexp a' i) := by simp [ha']
  exact H.uniq H'

name: bexp_pow2
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_pow2 {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : Pow2 (bexp a x)

name: lt_bexp
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_bexp {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : x < bexp a x

name: bexp_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_pos {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : 0 < bexp a x

name: lt_bexp_len
statement: lemma lt_bexp_len {a x : V} (h : ‖x‖ < ‖a‖) : x < bexp a ‖x‖

name: bexp_eq_of_exp
statement: lemma bexp_eq_of_exp {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) (H : Exponential x y) : bexp a x = y

name: log_bexp
statement: lemma log_bexp {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : log (bexp a x) = x

name: len_bexp
statement: lemma len_bexp {a x : V} (h : x < ‖a‖) : ‖bexp a x‖ = x + 1

name: bexp_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_zero_zero : bexp (0 : V) 0 = 0

name: bexp_pos_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma bexp_pos_zero {a : V} (h : 0 < a) : bexp a 0 = 1

name: bexp_monotone
statement:
lemma bexp_monotone {a₁ x₁ a₂ x₂ : V} (h₁ : x₁ < ‖a₁‖) (h₂ : x₂ < ‖a₂‖) :
  bexp a₁ x₁ < bexp a₂ x₂ ↔ x₁ < x₂

name: bexp_monotone_le
statement:
lemma bexp_monotone_le {a₁ x₁ a₂ x₂ : V} (h₁ : x₁ < ‖a₁‖) (h₂ : x₂ < ‖a₂‖) :
  bexp a₁ x₁ ≤ bexp a₂ x₂ ↔ x₁ ≤ x₂

name: bexp_add
statement:
lemma bexp_add {x₁ x₂ a : V} (h : x₁ + x₂ < ‖a‖) :
    bexp a (x₁ + x₂) = bexp a x₁ * bexp a x₂

name: bexp_two_mul
statement:
lemma bexp_two_mul {a a' x : V} (hx : 2 * x < ‖a‖) (hx' : x < ‖a'‖) :
    bexp a (2 * x) = (bexp a' x) ^ 2

name: bexp_two_mul_succ
statement: lemma bexp_two_mul_succ {a i : V} : bexp (2 * a) (i + 1) = 2 * bexp a i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  rcases show i ≥ ‖a‖ ∨ i < ‖a‖ from le_or_gt ‖a‖ i with (h | h)
  · simp [bexp_eq_zero_of_le, h, show ‖2 * a‖ ≤ i + 1 from by simp [length_two_mul_of_pos pos, h]]
  · exact bexp_eq_of_exp (by simp [length_two_mul_of_pos pos, h]) (exp_bexp_of_lt h).succ

name: bexp_two_mul_add_one_succ
statement: lemma bexp_two_mul_add_one_succ {a i : V} : bexp (2 * a + 1) (i + 1) = 2 * bexp a i
proof:
:= by
  rcases show i ≥ ‖a‖ ∨ i < ‖a‖ from le_or_gt ‖a‖ i with (h | h)
  · simp [bexp_eq_zero_of_le, h, show ‖2 * a + 1‖ ≤ i + 1 from by simp [length_two_mul_add_one, h]]
  · exact bexp_eq_of_exp (by simp [length_two_mul_add_one, h]) (exp_bexp_of_lt h).succ

statement: lemma numeral_add_numeral (n m : ℕ) : (numeral n : M) + numeral m = numeral (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [models_iff] using Theory.models M _ (R0.Ω₁ n m)

statement: lemma numeral_ne_numeral_of_ne {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≠ m) : (numeral n : M) ≠ numeral m

:= by
  simpa [models_iff] using Theory.models M _ (R0.Ω₃ n m h)

name: lt_numeral_iff
statement: lemma lt_numeral_iff {x : M} {n : ℕ} : x < numeral n ↔ ∃ i : Fin n, x = numeral i
proof:
:= by
  have := by simpa [models_iff] using Theory.models M _ (R0.Ω₄ n)
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases (this x).mp hx with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (this (numeral i)).mpr ⟨i, by simp, rfl⟩

name: numeral_inj_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_inj_iff {n m : ℕ} : (numeral n : M) = numeral m ↔ n = m
proof:
:=
  ⟨by contrapose; exact numeral_ne_numeral_of_ne, by rintro rfl; rfl⟩

name: numeral_lt_numeral_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_lt_numeral_iff : (numeral n : M) < numeral m ↔ n < m
proof:
:=
  ⟨by contrapose
      intro h H
      rcases lt_numeral_iff.mp H with ⟨i, hi⟩
      rcases numeral_inj_iff.mp hi
      exact (lt_self_iff_false m).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_not_gt h) i.prop),
   fun h ↦ lt_numeral_iff.mpr ⟨⟨n, h⟩, by simp⟩⟩

name: val_numeral
statement:
lemma val_numeral {n ξ} (bv : Fin n → ℕ) (fv : ξ → ℕ) (t : ArithmeticSemiterm ξ n) :
    t.val (M := M) (numeral ∘ bv) (numeral ∘ fv) = numeral (t.val bv fv)
proof:
:=
  match t with
  |                         #_ => by simp
  |                         &_ => by simp
  | .func Language.Zero.zero _ => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
  |   .func Language.One.one _ => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
  |   .func Language.Add.add v => by simp [Semiterm.val_func, val_numeral _ _ (v 0), val_numeral _ _ (v 1), numeral_add_numeral]
  |   .func Language.Mul.mul v => by simp [Semiterm.val_func, val_numeral _ _ (v 0), val_numeral _ _ (v 1), numeral_mul_numeral]

name: bold_sigma_one_completeness
statement:
lemma bold_sigma_one_completeness {n} {φ : ArithmeticSemiformula ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ) {bv : Fin n → ℕ} {fv : ξ → ℕ} :
    φ.Eval bv fv → φ.Eval (M := M) (numeral ∘ bv) (numeral ∘ fv)
proof:
:= by
  revert bv
  apply sigma₁_induction' hp
  case hVerum => simp
  case hFalsum => simp
  case hEQ => intro n t₁ t₂ e; simp [val_numeral]
  case hNEQ => intro n t₁ t₂ e; simp [val_numeral]
  case hLT => intro n t₁ t₂ e; simp [val_numeral]
  case hNLT => intro n t₁ t₂ e; simp [val_numeral]
  case hAnd => simp; grind
  case hOr => simp; grind
  case hBall =>
    intro n t φ _ ihp bv
    suffices
      (∀ x < t.val bv fv, (φ.Eval (x :> bv) fv)) →
       ∀ x < numeral (t.val bv fv), (φ.Eval (x :> numeral ∘ bv) (numeral ∘ fv)) by
      simpa [val_numeral]
    intro hp x hx
    rcases lt_numeral_iff.mp hx with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    simpa [Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using ihp (hp x (by simp))
  case hExs =>
    simp only [Semiformula.eval_ex, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, forall_exists_index]
    intro n φ _ ihp e x hp
    exact ⟨numeral x, by simpa [Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using ihp hp⟩

name: R0.model_complete
statement:
lemma R0.model_complete {σ : ArithmeticSentence} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 σ) :
    ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ σ → M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ σ
proof:
:= by
  suffices σ.Evalb (M := ℕ) ![] → σ.Evalb (M := M) ![] by simpa [models_iff]
  intro h
  simpa [Matrix.empty_eq, Empty.eq_elim] using bold_sigma_one_completeness hσ h

name: sigma_one_completeness
statement:
theorem sigma_one_completeness {σ : ArithmeticSentence} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 σ) :
    ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ σ → T ⊢ σ
proof:
:= fun H =>
  haveI : 𝗘𝗤 _ ⪯ T := Entailment.WeakerThan.trans (𝓣 := 𝗥₀) inferInstance inferInstance
  complete.{0} _ _ <| fun M _ _ ↦ by
    have : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗥₀ := ModelsTheory.of_provably_subtheory M 𝗥₀ T inferInstance
    exact R0.model_complete hσ H

name: sigma_one_completeness_iff

theorem sigma_one_completeness_iff [T.SoundOnHierarchy 𝚺 1] {σ : ArithmeticSentence} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 σ) :
    ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ σ ↔ T ⊢ σ
proof:
:=
  haveI : 𝗥₀ ⪯ T := Entailment.WeakerThan.trans (𝓣 := T) inferInstance inferInstance
  ⟨fun h ↦ sigma_one_completeness hσ h, fun h ↦ T.soundOnHierarchy 𝚺 1 h (by simp [hσ])⟩

lemma term_primrec {k f} : (t : ArithmeticSemiterm ξ k) → Primrec (fun v : List.Vector ℕ k ↦ t.val v.get f)

  |                         &x => by simpa using Primrec.const _

  |   .func Language.One.one _ => by simpa using Primrec.const 1
  |   .func Language.Add.add v => by

sigma1_re
statement:
lemma sigma1_re (ε : ξ → ℕ) {k} {φ : ArithmeticSemiformula ξ k} (hp : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ) :
    REPred fun v : List.Vector ℕ k ↦ φ.Eval v.get ε
proof:
:= by
  apply sigma₁_induction' hp
  case hVerum => simp;
  case hFalsum => simp
  case hEQ =>
    intro n t₁ t₂
    refine ComputablePred.to_re <| ComputablePred.computable_iff.mpr
      <| ⟨fun v : List.Vector ℕ n ↦ decide (t₁.val v.get ε = t₂.val v.get ε), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Primrec.to_comp (Primrec.eq.comp (term_primrec t₁) (term_primrec t₂)).decide
    · simp
  case hNEQ =>
    intro n t₁ t₂
    refine ComputablePred.to_re <| ComputablePred.computable_iff.mpr
      <| ⟨fun v : List.Vector ℕ n ↦ !decide (t₁.val v.get ε = t₂.val v.get ε), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.not.comp (Primrec.eq.comp (term_primrec t₁) (term_primrec t₂)).decide
    · simp
  case hLT =>
    intro n t₁ t₂
    refine ComputablePred.to_re <| ComputablePred.computable_iff.mpr
      <| ⟨fun v : List.Vector ℕ n ↦ decide (t₁.val v.get ε < t₂.val v.get ε), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Primrec.to_comp (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (term_primrec t₁) (term_primrec t₂)).decide
    · simp
  case hNLT =>
    intro n t₁ t₂
    refine ComputablePred.to_re <| ComputablePred.computable_iff.mpr
      <| ⟨fun v : List.Vector ℕ n ↦ !decide (t₁.val v.get ε < t₂.val v.get ε), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.not.comp (Primrec.nat_lt.comp (term_primrec t₁) (term_primrec t₂)).decide
    · simp
  case hAnd =>
    intro n φ ψ _ _ ihp ihq
    exact REPred.of_eq (ihp.and ihq) fun v ↦ by simp
  case hOr =>
    intro n φ ψ _ _ ihp ihq
    exact REPred.of_eq (ihp.or ihq) fun v ↦ by simp
  case hBall =>
    intro n t φ _ ih
    rcases REPred.iff'.mp ih with ⟨f, hf, H⟩
    let g : List.Vector ℕ n →. Unit := fun v ↦
      Nat.rec (.some ()) (fun x ih ↦ ih.bind fun _ ↦ f (x ::ᵥ v)) (t.val v.get ε)
    have : Partrec g :=
      Partrec.nat_rec (term_primrec t).to_comp (Computable.const ())
        (Partrec.to₂ <| hf.comp (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp .snd) .fst))
    refine REPred.iff.mpr ⟨_, this, ?_⟩
    funext v
    suffices ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ x < k, φ.Eval (x :> v.get) ε) ↔
      Part.Dom (Nat.rec (.some ()) (fun x ih ↦ ih.bind fun _ ↦ f (x ::ᵥ v)) k) by simpa [g] using this _
    intro k; induction k
    case zero => simp
    case succ k ih =>
      suffices
        (∀ x < k + 1, φ.Eval (x :> v.get) ε)
        ↔ (∀ x < k, φ.Eval (x :> v.get) ε) ∧ (f (k ::ᵥ v)).Dom by simpa [←ih]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨fun x hx ↦ h x (lt_trans hx (by simp)),
          (H (k ::ᵥ v)).mp (by simpa [List.Vector.cons_get] using h k (by simp))⟩
      · rintro ⟨hs, hd⟩ x hx
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hx) with (hx | rfl)
        · exact hs x hx
        · simpa [List.Vector.cons_get] using (H (x ::ᵥ v)).mpr hd
  case hExs =>
    intro n φ _ ih
    rcases REPred.iff'.mp ih with ⟨f, _, _⟩
    have : REPred fun vx : List.Vector ℕ n × ℕ ↦ φ.Eval (vx.2 :> vx.1.get) ε := by
      simpa [List.Vector.cons_get] using ih.comp (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_cons.comp .snd .fst)
    simpa using this.projection

name: codeAux_sigma_one
statement: private lemma codeAux_sigma_one {k} (c : Nat.ArithPart₁.Code k) : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 (codeAux c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c
  case zero => simp [codeAux]
  case one => simp [codeAux]
  case add => simp [codeAux]
  case mul => simp [codeAux]
  case lt => simp [codeAux, Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two]
  case equal => simp [codeAux, Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two]
  case proj => simp [codeAux]
  case comp c d ihc ihg =>
    exact Hierarchy.exsClosure (by simp [ihc, ihg])
  case rfind k c ih => simp [codeAux, Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two]; simp [ih]

name: models_codeAux
statement:
private lemma models_codeAux {c : Code k} {f : List.Vector ℕ k →. ℕ} (hc : c.eval f) (y : ℕ) (v : Fin k → ℕ) :
    (codeAux c).Evalf (y :> v) ↔ f (List.Vector.ofFn v) = Part.some y
proof:
:= by
  induction hc generalizing y
  case zero =>
    have : (0 : Part ℕ) = Part.some 0 := rfl
    simp [codeAux, this, eq_comm]
  case one =>
    have : (1 : Part ℕ) = Part.some 1 := rfl
    simp [codeAux, this, eq_comm]
  case equal i j =>
    by_cases hv : v i = v j <;> simp [codeAux, hv, Nat.isEqNat, eq_comm]
  case lt i j =>
    simp [codeAux]
    by_cases hv : v i < v j <;> simp [hv, Nat.isLtNat, eq_comm, Nat.not_lt.mp]
  case add => simp [codeAux, eq_comm]
  case mul => simp [codeAux, eq_comm]
  case proj => simp [codeAux, eq_comm]
  case comp m n c d f g _ _ ihf ihg =>
    suffices
      (∃ e' : Fin n → ℕ, (codeAux c).Evalf (y :> e') ∧ ∀ i, (codeAux (d i)).Evalf (e' i :> v))
      ↔ (List.Vector.mOfFn (g · (List.Vector.ofFn v))).bind f = Part.some y by
        simp [codeAux]
        simpa [Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, hf, hg⟩
      have hf : f (List.Vector.ofFn e) = Part.some y := (ihf _ _).mp hf
      have hg : ∀ i, g i (List.Vector.ofFn v) = Part.some (e i) := fun i => (ihg i _ _).mp (hg i)
      simp only [hg, Vector.mOfFn_part_some]
      exact (Part.bind_some (List.Vector.ofFn e) f).trans hf
    · intro h
      have : ∃ w, (∀ i, List.Vector.get w i ∈ g i (List.Vector.ofFn v)) ∧ y ∈ f w := by
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hy⟩ := Part.mem_bind_iff.mp (Part.eq_some_iff.mp h)
        exact ⟨w, Part.mem_vector_mOfFn.mp hw, hy⟩
      rcases this with ⟨w, hw, hy⟩
      exact ⟨w.get, (ihf y w.get).mpr (by simpa [Part.eq_some_iff] using hy),
        fun i ↦ (ihg i (w.get i) v).mpr (by simpa [Part.eq_some_iff] using hw i)⟩
  case rfind c f _ ihf =>
    suffices
      (f (y ::ᵥ List.Vector.ofFn v) = 0 ∧ ∀ x < y, 0 < f (x ::ᵥ List.Vector.ofFn v))
      ↔ (Nat.rfind fun n ↦ Part.some (decide (f (n ::ᵥ List.Vector.ofFn v) = 0))) = Part.some y by
      simp [codeAux]
      simpa [Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq, Matrix.comp_vecCons', ihf, List.Vector.ofFn_vecCons]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, h⟩
      exact Part.eq_some_iff.mpr (Nat.mem_rfind.mpr ⟨by simp [hy], fun hz => by simp [Nat.ne_zero_of_lt (h _ hz)]⟩)
    · intro h; simpa [pos_iff_ne_zero] using Nat.mem_rfind.mp (Part.eq_some_iff.mp h)

name: models_code
statement:
lemma models_code {c : Code k} {f : List.Vector ℕ k →. ℕ} (hc : c.eval f) (y : ℕ) (v : Fin k → ℕ) :
    (code c).Evalb (y :> v) ↔ y ∈ f (List.Vector.ofFn v)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [code, models_iff, Semiformula.eval_rew, Matrix.empty_eq, Function.comp_def,
    Matrix.comp_vecCons', ←Part.eq_some_iff] using models_codeAux hc y v

name: codeOfPartrec'_spec
statement:
lemma codeOfPartrec'_spec {k} {f : List.Vector ℕ k →. ℕ} (hf : Nat.Partrec' f) {y : ℕ} {v : Fin k → ℕ} :
    (codeOfPartrec' f).Evalb (y :> v) ↔ y ∈ f (List.Vector.ofFn v)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ c, ∀ y v, (code c).Evalb (y :> v) ↔ y ∈ f (List.Vector.ofFn v) := by
    rcases Nat.ArithPart₁.exists_code (of_partrec hf) with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨c, models_code hc⟩
  exact Classical.epsilon_spec this y v

name: codeAux_uniq
statement:
private lemma codeAux_uniq {k} {c : Code k} {v : Fin k → M} {z z' : M} :
    (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (z :> v) → (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (z' :> v) → z = z'
proof:
:= by
  induction c generalizing z z' with
  | zero _ => intro h h'; simp_all [codeAux]
  | one _ => intro h h'; simp_all [codeAux]
  | add i j => intro h h'; simp_all [codeAux]
  | mul i j => intro h h'; simp_all [codeAux]
  | proj i => intro h h'; simp_all [codeAux]
  | equal i j =>
    intro h h'
    by_cases hv : v i = v j <;> simp_all [codeAux]
  | lt i j =>
    intro h h'
    by_cases hv : v i < v j <;> simp_all [codeAux]
  | comp c d ihc ihd =>
    intro h h'
    obtain ⟨w₁, hc₁, hd₁⟩ :
        ∃ e', (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (z :> e') ∧
          ∀ i, (codeAux (d i)).Evalf (M := M) (e' i :> v) := by
      simpa [codeAux, Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq,
        Matrix.comp_vecCons'] using h
    obtain ⟨w₂, hc₂, hd₂⟩ :
        ∃ e', (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (z' :> e') ∧
          ∀ i, (codeAux (d i)).Evalf (M := M) (e' i :> v) := by
      simpa [codeAux, Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq,
        Matrix.comp_vecCons'] using h'
    have : w₁ = w₂ := funext fun i => ihd i (hd₁ i) (hd₂ i)
    rcases this with rfl
    exact ihc hc₁ hc₂
  | rfind c ih =>
    intro H₁ H₂
    obtain ⟨h₁, hm₁⟩ :
        (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (0 :> z :> v) ∧
          ∀ x < z, ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (y :> x :> v) := by
      simpa [codeAux, Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq,
        Matrix.comp_vecCons'] using H₁
    obtain ⟨h₂, hm₂⟩ :
        (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (0 :> z' :> v) ∧
          ∀ x < z', ∃ y, y ≠ 0 ∧ (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (y :> x :> v) := by
      simpa [codeAux, Semiformula.eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq,
        Matrix.comp_vecCons'] using H₂
    clear H₁ H₂
    by_contra hz
    wlog h : z < z' with Hz
    case inr =>
      have : z' < z := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h) (Ne.symm hz)
      exact Hz (k := k) c ih h₂ hm₂ h₁ hm₁ (Ne.symm hz) this
    have : ∃ x, x ≠ 0 ∧ (codeAux c).Evalf (M := M) (x :> z :> fun i => v i) := hm₂ z h
    rcases this with ⟨x, xz, hx⟩
    exact xz (ih hx h₁)

name: code_uniq
statement:
lemma code_uniq {k} {c : Code k} {v : Fin k → M} {z z' : M} :
    (code c).Evalb (M := M) (z :> v) → (code c).Evalb (M := M) (z' :> v) → z = z'
proof:
:= by
  intro h h'
  exact codeAux_uniq
    (by simpa [code, Semiformula.eval_rew, Matrix.empty_eq, Function.comp_def] using h)
    (by simpa [code, Semiformula.eval_rew, Matrix.empty_eq, Function.comp_def] using h')

name: codeOfREPred_spec
statement:
lemma codeOfREPred_spec {p : ℕ → Prop} (hp : REPred p) {x : ℕ} :
    (codeOfREPred p).Evalb ![x] ↔ p x
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ →. Unit := fun a ↦ Part.assert (p a) fun _ ↦ Part.some ()
  suffices (codeOfPartrec' fun v ↦ Part.map (fun _ ↦ 0) (f (v.get 0)))/[‘0’, #0].Evalb (![x]) ↔ p x from this
  have : Partrec fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 ↦ (f (v.get 0)).map fun _ ↦ 0 := by
    refine Partrec.map (Partrec.comp hp (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_get.comp .id (.const 0))) (Computable.const 0).to₂
  simpa [Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.comp_vecCons', Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]
    using (codeOfPartrec'_spec (Nat.Partrec'.of_part this) (v := ![x]) (y := 0)).trans (by simp [f])

name: rePred_weak_representation
statement:
theorem rePred_weak_representation {p : ℕ → Prop} (hp : REPred p) {x : ℕ} :
    p x ↔ T ⊢ (codeOfREPred p)/[x]
proof:
:= Iff.trans
  (by simpa [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using (codeOfREPred_spec hp (x := x)).symm)
  (sigma_one_completeness_iff <| by simp [codeOfREPred, codeOfPartrec'])

name: codeOfComputablePred_sigma1
statement: @[simp] lemma codeOfComputablePred_sigma1 (p : ℕ → Prop) : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 (codeOfComputablePred p)

name: codeOfComputablePred_val_spec
proof:
:= by
  have hpart :
      Nat.Partrec' (fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 ↦ Part.some (if p (v.get 0) then 1 else 0)) := by
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := ComputablePred.computable_iff.mp hp
    have hc : Computable fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 ↦ f (v.get 0) :=
      hf.comp (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_get.comp .id (.const 0))
    have : Computable fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 ↦ if (f (v.get 0) : Prop) then (1 : ℕ) else 0 :=
      (Computable.cond hc (Computable.const 1) (Computable.const 0)).of_eq fun v ↦ by
        cases f (v.get 0) <;> simp
    exact Nat.Partrec'.of_part (this.partrec.of_eq fun v ↦ by simp)
  simpa using codeOfPartrec'_spec hpart (y := y) (v := ![x])

name: codeOfComputablePred_provable
statement:
theorem codeOfComputablePred_provable [𝗥₀ ⪯ T] (hp : ComputablePred p) (h : p x) :
    T ⊢ (codeOfComputablePred p)/[↑x]
proof:
:=
  sigma_one_completeness (by simp) (by
    have : (codeOfComputablePred p).Evalb ![x] ↔ p x := by
      simpa [codeOfComputablePred, Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.comp_vecCons',
        Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]
        using (codeOfComputablePred_val_spec hp x 1).trans (by by_cases hx : p x <;> simp [hx])
    simpa [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using this.mpr h)

name: codeOfComputablePred_provable_neg
statement:
theorem codeOfComputablePred_provable_neg [𝗣𝗔⁻ ⪯ T] (hp : ComputablePred p) (h : ¬p x) :
    T ⊢ ∼((codeOfComputablePred p)/[↑x])
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝗘𝗤 _ ⪯ T := Entailment.WeakerThan.trans (𝓣 := 𝗣𝗔⁻) inferInstance inferInstance
  refine complete.{0} T _ fun M _ _ ↦ ?_
  have hPA : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔⁻ := ModelsTheory.of_provably_subtheory M 𝗣𝗔⁻ T inferInstance
  have hNotEval : ¬(codeOfComputablePred p).Evalb (M := M) ![ORingStructure.numeral x] := by
    intro hM
    have hR0 : M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗥₀ := ModelsTheory.of_provably_subtheory M 𝗥₀ 𝗣𝗔⁻ inferInstance
    have h0 : (codeOfPartrec' (fun v ↦ Part.some (if p (v.get 0) then 1 else 0))).Evalb
        (M := ℕ) (0 :> ![x]) :=
      (codeOfComputablePred_val_spec hp x 0).mpr (by simp [h])
    have h1 : (codeOfPartrec' (fun v ↦ Part.some (if p (v.get 0) then 1 else 0))).Evalb (M := M)
        ((0 : M) :> ![ORingStructure.numeral x]) := by
      simpa using bold_sigma_one_completeness' (M := M)
        (σ := codeOfPartrec' (fun v ↦ Part.some (if p (v.get 0) then 1 else 0)))
        (by simp [codeOfPartrec']) h0
    have h2 : (codeOfPartrec' (fun v ↦ Part.some (if p (v.get 0) then 1 else 0))).Evalb (M := M)
        ((1 : M) :> ![ORingStructure.numeral x]) := by
      simpa [codeOfComputablePred, Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.comp_vecCons',
        Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]
        using hM
    exact absurd (code_uniq h1 h2) (ne_of_lt zero_lt_one)
  simpa [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_substs, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton] using hNotEval

name: rePred_iff_sigma1
statement: theorem rePred_iff_sigma1 {p : ℕ → Prop} : REPred p ↔ 𝚺₁-Predicate p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨.mkSigma (codeOfREPred p) (by simp [codeOfREPred, codeOfPartrec']), ?_⟩
    intro v
    simpa [←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_one] using codeOfREPred_spec h (x := v 0)
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    have : REPred fun x ↦ (Semiformula.Eval (x ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil).get id) _ :=
      (sigma1_re id (φ.sigma_prop)).comp
        (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_cons.comp .id <| .const _)
    exact this.of_eq <| by intro x; simpa [List.Vector.cons_get, Matrix.empty_eq] using hφ ![x]

name: computablePred_iff_delta1
statement: theorem computablePred_iff_delta1 {p : ℕ → Prop} : ComputablePred p ↔ 𝚫₁-Predicate p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hp
    change 𝚫₁.Definable (fun v : Fin 1 → ℕ ↦ p (v 0))
    rw [HierarchySymbol.Definable.delta_iff_sigma_and_pi]
    rcases ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mp hp with ⟨hp, hnp⟩
    exact ⟨(rePred_iff_sigma1.mp hnp).notSigma.of_iff (by intro v; simp), rePred_iff_sigma1.mp hp⟩
  · intro h
    change 𝚫₁.Definable (fun v : Fin 1 → ℕ ↦ p (v 0)) at h
    rw [HierarchySymbol.Definable.delta_iff_sigma_and_pi] at h
    exact ComputablePred.computable_iff_re_compl_re'.mpr
      ⟨rePred_iff_sigma1.mpr h.2, rePred_iff_sigma1.mpr h.1.notPi⟩

name: computable_iff_sigma1
statement: theorem computable_iff_sigma1 {f : ℕ → ℕ} : Computable f ↔ 𝚺₁-Function₁ f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    let F : List.Vector ℕ 1 →. ℕ := fun v ↦ Part.some (f (v.get 0))
    have hF : Partrec F := by
      change Partrec fun v : List.Vector ℕ 1 ↦ Part.some (f (v.get 0))
      exact hf.comp (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_get.comp .id (.const (0 : Fin 1)))
    refine ⟨.mkSigma (codeOfPartrec' F) (by simp [codeOfPartrec']), ?_⟩
    intro v
    simpa [F, ←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two]
      using codeOfPartrec'_spec (Nat.Partrec'.of_part hF) (y := v 0) (v := ![v 1])
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    have hRe : REPred fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦
        φ.val.Eval (p.2 ::ᵥ p.1 ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil : List.Vector ℕ 2).get id :=
      (sigma1_re id φ.sigma_prop).comp
        (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_cons.comp .snd
          (Primrec.vector_cons.comp .fst (.const List.Vector.nil)))
    exact ComputablePred.of_graph_rePred <| hRe.of_eq <| by
      intro p
      simpa [List.Vector.cons_get] using hφ ![p.2, p.1]

name: computable
statement: theorem computable₂_iff_sigma1 {f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ} : Computable₂ f ↔ 𝚺₁-Function₂ f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    let F : List.Vector ℕ 2 →. ℕ := fun v ↦ Part.some (f (v.get 0) (v.get 1))
    have hF : Partrec F := by
      have hArg : Computable fun v : List.Vector ℕ 2 ↦ (v.get 0, v.get 1) :=
        (Primrec.vector_get.comp .id (.const (0 : Fin 2))).to_comp.pair
          (Primrec.vector_get.comp .id (.const (1 : Fin 2))).to_comp
      have hf' : Computable fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ f p.1 p.2 := hf
      change Partrec fun v : List.Vector ℕ 2 ↦ Part.some (f (v.get 0) (v.get 1))
      exact hf'.comp hArg
    refine ⟨.mkSigma (codeOfPartrec' F) (by simp [codeOfPartrec']), ?_⟩
    intro v
    simpa [F, ←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_three]
      using codeOfPartrec'_spec (Nat.Partrec'.of_part hF) (y := v 0) (v := ![v 1, v 2])
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    have hRe : REPred fun p : (ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ ↦
        φ.val.Eval
          (p.2 ::ᵥ p.1.1 ::ᵥ p.1.2 ::ᵥ List.Vector.nil : List.Vector ℕ 3).get id :=
      (sigma1_re id φ.sigma_prop).comp
        (Primrec.to_comp <| Primrec.vector_cons.comp .snd
          (Primrec.vector_cons.comp (Primrec.fst.comp .fst)
            (Primrec.vector_cons.comp (Primrec.snd.comp .fst) (.const List.Vector.nil))))
    exact ComputablePred.of_graph_rePred <| hRe.of_eq <| by
      intro p
      simpa [List.Vector.cons_get] using hφ ![p.2, p.1.1, p.1.2]

name: and_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma and_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋏ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ
proof:
:=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋏ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hr
      case and =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
   by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.and hp hq⟩

name: or_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma or_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ ⋎ ψ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ
proof:
:=
  ⟨by generalize hr : φ ⋎ ψ = r
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hr
      case or =>
        rcases hr with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        constructor <;> assumption,
      by rintro ⟨hp, hq⟩; exact Hierarchy.or hp hq⟩

name: conj_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma conj_iff {φ : Fin m → Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (Matrix.conj φ) ↔ ∀ i, Hierarchy Γ s (φ i)
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> simp [Matrix.conj, Matrix.vecTail, *]
  · exact ⟨by rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [*],
           by intro h; exact ⟨h 0, fun _ => h _⟩⟩

name: zero_eq_alt
statement: lemma zero_eq_alt {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ
proof:
:= by
  generalize hz : 0 = z
  rw [eq_comm] at hz
  intro h
  induction h <;> try simp at hz ⊢
  case and _ _ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case or _ _ ihp ihq => exact ⟨ihp hz, ihq hz⟩
  case ball pos _ ih => exact ball pos (ih hz)
  case bexs pos _ ih => exact bexs pos (ih hz)

name: pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero
statement: lemma pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy 𝚷 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy 𝚺 0 φ

name: zero_iff
statement: lemma zero_iff {Γ Γ'} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ' 0 φ
proof: := by rcases Γ <;> rcases Γ' <;> simp [pi_zero_iff_sigma_zero]

name: zero_iff_delta_zero
statement: lemma zero_iff_delta_zero {Γ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ 0 φ ↔ DeltaZero φ

name: alt_zero_iff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma alt_zero_iff_zero {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ.alt 0 φ ↔ Hierarchy Γ 0 φ

name: accum
statement:
lemma accum {Γ} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → ∀ Γ', Hierarchy Γ' (s + 1) φ
  |    verum _ _ _, _ => verum _ _ _
  |   falsum _ _ _, _ => falsum _ _ _
  |    rel _ _ r v, _ => rel _ _ r v
  |   nrel _ _ r v, _ => nrel _ _ r v
  |      and hp hq, _ => and (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  |       or hp hq, _ => or (hp.accum _) (hq.accum _)
  |    ball pos hp, _ => ball pos (hp.accum _)
  |     bexs pos hp, _ => bexs pos (hp.accum _)
  |         all hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact hp.dummy_sigma
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).all
  |          exs hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).exs
    · exact hp.dummy_pi
  |       sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).exs
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi
  |          pi hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  | dummy_sigma hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚷).dummy_sigma
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚷).accum 𝚷).all
  |    dummy_pi hp, Γ => by
    cases Γ
    · exact ((hp.accum 𝚺).accum 𝚺).exs
    · exact (hp.accum 𝚺).dummy_pi

name: strict_mono
statement: lemma strict_mono {Γ s} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (Γ') {s'} (h : s < s') : Hierarchy Γ' s' φ
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ d, Hierarchy Γ' (s + d + 1) φ := by
    intro d
    induction' d with s ih
    · simpa using hp.accum Γ'
    · simpa only [Nat.add_succ, add_zero] using ih.accum _
  simpa [show s + (s' - s.succ) + 1 = s' from by simpa [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_sub_of_le h] using this (s' - s.succ)

name: mono
statement: lemma mono {Γ} {s s' : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy Γ s φ) (h : s ≤ s') : Hierarchy Γ s' φ
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl)
  · exact hp.strict_mono Γ lt
  · assumption

name: of_zero
statement: lemma of_zero {b b'} {s : ℕ} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : Hierarchy b 0 φ) : Hierarchy b' s φ
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.zero_le s) with (rfl | pos)
  · exact zero_iff.mp hp
  · exact strict_mono hp b' pos

name: equal
statement: @[simp] lemma equal [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t = !!u”

name: lt
statement: @[simp] lemma lt [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t < !!u”

name: le
statement: @[simp] lemma le [L.Eq] [L.LT] {t u : Semiterm L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s “!!t ≤ !!u”
proof:
:= by
  simp [Semiformula.Operator.operator, Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two,
    Semiformula.Operator.Eq.sentence_eq, Semiformula.Operator.LT.sentence_eq,
    Semiformula.Operator.LE.sentence_eq]

name: neg
statement: lemma neg {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ.alt s (∼φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h; induction h <;> try simp [*]
  case bexs pos _ ih => exact ball pos ih
  case ball pos _ ih => exact bexs pos ih
  case exs ih => exact all ih
  case all ih => exact exs ih
  case sigma ih => exact pi ih
  case pi ih => exact sigma ih
  case dummy_pi ih => exact dummy_sigma ih
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact dummy_pi ih

name: neg_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (∼φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using neg h, fun h => by simpa using neg h⟩

name: imp_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma imp_iff {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ n} : Hierarchy Γ s (φ 🡒 ψ) ↔ (Hierarchy Γ.alt s φ ∧ Hierarchy Γ s ψ)

name: ball_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma ball_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∀¹[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∀¹[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hq
      case ball φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case all hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case pi s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚺 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_sigma hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.ball ht⟩

name: bexs_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma bexs_iff {Γ s n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ (n + 1)} (ht : t.Positive) :
    Hierarchy Γ s (∃¹[“x. x < !!t”] φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨by generalize hq : (∃¹[“x. x < !!t”] φ) = ψ
      intro H
      induction H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hq
      case bexs φ t pt hp ih =>
        rcases hq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        assumption
      case exs hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simpa using hp
      case sigma s _ _ hp ih =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        exact (show Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ from by simpa using hp).accum _
      case dummy_pi hp _ =>
        rcases hq with rfl
        simp at hp
        exact hp.accum _,
   by intro hp; exact hp.bexs ht⟩

name: pi_of_pi_all
statement: lemma pi_of_pi_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 s (∀¹ φ) → Hierarchy 𝚷 s φ
proof:
:= by
  generalize hr : ∀¹ φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚷 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hr
  case ball => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case all => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

statement: @[simp] lemma all_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} : Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) (∀¹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy 𝚷 (s + 1) φ

:= by
  generalize hr : ∃¹ φ = r
  generalize hb : (𝚺 : Polarity) = Γ
  intro H
  cases H <;> try simp [FFL.FirstOrder.ball, FFL.FirstOrder.bexs] at hr
  case bexs => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case exs => rcases hr with rfl; simpa
  case sigma hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _
  case dummy_pi hp => rcases hr with rfl; exact hp.accum _

name: rew
statement: lemma rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} : Hierarchy Γ s φ → Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h; induction h generalizing n₂ <;> try simp [*]
  case sigma ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case pi ih => exact (ih _).accum _
  case dummy_pi ih => exact (ih _).dummy_pi
  case dummy_sigma ih => exact (ih _).dummy_sigma

name: rew_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma rew_iff {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} :
    Hierarchy Γ s (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Hierarchy Γ s φ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · generalize eq : ω ▹ φ = ψ
    intro hq
    induction hq generalizing φ n₁
      <;> try simp [Semiformula.eq_rel_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_nrel_iff, Semiformula.eq_ball_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_bexs_iff, Semiformula.eq_all_iff,
        Semiformula.eq_exs_iff] at eq
    case verum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case falsum => rcases eq with rfl; simp
    case rel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case nrel => rcases eq with ⟨v', rfl, rfl⟩; simp
    case and ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case or ihp ihq =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa using ⟨ihp rfl, ihq rfl⟩
    case ball pos _ ih =>
      simp only [Rew.eq_lt_iff, Rew.q_eq_zero_iff, Matrix.vecCons_empty_eq_singleton,
        exists_and_left, exists_eq_left] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case bexs pos _ ih =>
      simp only [Rew.eq_lt_iff, Rew.q_eq_zero_iff, Matrix.vecCons_empty_eq_singleton,
        exists_and_left, exists_eq_left] at eq
      rcases eq with ⟨hp, ⟨u, rfl, s, hs, rfl⟩, φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      simpa [show u.Positive from by simpa using pos] using ih rfl
    case all ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).all
    case exs ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).exs
    case pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).pi
    case sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).sigma
    case dummy_sigma ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_sigma
    case dummy_pi ih =>
      rcases eq with ⟨φ, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact (ih rfl).dummy_pi
  · exact rew _

name: exsClosure
statement:
lemma exsClosure : {n : ℕ} → {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 (s + 1) (exsClosure φ)
  | 0, _, hp => hp
  | _ + 1, φ, hp => exsClosure (φ := ∃¹ φ) hp.exs

instance : LogicalConnective.AndOrClosed (Hierarchy Γ s : Semiformula L ξ k → Prop) where
  verum
proof:
:= verum _ _ _
  falsum := falsum _ _ _
  and := and
  or := or

  case hand ihp ihq => intro hp hq; exact ⟨ihp hp, ihq hq⟩
  case hor ihp ihq => intro hp hq; exact ⟨ihp hp, ihq hq⟩

statement:
@[simp] lemma list_conj₂_iff {Γ s n} {l : List (Semiformula L ξ n)} :

proof:
:= by
  match l with
  |          [] => simp
  |         [_] => simp
  | ψ :: χ :: l => simp [list_conj₂_iff (l := χ :: l)]

proof:

name: toPrenex
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing n j with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ s ih =>
    rw [Polarity.altItr_succ] at h
    show Hierarchy Γ (j + (s + 1)) (Polarity.quantItr Γ (s + 1) φ)
    rw [Polarity.quantItr_succ', (show j + (s + 1) = (j + 1) + s by omega)]
    rcases hΓ : Γ.altItr s with _ | _
    . apply ih
      rw [hΓ] at h ⊢
      exact h.sigma
    . apply ih
      rw [hΓ] at h ⊢
      exact h.pi

name: sigma
statement:
lemma sigma₁_induction {P : (n : ℕ) → ArithmeticSemiformula ξ n → Prop}
    (hVerum : ∀ n, P n ⊤)
    (hFalsum : ∀ n, P n ⊥)
    (hEQ : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.rel Language.Eq.eq ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hNEQ : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.nrel Language.Eq.eq ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hLT : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.rel Language.LT.lt ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hNLT : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.nrel Language.LT.lt ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hAnd : ∀ n φ ψ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 1 ψ → P n φ → P n ψ → P n (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hOr : ∀ n φ ψ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 1 ψ → P n φ → P n ψ → P n (φ ⋎ ψ))
    (hBall : ∀ n t φ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → P (n + 1) φ → P n (∀¹[“#0 < !!(Rew.bShift t)”] φ))
    (hExs : ∀ n φ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → P (n + 1) φ → P n (∃¹ φ)) (n φ) : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → P n φ
  |               Hierarchy.verum _ _ _ => hVerum _
  |              Hierarchy.falsum _ _ _ => hFalsum _
  |  Hierarchy.rel _ _ Language.Eq.eq v => by simpa [←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two] using hEQ _ (v 0) (v 1)
  | Hierarchy.nrel _ _ Language.Eq.eq v => by simpa [←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two] using hNEQ _ (v 0) (v 1)
  |  Hierarchy.rel _ _ Language.LT.lt v => by simpa [←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two] using hLT _ (v 0) (v 1)
  | Hierarchy.nrel _ _ Language.LT.lt v => by simpa [←Matrix.fun_eq_vec_two] using hNLT _ (v 0) (v 1)
  |                 Hierarchy.and hp hq =>
    hAnd _ _ _ hp hq
      (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hp)
      (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hq)
  |                  Hierarchy.or hp hq =>
    hOr _ _ _ hp hq
      (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hp)
      (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hq)
  |                Hierarchy.ball pt hp => by
    rcases Rew.positive_iff.mp pt with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact hBall _ t _ hp (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hp)
  |                 Hierarchy.bexs pt hp => by
    apply hExs
    · simp [hp]
    · rcases Rew.positive_iff.mp pt with ⟨t, rfl⟩
      apply hAnd _ _ _ (by simp) hp (by simpa [Semiformula.Operator.lt_def] using hLT _ _ _)
        (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hp)
  |         Hierarchy.sigma (φ := φ) hp =>
    have : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ
proof:
:= hp.accum _
    hExs _ _ this (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ this)
  |                    Hierarchy.exs hp =>
    hExs _ _ hp (sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs _ _ hp)

name: sigma
statement:
lemma sigma₁_induction' {n φ} (hp : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ)
    {P : (n : ℕ) → ArithmeticSemiformula ξ n → Prop}
    (hVerum : ∀ n, P n ⊤)
    (hFalsum : ∀ n, P n ⊥)
    (hEQ : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.rel Language.Eq.eq ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hNEQ : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.nrel Language.Eq.eq ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hLT : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.rel Language.LT.lt ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hNLT : ∀ n t₁ t₂, P n (.nrel Language.LT.lt ![t₁, t₂]))
    (hAnd : ∀ n φ ψ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 1 ψ → P n φ → P n ψ → P n (φ ⋏ ψ))
    (hOr : ∀ n φ ψ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → Hierarchy 𝚺 1 ψ → P n φ → P n ψ → P n (φ ⋎ ψ))
    (hBall : ∀ n t φ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → P (n + 1) φ → P n (∀¹[“#0 < !!(Rew.bShift t)”] φ))
    (hExs : ∀ n φ, Hierarchy 𝚺 1 φ → P (n + 1) φ → P n (∃¹ φ)) : P n φ
proof:
:=
  sigma₁_induction hVerum hFalsum hEQ hNEQ hLT hNLT hAnd hOr hBall hExs n φ hp

name: ArithmeticTheory.soundOnHierarchy
statement:
lemma ArithmeticTheory.soundOnHierarchy (T : ArithmeticTheory) (Γ : Polarity) (k : ℕ) [T.SoundOnHierarchy Γ k] :
    T ⊢ σ → Arithmetic.Hierarchy Γ k σ → ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ σ

name: complete_aux
statement:
private lemma complete_aux (T : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ T] (φ : ArithmeticSentence)
    (H : ∀ (M : Type w)
           [ORingStructure M]
           [Structure ℒₒᵣ M]
           [Structure.ORing ℒₒᵣ M]
           [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T],
           M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ φ) :
    T ⊢ φ
proof:
:= Theory.Proof.complete <| consequence_iff_eq.mpr fun M _ _ _ hT ↦
  letI : (Structure.Model ℒₒᵣ M)↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T := Structure.ElementaryEquiv.modelsTheory.mp hT
  Structure.ElementaryEquiv.models.mpr (H (Structure.Model ℒₒᵣ M))

name: standardModel_unique'
statement:
lemma standardModel_unique' (s : Structure ℒₒᵣ M)
    (hZero : Structure.Zero ℒₒᵣ M) (hOne : Structure.One ℒₒᵣ M) (hAdd : Structure.Add ℒₒᵣ M) (hMul : Structure.Mul ℒₒᵣ M)
    (hEq : Structure.Eq ℒₒᵣ M) (hLT : Structure.LT ℒₒᵣ M) : s = standardModel M
proof:
:= Structure.ext
  (funext₃ fun k f _ ↦
    match k, f with
    | _, Language.Zero.zero => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
    | _,   Language.One.one => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
    | _,   Language.Add.add => by simp
    | _,   Language.Mul.mul => by simp)
  (funext₃ fun k r _ =>
    match k, r with
    | _, Language.Eq.eq => by simp
    | _, Language.LT.lt => by simp)

name: standardModel_unique
statement:
lemma standardModel_unique (s : Structure ℒₒᵣ M)
    [hZero : Structure.Zero ℒₒᵣ M] [hOne : Structure.One ℒₒᵣ M] [hAdd : Structure.Add ℒₒᵣ M] [hMul : Structure.Mul ℒₒᵣ M]
    [hEq : Structure.Eq ℒₒᵣ M] [hLT : Structure.LT ℒₒᵣ M] : s = standardModel M
proof:
:=
  standardModel_unique' M s hZero hOne hAdd hMul hEq hLT

name: complete
statement:
lemma complete (T : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ T] (φ : ArithmeticSentence) (H : ∀ (M : Type*) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T], M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ φ) :
    T ⊢ φ
proof:
:= complete_aux T φ fun M _ s _ _ ↦ by
  rcases standardModel_unique M s
  exact H M

name: provable_iff_of_models_iff
proof:
:= by
  apply Arithmetic.complete T _
  intro V _ _
  simpa [models_iff] using h V

name: models_iff_of_provable_iff
statement:
lemma models_iff_of_provable_iff {T : ArithmeticTheory} [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ T] {n}
    {φ ψ : ArithmeticSemisentence n} (h : T ⊢ ∀¹* (φ 🡘 ψ)) (V : Type*)
    [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] (e : Fin n → V) :
    V ⊧/e φ ↔ V ⊧/e ψ
proof:
:= by
  have h' := consequence_iff.mp (Theory.Proof.sound h) V inferInstance
  simp only [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_allClosure] at h'
  simpa using h' e

name: weakerThan_of_models
statement:
lemma weakerThan_of_models (T S : ArithmeticTheory) [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ S]
    (H : ∀ (M : Type*)
           [ORingStructure M]
           [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* S],
           M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T) : T ⪯ S
proof:
:=
  Entailment.weakerThan_iff.mpr fun h ↦ complete _ _ fun M _ _ ↦ Theory.Proof.sound h (H M)

name: equiv_of_models
statement:
lemma equiv_of_models {T S : ArithmeticTheory} [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ S] [𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ⪯ T]
    (hTS : ∀ (M : Type*) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* S], M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T)
    (hST : ∀ (M : Type*) [ORingStructure M] [M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T], M↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* S) : T ≊ S
proof:
:=
  Entailment.Equiv.antisymm ⟨weakerThan_of_models T S hTS, weakerThan_of_models S T hST⟩

    U.SoundOn F

name: g
statement:
lemma gödelNumber_def (a : α) :

@[simp] lemma numeral_eq_numeral : (z : ℕ) → (Semiterm.Operator.numeral L z).val ![] = (ORingStructure.numeral z : M)

name: eval_ballLTSucc

lemma eval_ballLTSucc {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} {fv bv} :
    (φ.ballLTSucc t).Eval (M := M) fv bv ↔ ∀ x < t.val (M := M) fv bv + 1, φ.Eval (M := M) (x :> fv) bv

lemma eval_bexsLTSucc {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} {t : Semiterm L ξ n} {fv bv} :
