name: term_monotone
proof:
:= by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, Monotone.monotone]

name: _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Theory.OmegaOne.mem_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Theory.OmegaOne.mem_iff {σ} : σ ∈ 𝝮₁ ↔ σ = Omega1.omega1
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨⟩; rfl, by rintro rfl; exact Omega1.omega⟩

name: models_Omega1_iff
statement: lemma models_Omega1_iff [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₀] : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ Omega1.omega1 ↔ ∀ x : V, ∃ y, Exponential (‖x‖^2) y

name: omega1_of_ISigma1
statement: lemma omega1_of_ISigma1 [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁] : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧ Omega1.omega1

name: exists_exponential_sq_length
statement: lemma exists_exponential_sq_length (x : V) : ∃ y, Exponential (‖x‖^2) y

name: exists_unique_exponential_sq_length
statement: lemma exists_unique_exponential_sq_length (x : V) : ∃! y, Exponential (‖x‖^2) y
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_exponential_sq_length x with ⟨y, h⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro y h (fun y' h' ↦ h'.uniq h)

name: smash_exists_unique
statement: lemma smash_exists_unique (x y : V) : ∃! z, Exponential (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) z
proof:
:= by
  wlog le : x ≤ y
  · simpa [mul_comm] using this y x (le_of_not_ge le)
  rcases exists_exponential_sq_length y with ⟨z, h⟩
  have : ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ < ‖z‖ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (by simpa [sq] using mul_le_mul_right (length_monotone le)) h.lt_length
  have : Exponential (‖x‖ * ‖y‖) (bexp z (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)) := exp_bexp_of_lt (a := z) (x := ‖x‖ * ‖y‖) this
  exact ExistsUnique.intro (bexp z (‖x‖ * ‖y‖)) this (fun z' H' ↦ H'.uniq this)

name: exponential_smash
statement: lemma exponential_smash (a b : V) : Exponential (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) (a ⨳ b)

name: exponential_smash_one
statement: lemma exponential_smash_one (a : V) : Exponential ‖a‖ (a ⨳ 1)

name: smash_pow2
statement: @[simp] lemma smash_pow2 (a b : V) : Pow2 (a ⨳ b)

name: smash_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma smash_pos (a b : V) : 0 < a ⨳ b

name: smash_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma smash_lt (a b : V) : ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ < a ⨳ b

name: length_smash
statement: lemma length_smash (a b : V) : ‖a ⨳ b‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ + 1

name: smash_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma smash_zero_left (a : V) : 0 ⨳ a = 1

name: smash_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma smash_zero_right (a : V) : a ⨳ 0 = 1

name: smash_comm
statement: lemma smash_comm (a b : V) : a ⨳ b = b ⨳ a
proof: := (exponential_smash a b).uniq (by simpa [mul_comm] using exponential_smash b a)

name: lt_smash_one_right
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_smash_one_right (a : V) : a < a ⨳ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Exponential ‖a‖ (a ⨳ 1) := by simpa using (exponential_smash a 1)
  exact lt_exponential_length this

name: lt_smash_one_righs
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_smash_one_righs (a : V) : a ⨳ 1 ≤ 2 * a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · exact (le_iff_lt_length_of_exp (exponential_smash a 1)).mpr (by
      suffices ‖a‖ < ‖a * 2 + 1‖ by simpa [mul_comm 2 a]
      have : ‖a * 2 + 1‖ = ‖a‖ + 1 := by
        simpa using length_mul_pow2_add_of_lt pos (show Pow2 2 from by simp) one_lt_two
      simp [this])

name: lt_smash_iff
statement: lemma lt_smash_iff {a b c : V} : a < b ⨳ c ↔ ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖ * ‖c‖

name: smash_le_iff
statement: lemma smash_le_iff {a b c : V} : b ⨳ c ≤ a ↔ ‖b‖ * ‖c‖ < ‖a‖

name: lt_smash_one_iff
statement: lemma lt_smash_one_iff {a b : V} : a < b ⨳ 1 ↔ ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖
proof: := by simpa using lt_smash_iff (a := a) (b := b) (c := 1)

name: smash_monotone
statement: lemma smash_monotone {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : V} (h₁ : a₁ ≤ b₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≤ b₂) : a₁ ⨳ a₂ ≤ b₁ ⨳ b₂
proof:
:=
  (exponential_smash a₁ a₂).monotone_le (exponential_smash b₁ b₂) (mul_le_mul (length_monotone h₁) (length_monotone h₂) (by simp) (by simp))

name: bexp_eq_smash
statement: lemma bexp_eq_smash (a b : V) : bexp (a ⨳ b) (‖a‖ * ‖b‖) = a ⨳ b

name: smash_two_mul
statement: lemma smash_two_mul (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : a ⨳ (2 * b) = (a ⨳ b) * (a ⨳ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : Exponential (‖a‖ * ‖b‖ + ‖a‖) (a ⨳ (2 * b)) := by
    simpa [length_two_mul_of_pos pos, mul_add] using exponential_smash a (2 * b)
  have h₂ : Exponential (‖a‖ * ‖b‖ + ‖a‖) (a ⨳ b * a ⨳ 1) := (exponential_smash a b).add_mul (exponential_smash_one a)
  exact h₁.uniq h₂

name: smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash
statement: lemma smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash (a b : V) : a ⨳ (2 * b) ≤ (a ⨳ b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · simpa [smash_two_mul a pos, sq]
    using smash_monotone (by rfl) (pos_iff_one_le.mp pos)

name: llen_lt_len_smash_len
statement: @[simp] lemma llen_lt_len_smash_len (K : V) : ‖‖K‖‖ < ‖K ⨳ ‖K‖‖
proof:
:= by
  suffices ‖‖K‖‖ ≤ ‖K‖ * ‖‖K‖‖ by simpa [length_smash, lt_succ_iff_le]
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le ‖K‖ with (hK | pos)
  · simp [←hK]
  · exact le_mul_of_pos_left pos

name: mul_len_lt_len_smash
statement: lemma mul_len_lt_len_smash {i I L : V} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) : i * ‖L‖ < ‖I ⨳ L‖

name: mul_len_lt_len_smash'
statement: lemma mul_len_lt_len_smash' {i K z : V} (hi : i ≤ ‖z‖) : i * ‖‖K‖‖ < ‖z ⨳ ‖K‖‖

name: ext_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: lemma ext_eq_zero_of_lt {L S i : V} (h : ‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖) : S{L}[i] = 0

name: ext_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma ext_le_self (L S i : V) : S{L}[i] ≤ S

name: ext_graph_aux
statement: lemma ext_graph_aux (z S L i : V) : z = S{L}[i] ↔ (‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ → z = 0) ∧ (i * ‖L‖ < ‖S‖ → ∃ b ≤ S, Exponential (i * ‖L‖) b ∧ z = S / b % (L ⨳ 1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases show ‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ ∨ i * ‖L‖ < ‖S‖ from le_or_gt _ _ with (le | lt)
  · simp [ext_eq_zero_of_lt le, le, not_lt.mpr le]
  · suffices z = S / bexp S (i * ‖L‖) % L ⨳ 1 ↔ ∃ b ≤ S, Exponential (i * ‖L‖) b ∧ z = S / b % L ⨳ 1 by
      simpa [lt, not_le.mpr lt, ext]
    have := exp_bexp_of_lt lt
    constructor
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨bexp S (i * ‖L‖), by simp, exp_bexp_of_lt lt, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨b, _, H, rfl⟩
      rcases H.uniq (exp_bexp_of_lt lt); rfl

name: ext_graph
statement:
lemma ext_graph (z S L i : V) : z = S{L}[i] ↔
    ∃ lS ≤ S, lS = ‖S‖ ∧ ∃ lL ≤ L, lL = ‖L‖ ∧
      (lS ≤ i * lL → z = 0) ∧
      (i * lL < lS →
        ∃ b ≤ S, Exponential (i * lL) b ∧ ∃ hL ≤ 2 * L + 1, Exponential lL hL ∧ ∃ divS ≤ S, divS = S / b ∧ z = divS % hL)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ext_graph_aux]
  rcases show ‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ ∨ i * ‖L‖ < ‖S‖ from le_or_gt _ _ with (le | lt)
  · simp [le, not_lt.mpr le]
  · suffices (∃ b ≤ S, Exponential (i * ‖L‖) b ∧ z = S / b % L ⨳ 1)
      ↔ ∃ b ≤ S, Exponential (i * ‖L‖) b ∧ ∃ hL ≤ 2 * L + 1, Exponential ‖L‖ hL ∧ z = S / b % hL
    by simpa [lt, not_le.mpr lt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, Hb, rfl⟩;
      refine ⟨b, hb, Hb, L ⨳ 1, by simp, exponential_smash_one L, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, Hb, hL, _, HhL, _, _, rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨b, hb, Hb, by rw [HhL.uniq (exponential_smash_one L)]⟩

statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_seven {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 7 = s 6

statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_eight {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 8 = s 7

statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_nine {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 9 = s 8

name: ext_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma ext_zero (L i : V) : 0{L}[i] = 0

name: ext_zero_eq_self_of_le
statement: lemma ext_zero_eq_self_of_le {L S : V} (h : ‖S‖ ≤ ‖L‖) : S{L}[0] = S
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le S with (rfl | pos)
  · simp [ext]
  · simp [ext]
    have : bexp S 0 = 1 := (exp_bexp_of_lt (show 0 < ‖S‖ from by simp [pos])).zero_uniq
    simp [this, lt_smash_one_iff.mpr h]

name: ext_eq_of_ge
statement: lemma ext_eq_of_ge {L S S' i : V} (h : S ≤ S') : S / bexp S' (i * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1) = S{L}[i]
proof:
:= by
  rcases show i * ‖L‖ < ‖S‖ ∨ ‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ from lt_or_ge (i * ‖L‖) ‖S‖ with (lt | le)
  · unfold ext; congr 2; exact bexp_eq_of_lt_length (lt_of_lt_of_le lt $ length_monotone h) lt
  · simp only [ext_eq_zero_of_lt le]
    rcases show i * ‖L‖ < ‖S'‖ ∨ ‖S'‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ from lt_or_ge (i * ‖L‖) ‖S'‖ with (lt' | le')
    · have : S < bexp S' (i * ‖L‖) := ((exp_bexp_of_lt lt').lt_iff_len_le).mpr le
      simp [this]
    · simp [bexp_eq_zero_of_le le']

name: ext_eq_of_gt
statement: lemma ext_eq_of_gt {L S S' i : V} (h : i * ‖L‖ < ‖S'‖) : S / bexp S' (i * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1) = S{L}[i]
proof:
:= by
  rcases show i * ‖L‖ < ‖S‖ ∨ ‖S‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖ from lt_or_ge (i * ‖L‖) ‖S‖ with (lt | le)
  · unfold ext; congr 2; exact bexp_eq_of_lt_length h lt
  · simp only [ext_eq_zero_of_lt le]
    have : S < bexp S' (i * ‖L‖) := ((exp_bexp_of_lt h).lt_iff_len_le).mpr le
    simp [this]

name: ext_eq_smash_of_le
statement: lemma ext_eq_smash_of_le {L S i : V} (h : i ≤ ‖I‖) : S / bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1) = S{L}[i]

name: ext_add
statement:
lemma ext_add₁_pow2 {L i S₁ S₂ p : V} (pp : Pow2 p) (h : (i + 1) * ‖L‖ < ‖p‖) :
    (S₁ + S₂ * p){L}[i] = S₁{L}[i]
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le S₂ with (rfl | pos₂)
  · simp
  have lt_len : i * ‖L‖ < ‖S₁ + S₂ * p‖ := calc
        i * ‖L‖ ≤ (i + 1) * ‖L‖ := mul_le_mul_right (by simp)
        _       < ‖p‖           := h
        _       ≤ ‖S₁ + S₂ * p‖ := length_monotone (le_add_left (le_mul_of_pos_left pos₂))
  have : Exponential ((i + 1) * ‖L‖) (bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) * L ⨳ 1) := by
    simpa [add_mul]
      using Exponential.add_mul (by simp [lt_len]) (by simpa using exponential_smash L 1)
  have : bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) * L ⨳ 1 ∣ p :=
    Pow2.dvd_of_le (by simpa using bexp_pow2 lt_len) pp (this.monotone_le (exponential_of_pow2 pp) (le_log_of_lt_length h))
  rcases this with ⟨q, hq⟩
  calc
    (S₁ + S₂ * p){L}[i] = (S₁ + p * S₂) / bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) % L ⨳ 1         := by simp [ext, mul_comm S₂]
    _                   = (S₁ + bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) * (L ⨳ 1 * q * S₂)) / bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) % L ⨳ 1 := by simp [←mul_assoc, ←hq]
    _                   = (S₁ / bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) + L ⨳ 1 * q * S₂) % L ⨳ 1 := by rw [div_add_mul_self' _ _ (bexp_pos lt_len)]
    _                   = S₁ / bexp (S₁ + S₂ * p) (i * ‖L‖) % L ⨳ 1                    := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _                   = S₁{L}[i]                                                     := ext_eq_of_ge le_self_add

name: ext_add
statement:
lemma ext_add₁_bexp {L i j S₁ S₂ : V} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) (hij : j < i) :
    (S₁ + S₂ * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[j] = S₁{L}[j]
proof:
:=
  ext_add₁_pow2 (bexp_pow2 $ mul_len_lt_len_smash hi)
    (by rw [len_bexp (mul_len_lt_len_smash hi), lt_succ_iff_le]; exact mul_le_mul_right (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hij))

name: ext_add
statement:
lemma ext_add₂_bexp {I i j S₁ S₂ : V} (hij : i + j ≤ ‖I‖) (hS₁ : ‖S₁‖ ≤ i * ‖L‖) :
    (S₁ + S₂ * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[i + j] = S₂{L}[j]
proof:
:= by
  have hie : Exponential (i * ‖L‖) (bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)) := exp_bexp_of_lt (mul_len_lt_len_smash $ le_trans le_self_add hij)
  calc  (S₁ + S₂ * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[i + j]
      = (S₁ + S₂ * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)) / bexp (I ⨳ L) ((i + j) * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1)                    := by rw [ext_eq_smash_of_le hij]
    _ = (S₁ + S₂ * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)) / bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) / bexp (I ⨳ L) (j * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1) := by
      simp only [add_mul, ← Arithmetic.div_mul]; congr 2; exact bexp_add (by simp [←add_mul, mul_len_lt_len_smash hij])
    _ = S₂ / bexp (I ⨳ L) (j * ‖L‖) % (L ⨳ 1)                                                          := by
      congr 2; rw [div_add_mul_self, div_eq_zero_of_lt] <;> simp [hie.lt_iff_len_le.mpr hS₁, hie.range_pos]
    _ = S₂{L}[j]                                                                                       := ext_eq_smash_of_le (le_trans le_add_self hij)

name: append_nil
statement: lemma append_nil (I L S i : V) : append I L S i 0 = S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)

name: len_append
statement: lemma len_append (I L S : V) {i X} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) (hX : 0 < X) : ‖append I L S i X‖ = ‖X‖ + i * ‖L‖
proof:
:= calc
  ‖append I L S i X‖ = ‖X * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) + S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)‖ := by simp [append, add_comm]
  _                  = ‖X‖ + log (bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖))                        := length_mul_pow2_add_of_lt hX
                                                                                      (bexp_pow2 $ mul_len_lt_len_smash hi)
                                                                                      (mod_lt _ $ bexp_pos $ mul_len_lt_len_smash hi)
  _                  = ‖X‖ + i * ‖L‖                                             := by simp [log_bexp (mul_len_lt_len_smash hi)]

name: append_lt_smash
statement: lemma append_lt_smash (I L S : V) {i X} (hi : i < ‖I‖) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ ‖L‖) : append I L S i X < I ⨳ L
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le X with (rfl | pos)
  · simpa [append_nil]
      using lt_of_lt_of_le (mod_lt _ (bexp_pos $ mul_len_lt_len_smash $ le_of_lt hi)) (by simp)
  · suffices ‖X‖ + i * ‖L‖ ≤ ‖I‖ * ‖L‖ by simpa [lt_smash_iff, len_append I L S (le_of_lt hi) pos]
    calc
      ‖X‖ + i * ‖L‖ ≤ (i + 1) * ‖L‖ := by simp [add_mul, add_comm (i * ‖L‖), hX]
      _             ≤ ‖I‖ * ‖L‖     := mul_le_mul_right (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hi)

name: append_lt_sq_smash
statement: lemma append_lt_sq_smash (I L S : V) {i X} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ ‖L‖) (Ipos : 0 < I) : append I L S i X < (I ⨳ L)^2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hi with (rfl | hi)
  · calc
      append I L S ‖I‖ X = S % I ⨳ L + X * I ⨳ L := by simp [append, bexp_eq_smash]
      _                  < (X + 1) * I ⨳ L       := by simp [add_mul, add_comm]
      _                  ≤ L ⨳ 1 * I ⨳ L         := mul_le_mul_right (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr $ lt_smash_one_iff.mpr hX)
      _                  ≤ (I ⨳ L) ^ 2           := by simpa [sq, smash_comm L 1] using smash_monotone (pos_iff_one_le.mp Ipos) (by rfl)
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (append_lt_smash I L S hi hX) (by simp)

name: ext_append_last
statement: lemma ext_append_last (I L S : V) {i X} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) (hX : ‖X‖ ≤ ‖L‖) : (append I L S i X){L}[i] = X
proof:
:= calc
  (append I L S i X){L}[i] = (S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) + X * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[i + 0] := by simp [append]
  _                        =  X{L}[0]                                                            := ext_add₂_bexp (by simpa using hi)
                                                                                                      ((exp_bexp_of_lt (mul_len_lt_len_smash hi)).lt_iff_len_le.mp
                                                                                                        (mod_lt _ $ bexp_pos $ mul_len_lt_len_smash hi))
  _                        =  X                                                                  := ext_zero_eq_self_of_le hX

name: ext_append_lt
statement:
lemma ext_append_lt (I L S : V) {i j X} (hi : i ≤ ‖I‖) (hij : j < i) :
    (append I L S i X){L}[j] = S{L}[j]
proof:
:= calc
  (append I L S i X){L}[j] = (S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) + X * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[j] := rfl
  _                        = (S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[j]                              := ext_add₁_bexp hi hij
  _                        = (S % bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖) + (S / bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)) * bexp (I ⨳ L) (i * ‖L‖)){L}[j] := Eq.symm <| ext_add₁_bexp hi hij
  _                        = S{L}[j]                                                         := by rw [add_comm, mul_comm, div_add_mod]

name: SeriesSegment.series
statement:
lemma SeriesSegment.series {U I L A k n : V} (H : SeriesSegment U I L A k n) :
    ∃ T S, IsSeries U I L A (k / ‖I‖) T ∧ IsSegment L A (‖I‖ * (k / ‖I‖)) (k % ‖I‖) S ∧ T{L}[0] = 0 ∧ T{L}[k / ‖I‖] = S{L}[0] ∧ S{L}[k % ‖I‖] = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨_, _, ⟨T, _, hT, hTₛ, hTₑ⟩, ⟨S, _, hS, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  exact ⟨T, S, hT, hS, hTₛ, hTₑ, rfl⟩

name: IsSegment.le_add
statement: lemma IsSegment.le_add {L A start intv S : V} (H : IsSegment L A start intv S) : ∀ i ≤ intv, S{L}[i] ≤ S{L}[0] + i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ i IH =>
    intro h
    have IH : S{L}[i] ≤ S{L}[0] + i := IH (le_trans (by simp) h)
    calc
      S{L}[i + 1] = S{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i) := H i (succ_le_iff_lt.mp h)
      _           ≤ S{L}[i] + 1                  := by simp
      _           ≤ S{L}[0] + (i + 1)            := by simp [←add_assoc, IH]

name: Segment.refl
statement: lemma Segment.refl (U L A start n : V) (hL : L ⨳ 1 ≤ U) (hn : ‖n‖ ≤ ‖L‖) : Segment U L A start 0 n n
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_smash_one_iff.mpr hn) hL, by intro; simp, ext_zero_eq_self_of_le hn, ext_zero_eq_self_of_le hn⟩

name: Segment.le_add
statement: lemma Segment.le_add {U L A start intv nₛ nₑ : V} (H : Segment U L A start intv nₛ nₑ) : nₑ ≤ nₛ + intv
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨S, _, hS, rfl, rfl⟩; exact hS.le_add intv (by rfl)

name: Segment.uniq
statement:
lemma Segment.uniq {U L A start intv nₛ nₑ₁ nₑ₂ : V}
    (H₁ : Segment U L A start intv nₛ nₑ₁) (H₂ : Segment U L A start intv nₛ nₑ₂) : nₑ₁ = nₑ₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases H₁ with ⟨S₁, _, HS₁, Hₛ, rfl⟩
  rcases H₂ with ⟨S₂, _, HS₂, rfl, rfl⟩
  suffices ∀ i ≤ intv, S₁{L}[i] = S₂{L}[i] from this intv (by rfl)
  intro i; induction i using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => intro _; exact Hₛ
  case succ i IH =>
    intro hi
    have h₁ : S₁{L}[i + 1] = S₁{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i) := HS₁ i (lt_iff_succ_le.mpr hi)
    have h₂ : S₂{L}[i + 1] = S₂{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i) := HS₂ i (lt_iff_succ_le.mpr hi)
    simp [IH (le_trans (by simp) hi), h₁, h₂]

name: IsSeries.le_add
statement: lemma IsSeries.le_add {U I L A iter T : V} (H : IsSeries U I L A iter T) : ∀ l ≤ iter, T{L}[l] ≤ T{L}[0] + ‖I‖ * l
proof:
:= by
  intro l
  induction l using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ l IH =>
    intro h
    have IH : T{L}[l] ≤ T{L}[0] + ‖I‖ * l := IH (le_trans (by simp) h)
    calc
      T{L}[l + 1] ≤ T{L}[l] + ‖I‖           := (H l (succ_le_iff_lt.mp h)).le_add
      _           ≤ T{L}[0] + ‖I‖ * (l + 1) := by simpa [mul_add, ←add_assoc] using IH

name: Series.le_add
statement: lemma Series.le_add {U I L A iter n : V} (H : Series U I L A iter n) : n ≤ ‖I‖ * iter
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨T, _, hT, hzero, rfl⟩; simpa [hzero] using hT.le_add iter (by rfl)

name: Series.uniq
statement: lemma Series.uniq {U I L A iter n₁ n₂ : V} (H₁ : Series U I L A iter n₁) (H₂ : Series U I L A iter n₂) : n₁ = n₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases H₁ with ⟨T₁, _, HT₁, Hₛ₁, rfl⟩
  rcases H₂ with ⟨T₂, _, HT₂, Hₛ₂, rfl⟩
  suffices ∀ i ≤ iter, T₁{L}[i] = T₂{L}[i] from this iter (by rfl)
  intro i; induction i using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => intro _; simp [Hₛ₁, Hₛ₂]
  case succ i IH =>
    intro hi
    have IH : T₁{L}[i] = T₂{L}[i] := IH (le_trans (by simp) hi)
    have h₁ : Segment U L A (‖I‖ * i) ‖I‖ (T₁{L}[i]) (T₁{L}[i + 1]) := HT₁ i (lt_iff_succ_le.mpr hi)
    have h₂ : Segment U L A (‖I‖ * i) ‖I‖ (T₁{L}[i]) (T₂{L}[i + 1]) := by simpa [IH] using HT₂ i (lt_iff_succ_le.mpr hi)
    exact h₁.uniq h₂

name: SeriesSegment.le
statement:
lemma SeriesSegment.le {U I L A k n : V} (H : SeriesSegment U I L A k n) :
    n ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨nₖ, _, hT, hS⟩
  calc
    n ≤ nₖ + k % ‖I‖              := hS.le_add
    _ ≤ ‖I‖ * (k / ‖I‖) + k % ‖I‖ := by simpa [mul_comm] using hT.le_add
    _ = k                         := div_add_mod k ‖I‖

name: SeriesSegment.initial
statement: lemma SeriesSegment.initial {U I L A : V} (Upos : 0 < U) : SeriesSegment U I L A 0 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by rfl, ⟨0, Upos, by simp [IsSeries]⟩, ⟨0, Upos, by simp [IsSegment]⟩⟩

name: SeriesSegment.zero
statement: lemma SeriesSegment.zero {U I L k : V} (Upos : 0 < U) : SeriesSegment U I L 0 k 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by rfl, ⟨0, Upos, fun _ _ ↦ ⟨0, Upos, fun _ _ ↦ by simp, by simp⟩, by simp⟩, ⟨0, Upos, fun _ _ ↦ by simp, by simp⟩⟩

name: SeriesSegment.uniq
statement:
lemma SeriesSegment.uniq {U I L A k n₁ n₂ : V} (H₁ : SeriesSegment U I L A k n₁) (H₂ : SeriesSegment U I L A k n₂) :
    n₁ = n₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases H₁ with ⟨nₘ₁, _, hT₁, hS₁⟩
  rcases H₂ with ⟨nₘ₂, _, hT₂, hS₂⟩
  rcases show nₘ₁ = nₘ₂ from hT₁.uniq hT₂
  exact hS₁.uniq hS₂

name: Segment.succ
statement:
lemma Segment.succ (hU : (I ⨳ L)^2 ≤ U) {start intv nₛ nₑ : V} (H : Segment U L A start intv nₛ nₑ) (hintv : intv < ‖I‖) (hnₛ : ‖nₛ + ‖I‖‖ ≤ ‖L‖) :
    Segment U L A start (intv + 1) nₛ (nₑ + fbit A (start + intv))
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨S, _, H, rfl, rfl⟩
  let S' := append I L S (intv + 1) (S{L}[intv] + fbit A (start + intv))
  have le_len_L : ‖S{L}[intv] + fbit A (start + intv)‖ ≤ ‖L‖ := calc
    ‖S{L}[intv] + fbit A (start + intv)‖ ≤ ‖S{L}[intv] + 1‖     := length_monotone <| by simp
    _                                    ≤ ‖S{L}[0] + intv + 1‖ := length_monotone <| by simpa using H.le_add intv (by rfl)
    _                                    ≤ ‖S{L}[0] + ‖I‖‖      := length_monotone <| by simp [add_assoc, succ_le_iff_lt, hintv]
    _                                    ≤ ‖L‖                  := hnₛ
  have H' : IsSegment L A start (intv + 1) S' := by
    intro i hi
    rcases show i ≤ intv from lt_succ_iff_le.mp hi with (rfl | hi)
    · calc
        S'{L}[i + 1] = S{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i)  := ext_append_last I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) le_len_L
        _            = S'{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i) := by congr 1; symm; exact ext_append_lt I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) (by simp)
    · calc
        S'{L}[i + 1] = S{L}[i + 1]                   := ext_append_lt I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) (by simpa using hi)
        _            = S{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i)  := H i hi
        _            = S'{L}[i] + fbit A (start + i) := by congr 1; symm; apply ext_append_lt I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) (by assumption)
  exact
    ⟨ S',
      lt_of_lt_of_le (append_lt_sq_smash I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) le_len_L (by simpa using pos_of_gt hintv)) hU,
      H',
      ext_append_lt I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) (by simp),
      ext_append_last I L S (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hintv) le_len_L ⟩

name: Series.succ
statement:
lemma Series.succ (hU : (I ⨳ L)^2 ≤ U) (hIL : ‖‖I‖^2‖ ≤ ‖L‖)
    {iter n n' : V} (HT : Series U I L A iter n) (HS : Segment U L A (‖I‖ * iter) ‖I‖ n n') (hiter : iter < ‖I‖) :
    Series U I L A (iter + 1) n'
proof:
:= by
  have Hn : n ≤ ‖I‖ * iter := HT.le_add
  rcases HT with ⟨T, _, HT, Tₛ, rfl⟩
  let T' := append I L T (iter + 1) n'
  have hn'L : ‖n'‖ ≤ ‖L‖ := calc
    ‖n'‖ ≤ ‖T{L}[iter] + ‖I‖‖ := length_monotone HS.le_add
    _    ≤ ‖(iter + 1) * ‖I‖‖ := length_monotone <| by simp [add_mul, mul_comm iter, Hn]
    _    ≤ ‖‖I‖^2‖            := length_monotone <| by simpa [sq] using mul_le_mul_right (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hiter)
    _    ≤ ‖L‖                := hIL
  have hTlast : T'{L}[iter + 1] = n' := ext_append_last I L T (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hiter) hn'L
  have hTofLt : ∀ l ≤ iter, T'{L}[l] = T{L}[l] := fun l hl ↦ ext_append_lt I L T (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hiter) (by simp [lt_succ_iff_le, hl])
  have HT' : IsSeries U I L A (iter + 1) T' := by
    intro l hl
    rcases show l ≤ iter from lt_succ_iff_le.mp hl with (rfl | hl)
    · simpa [hTofLt l (by simp), hTlast] using HS
    · have : T'{L}[l] = T{L}[l] := hTofLt l (le_of_lt hl)
      have : T'{L}[l + 1] = T{L}[l + 1] := hTofLt (l + 1) (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hl)
      simpa [*] using HT l hl
  exact
  ⟨ T',
    lt_of_lt_of_le (append_lt_sq_smash I L T (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hiter) hn'L (by simpa using pos_of_gt hiter)) hU,
    HT',
    Eq.trans (ext_append_lt I L T (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hiter) (by simp)) Tₛ,
    hTlast ⟩

name: div_mod_succ
statement: lemma div_mod_succ (a b : V) : ((a + 1) / b = a / b + 1 ∧ (a + 1) % b = 0 ∧ a % b + 1 = b) ∨ ((a + 1) / b = a / b ∧ (a + 1) % b = a % b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  have : a % b + 1 ≤ b := lt_iff_succ_le.mp <| mod_lt a (by simp [pos])
  rcases this with (hb | ltb)
  · left
    have : b * (a / b + 1) = a + 1 := calc
      b * (a / b + 1) = b * (a / b) + a % b + 1 := by simp [hb, add_assoc, mul_add]
      _               = a + 1                   := by simp [div_add_mod a b]
    constructor <;> { rw [←this]; simp [pos, hb] }
  · right
    have : b * (a / b) + (a % b + 1) = a + 1 := by simp [←add_assoc, div_add_mod a b]
    constructor
    · rw [←this, mul_comm b, div_mul_add_self (a / b) (a % b + 1) pos]
      simp [ltb]
    · rw [←this, mul_comm b, mod_mul_add _ _ pos]
      simp [ltb]

name: SeriesSegment.succ
statement:
lemma SeriesSegment.succ (hU : (I ⨳ L)^2 ≤ U) (hIL : ‖‖I‖^2‖ ≤ ‖L‖)
    {k n : V} (hk : k < ‖I‖^2) (H : SeriesSegment U I L A k n) :
    SeriesSegment U I L A (k + 1) (n + fbit A k)
proof:
:= by
  have hhk : (k + 1)/‖I‖ ≤ ‖I‖ := by simpa using div_monotone (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hk) ‖I‖
  have hnk : n ≤ k := H.le
  have Ipos : 0 < I := by simpa using pos_of_gt hk
  rcases H with ⟨nₘ, hnₘn, HT, HS⟩
  have hnₘL : ‖nₘ + ‖I‖‖ ≤ ‖L‖ := by
    have : k / ‖I‖ < ‖I‖ := div_lt_of_lt_mul (by simpa [sq] using hk)
    calc
      ‖nₘ + ‖I‖‖ ≤ ‖‖I‖ * (k / ‖I‖ + 1)‖ := length_monotone <| by simp [mul_add, HT.le_add]
      _        ≤ ‖‖I‖^2‖                 := length_monotone <| by simpa [sq] using mul_le_mul_left (lt_iff_succ_le.mp this)
      _        ≤ ‖L‖                     := hIL
  rcases div_mod_succ k ‖I‖ with (⟨hdiv, hmodsucc, hmod⟩ | ⟨hdiv, hmod⟩)
  · have : Segment U L A (‖I‖ * (k / ‖I‖)) ‖I‖ nₘ (n + fbit A k) := by
      simpa [div_add_mod, hmod] using HS.succ hU (mod_lt _ $ by simp [Ipos]) hnₘL
    have : Series U I L A ((k + 1) / ‖I‖) (n + fbit A k) := by
      simpa [hdiv] using HT.succ hU hIL this (lt_iff_succ_le.mpr $ by simpa [hdiv] using hhk)
    exact ⟨n + fbit A k, by rfl, this, by
      simp only [hmodsucc]; apply Segment.refl U L A
      · calc
          L ⨳ 1 ≤ I ⨳ L     := by rw [smash_comm L 1]; apply smash_monotone (pos_iff_one_le.mp Ipos) (by rfl)
          _     ≤ (I ⨳ L)^2 := by simp
          _     ≤ U         := hU
      · calc
          ‖n + fbit A k‖ ≤ ‖n + 1‖ := length_monotone <| by simp
          _              ≤ ‖k + 1‖ := length_monotone <| by simp [hnk]
          _              ≤ ‖‖I‖^2‖ := length_monotone <| succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hk
          _              ≤ ‖L‖     := hIL⟩
  · have HS' : Segment U L A (‖I‖ * ((k + 1) / ‖I‖)) ((k + 1) % ‖I‖) nₘ (n + fbit A k) := by
      simpa [div_add_mod, hdiv, hmod] using HS.succ hU (mod_lt _ $ by simp [Ipos]) hnₘL
    have HT' : Series U I L A ((k + 1) / ‖I‖) nₘ := by simpa [hdiv] using HT
    exact ⟨nₘ, le_trans hnₘn le_self_add, HT', HS'⟩

name: len_polyI
statement: lemma len_polyI {A : V} (pos : 0 < A) : ‖polyI A‖ = √‖A‖ + 1
proof:
:=
  len_bexp (show √‖A‖ < ‖2 * A‖ from by simp [length_two_mul_of_pos pos, lt_succ_iff_le])

name: polyI_le
statement: lemma polyI_le {A : V} (pos : 0 < A) : ‖A‖ < ‖polyI A‖ ^ 2

name: two_add_two_eq_four
statement: lemma two_add_two_eq_four : 2 + 2 = (4 : V)

name: four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul
statement: lemma four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul (a : V) : 4 * a = 2 * (2 * a)

name: two_mul_sqrt_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma two_mul_sqrt_le_self (a : V) : 2 * √a ≤ a + 1

name: four_mul_smash_self
statement: lemma four_mul_smash_self (a : V) : (4 * a) ⨳ (4 * a) ≤ (a ⨳ a) ^ 16
proof:
:= calc
  (4 * a) ⨳ (4 * a) ≤ ((4 * a) ⨳ (2 * a)) ^ 2 := by simp [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul, smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash]
  _                 ≤ ((4 * a) ⨳ a) ^ 4       := by simp [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash]
  _                 ≤ ((a ⨳ (2 * a)) ^ 2) ^ 4 := by rw [smash_comm (4 * a) a]
                                                    simp [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul, pow_four_eq_sq_sq, smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash]
  _                 ≤ ((a ⨳ a) ^ 4) ^ 4       := by simp [pow_four_eq_sq_sq, smash_two_mul_le_sq_smash]
  _                 ≤ (a ⨳ a) ^ 16       := by simp [←pow_mul]

name: pos_sq_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma pos_sq_iff {a : V} : 0 < √a ↔ 0 < a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le h (by simp),
    by intro h; by_contra A; simp at A;
       simp [show a = 0 from by simpa [A] using sqrt_lt_sq a] at h⟩

name: pow_four_le_pow_four
statement: @[simp] lemma pow_four_le_pow_four {a b : V} : a ^ 4 ≤ b ^ 4 ↔ a ≤ b

name: bexp_four_mul
statement:
lemma bexp_four_mul {a a' x : V} (hx : 4 * x < ‖a‖) (hx' : x < ‖a'‖) :
    bexp a (4 * x) = (bexp a' x) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul, bexp_two_mul (a' := a), bexp_two_mul (a := a), pow_four_eq_sq_sq]
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul]) hx
  · exact hx'
  · simpa [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul] using hx
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp [four_mul_eq_two_mul_two_mul]) hx

name: polyI_smash_self_polybounded
statement: lemma polyI_smash_self_polybounded {A : V} (pos : 0 < A) : (polyI A) ⨳ (polyI A) ≤ (2 * A + 1) ^ 4
proof:
:= calc
  (polyI A) ⨳ (polyI A) = bexp ((polyI A) ⨳ (polyI A)) ((√‖A‖ + 1) ^ 2) := Eq.symm <| by simpa [sq, len_polyI pos] using bexp_eq_smash (polyI A) (polyI A)
  _                     ≤ bexp ((2 * A) ⨳ (2 * A)) ((2 * √‖A‖) ^ 2)     :=
    (bexp_monotone_le
      (by simp [length_smash, ←sq, len_polyI pos])
      (by simp [length_smash, lt_succ_iff_le, ←sq, length_two_mul_of_pos pos])).mpr
    (by simp [two_mul, ←pos_iff_one_le, pos])
  _                     ≤ bexp ((2 * A) ⨳ (2 * A)) (4 * (√‖A‖) ^ 2)     := by simp [mul_pow, two_pow_two_eq_four]
  _                     = (bexp (A ⨳ 1) ((√‖A‖) ^ 2)) ^ 4               :=
    bexp_four_mul
      (by simp [length_smash, lt_succ_iff_le, ←sq, length_two_mul_of_pos pos, ←two_pow_two_eq_four, ←mul_pow])
      (by simp [length_smash, lt_succ_iff_le])
  _                     ≤ (bexp (A ⨳ 1) ‖A‖) ^ 4                        := by
    simpa using (bexp_monotone_le (by simp [length_smash, lt_succ_iff_le]) (by simp [length_smash])).mpr (by simp)
  _                     = (A ⨳ 1) ^ 4                                   := by congr 1; simpa using bexp_eq_smash A 1
  _                     ≤ (2 * A + 1) ^ 4                               := by simp

name: polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded
statement: lemma polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded {A : V} (pos : 0 < A) : (polyI A) ⨳ (polyL A) ≤ (2 * A + 1) ^ 64
proof:
:= calc
  (polyI A) ⨳ (polyL A) ≤ (polyI A) ⨳ (3 * polyI A)         := smash_monotone (by rfl) (by simp [polyL, sq_len_le_three_mul])
  _                     ≤ (4 * polyI A) ⨳ (4 * polyI A)     := smash_monotone (le_mul_of_pos_left $ by simp) (mul_le_mul_right $ by simp [←three_add_one_eq_four])
  _                     ≤ ((polyI A) ⨳ (polyI A)) ^ (4 * 4) := by simpa using four_mul_smash_self _
  _                     ≤ ((2 * A + 1) ^ 4) ^ (4 * 4)       := by simp only [pow_mul, pow_four_le_pow_four, polyI_smash_self_polybounded pos]
  _                     = (2 * A + 1) ^ 64         := by simp [←pow_mul]

name: sq_polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded
statement: lemma sq_polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded {A : V} (pos : 0 < A) : ((polyI A) ⨳ (polyL A)) ^ 2 ≤ polyU A
proof:
:= calc
  ((polyI A) ⨳ (polyL A)) ^ 2 ≤ ((2 * A + 1) ^ 64) ^ 2 := by simp [polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded pos]
  _                           = polyU A                         := by simp [polyU, ←pow_mul]

name: bexs_eq_le_iff
statement:
lemma bexs_eq_le_iff {p : V → Prop} {b : V} :
    (∃ a ≤ z, a = b ∧ p a) ↔ (b ≤ z ∧ p b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨a, hp, rfl, hr⟩; exact ⟨hp, hr⟩, by rintro ⟨hp, hr⟩; exact ⟨b, hp, rfl, hr⟩⟩

name: bexs_eq_lt_iff
statement:
lemma bexs_eq_lt_iff {p : V → Prop} {b : V} :
    (∃ a < z, a = b ∧ p a) ↔ (b < z ∧ p b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨a, hp, rfl, hr⟩; exact ⟨hp, hr⟩, by rintro ⟨hp, hr⟩; exact ⟨b, hp, rfl, hr⟩⟩

name: NuonAux.initial
statement: @[simp] lemma NuonAux.initial (A : V) : NuonAux A 0 0

name: NuonAux.initial_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma NuonAux.initial_iff (A n : V) : NuonAux A 0 n ↔ n = 0
proof: := ⟨fun h ↦ h.uniq (NuonAux.initial A), by rintro rfl; simp⟩

name: NuonAux.zero
statement: @[simp] lemma NuonAux.zero (k : V) : NuonAux 0 k 0

name: NuonAux.le
statement: lemma NuonAux.le {A k n : V} (H : NuonAux A k n) : n ≤ k

name: NuonAux.uniq
statement: lemma NuonAux.uniq {A k n₁ n₂ : V} (H₁ : NuonAux A k n₁) (H₂ : NuonAux A k n₂) : n₁ = n₂

name: NuonAux.succ
statement: lemma NuonAux.succ {A k : V} (H : NuonAux A k n) (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) : NuonAux A (k + 1) (n + fbit A k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le A with (rfl | pos)
  · rcases show n = 0 from H.uniq (NuonAux.zero k); simp
  exact SeriesSegment.succ (sq_polyI_smash_polyL_polybounded pos) (by simp [polyL]) (lt_of_le_of_lt hk $ polyI_le pos) H

name: NuonAux.exists
statement: lemma NuonAux.exists {k : V} (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) : ∃ n, NuonAux A k n
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ n ≤ k, NuonAux A k n by
    rcases this with ⟨n, _, h⟩; exact ⟨n, h⟩
  revert hk
  induction k using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  case succ k IH =>
    intro hk
    rcases IH (le_trans (by simp) hk) with ⟨n, hn, Hn⟩
    exact ⟨n + fbit A k, add_le_add hn (by simp), Hn.succ (le_trans (by simp) hk)⟩

name: NuonAux.succ_elim
statement: lemma NuonAux.succ_elim {A k : V} (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) (H : NuonAux A (k + 1) n) : ∃ n', n = n' + fbit A k ∧ NuonAux A k n'
proof:
:= by
  rcases NuonAux.exists hk with ⟨n', H'⟩
  rcases H.uniq (H'.succ hk)
  exact ⟨n', rfl, H'⟩

name: NuonAux.succ_iff
statement: lemma NuonAux.succ_iff {A k : V} (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) : NuonAux A (k + 1) (n + fbit A k) ↔ NuonAux A k n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    rcases NuonAux.exists hk with ⟨n', H'⟩
    rcases show n' = n from by simpa using (H'.succ hk).uniq H
    exact H'
  · exact (NuonAux.succ · hk)

name: NuonAux.two_mul
statement: lemma NuonAux.two_mul {k n : V} (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) : NuonAux A k n → NuonAux (2 * A) (k + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  revert n hk
  suffices ∀ n ≤ k, k ≤ ‖A‖ → NuonAux A k n → NuonAux (2 * A) (k + 1) n by
    intro n hk H
    exact this n H.le hk H
  induction k using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simp; simpa using (NuonAux.initial (2 * A)).succ (by simp)
  case succ k IH =>
    intro n hn hk H
    rcases H.succ_elim (le_trans (by simp) hk) with ⟨n', rfl, H'⟩
    have IH : NuonAux (2 * A) (k + 1) n' := IH n' H'.le (le_trans (by simp) hk) H'
    simpa using IH.succ (le_trans hk (length_monotone $ by simp))

name: NuonAux.two_mul_add_one
statement: lemma NuonAux.two_mul_add_one {k n : V} (hk : k ≤ ‖A‖) : NuonAux A k n → NuonAux (2 * A + 1) (k + 1) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  revert n hk
  suffices ∀ n ≤ k, k ≤ ‖A‖ → NuonAux A k n → NuonAux (2 * A + 1) (k + 1) (n + 1) by
    intro n hk H
    exact this n H.le hk H
  induction k using ISigma0.succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simpa using (NuonAux.initial (2 * A + 1)).succ (by simp)
  case succ k IH =>
    intro n hn hk H
    rcases H.succ_elim (le_trans (by simp) hk) with ⟨n', rfl, H'⟩
    have IH : NuonAux (2 * A + 1) (k + 1) (n' + 1) := IH n' H'.le (le_trans (by simp) hk) H'
    simpa [add_right_comm n' 1] using IH.succ (le_trans hk (by simp [length_two_mul_add_one]))

name: Nuon.exists_unique
statement: lemma Nuon.exists_unique (A : V) : ∃! n, Nuon A n
proof:
:= by
  rcases show ∃ n, Nuon A n from NuonAux.exists (by simp) with ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro n hn (fun n' hn' ↦ hn'.uniq hn)

name: nuon_nuon
statement: @[simp] lemma nuon_nuon (a : V) : Nuon a (nuon a)

name: nuon_bit0
statement: lemma nuon_bit0 (a : V) : nuon (2 * a) = nuon a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · have : Nuon (2 * a) (nuon a) := by simpa [Nuon, length_two_mul_of_pos pos] using (nuon_nuon a).two_mul (by simp)
    exact this.nuon_eq

name: nuon_bit1
statement: lemma nuon_bit1 (a : V) : nuon (2 * a + 1) = nuon a + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Nuon (2 * a + 1) (nuon a + 1) := by simpa [Nuon, length_two_mul_add_one] using (nuon_nuon a).two_mul_add_one (by simp)
  exact this.nuon_eq

name: mul_succ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_succ : a * (b + 1) = a * b + a
proof:
:= by
  match a, b with
  | ⊤            , ⊤
  | ⊤            , .some 0
  | ⊤            , .some (n + 1)
  | .some 0      , .some n
  | .some 0      , ⊤
  | .some (m + 1), .some n
  | .some (m + 1), ⊤
  => rfl

lemma lt_def : a < b ↔ ∃ c, a + c + 1 = b

statement: lemma exists_add_one_eq_self : ∃ x : OmegaAddOne, x + 1 = x

name: RobinsonQ.unprovable_neSucc

name: sub_existsUnique
statement: lemma sub_existsUnique (a b : V) : ∃! c, (a ≥ b → a = b + c) ∧ (a < b → c = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : b ≤ a ∨ a < b := le_or_gt b a
  rcases this with (hxy | hxy)
  · have : ∃ c, a = b + c := exists_add_of_le hxy
    rcases this with ⟨c, rfl⟩
    simp [hxy]
  · simp [hxy]

name: sub_spec_of_ge
statement: lemma sub_spec_of_ge (h : a ≥ b) : a = b + (a - b)

name: sub_spec_of_lt
statement: lemma sub_spec_of_lt (h : a < b) : a - b = 0

name: sub_eq_iff
statement: lemma sub_eq_iff : c = a - b ↔ ((a ≥ b → a = b + c) ∧ (a < b → c = 0))

name: sub_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma sub_le_self (a b : V) : a - b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  have : b ≤ a ∨ a < b := le_or_gt b a
  rcases this with (hxy | hxy) <;> simp
  · simpa [← sub_spec_of_ge hxy] using show a - b ≤ b + (a - b) from le_add_self
  · simp [sub_spec_of_lt hxy]

name: sub_self
statement: @[simp] lemma sub_self (a : V) : a - a = 0

name: sub_spec_of_le
statement: lemma sub_spec_of_le (h : a ≤ b) : a - b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with (lt | rfl) <;> simp [sub_spec_of_lt, *]

name: sub_add_self_of_le
statement: lemma sub_add_self_of_le (h : b ≤ a) : a - b + b = a
proof: := by symm; rw [add_comm]; exact sub_spec_of_ge h

name: add_tsub_self_of_le
statement: lemma add_tsub_self_of_le (h : b ≤ a) : b + (a - b) = a

name: add_sub_self
statement: @[simp] lemma add_sub_self : (a + b) - b = a
proof:
:= by
  symm; simpa [add_comm b] using sub_spec_of_ge (show b ≤ a + b from le_add_self)

name: add_sub_self'
statement: @[simp] lemma add_sub_self' : (b + a) - b = a

name: zero_sub
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_sub (a : V) : 0 - a = 0

name: sub_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sub_zero (a : V) : a - 0 = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sub_add_self_of_le (show 0 ≤ a from Arithmetic.zero_le a)

name: sub_remove_left
statement: lemma sub_remove_left (e : a = b + c) : a - c = b

name: sub_sub
statement: lemma sub_sub : a - b - c = a - (b + c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : b + c ≤ a
  · exact sub_remove_left <| sub_remove_left <| by
      simp [add_assoc, show c + b = b + c from add_comm _ _, sub_add_self_of_le, ha]
  · suffices a - b - c = 0 by simpa [sub_spec_of_lt (show a < b + c from not_le.mp ha)]
    by_cases hc : c ≤ a - b
    · by_cases hb : b ≤ a
      · have : a < a := calc
          a < b + c       := not_le.mp ha
          _ ≤ b + (a - b) := by simp [hc]
          _ = a           := add_tsub_self_of_le hb
        simp at this
      · simp [show a - b = 0 from sub_spec_of_lt (not_le.mp hb)]
    · exact sub_spec_of_lt (not_le.mp hc)

name: pos_sub_iff_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma pos_sub_iff_lt : 0 < a - b ↔ b < a
proof:
:=
  ⟨by contrapose; simpa using sub_spec_of_le,
   by intro h; by_contra hs
      have : a = b := by
        simpa [show a - b = 0 by simpa using hs] using sub_spec_of_ge (show b ≤ a from LT.lt.le h)
      simp [this] at h⟩

name: sub_eq_zero_iff_le
statement: @[simp] lemma sub_eq_zero_iff_le : a - b = 0 ↔ a ≤ b

name: pred_lt_self_of_pos
statement: lemma pred_lt_self_of_pos (h : 0 < a) : a - 1 < a
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ a with (rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · simp_all
  · simp

name: tsub_lt_iff_left
statement: protected lemma tsub_lt_iff_left (h : b ≤ a) : a - b < c ↔ a < c + b

name: sub_mul
statement: lemma sub_mul (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b) * c = a * c - b * c
proof:
:= by
  have : a = (a - b) + b := (tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le h).mp rfl
  calc
    (a - b) * c = (a - b) * c + b * c - b * c := by simp
    _           = (a - b + b) * c - b * c     := by simp [add_mul]
    _           = a * c - b * c               := by simp [sub_add_self_of_le h]

name: mul_sub
statement: lemma mul_sub (h : b ≤ a) : c * (a - b) = c * a - c * b

name: add_sub_of_le
statement: lemma add_sub_of_le (h : c ≤ b) (a : V) : a + b - c = a + (b - c)

name: sub_succ_add_succ
statement: lemma sub_succ_add_succ {x y : V} (h : y < x) (z) : x - (y + 1) + (z + 1) = x - y + z
proof:
:= calc
  x - (y + 1) + (z + 1) = x - (y + 1) + 1 + z := by simp [add_assoc, add_comm]
  _                     = x - y - 1 + 1 + z   := by simp [sub_sub]
  _                     = x - y + z           := by
    simp [show x - y - 1 + 1 = x - y from sub_add_self_of_le <| one_le_of_zero_lt _ <| pos_sub_iff_lt.mpr h]

name: le_sub_one_of_lt
statement: lemma le_sub_one_of_lt {a b : V} (h : a < b) : a ≤ b - 1
proof:
:= by
  have : 1 ≤ b := one_le_of_zero_lt _ (pos_of_gt h)
  simp [le_iff_lt_succ, sub_add_self_of_le this, h]

name: le_mul_self_of_pos_left
statement: lemma le_mul_self_of_pos_left (hy : 0 < b) : a ≤ b * a
proof:
:= by
  have : 1 * a ≤ b * a := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (one_le_of_zero_lt b hy) (by simp)
  simpa using this

name: le_mul_self_of_pos_right
statement: lemma le_mul_self_of_pos_right (hy : 0 < b) : a ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_comm a b] using le_mul_self_of_pos_left hy

name: dvd_iff_bounded
statement: lemma dvd_iff_bounded {a b : V} : a ∣ b ↔ ∃ c ≤ b, b = a * c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : a = 0
  · simp [hx, show ∃ x, x ≤ b from ⟨0, by simp⟩]
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩; exact ⟨c, le_mul_self_of_pos_left (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx), rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hz, rfl⟩; exact dvd_mul_right a c

name: le_of_dvd
statement: lemma le_of_dvd (h : 0 < b) : a ∣ b → a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
  exact le_mul_self_of_pos_right
    (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (show c ≠ 0 from by rintro rfl; simp at h))

name: not_dvd_of_lt
statement: lemma not_dvd_of_lt (pos : 0 < b) : b < a → ¬a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  intro hb h; exact not_le.mpr hb (le_of_dvd pos h)

name: dvd_antisymm
statement: lemma dvd_antisymm : a ∣ b → b ∣ a → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy
  rcases show a = 0 ∨ 0 < a from eq_zero_or_pos a with (rfl | ltx)
  · simp [show b = 0 from by simpa using hx]
  · rcases show b = 0 ∨ 0 < b from eq_zero_or_pos b with (rfl | lty)
    · simp [show a = 0 from by simpa using hy]
    · exact le_antisymm (le_of_dvd lty hx) (le_of_dvd ltx hy)

name: dvd_one_iff
statement: lemma dvd_one_iff : a ∣ 1 ↔ a = 1
proof: := ⟨by { intro hx; exact dvd_antisymm hx (by simp) }, by rintro rfl; simp⟩

name: units_eq_one
statement: theorem units_eq_one (u : Vˣ) : u = 1

name: unit_iff_eq_one
statement: @[simp] lemma unit_iff_eq_one {a : V} : IsUnit a ↔ a = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩; simp [units_eq_one u], by rintro rfl; simp⟩

name: eq_one_or_eq_of_dvd_of_prime
statement: lemma eq_one_or_eq_of_dvd_of_prime {p a : V} (pp : Prime p) (hxp : a ∣ p) : a = 1 ∨ a = p
proof:
:= by
  have : p ∣ a ∨ a ∣ 1 := Prime.left_dvd_or_dvd_right_of_dvd_mul pp (show a ∣ p * 1 from by simpa using hxp)
  rcases this with (hx | hx)
  · right; exact dvd_antisymm hxp hx
  · left; exact dvd_one_iff.mp hx

name: finite
statement: @[simp] lemma finite : Set.Finite 𝗣𝗔⁻
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝗣𝗔⁻ =
    𝗘𝗤 ℒₒᵣ ∪
    { Axiom.addZero,
      Axiom.addAssoc,
      Axiom.addComm,
      Axiom.addEqOfLt,
      Axiom.zeroLe,
      Axiom.zeroLtOne,
      Axiom.oneLeOfZeroLt,
      Axiom.addLtAdd,
      Axiom.mulZero,
      Axiom.mulOne,
      Axiom.mulAssoc,
      Axiom.mulComm,
      Axiom.mulLtMul,
      Axiom.distr,
      Axiom.ltIrrefl,
      Axiom.ltTrans,
      Axiom.ltTri } := by
    ext φ; constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟩
      case equal => left; assumption
      case addZero => tauto
      case addAssoc => tauto
      case addComm => tauto
      case addEqOfLt => tauto
      case zeroLe => tauto
      case zeroLtOne => tauto
      case oneLeOfZeroLt => tauto
      case addLtAdd => tauto
      case mulZero => tauto
      case mulOne => tauto
      case mulAssoc => tauto
      case mulComm => tauto
      case mulLtMul => tauto
      case distr => tauto
      case ltIrrefl => tauto
      case ltTrans => tauto
      case ltTri => tauto
    · rintro (h | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact equal _ h
      · exact addZero
      · exact addAssoc
      · exact addComm
      · exact addEqOfLt
      · exact zeroLe
      · exact zeroLtOne
      · exact oneLeOfZeroLt
      · exact addLtAdd
      · exact mulZero
      · exact mulOne
      · exact mulAssoc
      · exact mulComm
      · exact mulLtMul
      · exact distr
      · exact ltIrrefl
      · exact ltTrans
      · exact ltTri
  rw [this]; simp only [Set.finite_union, FirstOrder.Theory.EqAxiom.finite, true_and]
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.Finite.insert
  apply Set.finite_singleton

name: equiv_singleton_finiteConj
statement:
lemma equiv_singleton_finiteConj :
    𝗣𝗔⁻ ≊ ({finite.toFinset.conj} : ArithmeticTheory)
proof:
:= by
  have hConj : 𝗣𝗔⁻ ⊢ finite.toFinset.conj :=
    Entailment.FConj_iff_forall_provable.mpr fun {σ} hσ ↦ Entailment.by_axm (by simp_all)
  exact Entailment.Equiv.antisymm_iff.mpr
    ⟨Entailment.WeakerThan.ofAxm! fun {σ} hσ ↦
        Entailment.mdp (Entailment.left_Fconj_intro (by simp_all)) (Entailment.by_axm rfl),
      Entailment.WeakerThan.ofAxm! fun {σ} hσ ↦ by
        rcases hσ with rfl; exact hConj⟩

name: le_def
statement: lemma le_def {x y : M} : x ≤ y ↔ x = y ∨ x < y

name: add_zero'
statement: protected lemma add_zero' : ∀ x : M, x + 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [models_iff] using Theory.models M _ PeanoMinus.addZero

name: add_assoc
statement: protected lemma add_assoc : ∀ x y z : M,  (x + y) + z = x + (y + z)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [models_iff] using Theory.models M _ PeanoMinus.addAssoc

name: add_comm
statement: protected lemma add_comm : ∀ x y : M,  x + y = y + x
proof:
:= by

name: eq_succ_of_pos
statement: lemma eq_succ_of_pos {x : M} (h : 0 < x) : ∃ y, x = y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_iff_exists_add.mp (one_le_of_zero_lt x h) with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨y, add_comm 1 y⟩

name: le_iff_lt_succ
statement: lemma le_iff_lt_succ {x y : M} : x ≤ y ↔ x < y + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (lt_add_one y),
   fun h => by
    rcases lt_iff_exists_add.mp h with ⟨z, hz, h⟩
    rcases eq_succ_of_pos hz with ⟨z', rfl⟩
    have : y = x + z' := by simpa [←add_assoc] using h
    simp [this]⟩

name: eq_nat_of_lt_nat
statement:
lemma eq_nat_of_lt_nat : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : M}, x < n → ∃ m : ℕ, x = m
  |     0, x, hx => by simp_all
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    have : x ≤ n
proof:
:= by simpa [le_iff_lt_succ] using hx
    rcases this with (rfl | hx)
    · exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
    · exact eq_nat_of_lt_nat hx

name: eq_nat_of_le_nat
statement: lemma eq_nat_of_le_nat {n : ℕ} {x : M} : x ≤ n → ∃ m : ℕ, x = m
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  have : x < ↑(n + 1) := by simpa [←le_iff_lt_succ] using h
  exact eq_nat_of_lt_nat this

  simp [lt_iff_succ_le,

      rw [show (2 : M) = 1 + 1 from one_add_one_eq_two.symm]; exact add_le_add_iff_right 1]

proof:
:= ⟨by
  intro hx
  have : a ≤ 0 := by exact le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (show a < 0 + 1 from by simpa using hx)
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp this,
  by rintro rfl; exact zero_lt_one⟩

name: le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one
statement: lemma le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one : a ≤ 1 ↔ a = 0 ∨ a = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; rcases h with (rfl | ltx)
      · simp
      · simp [show a = 0 from by simpa using ltx],
   by rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp⟩

name: le_two_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two
statement: lemma le_two_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two : a ≤ 2 ↔ a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; rcases h with (rfl | lt)
      · simp
      · rcases lt_two_iff_le_one.mp lt with (rfl | lt)
        · simp
        · simp [show a = 0 from by simpa using lt],
   by rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp⟩

name: le_three_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two_or_three
statement: lemma le_three_iff_eq_zero_or_one_or_two_or_three : a ≤ 3 ↔ a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = 2 ∨ a = 3
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; rcases h with (rfl | lt)
      · simp
      · have : a ≤ 2 := by simpa [←le_iff_lt_succ, ←two_add_one_eq_three] using lt
        rcases this with (rfl| lt)
        · simp
        · rcases lt_two_iff_le_one.mp lt with (rfl | lt)
          · simp
          · simp [show a = 0 from by simpa using lt],
   by rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp [←two_add_one_eq_three]⟩

statement: private lemma seq_iff (s : V) : Seq s ↔ IsMapping s ∧ ∃ l ≤ 2 * s, ∃ d ≤ 2 * s, d = domain s ∧ d = under l
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨hs, l, h⟩
      exact ⟨hs, l, (by
      calc
        l ≤ domain s := by simp [h]
        _ ≤ 2 * s    := by simp), ⟨domain s , by simp,  rfl, h⟩⟩,
   by rintro ⟨hs, l, _, _, _, rfl, h⟩; exact ⟨hs, l, h⟩⟩

proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Seq s
  · rcases h with ⟨h, l, hl⟩
    exact ExistsUnique.intro l
      (by simp [show Seq s from ⟨h, l, hl⟩, hl])
      (by simp [show Seq s from ⟨h, l, hl⟩, hl])
  · simp [h]

      _    ≤ 2 * s        := by simp [←hs.domain_eq]
  · simp [lh_prop_of_not_seq hs]

name: lh_graph

proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rintro rfl
    by_cases Hs : Seq s <;> simp [Hs, ←Seq.domain_eq, lh_prop_of_not_seq], by
    rintro ⟨h, hn⟩
    by_cases Hs : Seq s
    · rcases h Hs with ⟨_, _, rfl, h⟩; simpa [h] using Hs.domain_eq
    · simp [lh_prop_of_not_seq Hs, hn Hs]⟩

proof:

  lt_iff_le_and_ne.mpr <| ⟨le_of_subset <| by simp, by
    simp only [seqCons, ne_eq]; intro A
    have : ⟪lh s, x⟫ ∈ s := by simpa [←A] using mem_insert ⟪lh s, x⟫ s

  have : under (lh s + 1) = under (lh (s ⁀' x)) := by
    simpa [seqCons, h.domain_eq] using (h.seqCons x).domain_eq
  exact Eq.symm <| under_inj.mp this

name: mem_seqCons_iff
statement: lemma mem_seqCons_iff {i x z s : V} : ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s ⁀' z ↔ (i = lh s ∧ x = z) ∨ ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s

name: lh_mem_seqCons

proof:

  suffices ⟪lh s, x⟫ ∈ s → x = z by simpa [seqCons]

name: Seq.mem_seqCons_iff_of_lt
statement: lemma Seq.mem_seqCons_iff_of_lt {s x z : V} (hi : i < lh s) : ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s ⁀' z ↔ ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s

name: lh_not_mem

name: seqCons_graph
statement:
lemma seqCons_graph (t x s : V) :
    t = s ⁀' x ↔ ∃ l ≤ 2 * s, l = lh s ∧ ∃ p ≤ (2 * s + x + 1)^2, p = ⟪l, x⟫ ∧ t = insert p s
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl
      exact ⟨lh s, by simp, rfl, ⟪lh s, x⟫,
        le_trans (pair_le_pair_left (by simp) x) (pair_polybound (2 * s) x), rfl, by rfl⟩,
   by rintro ⟨l, _, rfl, p, _, rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

name: Seq.restr
statement: lemma Seq.restr {s : V} (H : Seq s) {i : V} (hi : i ≤ lh s) : Seq (s ↾ under i)

statement: lemma Seq.restr_lh {s : V} (H : Seq s) {i : V} (hi : i ≤ lh s) : lh (s ↾ under i) = i

name: domain_bitRemove_of_isMapping_of_mem
statement:
lemma domain_bitRemove_of_isMapping_of_mem {x y s : V} (hs : IsMapping s) (hxy : ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s) :
    domain (bitRemove ⟪x, y⟫ s) = bitRemove x (domain s)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x₁, (∃ y₁, (x₁ = x → y₁ ≠ y) ∧ ⟪x₁, y₁⟫ ∈ s) ↔ x₁ ≠ x ∧ ∃ y, ⟪x₁, y⟫ ∈ s by
    apply mem_ext; simpa [mem_domain_iff]
  intro x₁
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y₁, hy₁, hx₁y₁⟩; exact ⟨by rintro rfl; exact hy₁ rfl (hs.uniq hx₁y₁ hxy), y₁, hx₁y₁⟩
  · intro ⟨hx, y₁, hx₁y₁⟩
    exact ⟨y₁, by intro _; contradiction, hx₁y₁⟩

name: Seq.eq_of_eq_of_subset
statement:
lemma Seq.eq_of_eq_of_subset {s₁ s₂ : V} (H₁ : Seq s₁) (H₂ : Seq s₂)
    (hl : lh s₁ = lh s₂) (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_ext; intro u
  constructor
  · intro hu; exact h hu
  · intro hu
    have : π₁ u < lh s₁ := by
      simpa [hl] using H₂.lt_lh_of_mem (show ⟪π₁ u, π₂ u⟫ ∈ s₂ from by simpa using hu)
    have : ∃ y, ⟪π₁ u, y⟫ ∈ s₁ := H₁.exists this
    rcases this with ⟨y, hy⟩
    have : y = π₂ u := H₂.isMapping.uniq (h hy) (show ⟪π₁ u, π₂ u⟫ ∈ s₂ from by simpa using hu)
    rcases this with rfl
    simpa using hy

name: subset_pair
statement: lemma subset_pair {s t : V} (h : ∀ i x, ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s → ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ t) : s ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  simpa using h (π₁ u) (π₂ u) (by simpa using hu)

name: Seq.lh_ext
statement:
lemma Seq.lh_ext {s₁ s₂ : V} (H₁ : Seq s₁) (H₂ : Seq s₂) (h : lh s₁ = lh s₂)
    (H : ∀ i x₁ x₂, ⟪i, x₁⟫ ∈ s₁ → ⟪i, x₂⟫ ∈ s₂ → x₁ = x₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= H₁.eq_of_eq_of_subset H₂ h <| subset_pair <| by
      intro i x hx
      have hi : i < lh s₂ := by simpa [← h] using H₁.lt_lh_of_mem hx
      rcases H i _ _ hx (H₂.nth_mem hi)
      simp

name: Seq.seqCons_ext
statement:
@[simp] lemma Seq.seqCons_ext {a₁ a₂ s₁ s₂ : V} (H₁ : Seq s₁) (H₂ : Seq s₂) :
    s₁ ⁀' a₁ = s₂ ⁀' a₂ ↔ a₁ = a₂ ∧ s₁ = s₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      have hs₁s₂ : lh s₁ = lh s₂ := by simpa [H₁, H₂] using congr_arg lh h
      have hs₁ : ⟪lh s₁, a₁⟫ ∈ s₂ ⁀' a₂ := by simpa [h] using lh_mem_seqCons s₁ a₁
      have hs₂ : ⟪lh s₁, a₂⟫ ∈ s₂ ⁀' a₂ := by simp [hs₁s₂]
      have ha₁a₂ : a₁ = a₂ := (H₂.seqCons a₂).isMapping.uniq hs₁ hs₂
      have : s₁ ⊆ s₂ := subset_pair <| by
        intro i x hix
        have : i = lh s₂ ∧ x = a₂ ∨ ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s₂ := by
          simpa [mem_seqCons_iff, h] using Seq.subset_seqCons s₁ a₁ hix
        rcases this with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | hix₂)
        · have := H₁.lt_lh_of_mem hix; simp [hs₁s₂] at this
        · assumption
      exact ⟨ha₁a₂, H₁.eq_of_eq_of_subset H₂ hs₁s₂ this⟩,
   by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

name: ne_zero_iff_one_le
statement: lemma ne_zero_iff_one_le {a : V} : a ≠ 0 ↔ 1 ≤ a

name: Seq.cases_iff
statement: lemma Seq.cases_iff {s : V} : Seq s ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ x s', Seq s' ∧ s = s' ⁀' x
proof:
:= ⟨fun h ↦ by
  by_cases hs : lh s = 0
  · left
    simpa [hs] using h.domain_eq
  · right
    let i := lh s - 1
    have hi : i < lh s := pred_lt_self_of_pos (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs)
    have lhs_eq : lh s = i + 1 := Eq.symm <| tsub_add_cancel_of_le <| ne_zero_iff_one_le.mp hs
    let s' := bitRemove ⟪i, h.nth hi⟫ s
    have his : ⟪i, h.nth hi⟫ ∈ s := h.nth_mem hi
    have hdoms' : domain s' = under i := by
      simp only [domain_bitRemove_of_isMapping_of_mem h.isMapping his, h.domain_eq, s']
      apply mem_ext
      simpa [lhs_eq, and_or_left] using fun j hj ↦ ne_of_lt hj
    have hs' : Seq s' := ⟨ h.isMapping.of_subset (by simp [s']), i, hdoms' ⟩
    have hs'i : lh s' = i := by simpa [hs'.domain_eq] using hdoms'
    exact ⟨h.nth hi, s', hs', mem_ext <| fun v ↦ by
      simp only [seqCons, hs'i, mem_bitInsert_iff]
      simp [s']
      by_cases hv : v = ⟪i, h.nth hi⟫ <;> simp [hv]⟩,
  by  rintro (rfl | ⟨x, s', hs', rfl⟩)
      · simp
      · exact hs'.seqCons x⟩

name: seq_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem seq_induction (Γ) {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
  (hnil : P ∅) (hcons : ∀ s x, Seq s → P s → P (s ⁀' x)) :
    ∀ {s : V}, Seq s → P s
proof:
:= by
  intro s sseq
  induction s using ISigma1.order_induction
  · exact Γ
  · definability
  case ind s ih =>
    have : s = ∅ ∨ ∃ x s', Seq s' ∧ s = s' ⁀' x := sseq.cases
    rcases this with (rfl | ⟨x, s, hs, rfl⟩)
    · exact hnil
    · exact hcons s x hs (ih s (hs.lt_seqCons x) hs)

name: singleton_seq
statement: @[simp] lemma singleton_seq (x : V) : Seq !⟦x⟧

name: doubleton_seq
statement: @[simp] lemma doubleton_seq (x y : V) : Seq !⟦x, y⟧

statement: @[simp] lemma mem_singleton_seq_iff (x y : V) : ⟪0, x⟫ ∈ !⟦y⟧ ↔ x = y

name: sigmaOne_skolem_seq
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_skolem_seq {R : V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation R) {l}
    (H : ∀ x < l, ∃ y, R x y) : ∃ s, Seq s ∧ lh s = l ∧ ∀ i x, ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s → R i x
proof:
:= by
  rcases sigmaOne_skolem hP (show ∀ x ∈ under l, ∃ y, R x y by simpa using H) with ⟨s, ms, sdom, h⟩
  have : Seq s := ⟨ms, l, sdom⟩
  exact ⟨s, this, by simpa [this.domain_eq] using sdom, h⟩

name: sigmaOne_skolem_seq
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_skolem_seq! {R : V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation R) {l}
    (H : ∀ x < l, ∃! y, R x y) : ∃! s, Seq s ∧ lh s = l ∧ ∀ i x, ⟪i, x⟫ ∈ s → R i x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x < l, ∃ y, R x y := fun x hx ↦ (H x hx).exists
  rcases sigmaOne_skolem_seq hP this with ⟨s, Ss, rfl, hs⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro s ⟨Ss, rfl, hs⟩ (by
    rintro s' ⟨Ss', hss', hs'⟩
    exact Seq.lh_ext Ss' Ss hss' (fun i x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ ↦ H i (Ss.lt_lh_of_mem h₂) |>.unique (hs' i x₁ h₁) (hs i x₂ h₂)))

name: mem_vectoSeq

    · simpa [vecToSeq, mem_seqCons_iff] using Or.inr <| ih (v ·.castSucc) i

statement:
lemma eval_formula (v : Fin k.succ.succ → V) :
    φ.core.val.Evalb v ↔ c.Φ (v ·.succ.succ) {x | x ∈ v 1} (v 0)

name: succ_existsUnique
statement:
lemma succ_existsUnique (s ih : V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ x, (x ∈ u ↔ x ≤ s ∧ c.Φ v {z | z ∈ ih} x)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ x ≤ s ∧ c.Φ v {z | z ∈ ih} x := by
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.and (by definability)
      ⟨φ.core.sigma.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> &ih :> fun i ↦ &(v i)),
        by intro x; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, c.eval_formula]⟩
  exact finite_comprehension₁! this
    ⟨s + 1, fun i ↦ by rintro ⟨hi, _⟩; exact lt_succ_iff_le.mpr hi⟩

name: mem_succ_iff
statement:
lemma mem_succ_iff {v s ih} :
    x ∈ c.succ v s ih ↔ x ≤ s ∧ c.Φ v {z | z ∈ ih} x

name: succ_graph
statement:
private lemma succ_graph {u v s ih} :
    u = c.succ v s ih ↔ ∀ x < u + (s + 1), x ∈ u ↔ x ≤ s ∧ c.Φ v {z | z ∈ ih} x
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl x _; simp [mem_succ_iff], by
    intro h; apply mem_ext
    intro x; constructor
    · intro hx; exact c.mem_succ_iff.mpr <| h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp)) |>.mp hx
    · intro hx
      exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_succ_iff_le.mpr (c.mem_succ_iff.mp hx).1)
        (by simp)) |>.mpr (c.mem_succ_iff.mp hx)⟩

:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.succDef, succ_graph, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, c.eval_formula,
    c.defined.proper.iff', -and_imp,  BinderNotation.finSuccItr]
  grind

lemma eval_succDef (v : Fin (k + 3) → V) :

statement: @[simp] lemma limSeq_zero : c.limSeq v 0 = ∅

@[simp] lemma eval_limSeqDef (v : Fin (k + 2) → V) :

name: mem_limSeq_succ_iff
statement:
lemma mem_limSeq_succ_iff {x s : V} :
    x ∈ c.limSeq v (s + 1) ↔ x ≤ s ∧ c.Φ v {z | z ∈ c.limSeq v s} x

name: limSeq_cumulative
statement: lemma limSeq_cumulative {s s' : V} : s ≤ s' → c.limSeq v s ⊆ c.limSeq v s'
proof:
:= by
  induction s' using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction generalizing s
  · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.ball_le (by definability)
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂
    · exact ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> #1 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
    · exact ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> #2 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
  case zero =>
    simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero, limSeq_zero]; rintro rfl; simp
  case succ s' ih =>
    intro hs u hu
    rcases zero_or_succ s with (rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hu
    have hs : s ≤ s' := by simpa using hs
    rcases c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mp hu with ⟨hu, Hu⟩
    exact c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mpr ⟨_root_.le_trans hu hs, c.monotone (fun z hz ↦ ih hs hz) Hu⟩

name: mem_limSeq_self
statement:
lemma mem_limSeq_self [c.StrongFinite] {u s : V} :
    u ∈ c.limSeq v s → u ∈ c.limSeq v (u + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction u using ISigma1.pi1_order_induction generalizing s
  · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.all
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.imp
    · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂
        ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> #1 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
        (by definability)
    · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂
        ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> ‘#2 + 1’ :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
        (by definability)
  case ind u ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ s with (rfl | ⟨s, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    intro hu
    rcases c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mp hu with ⟨_, Hu⟩
    have : c.Φ v {z | z ∈ c.limSeq v s ∧ z < u} u := StrongFinite.strong_finite Hu
    have : c.Φ v {z | z ∈ c.limSeq v u} u :=
      c.monotone (by
        simp only [Set.ofPred_subset_ofPred, and_imp]
        intro z hz hzu
        exact c.limSeq_cumulative (succ_le_iff_lt.mpr hzu) (ih z hzu hz))
        this
    exact c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mpr ⟨by rfl, this⟩

name: fixpoint_iff
statement: lemma fixpoint_iff [c.StrongFinite] {x : V} : c.Fixpoint v x ↔ x ∈ c.limSeq v (x + 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨s, hs⟩; exact c.mem_limSeq_self hs, fun h ↦ ⟨x + 1, h⟩⟩

name: fixpoint_iff_succ
statement: lemma fixpoint_iff_succ {x : V} : c.Fixpoint v x ↔ ∃ u, x ∈ c.limSeq v (u + 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rintro ⟨u, h⟩
    rcases zero_or_succ u with (rfl | ⟨u, rfl⟩)
    · simp at h
    · exact ⟨u, h⟩, by rintro ⟨u, h⟩; exact ⟨u + 1, h⟩⟩

name: finite_upperbound
statement: lemma finite_upperbound (m : V) : ∃ s, ∀ z < m, c.Fixpoint v z → z ∈ c.limSeq v s
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ F : V, ∀ x, x ∈ F ↔ x < m ∧ c.Fixpoint v x := by
    have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ x < m ∧ c.Fixpoint v x :=
      HierarchySymbol.Definable.and (by definability)
        (HierarchySymbol.Definable.exs
          (HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂
            ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> #1 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
            (by definability)))
    exact finite_comprehension₁! this ⟨m, fun i hi ↦ hi.1⟩ |>.exists
  rcases this with ⟨F, hF⟩
  have : ∀ x ∈ F, ∃ u, x ∈ c.limSeq v u := by
    intro x hx; exact hF x |>.mp hx |>.2
  have : ∃ f, IsMapping f ∧ domain f = F ∧ ∀ (x y : V), ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f → x ∈ c.limSeq v y := sigmaOne_skolem
    (by apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.comp₂
          ⟨φ.limSeqDef.rew <| Rew.embSubsts (#0 :> #2 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by intro v; simp [c.eval_limSeqDef]⟩
          (by definability)) this
  rcases this with ⟨f, mf, rfl, hf⟩
  exact ⟨f, by
    intro z hzm hz
    have : ∃ u, ⟪z, u⟫ ∈ f := mf.get_exists_uniq ((hF z).mpr ⟨hzm, hz⟩) |>.exists
    rcases this with ⟨u, hu⟩
    have : z ∈ c.limSeq v u := hf z u hu
    exact c.limSeq_cumulative (le_of_lt <| lt_of_mem_rng hu) this⟩

name: case
statement: theorem case [c.Finite] : c.Fixpoint v x ↔ c.Φ v {z | c.Fixpoint v z} x
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      rcases c.fixpoint_iff_succ.mp h with ⟨u, hu⟩
      have : c.Φ v {z | z ∈ c.limSeq v u} x := (c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mp hu).2
      exact c.monotone (fun z hx ↦ by exact ⟨u, hx⟩) this,
   by intro hx
      rcases Finite.finite hx with ⟨m, hm⟩
      have : ∃ s, ∀ z < m, c.Fixpoint v z → z ∈ c.limSeq v s := c.finite_upperbound m
      rcases this with ⟨s, hs⟩
      have : c.Φ v {z | z ∈ c.limSeq v s} x :=
        c.monotone (by
          simp only [Set.ofPred_subset_ofPred, and_imp]
          intro z hz hzm; exact hs z hzm hz)
          hm
      exact ⟨max s x + 1,
        c.mem_limSeq_succ_iff.mpr <| ⟨by simp, c.monotone (fun z hz ↦ c.limSeq_cumulative (by simp) hz) this⟩⟩⟩

name: fixpoint_defined
statement: lemma fixpoint_defined : 𝚺₁.Defined (fun v ↦ c.Fixpoint (v ·.succ) (v 0)) φ.fixpointDef
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.fixpointDef, c.eval_limSeqDef]; rfl

name: eval_fixpointDef
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_fixpointDef (v : Fin (k + 1) → V) :
    φ.fixpointDef.val.Evalb v ↔ c.Fixpoint (v ·.succ) (v 0)

name: fixpoint_defined
statement: lemma fixpoint_definedΔ₁ [c.StrongFinite] : 𝚫₁.Defined (fun v ↦ c.Fixpoint (v ·.succ) (v 0)) φ.fixpointDefΔ₁
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro v; simp [Blueprint.fixpointDefΔ₁, c.eval_limSeqDef],
   by intro v; simp [Blueprint.fixpointDefΔ₁, c.eval_limSeqDef, fixpoint_iff]⟩

name: eval_fixpointDef
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_fixpointDefΔ₁ [c.StrongFinite] (v : Fin (k + 1) → V) :
    φ.fixpointDefΔ₁.val.Evalb v ↔ c.Fixpoint (v ·.succ) (v 0)

name: induction
statement:
theorem induction [c.StrongFinite] {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
    (H : ∀ C : Set V, (∀ x ∈ C, c.Fixpoint v x ∧ P x) → ∀ x, c.Φ v C x → P x) :
    ∀ x, c.Fixpoint v x → P x
proof:
:= by
  apply InductionOnHierarchy.order_induction_sigma (Γ := Γ) (m := 1) (P := fun x ↦ c.Fixpoint v x → P x)
  · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.imp
      (HierarchySymbol.DefinablePred.comp
        (by
          apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.of_deltaOne
          exact ⟨φ.fixpointDefΔ₁.rew <| Rew.embSubsts <| #0 :> fun x ↦ &(v x), c.fixpoint_definedΔ₁.proper.rew' _,
            by intro v; simp [c.eval_fixpointDefΔ₁]⟩)
        (by definability))
      (by definability)
  intro x ih hx
  have : c.Φ v {y | c.Fixpoint v y ∧ y < x} x := StrongFinite.strong_finite (c.case.mp hx)
  exact H {y | c.Fixpoint v y ∧ y < x} (by intro y ⟨hy, hyx⟩; exact ⟨hy, ih y hyx hy⟩) x this

name: insert_subset_insert_of_subset

proof:

  · simp
  · simp [h hz]

name: under_subset_under_of_le
statement: @[simp] lemma under_subset_under_of_le {i j : V} : under i ⊆ under j ↔ i ≤ j
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h; by_contra hij
      have : j < i := by simpa using hij
      simpa using h (mem_under_iff.mpr this),
   by intro hij x
      simp only [mem_under_iff]
      intro hx
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx hij⟩

name: sUnion_exists_unique
statement:
lemma sUnion_exists_unique (s : V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ x, (x ∈ u ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, x ∈ t)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ ∃ t ∈ s, x ∈ t := by definability
  exact finite_comprehension₁! this
    ⟨s, fun i ↦ by
      rintro ⟨t, ht, hi⟩; exact lt_trans (lt_of_mem hi) (lt_of_mem ht)⟩

name: mem_sUnion_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_sUnion_iff {a b : V} : a ∈ ⋃ʰᶠ b ↔ ∃ c ∈ b, a ∈ c

name: sUnion_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma sUnion_empty : (⋃ʰᶠ ∅ : V) = ∅

name: sUnion_lt_of_pos
statement: lemma sUnion_lt_of_pos {a : V} (ha : 0 < a) : ⋃ʰᶠ a < a
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_log ha <| by
    suffices ∀ i x, x ∈ a → i ∈ x → i < log a by simpa
    intro i x hx hi
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hi) (le_log_of_mem hx)

name: sUnion_le
statement: @[simp] lemma sUnion_le (a : V) : ⋃ʰᶠ a ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp [←emptyset_def]
  · exact le_of_lt (sUnion_lt_of_pos pos)

name: sUnion_graph
statement: lemma sUnion_graph {u s : V} : u = ⋃ʰᶠ s ↔ ∀ x < u + s, (x ∈ u ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, x ∈ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; simp, by
    intro h; apply mem_ext
    intro x
    suffices x ∈ u ↔ ∃ c ∈ s, x ∈ c by simpa
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp)) |>.mp hx
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, hx⟩
      exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_trans (lt_of_mem hx) (lt_of_mem hc)) (by simp)) |>.mpr ⟨c, hc, hx⟩⟩

name: mem_cup_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_cup_iff {a b c : V} : a ∈ b ∪ c ↔ a ∈ b ∨ a ∈ c

name: union_graph
statement: private lemma union_graph {u s t : V} : u = s ∪ t ↔ ∀ x < u + s + t, (x ∈ u ↔ x ∈ s ∨ x ∈ t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; simp, by
    intro h; apply mem_ext
    intro x
    suffices x ∈ u ↔ x ∈ s ∨ x ∈ t by simpa
    constructor
    · intro hx; exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp [add_assoc])) |>.mp hx
    · rintro (hx | hx)
      · exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp )) |>.mpr (Or.inl hx)
      · exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp )) |>.mpr (Or.inr hx)⟩

name: insert_eq_union_singleton
statement: lemma insert_eq_union_singleton (a s : V) : insert a s = {a} ∪ s

name: union_polybound
statement: @[simp] lemma union_polybound (a b : V) : a ∪ b ≤ 2 * (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ i, i ∈ a ∨ i ∈ b → i < log (2 * (a + b) + 1) from le_iff_lt_succ.mpr <| lt_of_lt_log (by simp) <| by simpa
  rintro i (hi | hi)
  · calc
      i ≤ log (a + b) := le_trans (le_log_of_mem hi) (log_monotone (by simp))
      _ < log (2 * (a + b)) := by simp [log_two_mul_of_pos (show 0 < a + b from by simp [pos_of_nonempty hi])]
      _ ≤ log (2 * (a + b) + 1) := log_monotone (by simp)
  · calc
      i ≤ log (a + b) := le_trans (le_log_of_mem hi) (log_monotone (by simp))
      _ < log (2 * (a + b)) := by simp [log_two_mul_of_pos (show 0 < a + b from by simp [pos_of_nonempty hi])]
      _ ≤ log (2 * (a + b) + 1) := log_monotone (by simp)

statement: lemma union_comm (a b : V) : a ∪ b = b ∪ a

statement: @[simp] lemma union_succ_union_right (a b : V) : b ⊆ a ∪ b

name: sInter_exists_unique
statement:
lemma sInter_exists_unique (s : V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ x, (x ∈ u ↔ s ≠ ∅ ∧ ∀ t ∈ s, x ∈ t)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ s ≠ ∅ ∧ ∀ t ∈ s, x ∈ t := by definability
  exact finite_comprehension₁! this
    ⟨s, fun i ↦ by
      rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
      have : log s ∈ s := log_mem_of_pos <| pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs
      exact _root_.trans (lt_of_mem <| h (log s) this) (lt_of_mem this)⟩

name: mem_sInter_iff
statement: lemma mem_sInter_iff {x s : V} : x ∈ ⋂ʰᶠ s ↔ s ≠ ∅ ∧ ∀ t ∈ s, x ∈ t

name: mem_sInter_iff_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_sInter_iff_empty : ⋂ʰᶠ (∅ : V) = ∅

name: mem_sInter_iff_of_pos
statement: lemma mem_sInter_iff_of_pos {x s : V} (h : s ≠ ∅) : x ∈ ⋂ʰᶠ s ↔ ∀ t ∈ s, x ∈ t

name: mem_inter_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_inter_iff {a b c : V} : a ∈ b ∩ c ↔ a ∈ b ∧ a ∈ c
proof:
:= by
  simp [Inter.inter, inter, mem_sInter_iff_of_pos (s := {b, c}) (nonempty_iff.mpr ⟨b, by simp⟩)]

name: inter_comm
statement: lemma inter_comm (a b : V) : a ∩ b = b ∩ a

name: inter_eq_self_of_subset
statement:
lemma inter_eq_self_of_subset {a b : V} (h : a ⊆ b) :
  a ∩ b = a
proof: := mem_ext (by simpa using fun i hi↦ h hi)

name: product_exists_unique
statement:
lemma product_exists_unique (a b : V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ x, (x ∈ u ↔ ∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ ∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫ := by definability
  exact finite_comprehension₁! this
    ⟨⟪log a, log b⟫ + 1, fun i ↦ by
      rintro ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩
      simpa [lt_succ_iff_le]
      using pair_le_pair (le_log_of_mem hy) (le_log_of_mem hz)⟩

name: mem_product_iff
statement: lemma mem_product_iff {x a b : V} : x ∈ a ×ʰᶠ b ↔ ∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫

name: mem_product_iff'
statement: lemma mem_product_iff' {x a b : V} : x ∈ a ×ʰᶠ b ↔ π₁ x ∈ a ∧ π₂ x ∈ b
proof:
:= by
  suffices (∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫) ↔ π₁ x ∈ a ∧ π₂ x ∈ b by simpa [mem_product_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩; simp [*]
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩; exact ⟨π₁ x, h₁, π₂ x, h₂, by simp⟩

name: pair_mem_product_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma pair_mem_product_iff {x y a b : V} : ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ a ×ʰᶠ b ↔ x ∈ a ∧ y ∈ b

name: pair_mem_product
statement: lemma pair_mem_product {x y a b : V} (hx : x ∈ a) (hy : y ∈ b) : ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ a ×ʰᶠ b

name: product_graph
statement: private lemma product_graph {u a b : V} : u = a ×ʰᶠ b ↔ ∀ x < u + (a + b + 1) ^ 2, (x ∈ u ↔ ∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl x _; simp [mem_product_iff], by
    intro h
    apply mem_ext; intro x
    suffices x ∈ u ↔ ∃ y ∈ a, ∃ z ∈ b, x = ⟪y, z⟫ by simpa [mem_product_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hx; exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp)) |>.mp hx
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact h ⟪y, z⟫ (lt_of_lt_of_le (pair_lt_pair (lt_of_mem hy) (lt_of_mem hz))
        (le_trans (pair_polybound a b) <| by simp)) |>.mpr ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩⟩

name: domain_exists_unique
statement:
lemma domain_exists_unique (s : V) :
    ∃! d : V, ∀ x, x ∈ d ↔ ∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ ∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s :=
    HierarchySymbol.DefinablePred.of_iff (Q := fun x ↦ ∃ y < s, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s)
      (by definability)
      (fun x ↦ ⟨by rintro ⟨y, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_right x y) (lt_of_mem hy), hy⟩,
                by rintro ⟨y, _, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩⟩)
  exact finite_comprehension₁!
    this
    (⟨s, fun x ↦ by rintro ⟨y, hy⟩; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_left x y) (lt_of_mem hy)⟩)

name: mem_domain_iff
statement: lemma mem_domain_iff {x s : V} : x ∈ domain s ↔ ∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s

name: domain_graph
statement: private lemma domain_graph {u s : V} : u = domain s ↔ ∀ x < u + s, (x ∈ u ↔ ∃ y < s, ∃ z ∈ s, z = ⟪x, y⟫)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl x _
    suffices (∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s) ↔ ∃ y < s, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s by simpa [mem_domain_iff]
    exact ⟨by rintro ⟨y, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_right x y) (lt_of_mem hy), hy⟩, by
      rintro ⟨y, _, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  · intro h; apply mem_ext; intro x
    suffices x ∈ u ↔ ∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s by simpa [mem_domain_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hx) (by simp)) |>.mp hx with ⟨y, _, _, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact h x (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_left x y) (lt_of_mem hy)) (by simp))
        |>.mpr ⟨y, lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_right x y) (lt_of_mem hy), _, hy, rfl⟩

name: domain_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_empty : domain (∅ : V) = ∅

name: domain_union
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_union (a b : V) : domain (a ∪ b) = domain a ∪ domain b
proof:
:= mem_ext (by
  suffices ∀ i, (∃ y, ⟪i, y⟫ ∈ a ∨ ⟪i, y⟫ ∈ b) ↔ (∃ y, ⟪i, y⟫ ∈ a) ∨ ∃ y, ⟪i, y⟫ ∈ b by simpa [mem_domain_iff]
  intro x; constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, (hy | hy)⟩
    · left; exact ⟨y, hy⟩
    · right; exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  · rintro (⟨y, hy⟩ | ⟨y, hy⟩)
    · exact ⟨y, Or.inl hy⟩
    · exact ⟨y, Or.inr hy⟩)

name: domain_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_singleton (x y : V) : (domain {⟪x, y⟫} : V) = {x}

name: domain_insert
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_insert (x y s : V) : domain (insert ⟪x, y⟫ s) = insert x (domain s)

name: domain_bound
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_bound (s : V) : domain s ≤ 2 * s
proof:
:= le_iff_lt_succ.mpr
  <| lt_of_lt_log (by simp) (by
    simp only [mem_domain_iff, forall_exists_index]
    intro i x hix
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_pair_left i x) (le_log_of_mem hix))
      (by simp [log_two_mul_add_one_of_pos (pos_of_nonempty hix)]))

name: mem_domain_of_pair_mem
statement: lemma mem_domain_of_pair_mem {x y s : V} (h : ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s) : x ∈ domain s

name: domain_subset_domain_of_subset
statement: lemma domain_subset_domain_of_subset {s t : V} (h : s ⊆ t) : domain s ⊆ domain t
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases mem_domain_iff.mp hx with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact mem_domain_iff.mpr ⟨y, h hy⟩

name: domain_eq_empty_iff_eq_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_eq_empty_iff_eq_empty {s : V} : domain s = ∅ ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp only [isempty_iff, mem_domain_iff, not_exists]
      intro h x hx
      exact h (π₁ x) (π₂ x) (by simpa using hx), by rintro rfl; simp⟩

name: domain_le_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma domain_le_self {P : V → Prop}
    (hempty : P ∅) (hinsert : ∀ s x, x ∉ s → P s → P (insert x s)) : ∀ x, P x

name: domain_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma domain_le_self (P : V → Prop) (s : V) : domain s ≤ s

name: range_exists_unique
statement:
lemma range_exists_unique (s : V) :
    ∃! r : V, ∀ y, y ∈ r ↔ ∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun y ↦ ∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s :=
    HierarchySymbol.DefinablePred.of_iff (Q := fun y ↦ ∃ x < s, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s)
      (by definability)
      (fun y ↦ ⟨by rintro ⟨x, hy⟩; exact ⟨x, lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_left x y) (lt_of_mem hy), hy⟩,
                by rintro ⟨y, _, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩⟩)
  exact finite_comprehension₁!
    this
    (⟨s, fun y ↦ by rintro ⟨x, hx⟩; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_pair_right x y) (lt_of_mem hx)⟩)

name: mem_range_iff
statement: lemma mem_range_iff {y s : V} : y ∈ range s ↔ ∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s

name: range_graph
statement: private lemma range_graph {s' s : V} : s' = range s ↔ ∀ y < s' + s, (y ∈ s' ↔ ∃ x < s, ∃ z ∈ s, z = ⟪x, y⟫)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl y _
      suffices (∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s) ↔ ∃ x < s, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s by simpa [mem_range_iff]
      exact ⟨by rintro ⟨x, hx⟩; exact ⟨x, lt_of_mem_dom hx, hx⟩, by rintro ⟨y, _, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩⟩,
   by intro h
      apply mem_ext
      intro y
      suffices y ∈ s' ↔ ∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ s by simpa [mem_range_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hy
        rcases h y (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem hy) (by simp)) |>.mp hy with ⟨y, _, _, hy, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, hy⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
        exact h y (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_mem_rng hx) (by simp))
          |>.mpr ⟨x, lt_of_mem_dom hx, _, hx, rfl⟩⟩

name: range_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma range_empty : range (∅ : V) = ∅

name: Disjoint.iff
statement: lemma Disjoint.iff {s t : V} : Disjoint s t ↔ ∀ x, x ∉ s ∨ x ∉ t

name: Disjoint.not_of_mem
statement: lemma Disjoint.not_of_mem {s t x : V} (hs : x ∈ s) (ht : x ∈ t) : ¬Disjoint s t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Disjoint.iff, not_or] using ⟨x, hs, ht⟩

name: Disjoint.symm
statement: lemma Disjoint.symm {s t : V} (h : Disjoint s t) : Disjoint t s
proof: := by simpa [Disjoint, inter_comm t s] using h

name: Disjoint.singleton_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma Disjoint.singleton_iff {a : V} : Disjoint ({a} : V) s ↔ a ∉ s

name: isMapping_iff
statement:
private lemma isMapping_iff {m : V} :
    IsMapping m ↔ ∃ d ≤ 2 * m, d = domain m ∧ ∀ x ∈ d, ∃ y < m, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m ∧ ∀ y' < m, ⟪x, y'⟫ ∈ m → y' = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro hm
      exact ⟨domain m, by simp, rfl, fun x hx ↦ by
        rcases hm x hx with ⟨y, hy, uniq⟩
        exact ⟨y, lt_of_mem_rng hy, hy, fun y' _ h' ↦ uniq y' h'⟩⟩,
   by rintro ⟨_, _, rfl, h⟩ x hx
      rcases h x hx with ⟨y, _, hxy, h⟩
      exact ExistsUnique.intro y hxy (fun y' hxy' ↦ h y' (lt_of_mem_rng hxy') hxy')⟩

name: IsMapping.get_exists_uniq
statement: lemma IsMapping.get_exists_uniq {m : V} (h : IsMapping m) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ domain m) : ∃! y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m

name: IsMapping.get_mem
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsMapping.get_mem {m : V} (h : IsMapping m) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ domain m) :

name: IsMapping.get_uniq
statement: lemma IsMapping.get_uniq {m : V} (h : IsMapping m) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ domain m) (hy : ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m) : y = h.get hx

name: IsMapping.empty
statement: @[simp] lemma IsMapping.empty : IsMapping (∅ : V)

name: IsMapping.union_of_disjoint_domain
statement:
lemma IsMapping.union_of_disjoint_domain {m₁ m₂ : V}
    (h₁ : IsMapping m₁) (h₂ : IsMapping m₂) (disjoint : Disjoint (domain m₁) (domain m₂)) : IsMapping (m₁ ∪ m₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  suffices x ∈ domain m₁ ∨ x ∈ domain m₂ → ∃! y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m₁ ∨ ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m₂ by simpa
  rintro (hx | hx)
  · exact ExistsUnique.intro (h₁.get hx) (by simp) (by
      intro y
      rintro (hy | hy)
      · exact h₁.get_uniq hx hy
      · by_contra; exact Disjoint.not_of_mem hx (mem_domain_of_pair_mem hy) disjoint)
  · exact ExistsUnique.intro (h₂.get hx) (by simp) (by
      intro y
      rintro (hy | hy)
      · by_contra; exact Disjoint.not_of_mem hx (mem_domain_of_pair_mem hy) disjoint.symm
      · exact h₂.get_uniq hx hy)

name: IsMapping.singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma IsMapping.singleton (x y : V) : IsMapping ({⟪x, y⟫} : V)
proof:
:= by
  intro x; simp only [domain_singleton, mem_singleton_iff, pair_ext_iff]
  rintro rfl; exact ExistsUnique.intro y (by simp) (by rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩; simp)

name: IsMapping.insert

lemma IsMapping.insert {x y m : V}

name: IsMapping.of_subset
statement: lemma IsMapping.of_subset {m m' : V} (h : IsMapping m) (ss : m' ⊆ m) : IsMapping m'
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  rcases mem_domain_iff.mp hx with ⟨y, hy⟩
  have : ∃! y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ m := h x (domain_subset_domain_of_subset ss hx)
  exact ExistsUnique.intro y hy (fun y' hy' ↦ this.unique (ss hy') (ss hy))

name: IsMapping.uniq
statement: lemma IsMapping.uniq {m x y₁ y₂ : V} (h : IsMapping m) : ⟪x, y₁⟫ ∈ m → ⟪x, y₂⟫ ∈ m → y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= fun h₁ h₂ ↦
  h x (mem_domain_iff.mpr ⟨y₁, h₁⟩) |>.unique h₁ h₂

name: restr_exists_unique

lemma restr_exists_unique (f s : V) :
    ∃! g : V, ∀ x, (x ∈ g ↔ x ∈ f ∧ π₁ x ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun x ↦ x ∈ f ∧ π₁ x ∈ s := by definability
  exact finite_comprehension₁! this
    ⟨f, fun i ↦ by rintro ⟨hi, _⟩; exact lt_of_mem hi⟩
