name: insert_induction
statement:
theorem insert_induction {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
    (hempty : P ∅) (hinsert : ∀ a s, a ∉ s → P s → P (insert a s)) : ∀ s, P s
proof:
:=
  InductionOnHierarchy.order_induction_sigma Γ 1 hP <| by
    intro s IH
    rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with (rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩)
    · exact hempty
    · simpa [insert_remove hx] using
        hinsert x (bitRemove x s) (by simp) (IH _ (bitRemove_lt_of_mem hx))

name: insert_induction_sigmaOne
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma insert_induction_sigmaOne {P : V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Predicate P)
    (hempty : P ∅) (hinsert : ∀ a s, a ∉ s → P s → P (insert a s)) : ∀ s, P s

name: insert_induction_piOne
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma insert_induction_piOne {P : V → Prop} (hP : 𝚷₁-Predicate P)
    (hempty : P ∅) (hinsert : ∀ a s, a ∉ s → P s → P (insert a s)) : ∀ s, P s

name: sigmaOne_skolem
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_skolem {R : V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation R) {s : V}
    (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ y, R x y) : ∃ f, IsMapping f ∧ domain f = s ∧ ∀ x y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f → R x y
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ u, u ⊆ s → ∃ f, IsMapping f ∧ domain f = u ∧ ∀ x y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f → R x y := by
    intro u hu
    induction u using insert_induction_sigmaOne
    · have : 𝚺₁-Predicate fun u ↦ u ⊆ s → ∃ f, IsMapping f ∧ domain f = u ∧ ∀ x < f, ∀ y < f, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f → R x y := by definability
      exact this.of_iff <| by
        intro x; apply imp_congr_right <| fun _ ↦ exists_congr <| fun f ↦ and_congr_right
          <| fun _ ↦ and_congr_right <| fun _ ↦
            ⟨fun h x _ y _ hxy ↦ h x y hxy, fun h x y hxy ↦ h x (lt_of_mem_dom hxy) y (lt_of_mem_rng hxy) hxy⟩
    case hempty =>
      exact ⟨∅, by simp⟩
    case hinsert a u ha ih =>
      have : ∃ f, IsMapping f ∧ domain f = u ∧ ∀ x y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f → R x y := ih (subset_trans (susbset_insert a u) hu)
      rcases this with ⟨f, mf, rfl, hf⟩
      have : ∃ b, R a b := H a <| And.left <| by simpa [subset_iff] using hu
      rcases this with ⟨b, hb⟩
      let f' := insert ⟪a, b⟫ f
      exact ⟨f', mf.insert (by simpa using ha), by simp [f'], by
        intro x y hxy
        rcases (show x = a ∧ y = b ∨ ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ f by simpa [f'] using hxy) with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | h)
        · exact hb
        · exact hf x y h⟩
  exact this s (by rfl)

name: sigma
statement:
theorem sigma₁_replacement {f : V → V} (hf : 𝚺₁-Function₁ f) (s : V) :
    ∃! t : V, ∀ y, y ∈ t ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, y = f x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ y, y = f x := by intro x _; exact ⟨f x, rfl⟩
  have : ∃ F, IsMapping F ∧ domain F = s ∧ ∀ (x y : V), ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ F → y = f x :=
    sigmaOne_skolem (by definability) this
  rcases this with ⟨F, _, rfl, hF⟩
  refine ExistsUnique.intro (range F) ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    simp only [mem_range_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩; exact ⟨x, by simpa [mem_domain_iff] using ⟨y, hx⟩, hF _ _ hx⟩
    · simp only [mem_domain_iff, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
      rintro x y hxy rfl; exact ⟨x, by rcases hF _ _ hxy; exact hxy⟩
  · intro s' hs'
    apply mem_ext; intro y
    suffices (∃ x, (∃ y, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ F) ∧ y = f x) ↔ ∃ x, ⟪x, y⟫ ∈ F by simpa [hs', mem_domain_iff, mem_range_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x, by rcases hF _ _ hxy; exact hxy⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hxy⟩; exact ⟨x, ⟨y, hxy⟩, hF _ _ hxy⟩

name: sigma
statement:
theorem sigma₁_replacement₂ {f : V → V → V} (hf : 𝚺₁-Function₂ f) (s₁ s₂ : V) :
    ∃! t : V, ∀ y, y ∈ t ↔ ∃ x₁ ∈ s₁, ∃ x₂ ∈ s₂, y = f x₁ x₂
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺₁-Function₁ (fun x ↦ f (π₁ x) (π₂ x)) := by definability
  exact (existsUnique_congr (by
      intro t; apply forall_congr'; intro y; apply iff_congr (by rfl)
      simp only [mem_product_iff']
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨π₁ x, h₁, π₂ x, h₂, by rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨x₁, h₁, x₂, h₂, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟪x₁, x₂⟫, by simp [h₁, h₂]⟩)).mp
    (sigma₁_replacement this (s₁ ×ʰᶠ s₂))

name: mem_hfsImage_iff
statement: lemma mem_hfsImage_iff {s y : V} : y ∈ hfsImage f s ↔ ∃ x ∈ s, y = f x

name: app_mem_hfsImage
statement: lemma app_mem_hfsImage {p s : V} (h : p ∈ s) : f p ∈ hfsImage f s

name: hfsImage_subset_of_subset
statement: lemma hfsImage_subset_of_subset {s t : V} (h : s ⊆ t) : hfsImage f s ⊆ hfsImage f t
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rcases mem_hfsImage_iff.mp hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact app_mem_hfsImage (h hx)

name: mem_hfsImage_union
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_hfsImage_union {s t : V} : hfsImage f (s ∪ t) = hfsImage f s ∪ hfsImage f t
proof:
:= mem_ext <| by
  simp only [mem_hfsImage_iff, mem_cup_iff]; grind

name: mem_hfsImage_insert
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_hfsImage_insert {x s : V} : hfsImage f (insert x s) = insert (f x) (hfsImage f s)

name: hfsImage_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma hfsImage_empty : hfsImage f (∅ : V) = ∅

name: hfsImage_graph
statement:
private lemma hfsImage_graph (t s : V) :
    t = hfsImage f s ↔ (∀ y ∈ t, ∃ x ∈ s, y = f x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    constructor
    · intro y hy; exact mem_hfsImage_iff.mp hy
    · intro x hx; exact mem_hfsImage_iff.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    apply mem_ext; intro y; constructor
    · intro hy; exact mem_hfsImage_iff.mpr (h₁ y hy)
    · intro hy
      rcases mem_hfsImage_iff.mp hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact h₂ x hx

name: fstIdx_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma fstIdx_le_self (p : V) : fstIdx p ≤ p
proof: := le_trans (by simp [fstIdx]) (show p - 1 ≤ p by simp)

proof: := le_trans (by simp [sndIdx]) (show p - 1 ≤ p by simp)

statement: @[simp] lemma iterExp_succ (x y : V) : iterExp x (y + 1) = Exp.exp (iterExp x y)

statement: lemma superexp_eq (x : V) : Superexp.superexp x = iterExp x x

statement: @[simp] lemma superexp_zero : Superexp.superexp (0 : V) = 0

name: superexp_one
statement: @[simp] lemma superexp_one : Superexp.superexp (1 : V) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [superexp_eq, congrArg (iterExp 1) (zero_add 1).symm, iterExp_succ, iterExp_zero, exp_one]

name: superexp_two
statement: @[simp] lemma superexp_two : Superexp.superexp (2 : V) = 16
proof:
:= by
  have exp_two : Exp.exp (2 : V) = 4 := by
    rw [show (2 : V) = 1 + 1 from one_add_one_eq_two.symm, exp_succ, exp_one]; norm_num
  have exp_four : Exp.exp (4 : V) = 16 := by
    rw [show (4 : V) = 3 + 1 from three_add_one_eq_four.symm, exp_succ,
      show (3 : V) = 2 + 1 from two_add_one_eq_three.symm, exp_succ, exp_two]
    norm_num
  rw [superexp_eq, congrArg (iterExp 2) (one_add_one_eq_two (R := V)).symm, iterExp_succ,
    congrArg (iterExp 2) (zero_add 1).symm, iterExp_succ, iterExp_zero, exp_two, exp_four]

name: superexp_three
statement: @[simp] lemma superexp_three : Superexp.superexp (3 : V) = Exp.exp 256
proof:
:= by
  have exp_two : Exp.exp (2 : V) = 4 := by
    rw [show (2 : V) = 1 + 1 from one_add_one_eq_two.symm, exp_succ, exp_one]; norm_num
  have exp_three : Exp.exp (3 : V) = 8 := by
    rw [show (3 : V) = 2 + 1 from two_add_one_eq_three.symm, exp_succ, exp_two]; norm_num
  have exp_four : Exp.exp (4 : V) = 16 := by
    rw [show (4 : V) = 3 + 1 from three_add_one_eq_four.symm, exp_succ, exp_three]; norm_num
  have exp_eight : Exp.exp (8 : V) = 256 := by
    rw [show (8 : V) = 2 * 4 from by norm_num, exp_even, exp_four]; norm_num [sq]
  rw [superexp_eq, congrArg (iterExp 3) (two_add_one_eq_three (R := V)).symm, iterExp_succ,
    congrArg (iterExp 3) (one_add_one_eq_two (R := V)).symm, iterExp_succ,
    congrArg (iterExp 3) (zero_add 1).symm, iterExp_succ, iterExp_zero, exp_three, exp_eight]

name: nil_or_adjoin
statement: lemma nil_or_adjoin (z : V) : z = 0 ∨ ∃ x v, z = x ∷ v
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ z with (rfl | ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  · left; rfl
  · right; exact ⟨π₁ z, π₂ z, by simp [succ_eq_adjoin]⟩

name: adjoin_le_adjoin
statement:
lemma adjoin_le_adjoin {x₁ x₂ v₁ v₂ : V} (hx : x₁ ≤ x₂) (hv : v₁ ≤ v₂) :
    x₁ ∷ v₁ ≤ x₂ ∷ v₂
proof: := by simpa [adjoin_def] using pair_le_pair hx hv

name: phi_iff
statement:
private lemma phi_iff (C pr : V) :
    Phi {x | x ∈ C} pr ↔
    (∃ v ≤ pr, ∃ fst ≤ v, fst = fstIdx v ∧ pr = ⟪v, 0, fst⟫) ∨
    (∃ v ≤ pr, ∃ i ≤ pr, ∃ x ≤ pr, pr = ⟪v, i + 1, x⟫ ∧ ∃ snd ≤ v, snd = sndIdx v ∧ ∃ six < C, six = ⟪snd, i, x⟫ ∧ six ∈ C)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨v, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, i, x, rfl, hC⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨v, by simp, _, by simp, rfl, rfl⟩
    · right; exact ⟨v, by simp,
        i, le_trans (le_trans (by simp) (le_pair_left _ _)) (le_pair_right _ _),
        x, le_trans (by simp) (le_pair_right _ _), rfl, _, by simp, rfl, _, lt_of_mem hC, rfl, hC⟩
  · rintro (⟨v, _, _, _, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, _, i, _, x, _, rfl, _, _, rfl, _, _, rfl, hC⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
    · right; exact ⟨v, i, x, rfl, hC⟩

name: zero_ne_add_one
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_ne_add_one (x : V) : 0 ≠ x + 1

name: graph_case
statement:
lemma graph_case {pr : V} :
    Graph pr ↔
    (∃ v, pr = ⟪v, 0, fstIdx v⟫) ∨ (∃ v i x, pr = ⟪v, i + 1, x⟫ ∧ Graph ⟪sndIdx v, i, x⟫)

name: graph_zero
statement:
lemma graph_zero {v x : V} :
    Graph ⟪v, 0, x⟫ ↔ x = fstIdx v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases graph_case.mp h with (⟨w, h⟩ | ⟨w, i, x, h, _⟩)
    · rcases show v = w ∧ x = fstIdx w by simpa using h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩; rfl
    · simp at h
  · rintro rfl; exact graph_case.mpr <| Or.inl ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: graph_succ
statement:
lemma graph_succ {v i x : V} :
    Graph ⟪v, i + 1, x⟫ ↔ Graph ⟪sndIdx v, i, x⟫
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases graph_case.mp h with (⟨w, h⟩ | ⟨w, j, y, h, hw⟩)
    · simp at h
    · rcases show v = w ∧ i = j ∧ x = y by simpa using h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩; exact hw
  · intro h; exact graph_case.mpr <| Or.inr ⟨v, i, x, rfl, h⟩

name: graph_exists
statement: lemma graph_exists (v i : V) : ∃ x, Graph ⟪v, i, x⟫
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ i' ≤ i, ∀ v' ≤ v, ∃ x, Graph ⟪v', i', x⟫ from this i (by simp) v (by simp)
  intro i' hi'
  induction i' using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero =>
    intro v' _
    exact ⟨fstIdx v', graph_case.mpr <| Or.inl ⟨v', rfl⟩⟩
  case succ i' ih =>
    intro v' hv'
    rcases ih (le_trans le_self_add hi') (sndIdx v') (le_trans (by simp) hv') with ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, graph_case.mpr <| Or.inr ⟨v', i', x, rfl, hx⟩⟩

name: graph_unique
statement: lemma graph_unique {v i x₁ x₂ : V} : Graph ⟪v, i, x₁⟫ → Graph ⟪v, i, x₂⟫ → x₁ = x₂
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing v x₁ x₂
  · definability
  case zero =>
    simp only [graph_zero]
    rintro rfl rfl; rfl
  case succ i ih =>
    simp only [graph_succ]
    exact ih

name: graph_existsUnique
statement: lemma graph_existsUnique (v i : V) : ∃! x, Graph ⟪v, i, x⟫
proof:
:= by
  rcases graph_exists v i with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro x hx (fun y hy ↦ graph_unique hy hx)

statement: lemma nth_graph (v i : V) : Graph ⟪v, i, v.[i]⟫

name: nth_eq_of_graph
statement: lemma nth_eq_of_graph {v i x : V} (h : Graph ⟪v, i, x⟫) : nth v i = x

name: nth_zero
statement: lemma nth_zero (v : V) : v.[0] = fstIdx v

name: nth_succ
statement: lemma nth_succ (v i : V) : v.[i + 1] = (sndIdx v).[i]

name: nth_adjoin_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_adjoin_zero (x v : V) : (x ∷ v).[0] = x

name: nth_adjoin_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_adjoin_succ (x v i : V) : (x ∷ v).[i + 1] = v.[i]

name: nth_adjoin_one
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_adjoin_one (x v : V) : (x ∷ v).[1] = v.[0]
proof:
:= by
  simpa using nth_adjoin_succ x v 0

name: nth_adjoin_two
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_adjoin_two (x v : V) : (x ∷ v).[2] = v.[1]
proof:
:= by
  simpa [-nth_adjoin_succ, one_add_one_eq_two] using nth_adjoin_succ x v 1

name: adjoin_cases
statement: lemma adjoin_cases (x : V) : x = 0 ∨ ∃ y v, x = y ∷ v
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · right; exact ⟨π₁ z, π₂ z, by simp [adjoin]⟩

name: adjoin_induction
statement:
lemma adjoin_induction (Γ) {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
    (nil : P 0) (adjoin : ∀ x v, P v → P (x ∷ v)) : ∀ v, P v
proof:
:=
  ISigma1.order_induction Γ hP (by
    intro v ih
    rcases nil_or_adjoin v with (rfl | ⟨x, v, rfl⟩)
    · exact nil
    · exact adjoin _ _ (ih v (by simp)))

name: adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction {P : V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Predicate P)
    (nil : P 0) (adjoin : ∀ x v, P v → P (x ∷ v)) : ∀ v, P v

name: adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction {P : V → Prop} (hP : 𝚷₁-Predicate P)
    (nil : P 0) (adjoin : ∀ x v, P v → P (x ∷ v)) : ∀ v, P v

name: adjoin_absolute
statement: lemma adjoin_absolute (a v : ℕ) : ((a ∷ v : ℕ) : V) = (a : V) ∷ (v : V)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using DefinedFunction.shigmaZero_absolute_func V adjoin_defined adjoin_defined ![a, v]

name: pi
statement: lemma pi₁_zero : π₁ (0 : V) = 0

name: pi
statement: lemma pi₂_zero : π₂ (0 : V) = 0

name: nth_zero_idx
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_zero_idx (i : V) : (0).[i] = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp [nth_zero, fstIdx, pi₁_zero]
  case succ i ih => simp [nth_succ, sndIdx, pi₂_zero, ih]

name: nth_lt_of_pos
statement: lemma nth_lt_of_pos {v} (hv : 0 < v) (i : V) : v.[i] < v
proof:
:= by
  induction i using ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing v
  · definability
  case zero =>
    rcases zero_or_succ v with (rfl | ⟨v, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hv
    · simp [succ_eq_adjoin]
  case succ i ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ v with (rfl | ⟨v, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hv
    · simp only [succ_eq_adjoin v, nth_adjoin_succ]
      rcases eq_zero_or_pos (π₂ v) with (h | h)
      · simp [h]
      · exact lt_trans (ih h) (by simp)

name: nth_le
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_le (v i : V) : v.[i] ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos v with (h | h)
  · simp [h]
  · exact le_of_lt <| nth_lt_of_pos h i

name: phi_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨x, xs, ih, rfl, hC⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right
      exact ⟨x, lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) (le_pair_left _ _),
        xs, lt_of_lt_of_le (by simp) (le_pair_left _ _), ih, lt_of_mem_rng hC, rfl , hC⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨x, _, xs, _, ih, _, rfl, hC⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨x, xs, ih, rfl, hC⟩

name: graph_defined
statement: lemma graph_defined : 𝚺₁.Defined (fun v ↦ c.Graph (v ·.succ) (v 0)) β.graphDef

name: graph_case
statement:
lemma graph_case {pr : V} :
    c.Graph param pr ↔ pr = ⟪0, c.nil param⟫ ∨ (∃ x xs ih, pr = ⟪x ∷ xs, c.adjoin param x xs ih⟫ ∧ c.Graph param ⟪xs, ih⟫)

name: graph_nil
statement:
lemma graph_nil {l : V} :
    c.Graph param ⟪0, l⟫ ↔ l = c.nil param
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases c.graph_case.mp h with (h | ⟨x, xs, ih, h, _⟩)
    · rcases show l = c.nil param by simpa using h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl
    · simp at h
  · rintro rfl; exact c.graph_case.mpr <| Or.inl rfl

name: graph_adjoin
statement:
lemma graph_adjoin {x xs y : V} :
    c.Graph param ⟪x ∷ xs, y⟫ ↔ ∃ y', y = c.adjoin param x xs y' ∧ c.Graph param ⟪xs, y'⟫
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases c.graph_case.mp h with (h | ⟨z, zs, v, h, hg⟩)
    · simp at h
    · rcases show (x = z ∧ xs = zs) ∧ y = c.adjoin param z zs v by simpa using h with ⟨⟨rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v, rfl, hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl, h⟩; exact c.graph_case.mpr <| Or.inr ⟨x, xs, y, rfl, h⟩

name: graph_exists
statement: lemma graph_exists (xs : V) : ∃ y, c.Graph param ⟪xs, y⟫
proof:
:= by
  induction xs using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil =>
    exact ⟨c.nil param, c.graph_nil.mpr rfl⟩
  case adjoin x xs ih =>
    · rcases ih with ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨c.adjoin param x xs y, c.graph_adjoin.mpr ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩⟩

name: graph_unique
statement: lemma graph_unique {xs y₁ y₂ : V} : c.Graph param ⟪xs, y₁⟫ → c.Graph param ⟪xs, y₂⟫ → y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  induction xs using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing y₁ y₂
  · definability
  case nil =>
    simp only [graph_nil]; rintro rfl rfl; rfl
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    simp only [graph_adjoin, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    rintro l₁ rfl h₁ l₂ rfl h₂
    rcases ih h₁ h₂; rfl

name: graph_existsUnique
statement: lemma graph_existsUnique (xs : V) : ∃! y, c.Graph param ⟪xs, y⟫
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.graph_exists param xs with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro y hy (fun y' hy' ↦ c.graph_unique hy' hy)

name: result_graph
statement: lemma result_graph (xs : V) : c.Graph param ⟪xs, c.result param xs⟫

name: result_eq_of_graph
statement: lemma result_eq_of_graph {xs y : V} (h : c.Graph param ⟪xs, y⟫) : c.result param xs = y

name: result_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma result_nil : c.result param (0 : V) = c.nil param

name: result_adjoin
statement:
@[simp] lemma result_adjoin (x xs : V) :
    c.result param (x ∷ xs) = c.adjoin param x xs (c.result param xs)
proof:
:=
  c.result_eq_of_graph param (c.graph_adjoin.mpr ⟨_, rfl, c.result_graph param xs⟩)

name: result_defined
statement: lemma result_defined : 𝚺₁.DefinedFunction (fun v ↦ c.result (v ·.succ) (v 0)) β.resultDef
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.resultDef, c.graph_defined.iff]
  constructor
  · intro h; symm; simpa using c.result_eq_of_graph _ h
  · intro h; rw [h]; exact c.result_graph _ _

name: eval_resultDef
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_resultDef (v : Fin (arity + 2) → V) :
    β.resultDef.val.Evalb v ↔ v 0 = c.result (v ·.succ.succ) (v 1)

name: len_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma len_nil : len (0 : V) = 0

name: len_adjoin
statement: @[simp] lemma len_adjoin (x v : V) : len (x ∷ v) = len v + 1

name: len_zero_iff_eq_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma len_zero_iff_eq_nil {v : V} : len v = 0 ↔ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases nil_or_adjoin v with (rfl | ⟨x, v, rfl⟩) <;> simp

name: nth_lt_len
statement: lemma nth_lt_len {v i : V} (hl : len v ≤ i) : v.[i] = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hl
    simpa using ih (by simpa using hl)

name: len_le
statement: @[simp] lemma len_le (v : V) : len v ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    simp only [len_adjoin]
    simp only [adjoin, add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact le_trans ih (le_pair_right x v)

name: nth_ext
statement: lemma nth_ext {v₁ v₂ : V} (hl : len v₁ = len v₂) (H : ∀ i < len v₁, v₁.[i] = v₂.[i]) : v₁ = v₂
proof:
:= by
  induction v₁ using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing v₂
  · definability
  case nil =>
    exact Eq.symm <| len_zero_iff_eq_nil.mp (by simp [←hl])
  case adjoin x₁ v₁ ih =>
    rcases nil_or_adjoin v₂ with (rfl | ⟨x₂, v₂, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hl
    have hx : x₁ = x₂ := by simpa using H 0 (by simp)
    have hv : v₁ = v₂ := ih (by simpa using hl) (by intro i hi; simpa using H (i + 1) (by simpa using hi))
    simp [hx, hv]

name: nth_ext'
statement: lemma nth_ext' (l : V) {v₁ v₂ : V} (hl₁ : len v₁ = l) (hl₂ : len v₂ = l) (H : ∀ i < l, v₁.[i] = v₂.[i]) : v₁ = v₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases hl₂; exact nth_ext hl₁ (by simpa [hl₁] using H)

name: le_of_nth_le_nth
statement: lemma le_of_nth_le_nth {v₁ v₂ : V} (hl : len v₁ = len v₂) (H : ∀ i < len v₁, v₁.[i] ≤ v₂.[i]) : v₁ ≤ v₂
proof:
:= by
  induction v₁ using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing v₂
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x₁ v₁ ih =>
    rcases nil_or_adjoin v₂ with (rfl | ⟨x₂, v₂, rfl⟩)
    · simp at hl
    have hx : x₁ ≤ x₂ := by simpa using H 0 (by simp)
    have hv : v₁ ≤ v₂ := ih (by simpa using hl) (by intro i hi; simpa using H (i + 1) (by simpa using hi))
    exact adjoin_le_adjoin hx hv

name: nth_lt_self
statement: lemma nth_lt_self {v i : V} (hi : i < len v) : v.[i] < v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case nil => simp at hi
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simpa using lt_trans (ih (by simpa using hi)) (by simp)

name: sigmaOne_skolem_vec
statement:
theorem sigmaOne_skolem_vec {R : V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation R) {l}
    (H : ∀ x < l, ∃ y, R x y) : ∃ v, len v = l ∧ ∀ i < l, R i v.[i]
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ k ≤ l, ∃ v, len v = k ∧ ∀ i < k, R (l - k + i) v.[i] := by
    intro k hk
    induction k using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
    · definability
    case zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    case succ k ih =>
      rcases ih (le_trans (by simp) hk) with ⟨v, hvk, hv⟩
      have : ∃ y, R (l - (k + 1)) y := H (l - (k + 1)) (by simp [tsub_lt_iff_left hk])
      rcases this with ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨y ∷ v, by simp [hvk], fun i hi ↦ by
        rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
        · simpa using hy
        · simpa [sub_succ_add_succ (succ_le_iff_lt.mp hk) i] using hv i (by simpa using hi)⟩
  simpa using this l (by rfl)

name: eq_singleton_iff_len_eq_one
statement: lemma eq_singleton_iff_len_eq_one {v : V} : len v = 1 ↔ ∃ x, v = ?[x]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨v.[0], nth_ext (by simp [h]) (by simp [h])⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; simp

name: eq_doubleton_of_len_eq_two
statement: lemma eq_doubleton_of_len_eq_two {v : V} : len v = 2 ↔ ∃ x y, v = ?[x, y]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨v.[0], v.[1],
      nth_ext (by simp [h, one_add_one_eq_two]) (by simp [lt_two_iff_le_one, le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one, h])⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, rfl⟩; simp [one_add_one_eq_two]

name: listMax_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma listMax_nil : listMax (0 : V) = 0

name: listMax_adjoin
statement: @[simp] lemma listMax_adjoin (x v : V) : listMax (x ∷ v) = max x (listMax v)

name: nth_le_listMax
statement: lemma nth_le_listMax {i v : V} (h : i < len v) : v.[i] ≤ listMax v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simp [ih (by simpa using h)]

name: listMaxss_le
statement: lemma listMaxss_le {v z : V} (h : ∀ i < len v, v.[i] ≤ z) : listMax v ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.pi1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    simp only [listMax_adjoin, max_le_iff]
    constructor
    · simpa using h 0 (by simp)
    · exact ih (fun i hi ↦ by simpa using h (i + 1) (by simp [hi]))

name: listMaxss_le_iff
statement: lemma listMaxss_le_iff {v z : V} : listMax v ≤ z ↔ ∀ i < len v, v.[i] ≤ z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i hi; exact le_trans (nth_le_listMax hi) h
  · exact listMaxss_le

name: nth_le_listMaxs
statement: lemma nth_le_listMaxs (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) : ∃ i < len v, v.[i] = listMax v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp at hv
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    simp

name: takeLast_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma takeLast_nil : takeLast (0 : V) k = 0

name: takeLast_adjoin
statement:
lemma takeLast_adjoin (x v : V) :
    takeLast (x ∷ v) k = if len v < k then x ∷ v else takeLast v k

name: len_takeLast
statement: lemma len_takeLast {v k : V} (h : k ≤ len v) : len (takeLast v k) = k
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp_all
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    have : k = len v + 1 ∨ k ≤ len v := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h with (h | h)
      · left; simpa using h
      · right; simpa [lt_succ_iff_le] using h
    rcases this with (rfl | hkv)
    · simp [takeLast_adjoin]
    · simp [takeLast_adjoin, not_lt_of_ge hkv, ih hkv]

name: takeLast_len_self
statement: @[simp] lemma takeLast_len_self (v : V) : takeLast v (len v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases nil_or_adjoin v with (rfl | ⟨x, v, rfl⟩) <;> simp [takeLast_adjoin]

name: add_sub_add
statement: @[simp] lemma add_sub_add (a b c : V) : (a + c) - (b + c) = a - b

name: takeLast_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma takeLast_zero (v : V) : takeLast v 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih => simp [takeLast_adjoin, ih]

name: takeLast_succ_of_lt
statement: lemma takeLast_succ_of_lt {i v : V} (h : i < len v) : takeLast v (i + 1) = v.[len v - (i + 1)] ∷ takeLast v i
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case nil => simp at h
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    rcases show i = len v ∨ i < len v from eq_or_lt_of_le (by simpa [lt_succ_iff_le] using h) with (rfl | hi)
    · simp [takeLast_adjoin]
    · have : len v - i = len v - (i + 1) + 1 := by
        rw [←Arithmetic.sub_sub, sub_add_self_of_le (pos_iff_one_le.mp (tsub_pos_of_lt hi))]
      simpa [takeLast_adjoin, lt_succ_iff_le, not_le_of_gt hi, this, not_lt_of_gt hi] using ih hi

name: concat_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma concat_nil (z : V) : concat 0 z = ?[z]

name: concat_adjoin
statement: @[simp] lemma concat_adjoin (x v z : V) : concat (x ∷ v) z = x ∷ concat v z

name: len_concat
statement: @[simp] lemma len_concat (v z : V) : len (concat v z) = len v + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih => simp [ih]

name: concat_nth_lt
statement: lemma concat_nth_lt (v z : V) {i} (hi : i < len v) : (concat v z).[i] = v.[i]
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case nil => simp at hi
  case adjoin x v ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simp [ih (by simpa using hi)]

name: concat_nth_len
statement: @[simp] lemma concat_nth_len (v z : V) : (concat v z).[len v] = z
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin x v ih => simp [ih]

name: concat_nth_len'
statement: lemma concat_nth_len' (v z : V) {i} (hi : len v = i) : (concat v z).[i] = z

name: not_memVec_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma not_memVec_empty (x : V) : ¬x ∈ᵥ 0
proof: := by rintro ⟨i, h, _⟩; simp at h

name: nth_mem_memVec
statement: lemma nth_mem_memVec {i v : V} (h : i < len v) : v.[i] ∈ᵥ v

name: memVec_insert_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma memVec_insert_fst {x v : V} : x ∈ᵥ x ∷ v

name: memVec_adjoin_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma memVec_adjoin_iff {x y v : V} : x ∈ᵥ y ∷ v ↔ x = y ∨ x ∈ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h, rfl⟩
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · right; simpa using nth_mem_memVec (by simpa using h)
  · rintro (rfl | hx)
    · simp
    · rcases hx with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i + 1, by simp [hi]⟩

name: le_of_memVec
statement: lemma le_of_memVec {x v : V} (h : x ∈ᵥ v) : x ≤ v
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨i, _, rfl⟩; simp

name: SubsetVec.refl
statement: @[simp, refl] lemma SubsetVec.refl (v : V) : v ⊆ᵥ v

name: subsetVec_insert_tail
statement: @[simp] lemma subsetVec_insert_tail (x v : V) : v ⊆ᵥ x ∷ v

name: repeatVec_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma repeatVec_zero (x : V) : repeatVec x 0 = 0

name: repeatVec_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma repeatVec_succ (x k : V) : repeatVec x (k + 1) = x ∷ repeatVec x k

name: len_repeatVec
statement: @[simp] lemma len_repeatVec (x k : V) : len (repeatVec x k) = k
proof:
:= by
  induction k using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ih => simp [ih]

name: le_repaetVec
statement: @[simp] lemma le_repaetVec (x k : V) : k ≤ repeatVec x k
proof:
:= by
  simpa using len_le (repeatVec x k)

name: nth_repeatVec
statement: lemma nth_repeatVec (x k : V) {i} (h : i < k) : (repeatVec x k).[i] = x
proof:
:= by
  induction k using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction generalizing i
  · definability
  case zero => simp at h
  case succ k ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simpa using ih (by simpa using h)

name: len_repeatVec_of_nth_le
statement: lemma len_repeatVec_of_nth_le {v m : V} (H : ∀ i < len v, v.[i] ≤ m) : v ≤ repeatVec m (len v)
proof:
:=
  le_of_nth_le_nth (by simp) (fun i hi ↦ by simp [nth_repeatVec m (len v) hi, H i hi])

name: vecToSet_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma vecToSet_nil : vecToSet (0 : V) = ∅

name: vecToSet_adjoin
statement:
@[simp] lemma vecToSet_adjoin (x v : V) :
    vecToSet (x ∷ v) = insert x (vecToSet v)

name: mem_vecToSet_iff
statement: lemma mem_vecToSet_iff {v x : V} : x ∈ vecToSet v ↔ ∃ i < len v, x = v.[i]
proof:
:= by
  induction v using adjoin_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case nil => simp
  case adjoin y v ih =>
    simp only [vecToSet_adjoin, mem_bitInsert_iff, ih, len_adjoin]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
      · exact ⟨i + 1, by simp [hi]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · simp
      · right; exact ⟨i, by simpa using hi, by simp⟩

name: nth_mem_vecToSet
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_mem_vecToSet {v i : V} (h : i < len v) : v.[i] ∈ vecToSet v

name: cseq_iff
statement:
private lemma cseq_iff (s : V) : c.CSeq v s ↔
    Seq s
    ∧ (∃ z < s, z = c.zero v ∧ ⟪0, z⟫ ∈ s)
    ∧ (∀ i < 2 * s,
      (∃ l ≤ 2 * s, l = lh s ∧ i + 1 < l) → ∀ z < s, ⟪i, z⟫ ∈ s → ∃ u < s, u = c.succ v i z ∧ ⟪i + 1, u⟫ ∈ s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨Hs, hz, hs⟩
      exact ⟨Hs, ⟨c.zero v, lt_of_mem_rng hz, rfl, hz⟩, fun i _ hi z _ hiz ↦
      ⟨c.succ v i z, by
        have := hs i (by rcases hi with ⟨l, _, rfl, hl⟩; simp [lt_tsub_iff_right, hl]) z hiz
        exact ⟨lt_of_mem_rng this, rfl, this⟩⟩⟩,
   by rintro ⟨Hs, ⟨z, _, rfl, hz⟩, h⟩
      exact ⟨Hs, hz, fun i hi z hiz ↦ by
        rcases h i
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hi (by simpa using le_trans (lh_bound _) (by simp)))
          ⟨lh s, by simp, rfl, by simpa [lt_tsub_iff_right] using hi⟩ z (lt_of_mem_rng hiz) hiz with ⟨_, _, rfl, h⟩
        exact h⟩⟩

name: cseq_defined
statement: lemma cseq_defined : 𝚺₁.Defined (fun v ↦ c.CSeq (v ·.succ) (v 0) : (Fin (k + 1) → V) → Prop) p.cseqDef
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.cseqDef, cseq_iff, c.zero_defined.iff, c.succ_defined.iff]

name: cseq_defined_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma cseq_defined_iff (v : Fin (k + 1) → V) :
    p.cseqDef.val.Evalb v ↔ c.CSeq (v ·.succ) (v 0)

name: seq
statement: lemma seq (h : c.CSeq v s) : Seq s

name: zero
statement: lemma zero (h : c.CSeq v s) : ⟪0, c.zero v⟫ ∈ s

name: succ
statement: lemma succ (h : c.CSeq v s) : ∀ i < lh s - 1, ∀ z, ⟪i, z⟫ ∈ s → ⟪i + 1, c.succ v i z⟫ ∈ s

name: unique
statement:
lemma unique {s₁ s₂ : V} (H₁ : c.CSeq v s₁) (H₂ : c.CSeq v s₂) (h₁₂ : lh s₁ ≤ lh s₂) {i} (hi : i < lh s₁) {z₁ z₂} :
    ⟪i, z₁⟫ ∈ s₁ → ⟪i, z₂⟫ ∈ s₂ → z₁ = z₂
proof:
:= by
  revert z₁ z₂
  suffices ∀ z₁ < s₁, ∀ z₂ < s₂, ⟪i, z₁⟫ ∈ s₁ → ⟪i, z₂⟫ ∈ s₂ → z₁ = z₂
  by intro z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂; exact this z₁ (lt_of_mem_rng hz₁) z₂ (lt_of_mem_rng hz₂) hz₁ hz₂
  intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ h₁ h₂
  induction i using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction generalizing z₁ z₂
  · definability
  case zero =>
    have : z₁ = c.zero v := H₁.seq.isMapping.uniq h₁ H₁.zero
    have : z₂ = c.zero v := H₂.seq.isMapping.uniq h₂ H₂.zero
    simp_all
  case succ i ih =>
    have hi' : i < lh s₁ := lt_of_le_of_lt (by simp) hi
    let z' := H₁.seq.nth hi'
    have ih₁ : ⟪i, z'⟫ ∈ s₁ := H₁.seq.nth_mem hi'
    have ih₂ : ⟪i, z'⟫ ∈ s₂ := by
      have : z' = H₂.seq.nth (lt_of_lt_of_le hi' h₁₂) :=
        ih hi' z' (by simp [z']) (H₂.seq.nth (lt_of_lt_of_le hi' h₁₂)) (by simp) (by simp [z']) (by simp)
      simp [this]
    have h₁' : ⟪i + 1, c.succ v i z'⟫ ∈ s₁ := H₁.succ i (by simp [lt_tsub_iff_right, hi]) z' ih₁
    have h₂' : ⟪i + 1, c.succ v i z'⟫ ∈ s₂ :=
      H₂.succ i (by simpa [lt_tsub_iff_right] using lt_of_lt_of_le hi h₁₂) z' ih₂
    have e₁ : z₁ = c.succ v i z' := H₁.seq.isMapping.uniq h₁ h₁'
    have e₂ : z₂ = c.succ v i z' := H₂.seq.isMapping.uniq h₂ h₂'
    simp [e₁, e₂]

name: initial
statement: lemma initial : c.CSeq v !⟦c.zero v⟧

name: successor
statement:
lemma successor {s l z : V} (Hs : c.CSeq v s) (hl : l + 1 = lh s) (hz : ⟪l, z⟫ ∈ s) :
    c.CSeq v (s ⁀' c.succ v l z)
proof:
:=
  ⟨ Hs.seq.seqCons _, by simp [seqCons, Hs.zero], by
    simp only [Hs.seq.lh_seqCons, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    intro i hi w hiw
    have hiws : ⟪i, w⟫ ∈ s := by
      rcases show i = lh s ∧ w = c.succ v l z ∨ ⟪i, w⟫ ∈ s by
        simpa [mem_seqCons_iff] using hiw with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | h)
      · simp at hi
      · assumption
    have : i ≤ l := by simpa [←hl, lt_succ_iff_le] using hi
    rcases this with (rfl | hil)
    · have : w = z := Hs.seq.isMapping.uniq hiws hz
      simp [this, hl]
    · simp only [mem_seqCons_iff]; right
      exact Hs.succ i (by simp [←hl, hil]) w hiws ⟩

name: CSeq.exists
statement: lemma CSeq.exists (l : V) : ∃ s, c.CSeq v s ∧ l + 1 = lh s
proof:
:= by
  induction l using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.exs
    apply HierarchySymbol.Definable.and
    · exact ⟨p.cseqDef.rew (Rew.embSubsts <| #0 :> fun i ↦ &(v i)), by
         intro w; simpa [Matrix.comp_vecCons''] using! c.cseq_defined_iff (w 0 :> v)⟩
    · definability
  case zero =>
    exact ⟨!⟦c.zero v⟧, CSeq.initial, by simp⟩
  case succ l ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨s, Hs, hls⟩
    have hl : l < lh s := by simp [←hls]
    have : ∃ z, ⟪l, z⟫ ∈ s := Hs.seq.exists hl
    rcases this with ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨s ⁀' c.succ v l z, Hs.successor hls hz, by simp [Hs.seq, hls]⟩

name: cSeq_result_existsUnique
statement: lemma cSeq_result_existsUnique (l : V) : ∃! z, ∃ s, c.CSeq v s ∧ l + 1 = lh s ∧ ⟪l, z⟫ ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases CSeq.exists c v l with ⟨s, Hs, h⟩
  have : ∃ z, ⟪l, z⟫ ∈ s := Hs.seq.exists (show l < lh s from by simp [←h])
  rcases this with ⟨z, hz⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro z ⟨s, Hs, h, hz⟩ (by
    rintro z' ⟨s', Hs', h', hz'⟩
    exact Eq.symm <| Hs.unique Hs' (by simp [←h, ←h']) (show l < lh s from by simp [←h]) hz hz')

name: result_spec
statement: lemma result_spec (u : V) : ∃ s, c.CSeq v s ∧ u + 1 = lh s ∧ ⟪u, c.result v u⟫ ∈ s

name: result_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem result_zero : c.result v 0 = c.zero v
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.result_spec v 0 with ⟨s, Hs, _, h0⟩
  exact Hs.seq.isMapping.uniq h0 Hs.zero

name: result_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem result_succ (u : V) : c.result v (u + 1) = c.succ v u (c.result v u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.result_spec v u with ⟨s, Hs, hk, h⟩
  have : CSeq c v (s ⁀' c.succ v u (result c v u) ) := Hs.successor hk h
  exact Eq.symm
    <| Classical.choose_uniq (c.cSeq_result_existsUnique v (u + 1))
    ⟨_, this, by simp [Hs.seq, hk], by simp [hk]⟩

name: result_graph
statement: lemma result_graph (z u : V) : z = c.result v u ↔ ∃ s, c.CSeq v s ∧ ⟪u, z⟫ ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl
      rcases c.result_spec v u with ⟨s, Hs, _, h⟩
      exact ⟨s, Hs, h⟩,
   by rintro ⟨s, Hs, h⟩
      rcases c.result_spec v u with ⟨s', Hs', hu, h'⟩
      exact Eq.symm <| Hs'.unique Hs
        (by simpa [←hu, succ_le_iff_lt] using Hs.seq.lt_lh_iff.mpr (mem_domain_of_pair_mem h))
        (by simp [←hu]) h' h⟩

name: result_defined
statement: lemma result_defined : 𝚺₁.DefinedFunction (fun v ↦ c.result (v ·.succ) (v 0) : (Fin (k + 1) → V) → V) p.resultDef
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.resultDef, result_graph, c.cseq_defined_iff]

name: result_defined_delta
statement: lemma result_defined_delta : 𝚫₁.DefinedFunction (fun v ↦ c.result (v ·.succ) (v 0) : (Fin (k + 1) → V) → V) p.resultDeltaDef

name: result_defined_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma result_defined_iff (v : Fin (k + 2) → V) :
    p.resultDef.val.Evalb v ↔ v 0 = c.result (v ·.succ.succ) (v 1)

name: succ_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma succ_induction {P : V → Prop}
    (hP : ∃ φ : ArithmeticSemiformula V 1, φ.Open ∧ ∀ x, P x ↔ φ.Eval ![x] id)
    (zero : P 0) (succ : ∀ x, P x → P (x + 1)) : ∀ x, P x
proof:
:=
  InductionScheme.succ_induction (C := Semiformula.Open) (by
    rcases hP with ⟨φ, hp, hhp⟩
    have : Inhabited V := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty'
    refine ⟨φ.enumerateFVar, Rew.rewriteMap φ.idxOfFVar ▹ φ, by simp [hp], ?_⟩
    intro x
    simp only [hhp, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Semiformula.eval_rewriteMap]
    exact Semiformula.eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ (by
      intro z hz
      simp [Semiformula.enumerateFVar_idxOfFVar (Semiformula.mem_fvarList_iff_fvar?.mpr hz)]))
    zero succ

name: least_number
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  have : ∀ x, P x := by
    intro x; induction x using succ_induction
    · exact hP
    case zero => exact zero
    case succ n ih =>
      have : ∀ (x : V), P x → P (x + 1) := by simpa using A
      exact this n ih
  have : P a := this a
  contradiction

name: div_exists_unique_pos
statement: lemma div_exists_unique_pos (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : ∃! u, b * u ≤ a ∧ a < b * (u + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ u, b * u ≤ a ∧ a < b * (u + 1) := by
    have : a < b * (a + 1) → ∃ u, b * u ≤ a ∧ a < b * (u + 1) := by
      simpa using least_number (P := fun u ↦ b * u ≤ a) ⟨“x. &b * x ≤ &a”, by simp, by intro x; simp⟩
    have hx : a < b * (a + 1) := by
      have : a + 0 < b * a + b :=
        add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (le_mul_self_of_pos_left pos) pos
      simpa [mul_add] using this
    exact this hx
  rcases this with ⟨u, hu⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro u hu (by
    intro u' hu'
    by_contra ne
    wlog lt : u < u'
    · exact this a pos u' hu' u hu (Ne.symm ne) (Ne.lt_of_le ne $ by simpa using lt)
    have : a < a := by calc
      a < b * (u + 1) := hu.2
      _ ≤ b * u'      := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ pos).mpr (lt_iff_succ_le.mp lt)
      _ ≤ a           := hu'.1
    exact LT.lt.false this)

name: div_exists_unique
statement: lemma div_exists_unique (a b : V) : ∃! u, (0 < b → b * u ≤ a ∧ a < b * (u + 1)) ∧ (b = 0 → u = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 ≤ b := by exact Arithmetic.zero_le b
  rcases this with (rfl | pos) <;> simp [*]
  · simpa [pos_iff_ne_zero.mp pos] using div_exists_unique_pos a pos

name: mul_div_le_pos
statement: lemma mul_div_le_pos (a : V) (h : 0 < b) : b * (a / b) ≤ a

name: lt_mul_div_succ
statement: lemma lt_mul_div_succ (a : V) (h : 0 < b) : a < b * (a / b + 1)

name: eq_mul_div_add_of_pos
statement: lemma eq_mul_div_add_of_pos (a : V) {b} (hb : 0 < b) : ∃ r < b, a = b * (a / b) + r
proof:
:= by
  let r := a - b * (a / b)
  have e : a = b * (a / b) + r := by simp [r, add_tsub_self_of_le (mul_div_le_pos a hb)]
  exact ⟨r, by
    by_contra A
    have hyv : b ≤ r := by simpa using A
    have : a < a := by calc
          a < b * (a / b + 1) := lt_mul_div_succ a hb
          _ ≤ b * (a / b) + r := by simpa [mul_add] using hyv
          _ = a               := e.symm
    simp at this, e⟩

name: div_spec_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma div_spec_zero (a : V) : a / 0 = 0

name: div_graph
statement: lemma div_graph {a b c : V} : c = a / b ↔ ((0 < b → b * c ≤ a ∧ a < b * (c + 1)) ∧ (b = 0 → c = 0))

name: div_spec_of_pos'
statement: lemma div_spec_of_pos' (a : V) (h : 0 < b) : ∃ v < b, a = (a / b) * b + v
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_comm] using eq_mul_div_add_of_pos a h

name: div_eq_of
statement: lemma div_eq_of {b : V} (hb : b * c ≤ a) (ha : a < b * (c + 1)) : a / b = c
proof:
:= by
  have pos : 0 < b := pos_of_mul_pos_left (pos_of_gt ha) (by simp)
  exact (div_exists_unique_pos a pos).unique ⟨mul_div_le_pos a pos, lt_mul_div_succ a pos⟩ ⟨hb, ha⟩

name: div_mul_add
statement: lemma div_mul_add (a b : V) {r} (hr : r < b) : (a * b + r) / b = a
proof:
:=
  div_eq_of (by simp [mul_comm]) (by simp [mul_comm b a, mul_add, hr])

name: div_mul_add'
statement: lemma div_mul_add' (a b : V) {r} (hr : r < b) : (b * a + r) / b = a
proof: := by simpa [mul_comm] using div_mul_add a b hr

name: zero_div
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_div (a : V) : 0 / a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · exact div_eq_of (by simp) (by simpa)

name: div_mul
statement: lemma div_mul (a b c : V) : a / (b * c) = a / b / c
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | hb)
  · simp
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le c with (rfl | hc)
  · simp
  exact div_eq_of
    (by calc
          b * c * (a / b / c) ≤ b * (a / b) := by simpa [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_left (mul_div_le_pos (a / b) hc)
          _                   ≤ a := mul_div_le_pos a hb)
    (by calc
          a < b * (a / b + 1)         := lt_mul_div_succ a hb
          _ ≤ b * c * (a / b / c + 1) := by simpa [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_left (lt_iff_succ_le.mp <| lt_mul_div_succ (a / b) hc))

name: mul_div_le
statement: @[simp] lemma mul_div_le (a b : V) : b * (a / b) ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 ≤ b := by exact Arithmetic.zero_le b
  rcases this with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · rcases eq_mul_div_add_of_pos a pos with ⟨v, _, e⟩
    simpa [← e] using show b * (a / b) ≤ b * (a / b) + v from le_self_add

name: div_le
statement: @[simp] lemma div_le (a b : V) : a / b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 ≤ b := Arithmetic.zero_le b
  rcases this with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · have : 1 * (a / b) ≤ b * (a / b) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by simp [pos])) (by simp)
    simpa using le_trans this (mul_div_le a b)

name: div_mul_le
statement: @[simp] lemma div_mul_le (a b : V) : a / b * b ≤ a

name: lt_mul_div
statement: lemma lt_mul_div (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : a < b * (a / b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_mul_div_add_of_pos a pos with ⟨v, hv, e⟩
  calc a = b * (a / b) + v := e
       _ < b * (a / b + 1) := by simp [mul_add, hv]

name: div_one
statement: @[simp] lemma div_one (a : V) : a / 1 = a
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by simp) (le_iff_lt_succ.mpr $ by simpa using lt_mul_div a one_pos)

name: div_add_mul_self
statement: lemma div_add_mul_self (a c : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (a + c * b) / b = a / b + c
proof:
:= by
  rcases div_spec_of_pos' a pos with ⟨r, hr, ex⟩
  simpa [add_mul, add_right_comm, ← ex] using div_mul_add (a / b + c) _ hr

name: div_add_mul_self'
statement: lemma div_add_mul_self' (a c : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (a + b * c) / b = a / b + c
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_comm] using div_add_mul_self a c pos

name: div_mul_add_self
statement: lemma div_mul_add_self (a c : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (a * b + c) / b = a + c / b

name: div_mul_add_self'
statement: lemma div_mul_add_self' (a c : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (b * a + c) / b = a + c / b
proof:
:= by
  simp [mul_comm b a, div_mul_add_self, pos]

name: div_mul_left
statement: @[simp] lemma div_mul_left (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (a * b) / b = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using div_mul_add a _ pos

name: div_mul_right
statement: @[simp] lemma div_mul_right (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (b * a) / b = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa [mul_comm] using div_mul_add a _ pos

name: div_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma div_eq_zero_of_lt (b : V) {a} (h : a < b) : a / b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using div_mul_add 0 b h

name: div_sq
statement: @[simp] lemma div_sq (a : V) : a^2 / a = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · simp [sq, pos]

name: div_self
statement: @[simp] lemma div_self {a : V} (hx : 0 < a) : a / a = 1

name: div_mul'
statement: @[simp] lemma div_mul' (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (b * a) / b = a

name: div_add_self_left
statement: @[simp] lemma div_add_self_left {a} (pos : 0 < a) (b : V) : (a + b) / a = 1 + b / a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using div_mul_add_self 1 b pos

name: div_add_self_right
statement: @[simp] lemma div_add_self_right (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : (a + b) / b = a / b + 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using div_add_mul_self a 1 pos

name: mul_div_self_of_dvd
statement: lemma mul_div_self_of_dvd {a b : V} : a * (b / a) = b ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | pos)
  · simp [eq_comm]
  · constructor
    · intro e; rw [←e]; simp
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩; simp [pos]

name: div_lt_of_pos_of_one_lt
statement: lemma div_lt_of_pos_of_one_lt {a b : V} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) : a / b < a
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le (a / b) with (e | lt)
  · simp [←e, ha]
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_mul_of_one_lt_left lt hb) (mul_div_le a b)

name: le_two_mul_div_two_add_one
statement: lemma le_two_mul_div_two_add_one (a : V) : a ≤ 2 * (a / 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : a < 2 * (a / 2 + 1) := lt_mul_div_succ a (show 0 < 2 from by simp)
  exact le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by simpa [add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two, mul_add] using this)

name: div_monotone
statement: lemma div_monotone {a b : V} (h : a ≤ b) (c : V) : a / c ≤ b / c
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le c with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  by_contra A
  have : b / c + 1 ≤ a / c := succ_le_iff_lt.mpr (by simpa using A)
  have : a < a := calc
    a ≤ b               := h
    _ < c * (b / c + 1) := lt_mul_div b pos
    _ ≤ c * (a / c)     := mul_le_mul_left this
    _ ≤ a               := mul_div_le a c
  simp_all

name: div_lt_of_lt_mul
statement: lemma div_lt_of_lt_mul {a b c : V} (h : a < b * c) : a / c < b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hb
  have : a < a := calc
    a < b * c     := h
    _ ≤ a / c * c := mul_le_mul_right (by simpa using hb)
    _ ≤ a         := by simp
  simp_all

name: div_cancel_left
statement: lemma div_cancel_left {c} (pos : 0 < c) (a b : V) : (c * a) / (c * b) = a / b

name: div_cancel_right
statement: lemma div_cancel_right {c} (pos : 0 < c) (a b : V) : (a * c) / (b * c) = a / b

name: two_mul_add_one_div_two
statement: @[simp] lemma two_mul_add_one_div_two (a : V) : (2 * a + 1) / 2 = a

name: mod_def
statement: lemma mod_def (a b : V) : a % b = a - b * (a / b)

name: rem_graph
statement: lemma rem_graph (a b c : V) : a = b % c ↔ ∃ x ≤ b, (x = b / c ∧ a = b - c * x)

name: div_add_mod
statement: lemma div_add_mod (a b : V) : b * (a / b) + (a % b) = a

name: mod_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_zero (a : V) : a % 0 = a

name: zero_mod
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_mod (a : V) : 0 % a = 0

name: mod_self
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_self (a : V) : a % a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le a with (rfl | h)
  · simp
  · simp [mod_def, h]

name: mod_mul_add_of_lt
statement: lemma mod_mul_add_of_lt (a b : V) {r} (hr : r < b) : (a * b + r) % b = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [mod_def, div_mul_add a b hr, mul_comm]

name: mod_mul_add
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_mul_add (a c : V) (pos : 0 < b) : (a * b + c) % b = c % b
proof:
:= by
  simp [mod_def, div_mul_add_self, pos, mul_add, ←Arithmetic.sub_sub, show b * a = a * b from mul_comm _ _]

name: mod_add_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_add_mul (a b : V) (pos : 0 < c) : (a + b * c) % c = a % c

name: mod_add_mul'
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_add_mul' (a b : V) (pos : 0 < c) : (a + c * b) % c = a % c

name: mod_mul_add'
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_mul_add' (a c : V) (pos : 0 < b) : (b * a + c) % b = c % b

name: mod_mul_self_left
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_mul_self_left (a b : V) : (a * b) % b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | h)
  · simp
  · simpa using mod_mul_add_of_lt a b h

name: mod_mul_self_right
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_mul_self_right (a b : V) : (b * a) % b = 0

name: mod_eq_self_of_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_eq_self_of_lt {a b : V} (h : a < b) : a % b = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mod_mul_add_of_lt 0 b h

name: mod_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_lt (a : V) {b} (pos : 0 < b) : a % b < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases div_spec_of_pos' a pos with ⟨r, hr, ha⟩
  have : ((a / b) * b + r) % b = r := mod_mul_add_of_lt _ _ hr
  have : a % b = r := by simpa [←ha] using this
  simp [this, hr]

name: mod_le
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_le (a b : V) : a % b ≤ a

name: mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd
statement: lemma mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd {a b : V} : b % a = 0 ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mod_def, sub_eq_zero_iff_le]
  constructor
  · intro H; exact mul_div_self_of_dvd.mp (le_antisymm (mul_div_le b a) H)
  · intro H; simp [mul_div_self_of_dvd.mpr H]

name: mod_add_remove_right
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_add_remove_right {a b : V} (pos : 0 < b) : (a + b) % b = a % b
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mod_add_mul a 1 pos

name: mod_add_remove_right_of_dvd
statement: lemma mod_add_remove_right_of_dvd {a b m : V} (h : m ∣ b) (pos : 0 < m) : (a + b) % m = a % m
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨b, rfl⟩; simp [pos]

name: mod_add_remove_left
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_add_remove_left {a b : V} (pos : 0 < a) : (a + b) % a = b % a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mod_mul_add 1 b pos

name: mod_add_remove_left_of_dvd
statement: lemma mod_add_remove_left_of_dvd {a b m : V} (h : m ∣ a) (pos : 0 < m) : (a + b) % m = b % m
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨b, rfl⟩; simp [pos]

name: mod_add
statement: lemma mod_add {a b m : V} (pos : 0 < m) : (a + b) % m = (a % m + b % m) % m
proof:
:= calc
  (a + b) % m = ((m * (a / m) + a % m) + (m * (b / m) + b % m)) % m := by simp [div_add_mod]
  _           = (m * (a / m) + m * (b / m) + (a % m) + (b % m)) % m := by simp [←add_assoc, add_right_comm]
  _           = (a % m + b % m) % m                                 := by simp [add_assoc, pos]

name: mod_mul
statement: lemma mod_mul {a b m : V} (pos : 0 < m) : (a * b) % m = ((a % m) * (b % m)) % m
proof:
:= calc
  (a * b) % m = ((m * (a / m) + (a % m)) * (m * (b / m) + b % m)) % m := by simp [div_add_mod]
  _           = ((a % m) * (b % m)) % m                               := by simp [add_mul, mul_add, pos, mul_left_comm _ m, add_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: mod_div
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_div (a b : V) : a % b / b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Arithmetic.zero_le b with (rfl | pos)
  · simp
  · exact div_eq_zero_of_lt b (by simp [pos])

name: mod_one
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_one (a : V) : a % 1 = 0

name: mod_two
statement: lemma mod_two (a : V) : a % 2 = 0 ∨ a % 2 = 1

name: mod_two_not_zero_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_two_not_zero_iff {a : V} : ¬a % 2 = 0 ↔ a % 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases mod_two a with (h | h) <;> simp [*]

name: mod_two_not_one_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma mod_two_not_one_iff {a : V} : ¬a % 2 = 1 ↔ a % 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases mod_two a with (h | h) <;> simp [*]

name: two_dvd_mul
statement: lemma two_dvd_mul {a b : V} : 2 ∣ a * b → 2 ∣ a ∨ 2 ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  intro H; by_contra A
  have A : ¬2 ∣ a ∧ ¬2 ∣ b := by simpa using A
  have ha : a % 2 = 1 := by
    have : a % 2 = 0 ∨ a % 2 = 1 := mod_two a
    simpa [show a % 2 ≠ 0 from by simpa [←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] using A.1] using this
  have hb : b % 2 = 1 := by
    have : b % 2 = 0 ∨ b % 2 = 1 :=
      le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp <| lt_two_iff_le_one.mp <| mod_lt b (b := 2) (by simp)
    simpa [show b % 2 ≠ 0 from by simpa [←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] using A.2] using this
  have : a * b % 2 = 1 := by simp [mod_mul, ha, hb]
  have : ¬2 ∣ a * b := by simp [←mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, this]
  contradiction

name: even_or_odd
statement: lemma even_or_odd (a : V) : ∃ x, a = 2 * x ∨ a = 2 * x + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨a / 2, by
    have : 2 * (a / 2) + (a % 2) = a := div_add_mod a 2
    rcases mod_two a with (e | e) <;> { simp [e] at this; simp [this] }⟩

name: even_or_odd'
statement: lemma even_or_odd' (a : V) : a = 2 * (a / 2) ∨ a = 2 * (a / 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have : 2 * (a / 2) + (a % 2) = a := div_add_mod a 2
  rcases mod_two a with (e | e) <;>  simp [e] at this <;> simp [*]

name: two_prime
statement: lemma two_prime : Prime (2 : V)
proof: := ⟨by simp, by simp, by intro a b h; exact two_dvd_mul h⟩

name: sqrt_exists_unique
statement: lemma sqrt_exists_unique (a : V) : ∃! x, x * x ≤ a ∧ a < (x + 1) * (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ x, x * x ≤ a ∧ a < (x + 1) * (x + 1) := by
    have : a < (a + 1) * (a + 1) → ∃ x, x * x ≤ a ∧ a < (x + 1) * (x + 1) := by
      simpa using least_number (P := λ x ↦ x * x ≤ a) ⟨“x. x * x ≤ &a”, by simp, by simp⟩
    have hn : a < (a + 1) * (a + 1) := calc
      a ≤ a * a             := le_mul_self a
      _ < a * a + 1         := lt_add_one (a * a)
      _ ≤ (a + 1) * (a + 1) := by simp [add_mul_self_eq]
    exact this hn
  rcases this with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro x hx (by
    intro y hy
    by_contra ne
    wlog lt : x < y
    · exact this a y hy x hx (Ne.symm ne) (Ne.lt_of_le ne $ by simpa using lt)
    have : a < a := calc
      a < (x + 1) * (x + 1) := hx.2
      _ ≤ y * y             := mul_self_le_mul_self (by simp) (lt_iff_succ_le.mp lt)
      _ ≤ a                 := hy.1
    simp at this)

name: sqrt_spec_le
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_spec_le (a : V) : √a * √a ≤ a

name: sqrt_spec_lt
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_spec_lt (a : V) : a < (√a + 1) * (√a + 1)

name: sqrt_graph
statement: lemma sqrt_graph {a b : V} : b = √a ↔ b * b ≤ a ∧ a < (b + 1) * (b + 1)

name: eq_sqrt
statement: lemma eq_sqrt (x a : V) : x * x ≤ a ∧ a < (x + 1) * (x + 1) → x = √a

name: sqrt_eq_of_le_of_lt
statement: lemma sqrt_eq_of_le_of_lt {x a : V} (le : x * x ≤ a) (lt : a < (x + 1) * (x + 1)) : √a = x

name: sqrt_eq_of_le_of_le
statement: lemma sqrt_eq_of_le_of_le {x a : V} (le : x * x ≤ a) (h : a ≤ x * x + 2 * x) : √a = x
proof:
:=
  sqrt_eq_of_le_of_lt le <| by simpa [add_mul_self_eq] using le_iff_lt_succ.mp h

name: sq_sqrt_le
statement: @[simp] lemma sq_sqrt_le (a : V) : (√a) ^ 2 ≤ a

name: sqrt_lt_sq
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_lt_sq (a : V) : a < (√a + 1) ^ 2

name: sqrt_mul_self
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_mul_self (a : V) : √(a * a) = a
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| eq_sqrt a (a * a) <| by simpa using mul_self_lt_mul_self (by simp) (by simp)

name: sqrt_sq
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_sq (a : V) : √(a^2) = a

name: sqrt_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_zero : √(0 : V) = 0

name: sqrt_one
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_one : √(1 : V) = 1

name: sqrt_two
statement: lemma sqrt_two : √(2 : V) = 1

name: sqrt_three
statement: lemma sqrt_three : √(3 : V) = 1

name: sqrt_four
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_four : √(4 : V) = 2

name: two_ne_square
statement: @[simp] lemma two_ne_square (a : V) : 2 ≠ a^2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases show a = √2 from by rw [h]; simp with rfl
  simp [sqrt_two] at h

name: sqrt_le_add
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_le_add (a : V) : a ≤ √a * √a + 2 * √a
proof:
:=
  le_iff_lt_succ.mpr (by have := sqrt_spec_lt a; rw [add_mul_self_eq] at this; simpa using this)

name: sqrt_le_self
statement: @[simp] lemma sqrt_le_self (a : V) : √a ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  have : a < a := calc
    a ≤ a^2    := le_sq a
    _ < (√a)^2 := by simpa [sq] using mul_self_lt_mul_self (by simp) (by simpa using A)
    _ ≤ a      := sq_sqrt_le a
  simp_all

name: sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt
statement: lemma sqrt_lt_self_of_one_lt {a : V} (h : 1 < a) : √a < a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  have : a * a ≤ √a * √a := mul_self_le_mul_self (by simp) (by simpa using A)
  have : a * a ≤ a := le_trans this (sqrt_spec_le a)
  exact not_lt.mpr this (lt_mul_self h)

name: sqrt_le_of_le_sq
statement: lemma sqrt_le_of_le_sq {a b : V} : a ≤ b^2 → √a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  intro h; by_contra A
  have : a < a := calc
    a ≤ b^2    := h
    _ < (√a)^2 := sq_lt_sq.mpr (by simpa using A)
    _ ≤ a      := by simp
  simp_all

name: sq_lt_of_lt_sqrt
statement: lemma sq_lt_of_lt_sqrt {a b : V} : a < √b → a^2 < b
proof:
:= by
  intro h; by_contra A
  exact not_le.mpr h (sqrt_le_of_le_sq $ show b ≤ a^2 from by simpa using A)

name: pair_graph
statement:
lemma pair_graph {a b c : V} :
    c = ⟪a, b⟫ ↔ (a < b ∧ c = b * b + a) ∨ (b ≤ a ∧ c = a * a + a + b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pair]
  by_cases h : a < b
  · simp [h, show ¬b ≤ a from by simpa using h]
  · simp [h, show b ≤ a from by simpa using h]

name: pair_unpair
statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma pair_unpair (a : V) : ⟪π₁ a, π₂ a⟫ = a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pi₁, unpair, pi₂]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [pair, h]
  · suffices √a * √a + √a + (a - √a * √a - √a) = a by
      simpa [pair, not_lt.mpr (show a - √a * √a - √a ≤ √a by simp [add_comm (2 * √a), ←two_mul])]
    have : √a ≤ a - √a * √a := by simpa using h
    calc
      √a * √a + √a + (a - √a * √a - √a) = √a * √a + (√a + (a - √a * √a - √a)) := by simp [add_assoc]
      _                                 = √a * √a + (a - √a * √a)             := by simp [add_tsub_self_of_le this]
      _                                 = a                                   := add_tsub_self_of_le (by simp)

name: unpair_pair
statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma unpair_pair (a b : V) : unpair ⟪a, b⟫ = (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pair]; split_ifs with h
  · have : √(b * b + a) = b := sqrt_eq_of_le_of_le (by simp) (by simpa using le_trans (le_of_lt h) (by simp))
    simp [unpair, this, show ¬b ≤ a from by simpa using h]
  · have : √(a * a + (a + b)) = a :=
      sqrt_eq_of_le_of_le (by simp) (by simp [two_mul, show b ≤ a from by simpa using h])
    simp [unpair, this, add_assoc]

name: pi
statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma pi₁_pair (a b : V) : π₁ ⟪a, b⟫ = a

name: pi
statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma pi₂_pair (a b : V) : π₂ ⟪a, b⟫ = b

name: pi
statement: @[simp] lemma pi₁_le_self (a : V) : π₁ a ≤ a

name: pi
statement: @[simp] lemma pi₂_le_self (a : V) : π₂ a ≤ a

name: le_pair_left
statement: @[simp] lemma le_pair_left (a b : V) : a ≤ ⟪a, b⟫

name: le_pair_right
statement: @[simp] lemma le_pair_right (a b : V) : b ≤ ⟪a, b⟫

name: lt_pair_left_of_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_pair_left_of_pos {a} (pos : 0 < a) (b : V) : a < ⟪a, b⟫
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pair]; split_ifs
  · simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.mp <| pos_of_gt (by assumption)
  · calc
      a < a * a + a     := lt_add_of_pos_left a (by simpa using (pos_iff_ne_zero.mp pos))
      _ ≤ a * a + a + b := by simp

name: pair_lt_pair_left
statement: lemma pair_lt_pair_left {a₁ a₂ : V} (h : a₁ < a₂) (b) : ⟪a₁, b⟫ < ⟪a₂, b⟫
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : a₁ < b
  · simp only [pair, h₁, ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases h₂ : a₂ < b
    · simp [h₂, h]
    · suffices b * b + a₁ < a₂ * a₂ + a₂ + b by simpa [pair, h₂, h]
      calc
        b * b + a₁ < b * b + b        := by simpa using h₁
        _          ≤ a₂ * a₂ + a₂     := add_le_add (mul_le_mul (by simpa using h₂) (by simpa using h₂) (by simp) (by simp)) (by simpa using h₂)
        _          ≤ a₂ * a₂ + a₂ + b := by simp
  · simp [pair, h₁]
    simpa [show ¬a₂ < b by simpa using le_trans (by simpa using h₁) (le_of_lt h)]
    using _root_.add_lt_add (by simpa [←sq] using h) h

name: pair_le_pair_left
statement: lemma pair_le_pair_left {a₁ a₂ : V} (h : a₁ ≤ a₂) (b) : ⟪a₁, b⟫ ≤ ⟪a₂, b⟫
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (rfl | lt)
  · simp
  · exact le_of_lt (pair_lt_pair_left lt b)

name: pair_lt_pair_right
statement: lemma pair_lt_pair_right (a : V) {b₁ b₂} (h : b₁ < b₂) : ⟪a, b₁⟫ < ⟪a, b₂⟫
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : a < b₁
  · simpa [pair, h₁, lt_trans h₁ h, ←sq] using h
  · by_cases h₂ : a < b₂
    · suffices a * a + a + b₁ < b₂ * b₂ + a by simpa [pair, h₁, h₂, h]
      calc
        a * a + a + b₁ < (a + 1) * (a + 1) + b₁ := by simpa [add_mul_self_eq] using lt_succ_iff_le.mpr (by simp)
        _              ≤ b₂ * b₂ + b₁           := by simpa [←sq, succ_le_iff_lt] using h₂
        _              ≤ b₂ * b₂ + a            := by simpa using h₁
    · simp [pair, h₁, h₂, h]

name: pair_le_pair_right
statement: lemma pair_le_pair_right (a : V) {b₁ b₂} (h : b₁ ≤ b₂) : ⟪a, b₁⟫ ≤ ⟪a, b₂⟫
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with (rfl | lt)
  · simp
  · exact le_of_lt (pair_lt_pair_right a lt)

name: pair_le_pair
statement: lemma pair_le_pair {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : V} (ha : a₁ ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ b₂) : ⟪a₁, b₁⟫ ≤ ⟪a₂, b₂⟫
proof:
:=
  calc
    ⟪a₁, b₁⟫ ≤ ⟪a₂, b₁⟫ := pair_le_pair_left ha b₁
    _        ≤ ⟪a₂, b₂⟫ := pair_le_pair_right a₂ hb

name: pair_lt_pair
statement: lemma pair_lt_pair {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : V} (ha : a₁ < a₂) (hb : b₁ < b₂) : ⟪a₁, b₁⟫ < ⟪a₂, b₂⟫
proof:
:=
  calc
    ⟪a₁, b₁⟫ < ⟪a₂, b₁⟫ := pair_lt_pair_left ha b₁
    _        < ⟪a₂, b₂⟫ := pair_lt_pair_right a₂ hb

name: pair_polybound
statement: @[simp] lemma pair_polybound (a b : V) : ⟪a, b⟫ ≤ (a + b + 1)^2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < b <;> simp [pair, h, sq, add_mul_self_eq, two_mul]
  · simp [←add_assoc, add_right_comm _ a]; simp [add_right_comm _ (b * b)]
  · simp [←add_assoc, add_right_comm _ b]; simp [add_right_comm _ a]; simp [add_assoc]

name: pair_ext_iff
statement: @[simp, grind =>] lemma pair_ext_iff {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : V} : ⟪a₁, b₁⟫ = ⟪a₂, b₂⟫ ↔ a₁ = a₂ ∧ b₁ = b₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e ↦ ⟨by simpa using congr_arg (π₁ ·) e, by simpa using congr_arg (π₂ ·) e⟩, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; simp⟩

name: fegergreg
statement: theorem fegergreg (v : Fin 4 → ℕ) : v (0 : Fin (Nat.succ 1)).succ.succ = v 2
proof:
:= by { simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
  Nat.reduceAdd, Fin.isValue, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two] }

name: fin4
statement: theorem fin4 {n} : (2 : Fin (n + 3)).succ = 3

name: Fin.succ_zero_eq_one''
statement: @[simp] theorem Fin.succ_zero_eq_one'' {n} : (0 : Fin (n + 1)).succ = 1

name: Fin.succ_two_eq_three
statement: @[simp] theorem Fin.succ_two_eq_three {n} : (2 : Fin (n + 3)).succ = 3

name: ss
statement: theorem ss (v : Fin 4 → ℕ) : v (Fin.succ (0 : Fin (Nat.succ 1))).succ = v 2
proof: := by { simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, Fin.isValue, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two] }

name: npair_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma npair_zero (v : Fin 0 → V) : npair v = 0

name: npair_succ
statement: lemma npair_succ (x) (v : Fin n → V) : npair (x :> v) = ⟪x, npair v⟫

name: unNpair_npair
statement: @[simp] lemma unNpair_npair {n} (i : Fin n) (v : Fin n → V) : unNpair i (npair v) = v i
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih
  · simpa [npair, unNpair] using i.elim0

name: polynomial_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma polynomial_induction [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔⁻] (Γ m) [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝗡𝗗 Γ m]
    {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[m]-Predicate P)
    (zero : P 0) (even : ∀ x > 0, P x → P (2 * x)) (odd : ∀ x, P x → P (2 * x + 1)) : ∀ x, P x
proof:
:= by
  have : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝗡𝗗 Γ m := inferInstance
  have : V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 := models_of_subtheory this
  intro x; induction x using InductionOnHierarchy.order_induction
  · exact Γ
  · exact m
  · exact hP
  case inst => exact inferInstance
  case ind x IH =>
    rcases Arithmetic.zero_le x with (rfl | pos)
    · exact zero
    · have : x / 2 < x := div_lt_of_pos_of_one_lt pos one_lt_two
      rcases even_or_odd' x with (hx | hx)
      · simpa [←hx] using even (x / 2) (by by_contra A; simp at A; simp [show x = 0 from by simpa [A] using hx] at pos) (IH (x / 2) this)
      · simpa [←hx] using odd (x / 2) (IH (x / 2) this)

proof:
:=
  polynomial_induction 𝚺 0 (P := P) hP zero even odd

proof:
:= by
  let : Structure Language.unit ℕ := modelStar c
  have : Structure.Zero ℒₒᵣ⋆ ℕ := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : Structure.One ℒₒᵣ⋆ ℕ := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : Structure.Add ℒₒᵣ⋆ ℕ := ⟨fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have : Structure.Eq ℒₒᵣ⋆ ℕ := ⟨fun _ _ => iff_of_eq rfl⟩
  have : Structure.LT ℒₒᵣ⋆ ℕ := ⟨fun _ _ => iff_of_eq rfl⟩
  have : ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ⋆] ⊧* starUnbounded c := by
    have : ∀ (i : Fin c), (↑i : ℕ) < Semiterm.Operator.Star.star.val (L := ℒₒᵣ⋆) ![] := Fin.prop
    simp [starUnbounded, models_iff, this]
  have : ℕ↓[ℒₒᵣ⋆] ⊧* trueArithWithStarUnbounded c := by
    simpa [trueArithWithStarUnbounded, models_iff] using this
  exact satisfiable_intro ℕ this

proof:

name: numeral_add
statement: lemma numeral_add (n m : ℕ) : (numeral n : M) + numeral m = numeral (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  match m with
  |     0 => simp
  |     1 => simp [numeral_add_one]
  | m + 2 => calc
    (numeral n : M) + (numeral (m + 1) + 1) = (numeral n + numeral (m + 1)) + 1 := Arithmetic.add_succ _ _
    _                                       = numeral (n + (m + 1)) + 1         := by rw [numeral_add n (m + 1)]
    _                                       = numeral (n + (m + 2))             := by simp [←add_assoc]; rfl

name: numeral_zero_mul
statement: lemma numeral_zero_mul {n : ℕ} : 0 * (numeral n : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  |     0 => simp
  |     1 => simp
  | n + 2 => calc
    (0 : M) * numeral (n + 2) = 0 * (numeral (n + 1) + 1) := rfl
    _                         = 0 * numeral (n + 1) + 0   := by rw [Arithmetic.mul_succ]
    _                         = 0                         := by simp [numeral_zero_mul]

name: numeral_mul_one
statement: lemma numeral_mul_one {n : ℕ} : (numeral n : M) * 1 = numeral n
proof:
:= calc
  (numeral n : M) * 1 = numeral n * (0 + 1)       := by simp
  _                   = numeral n * 0 + numeral n := by rw [Arithmetic.mul_succ]
  _                   = numeral n                 := by simp

name: numeral_mul
statement: lemma numeral_mul {n m : ℕ} : (numeral n : M) * numeral m = numeral (n * m)
proof:
:= by
  match m with
  |     0 => simp
  |     1 => simp [numeral_mul_one]
  | m + 2 => calc
    (numeral n : M) * (numeral (m + 1) + 1) = numeral n * numeral (m + 1) + numeral n := by rw [Arithmetic.mul_succ]
    _                                       = numeral (n * (m + 1)) + numeral n       := by rw [numeral_mul]
    _                                       = numeral (n * (m + 2))                   := by simp [numeral_add, mul_add, mul_two, ←add_assoc]

bexs_vec_le_boldfaceBoundedFunction
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k
  case zero => simpa [Matrix.empty_eq (α := V)] using hP
  case succ l ih =>
    simp only [Fin.exists_le_vec_iff_exists_le_exists_vec]
    apply bexs_ble (pp 0)
    apply ih
    · intro i; apply DefinableBoundedFunction.retraction (pp i.succ)
    · let g : Fin (k + (l + 1)) → Fin (k + 1 + l) := Matrix.vecAppend rfl (fun x ↦ x.succ.castAdd l) (Fin.castAdd l 0 :> fun j ↦ j.natAdd (k + 1))
      exact of_iff (retraction hP g) <| by
        intro v; simp only [g]
        apply iff_of_eq; congr
        · ext i; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
        · ext i
          cases' i using Fin.cases with i
          · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
          · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_succ]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]

name: substitution_boldfaceBoundedFunction
proof:
:= by
  have : ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ ∃ w ≤ (f · v), (∀ i, w i = f i v) ∧ P w := by
    apply bexs_vec_le_boldfaceBoundedFunction hf
    apply and
    · apply fintype_all; intro i
      simpa using retraction (.of_zero (hf i).2) (i.natAdd l :> Fin.castAdd k)
    · apply retraction hP
  apply of_iff this <| by
    intro v; constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨(f · v), by intro i; simp, by simp, h⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, e, h⟩
      rcases funext e

proof:
:= by
  have : f = g := by funext v; simp [h]
  rcases this; exact H

name: HierarchySymbol.DefinableFunction.bcomp
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Definable.substitution_boldfaceBoundedFunction (f := (· 0) :> fun i w ↦ f i (w ·.succ)) hF <| by
    intro i
    cases' i using Fin.cases with i
    · simp
    · simpa using DefinableBoundedFunction.retraction (hf i) Fin.succ

lemma DefinableBoundedFunction₃.comp {k} {F : V → V → V → V} {f₁ f₂ f₃ : (Fin k → V) → V}

name: df
statement: lemma df {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {φ : ℌ.Semisentence k} (h : Defined R φ) : FirstOrder.IsDefinedBy R φ.val
proof:
:=
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[_] => h.defined
  | 𝚷-[_] => h.defined
  | 𝚫-[_] => h.defined.2

@[simp] lemma iff {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {φ : ℌ.Semisentence k} [h : Defined R φ] :

name: of_zero
statement: lemma of_zero {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {φ : 𝚺₀.Semisentence k} (h : Defined R φ) : Defined R (φ.ofZero ℌ)
proof:
:= Defined.mk <|
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] => by intro _; simp
  | 𝚷-[m] => by intro _; simp
  | 𝚫-[m] => ⟨by simp, by intro _; simp⟩

name: of_iff
statement: lemma of_iff {P Q : (Fin k → V) → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P x ↔ Q x) {φ : ℌ.Semisentence k} (H : Defined Q φ) : Defined P φ
proof:
:= by
  rwa [show P = Q from by funext v; simp [h]]

name: to_definable
statement: lemma to_definable (φ : ℌ.Semisentence k) (hP : Defined P φ) : ℌ.Definable P
proof:
:= ⟨φ.rew Rew.emb, by
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[_] => intro; simp [hP.iff]
  | 𝚷-[_] => intro; simp [hP.iff]
  | 𝚫-[_] => exact ⟨
    fun v ↦ by rcases φ; simpa [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.rew] using hP.proper.rew Rew.emb v,
    by intro; simp⟩⟩

name: to_definable
statement:
lemma to_definable₀ {φ : 𝚺₀.Semisentence k} (hP : Defined P φ) :
    ℌ.Definable P

statement:
lemma of_eq {f g : (Fin k → V) → V} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x)
