name: graph_delta
statement:
lemma graph_delta {f : (Fin k → V) → V} {φ : 𝚺-[m].Semisentence (k + 1)}
    (h : DefinedFunction f φ) : DefinedFunction f φ.graphDelta
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
      cases' m with m
      case zero => simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.graphDelta]
      case succ =>
        simp only [Semiformula.graphDelta]
        intro e
        simp; tauto,
   by intro v; simp⟩

name: df
statement: lemma df {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {φ : ℌ.Semiformula V k} (h : IsDefinedByWithParam R φ) : FirstOrder.IsDefinedByWithParam R φ.val

name: iff
statement:
lemma iff {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {φ : ℌ.Semiformula V k} (h : IsDefinedByWithParam R φ) {v} :
    φ.val.Eval v id ↔ R v

name: proper
statement: lemma proper {R : (Fin k → V) → Prop} {m} {φ : 𝚫-[m].Semiformula V k} (h : IsDefinedByWithParam R φ) : φ.ProperWithParamOn V

name: mk'
statement: lemma mk' {ℌ : HierarchySymbol} (φ : ℌ.Semiformula V k) (H : IsDefinedByWithParam P φ) : ℌ.Definable P

name: mkPolarity
statement:
lemma mkPolarity {Γ : Polarity}
    (φ : ArithmeticSemiformula V k) (hp : Hierarchy Γ m φ) (hP : ∀ v, P v ↔ φ.Eval v id) : Γ-[m].Definable P
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => ⟨.mkSigma φ hp, by intro v; simp [hP]⟩
  | 𝚷 => ⟨.mkPi φ hp, by intro v; simp [hP]⟩

name: of_zero
statement: lemma of_zero (h : Definable (Γ'-[0]) P) {ℌ : HierarchySymbol} : ℌ.Definable P
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
  apply Definable.mk' (φ.ofZero ℌ)
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] | 𝚷-[m] => intro _; simp [hφ.iff]
  | 𝚫-[m] =>
    constructor
    · simp
    · intro _; simp [hφ.iff]

name: of_deltaOne
statement: lemma of_deltaOne {Γ m} (h : 𝚫₁.Definable P) : Γ-[m+1].Definable P
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  apply Definable.mk' (φ.ofDeltaOne Γ m)
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => intro _; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ofDeltaOne, h.iff, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma]
  | 𝚷 => intro _; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ofDeltaOne, h.iff, h.proper.iff']
  | 𝚫 => exact ⟨by intro _; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ofDeltaOne, h.iff, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, h.proper.iff'],
    by intro _; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ofDeltaOne, h.df.iff, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma]⟩

name: of_delta
statement: lemma of_delta (h : 𝚫-[m].Definable P) : Γ-[m].Definable P
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => exact ⟨φ.sigma, by intro v; simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, h.df.iff]⟩
  | 𝚷 => exact ⟨φ.pi, by intro v; simp [←h.proper v, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, h.df.iff]⟩
  | 𝚫 => exact ⟨φ, h⟩

name: delta_iff_sigma_and_pi
statement: lemma delta_iff_sigma_and_pi : 𝚫-[m].Definable P ↔ 𝚷-[m].Definable P ∧ 𝚺-[m].Definable P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨of_delta (Γ := 𝚷) h, of_delta (Γ := 𝚺) h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hπ, hσ⟩
    rcases hσ with ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    rcases hπ with ⟨ψ, hψ⟩
    exact ⟨.mkDelta φ ψ, by intro v; simp [hφ.df.iff, hψ.df.iff], by intro v; simp [hφ.df.iff]⟩

name: of_sigma_of_pi
statement: lemma of_sigma_of_pi (hσ : 𝚺-[m].Definable P) (hπ : 𝚷-[m].Definable P) : Γ-[m].Definable P
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => hσ
  | 𝚷 => hπ
  | 𝚫 => by
    rcases hσ with ⟨φ, hp⟩; rcases hπ with ⟨ψ, hq⟩
    exact ⟨.mkDelta φ ψ, by intro v; simp [hp.df.iff, hq.df.iff], by intro v; simp [hp.df.iff]⟩

name: of_iff
statement: lemma of_iff (H : ℌ.Definable Q) (h : ∀ x, P x ↔ Q x) : ℌ.Definable P
proof:
:= by
  rwa [show P = Q from by funext v; simp [h]]

name: retraction
statement:
lemma retraction (h : ℌ.Definable P) (f : Fin k → Fin l) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ P fun i ↦ v (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  apply Definable.mk' (φ.rew <| Rew.subst fun x ↦ #(f x))
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[_] | 𝚷-[_] => intro; simp [h.iff, Function.comp_def]
  | 𝚫-[_] => exact ⟨h.proper.rew _, by intro; simp [h.iff, Function.comp_def]⟩

name: retractiont
statement:
lemma retractiont (h : ℌ.Definable P) (f : Fin k → ArithmeticSemiterm V n) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ P (fun i ↦ (f i).val v id)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  exact ⟨φ.rew (Rew.subst f),
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[_] | 𝚷-[_] => by intro; simp [h.df.iff, Function.comp_def]
  | 𝚫-[_] => ⟨h.proper.rew _, by intro; simp [h.df.iff, Function.comp_def]⟩⟩

name: and
statement: lemma and (hP : ℌ.Definable P) (hQ : ℌ.Definable Q) : ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ P x ∧ Q x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hP with ⟨φ, hP⟩
  rcases hQ with ⟨ψ, hQ⟩
  apply Definable.mk' (φ ⋏ ψ)
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] | 𝚷-[m] => intro v; simp [hP.iff, hQ.iff]
  | 𝚫-[m] => exact ⟨hP.proper.and hQ.proper, by intro v; simp [hP.iff, hQ.iff]⟩

name: or
statement: lemma or (hP : ℌ.Definable P) (hQ : ℌ.Definable Q) : ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ P x ∨ Q x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hP with ⟨φ, hP⟩
  rcases hQ with ⟨ψ, hQ⟩
  apply Definable.mk' (φ ⋎ ψ)
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] | 𝚷-[m] => intro v; simp [hP.iff, hQ.iff]
  | 𝚫-[m] => exact ⟨hP.proper.or hQ.proper, by intro v; simp [hP.iff, hQ.iff]⟩

name: notSigma
statement: lemma notSigma (h : 𝚺-[m].Definable P) : 𝚷-[m].Definable fun x ↦ ¬P x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩; exact Definable.mk' φ.negSigma fun v ↦ by simp [h.iff]

name: notPi
statement: lemma notPi (h : 𝚷-[m].Definable P) : 𝚺-[m].Definable fun x ↦ ¬P x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  exact Definable.mk' φ.negPi fun v ↦ by simp [h.iff]

name: notDelta
statement: lemma notDelta (h : 𝚫-[m].Definable P) : 𝚫-[m].Definable fun x ↦ ¬P x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  exact Definable.mk' (∼φ) ⟨h.proper.neg, by intro v; simp [h.proper.eval_neg, h.iff]⟩

name: not
statement:
lemma not (h : Γ.alt-[m].Definable P) :
    Γ-[m].Definable (fun v ↦ ¬P v)
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => h.notPi
  | 𝚷 => h.notSigma
  | 𝚫 => h.notDelta

name: impDelta
statement:
lemma impDelta (hp : 𝚫-[m].Definable P) (hq : 𝚫-[m].Definable Q) :
    𝚫-[m].Definable fun x ↦ P x → Q x

name: imp
statement:
lemma imp (h₁ : Γ.alt-[m].Definable P) (h₂ : Γ-[m].Definable Q) :
    Γ-[m].Definable (fun v ↦ P v → Q v)
proof:
:= by
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 =>
    rcases h₁ with ⟨φ₁, h₁⟩; rcases h₂ with ⟨φ₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨φ₁.negPi ⋎ φ₂, fun _ ↦ by simp [Semiformula.negPi, h₁.iff, h₂.iff, imp_iff_not_or]⟩
  | 𝚷 =>
    rcases h₁ with ⟨p₁, h₁⟩; rcases h₂ with ⟨p₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨p₁.negSigma ⋎ p₂, fun _ ↦ by simp [h₁.iff, h₂.iff, imp_iff_not_or]⟩
  | 𝚫 => exact impDelta h₁ h₂

name: biconditional
statement:
lemma biconditional (h₁ : 𝚫-[m].Definable P) (h₂ : 𝚫-[m].Definable Q) {Γ} :
    Γ-[m].Definable (fun v ↦ P v ↔ Q v)
proof:
:=
  .of_delta <| ((h₁.impDelta h₂).and (h₂.impDelta h₁)).of_iff <| by intro v; simp [iff_iff_implies_and_implies]

name: ball
statement:
lemma ball {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : ℌ.Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) (t : ArithmeticSemiterm V k) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ ∀ x < t.val v id, P v x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ball t φ, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩
  | 𝚷-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ball t φ, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩
  | 𝚫-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.ball t φ, ⟨h.proper.ball, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩⟩

name: bexs
statement:
lemma bexs {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : ℌ.Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) (t : ArithmeticSemiterm V k) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ ∃ x < t.val v id, P v x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩
  match ℌ with
  | 𝚺-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.bexs t φ, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩
  | 𝚷-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.bexs t φ, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩
  | 𝚫-[m] => exact ⟨HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.bexs t φ, ⟨h.proper.bexs, by intro v; simp [h.iff]⟩⟩

name: ball'
statement:
lemma ball' [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔⁻] {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : ℌ.Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) (t : ArithmeticSemiterm V k) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ ∀ x ≤ t.val v id, P v x
proof:
:= by
  apply (ball h ‘!!t + 1’).of_iff
  intro v; simp [lt_succ_iff_le]

name: bexs'
statement:
lemma bexs' [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗣𝗔⁻] {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : ℌ.Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) (t : ArithmeticSemiterm V k) :
    ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ ∃ x ≤ t.val v id, P v x
proof:
:= by
  apply (bexs h ‘!!t + 1’).of_iff
  intro v; simp [lt_succ_iff_le]

name: exs
statement:
lemma exs {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : 𝚺-[m + 1].Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) :
    𝚺-[m + 1].Definable fun v ↦ ∃ x, P v x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩; exact ⟨φ.exs, by intro _; simp [h.iff]⟩

name: all
statement:
lemma all {P : (Fin k → V) → V → Prop} (h : 𝚷-[m + 1].Definable fun w ↦ P (w ·.succ) (w 0)) :
    𝚷-[m + 1].Definable fun v ↦ ∀ x, P v x
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨φ, h⟩; exact ⟨φ.all, by intro _; simp [h.iff]⟩

name: conj
statement:
lemma conj₂ (Γ : List ι) {R : ι → (Fin k → V) → Prop} (hR : ∀ i, ℌ.Definable (R i)) :
    ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ ∀ i ∈ Γ, R i x
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  |          [] => by simp
  |         [i] => by simpa using hR i
  | i :: j :: Γ => by simpa using (hR i).and (conj₂ (j :: Γ) hR)

name: disj
statement:
lemma disj₂ (Γ : List ι) {R : ι → (Fin k → V) → Prop} (hR : ∀ i, ℌ.Definable (R i)) :
    ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ ∃ i ∈ Γ, R i x
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  |          [] => by simp
  |         [i] => by simpa using hR i
  | i :: j :: Γ => by simpa using (hR i).or (disj₂ (j :: Γ) hR)

name: fconj
statement:
lemma fconj (s : Finset ι) {R : ι → (Fin k → V) → Prop} (h : ∀ i, ℌ.Definable (R i)) :
    ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ ∀ i ∈ s, R i x
proof: := by simpa using conj₂ s.toList h

name: fdisj
statement:
lemma fdisj (s : Finset ι) {R : ι → (Fin k → V) → Prop} (h : ∀ i, ℌ.Definable (R i)) :
    ℌ.Definable fun x ↦ ∃ i ∈ s, R i x
proof: := by simpa using disj₂ s.toList h

name: fintype_all
proof:
:= by
  simpa using fconj Finset.univ h

name: fintype_exs
proof:
:= by
  simpa using fdisj Finset.univ h

name: equal'
statement: lemma equal' (i j : Fin k) : ℌ.Definable fun v : Fin k → V ↦ v i = v j
proof:
:= by
  simpa using retraction DefinableRel.eq ![i, j]

name: of_sigma
statement: lemma of_sigma {f : (Fin k → V) → V} (h : 𝚺-[m].DefinableFunction f) {Γ} : Γ-[m].DefinableFunction f
proof:
:= by
  cases' m with m
  · exact of_zero h
  apply of_sigma_of_pi
  · exact h
  · have : 𝚷-[m + 1].Definable fun v ↦ ∀ y, y = f (v ·.succ) → v 0 = y := all <| imp
      (by simpa using retraction h (0 :> (·.succ.succ)))
      (by simpa using equal' 1 0)
    exact this.of_iff fun v ↦ by simp

name: exsVec
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k
  case zero => simpa [Matrix.empty_eq] using h
  case succ l ih =>
    suffices 𝚺-[m + 1].Definable fun v : Fin k → V ↦ ∃ y, ∃ ys : Fin l → V, P v (y :> ys) by
      apply of_iff this; intro x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨ys, h⟩; exact ⟨ys 0, (ys ·.succ), by simpa using h⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, ys, h⟩; exact ⟨_, h⟩
    apply exs
    apply ih
    let g : Fin (k + (l + 1)) → Fin (k + 1 + l) := Matrix.vecAppend rfl (fun x ↦ x.succ.castAdd l) (Fin.castAdd l 0 :> fun j ↦ j.natAdd (k + 1))
    exact of_iff (retraction h g) (by
      intro v; simp only [g]
      apply iff_of_eq; congr
      · ext i; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
      · ext i
        cases' i using Fin.cases with i
        · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
        · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_succ]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite])

name: allVec
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k
  case zero => simpa [Matrix.empty_eq] using h
  case succ l ih =>
    suffices 𝚷-[m+1].Definable fun v : Fin k → V ↦ ∀ y, ∀ ys : Fin l → V, P v (y :> ys) by
      apply of_iff this; intro x
      constructor
      · intro h y ys; apply h
      · intro h ys; simpa using h (ys 0) (ys ·.succ)
    apply all; apply ih
    let g : Fin (k + (l + 1)) → Fin (k + 1 + l) := Matrix.vecAppend rfl (fun x ↦ x.succ.castAdd l) (Fin.castAdd l 0 :> fun j ↦ j.natAdd (k + 1))
    exact of_iff (retraction h g) (by
      intro v; simp only [g]
      apply iff_of_eq; congr
      · ext i; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
      · ext i
        cases' i using Fin.cases with i
        · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite]
        · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_succ]; congr 1; ext; simp [Matrix.vecAppend_eq_ite])

name: substitution_sigma
statement:
private lemma substitution_sigma {f : Fin k → (Fin l → V) → V} (hP : 𝚺-[m+1].Definable P) (hf : ∀ i, 𝚺-[m+1].DefinableFunction (f i)) :
    𝚺-[m+1].Definable fun z ↦ P (fun i ↦ f i z)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚺-[m+1].Definable fun z ↦ ∃ ys : Fin k → V, (∀ i, ys i = f i z) ∧ P ys := by
    apply exsVec; apply and
    · apply fintype_all; intro i
      simpa using retraction (of_sigma (hf i)) (i.natAdd l :> fun i ↦ i.castAdd k)
    · exact retraction hP (Fin.natAdd l)
  exact of_iff this <| by
    intro v
    constructor
    · intro hP
      exact ⟨(f · v), by simp, hP⟩
    · rintro ⟨ys, hys, hP⟩
      have : ys = fun i ↦ f i v := funext hys
      rcases this; exact hP

name: substitution_pi
statement:
private lemma substitution_pi {f : Fin k → (Fin l → V) → V} (hP : 𝚷-[m+1].Definable P) (hf : ∀ i, 𝚺-[m+1].DefinableFunction (f i)) :
    𝚷-[m+1].Definable fun z ↦ P (fun i ↦ f i z)
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝚷-[m+1].Definable fun z ↦ ∀ ys : Fin k → V, (∀ i, ys i = f i z) → P ys := by
    apply allVec; apply imp
    · apply fintype_all; intro i
      simpa using retraction (of_sigma (hf i)) (i.natAdd l :> fun i ↦ i.castAdd k)
    · exact retraction hP (Fin.natAdd l)
  exact of_iff this <| by
    intro v
    constructor
    · intro h ys e
      have : ys = (f · v) := funext e
      rcases this; exact h
    · intro h; apply h _ (by simp)

name: substitution
proof:
:=
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => substitution_sigma hP hf
  | 𝚷 => substitution_pi hP hf
  | 𝚫 => of_sigma_of_pi (substitution_sigma (of_delta hP) hf) (substitution_pi (of_delta hP) hf)

  exact ⟨φ.graphDelta, by

name: term_retraction
statement:
@[simp] lemma term_retraction (t : ArithmeticSemiterm V n) (e : Fin n → Fin k) :
    ℌ.DefinableFunction fun v : Fin k → V ↦ t.val (fun x ↦ v (e x)) id
proof:
:=
  .of_zero (Γ' := 𝚺)
    ⟨.mkSigma “x. x = !!(Rew.subst (fun x ↦ #(e x).succ) t)”, fun v ↦ by
    simp [Semiterm.val_substs, Function.comp_def]⟩

name: retraction
statement:
lemma retraction {n} (hf : ℌ.DefinableFunction f) (e : Fin k → Fin n) :
    ℌ.DefinableFunction fun v ↦ f (fun i ↦ v (e i))
proof:
:=
  have : ℌ.Definable fun v ↦ v 0 = f fun x ↦ v (e x).succ :=
    Definable.retraction hf (0 :> fun i ↦ (e i).succ)
  this.of_iff (by intro x; simp)

name: retractiont
statement:
lemma retractiont {n} (hf : ℌ.DefinableFunction f) (t : Fin k → ArithmeticSemiterm V n) :
    ℌ.DefinableFunction fun v ↦ f (fun i ↦ (t i).val v id)
proof:
:=
  have := Definable.retractiont (n := n + 1) hf (#0 :> fun i ↦ Rew.bShift (t i))
  this.of_iff (by intro x; simp [Semiterm.val_bShift'])

proof:
:= by

name: ball_lt
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨bf, hbf⟩
  rcases h with ⟨φ, hp⟩
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => exact
    ⟨ .mkSigma (∃¹ (bf.val ⋏ (∀¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
      by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff] ⟩
  | 𝚷 => exact
    ⟨ .mkPi (∀¹ (bf.val 🡒 (∀¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
      by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff] ⟩
  | 𝚫 =>
    exact .of_sigma_of_pi
      ⟨ .mkSigma (∃¹ (bf.val ⋏ (∀¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.sigma.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
          by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma] ⟩
      ⟨ .mkPi (∀¹ (bf.val 🡒 (∀¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.pi.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
        by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff, hp.proper.iff'] ⟩

name: bexs_lt
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨bf, hbf⟩
  rcases h with ⟨φ, hp⟩
  match Γ with
  | 𝚺 => exact
    ⟨ .mkSigma (∃¹ (bf.val ⋏ (∃¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
      by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff] ⟩
  | 𝚷 => exact
    ⟨ .mkPi (∀¹ (bf.val 🡒 (∃¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
      by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff] ⟩
  | 𝚫 =>
    exact .of_sigma_of_pi
      ⟨ .mkSigma (∃¹ (bf.val ⋏ (∃¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.sigma.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
          by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma] ⟩
      ⟨ .mkPi (∀¹ (bf.val 🡒 (∃¹[“#0 < #1”] φ.pi.val ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))))) (by simp),
        by intro v; simp [hbf.df.iff, hp.df.iff, hp.proper.iff'] ⟩

name: ball_le
proof:
:= by
  have : Γ-[m + 1].Definable (fun v ↦ ∀ x < f v + 1, P v x) := ball_lt (DefinableFunction₂.comp hf (by simp)) h
  exact this.of_iff <| by intro v; simp [lt_succ_iff_le]

name: bexs_le
proof:
:= by
  have : Γ-[m + 1].Definable (fun v ↦ ∃ x < f v + 1, P v x) := bexs_lt (DefinableFunction₂.comp hf (by simp)) h
  exact this.of_iff <| by intro v; simp [lt_succ_iff_le]

name: definablePred_of_hierarchy

name: models_iff_of_Sigma0
statement:
lemma models_iff_of_Sigma0 {σ : ArithmeticSemisentence n} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 0 σ) {e : Fin n → ℕ} :
    σ.Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) ↔ σ.Evalb e
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : σ.Evalb e <;> simp [h]
  · have : σ.Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) := by
      simpa [numeral_eq_natCast] using bold_sigma_one_completeness' (M := V) (by simp [Hierarchy.of_zero hσ]) h
    simpa [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma] using this
  · have : (∼σ).Evalb (M := ℕ) e := by simpa using h
    have : (∼σ).Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) := by
      simpa [numeral_eq_natCast] using bold_sigma_one_completeness' (M := V) (by simp [Hierarchy.of_zero hσ]) this
    simpa using this

name: models_iff_of_Delta1
statement:
lemma models_iff_of_Delta1 {σ : 𝚫₁.Semisentence n} (hσ : σ.ProperOn ℕ) (hσV : σ.ProperOn V) {e : Fin n → ℕ} :
    σ.val.Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) ↔ σ.val.Evalb e
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : σ.val.Evalb e <;> simp [h]
  · have : σ.sigma.val.Evalb e := by simpa [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma] using h
    have : σ.sigma.val.Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) := by simpa [numeral_eq_natCast] using bold_sigma_one_completeness' (M := V) (by simp) this
    simpa [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma] using this
  · have : (∼σ.pi.val).Evalb (M := ℕ) e := by simpa [hσ.iff'] using h
    have : (∼σ.pi.val).Evalb (M := V) (Nat.cast ∘ e) := by
      simpa [numeral_eq_natCast] using bold_sigma_one_completeness' (M := V) (by simp) this
    simpa [hσV.iff'] using this

name: sigma_one_completeness_iff_param
statement:
theorem sigma_one_completeness_iff_param {σ : ArithmeticSemisentence n} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 1 σ) {e : Fin n → ℕ} :
    ℕ ⊧/e σ ↔ T ⊢ (σ ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x))
proof:
:= Iff.trans
  (by simp [models_iff, Semiformula.eval_substs, Function.comp_def, Matrix.empty_eq])
  (sigma_one_completeness_iff (T := T) (by simp [hσ]))

name: models_iff_provable_of_Sigma0_param
statement:
lemma models_iff_provable_of_Sigma0_param [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] {σ : ArithmeticSemisentence n} (hσ : Hierarchy 𝚺 0 σ) {e : Fin n → ℕ} :
    V ⊧/(Nat.cast ∘ e) σ ↔ T ⊢ (σ ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    V ⊧/(Nat.cast ∘ e) σ ↔ ℕ ⊧/e σ        := by
      simp [models_iff_of_Sigma0 hσ]
  _             ↔ T ⊢ (σ ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x)) := by
      apply sigma_one_completeness_iff_param (by simp [Hierarchy.of_zero hσ])

name: models_iff_provable_of_Delta1_param
statement:
lemma models_iff_provable_of_Delta1_param [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* T] {σ : 𝚫₁.Semisentence n} (hσ : σ.ProperOn ℕ) (hσV : σ.ProperOn V) {e : Fin n → ℕ} :
    V ⊧/(Nat.cast ∘ e) σ.val ↔ T ⊢ (σ.val ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    V ⊧/(Nat.cast ∘ e) σ.val ↔ ℕ ⊧/e σ.val        := by
      simp [models_iff_of_Delta1 hσ hσV]
  _                 ↔ ℕ ⊧/e σ.sigma.val  := by
      simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma]
  _                 ↔ T ⊢ (σ.sigma.val ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x)) := by
      apply sigma_one_completeness_iff_param (by simp)
  _                 ↔ T ⊢ (σ.val ⇜ fun x ↦ Semiterm.Operator.numeral ℒₒᵣ (e x))       := by
      simp [HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma]

proof:

name: rel

protected lemma rel {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → M₁) :

name: eval_hom_iff_of_open
statement:
lemma eval_hom_iff_of_open {n} {e₁ : Fin n → M₁} {ε₁ : ξ → M₁} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (h : φ.Open) :
    φ.Eval e₁ ε₁ ↔ φ.Eval (Θ ∘ e₁) (Θ ∘ ε₁)
proof:
:=
  match φ with
  | rel r v | nrel r v => by simp [Function.comp_def, ←EmbeddingClass.rel Θ, HomClass.val_term]
  | ⊤ | ⊥ => by simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ | φ ⋎ ψ => by simp at h ⊢; simp [eval_hom_iff_of_open h.1, eval_hom_iff_of_open h.2]

name: eval_hom_allClosure
statement:
lemma eval_hom_allClosure {n} {ε₁ : ξ → M₁} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : φ.Open) :
    (∀¹* φ).Evalf (Θ ∘ ε₁) → (∀¹* φ).Evalf ε₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_allClosure]
  intro h e₁; exact (eval_hom_iff_of_open Θ hp).mpr (h (Θ ∘ e₁))

name: modelsTheory
statement:
lemma modelsTheory [h : M₁ ≡ₑ[L] M₂] {T : Theory L} :

name: modelsTheory'
statement:
lemma modelsTheory' [M₁ ≡ₑ[L] M₂] (T : Theory L) [h : M₂↓[L] ⊧* T] :

name: ofEquiv
statement:
lemma ofEquiv [Nonempty N] (Θ : M ≃ N) :
    letI : Structure L N
proof:
:= Structure.ofEquiv Θ
    M ≡ₑ[L] N :=
  letI : Structure L N := Structure.ofEquiv Θ
  ⟨by simp [models_iff, Empty.eq_elim, Structure.evalf_ofEquiv_iff (Θ := Θ)]⟩

name: val_eq_of_equiv
statement:
lemma val_eq_of_equiv {f₁ f₂ b₁ b₂}
    (I : M₁ ≃ M₂)
    (hf : ∀ x, I (f₁ x) = f₂ x) (hb : ∀ x, I (b₁ x) = b₂ x)
    (hfunc : ∀ {k} (f : L.Func k) {v₁ : Fin k → M₁} {v₂ : Fin k → M₂}, (∀ i, I (v₁ i) = v₂ i) → I (s₁.func f v₁) = s₂.func f v₂)
    (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    I (t.val b₁ f₁) = t.val b₂ f₂
proof:
:=
  match t with
  | #x => by simp [hb]
  | &x => by simp [hf]
  | .func f v => by
    have ih : ∀ i, I ((v i).val b₁ f₁) = (v i).val b₂ f₂ := fun i ↦
      val_eq_of_equiv I hf hb hfunc (v i)
    simp [hfunc, ih, Function.comp_def]

name: eval_iff_of_equiv
statement:
lemma eval_iff_of_equiv {f₁ f₂ b₁ b₂}
    (I : M₁ ≃ M₂)
    (hf : ∀ x, I (f₁ x) = f₂ x) (hb : ∀ x, I (b₁ x) = b₂ x)
    (hrel : ∀ {k} (R : L.Rel k) {v₁ : Fin k → M₁} {v₂ : Fin k → M₂}, (∀ i, I (v₁ i) = v₂ i) → (s₁.rel R v₁ ↔ s₂.rel R v₂))
    (hfunc : ∀ {k} (f : L.Func k) {v₁ : Fin k → M₁} {v₂ : Fin k → M₂}, (∀ i, I (v₁ i) = v₂ i) → I (s₁.func f v₁) = s₂.func f v₂)
    (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    φ.Eval b₁ f₁ ↔ φ.Eval b₂ f₂
proof:
:=
  match φ with
  | .rel R v => by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hrel R fun i ↦ val_eq_of_equiv I hf hb hfunc (v i)
  | .nrel R v => by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using not_congr <| hrel R fun i ↦ val_eq_of_equiv I hf hb hfunc (v i)
  | ⊤ => by simp
  | ⊥ => by simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ => by
    simp [eval_iff_of_equiv I hf hb hrel hfunc φ, eval_iff_of_equiv I hf hb hrel hfunc ψ]
  | φ ⋎ ψ => by
    simp [eval_iff_of_equiv I hf hb hrel hfunc φ, eval_iff_of_equiv I hf hb hrel hfunc ψ]
  | ∀¹ φ => by
    suffices
      (∀ x₁ : M₁, φ.Eval (x₁ :> b₁) f₁) ↔ (∀ x₂ : M₂, φ.Eval (x₂ :> b₂) f₂) by simpa
    constructor
    · intro h x₂
      have : φ.Eval (I.symm x₂ :> b₁) f₁ ↔ φ.Eval (x₂ :> b₂) f₂ :=
        eval_iff_of_equiv I (b₁ := I.symm x₂ :> b₁) (b₂ := x₂ :> b₂) hf
          (by intro i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb])
          hrel hfunc φ
      exact this.mp (h (I.symm x₂))
    · intro h x₁
      have : φ.Eval (x₁ :> b₁) f₁ ↔ φ.Eval (I x₁ :> b₂) f₂ :=
        eval_iff_of_equiv I (b₁ := x₁ :> b₁) (b₂ := I x₁ :> b₂) hf
          (by intro i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb])
          hrel hfunc φ
      exact this.mpr (h _)
  | ∃¹ φ => by
    suffices
      (∃ x₁, φ.Eval (x₁ :> b₁) f₁) ↔ (∃ x₂, φ.Eval (x₂ :> b₂) f₂) by simpa
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x₁, h⟩
      have : φ.Eval (x₁ :> b₁) f₁ ↔ φ.Eval (I x₁ :> b₂) f₂ :=
        eval_iff_of_equiv I (b₁ := x₁ :> b₁) (b₂ := I x₁ :> b₂) hf
          (by intro i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb])
          hrel hfunc φ
      exact ⟨I x₁, this.mp h⟩
    · rintro ⟨x₂, h⟩
      have : φ.Eval (I.symm x₂ :> b₁) f₁ ↔ φ.Eval (x₂ :> b₂) f₂ :=
        eval_iff_of_equiv I (b₁ := I.symm x₂ :> b₁) (b₂ := x₂ :> b₂) hf
          (by intro i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb])
          hrel hfunc φ
      exact ⟨I.symm x₂, this.mpr h⟩

name: of_equiv
statement:
lemma of_equiv
    (I : M₁ ≃ M₂)
    (hrel : ∀ {k} (R : L.Rel k) {v₁ : Fin k → M₁} {v₂ : Fin k → M₂}, (∀ i, I (v₁ i) = v₂ i) → (s₁.rel R v₁ ↔ s₂.rel R v₂))
    (hfunc : ∀ {k} (f : L.Func k) {v₁ : Fin k → M₁} {v₂ : Fin k → M₂}, (∀ i, I (v₁ i) = v₂ i) → I (s₁.func f v₁) = s₂.func f v₂) :
    M₁ ≡ₑ[L] M₂
proof:
:= ⟨fun {φ} ↦
  eval_iff_of_equiv
    (b₁ := ![]) (b₂ := ![]) (f₁ := Empty.elim) (f₂ := Empty.elim) I (by simp) (by simp) hrel hfunc φ⟩

name: lMap_func
statement: @[simp] lemma lMap_func {k} {f : L₁.Func k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).func f v = s₂.func (φ.func f) v

name: lMap_rel
statement: @[simp] lemma lMap_rel {k} {r : L₁.Rel k} {v : Fin k → M} : (s₂.lMap φ).rel r v ↔ s₂.rel (φ.rel r) v

name: val_bvar
statement: @[simp] lemma val_bvar (x) : val b f (#x : Semiterm L ξ n) = b x

name: val_fvar
statement: @[simp] lemma val_fvar (x) : val b f (&x : Semiterm L ξ n) = f x

name: val_func
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_func {k} (F : L.Func k) (v) :
    (func F v).val b f = s.func F (Semiterm.val b f ∘ v)

name: val_func'
statement:
lemma val_func' {k} (F : L.Func k) (v) :
    (func F v).val b f = s.func F fun i ↦ Semiterm.val b f (v i)

name: val_rew
statement:
lemma val_rew (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n₁) :
    (ω t).val b₂ f₂ = t.val (val b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ bvar) (val b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ fvar)

name: val_rewrite
statement:
lemma val_rewrite (f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n) (t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewrite f t).val b f₂ = t.val b (val b f₂ ∘ f)

name: val_rewriteMap
statement:
lemma val_rewriteMap (f : ξ₁ → ξ₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ₁ n) :
    (Rew.rewriteMap f t).val b f₂ = t.val b (f₂ ∘ f)

name: val_substs
statement:
lemma val_substs (w : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L ξ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.subst w t).val b₂ f = t.val (val b₂ f ∘ w) f

name: val_bShift
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_bShift (a : M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val (a :> b) f = t.val b f

name: val_bShift'
statement:
lemma val_bShift' (b : Fin (n + 1) → M) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    (Rew.bShift t).val b f = t.val (b ·.succ) f

name: val_emb
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_emb {o : Type v'} [i : IsEmpty o] (t : Semiterm L o n) :
    (Rew.emb t : Semiterm L ξ n).val b f = t.val b i.elim
proof:
:= by
  simp only [val_rew]; congr; funext x; exact i.elim' x

name: val_castLE
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (t : Semiterm L ξ n₁) :
    (Rew.castLE h t).val b₂ f = t.val (fun x ↦ b₂ (x.castLE h)) f

name: val_embSubsts
statement:
lemma val_embSubsts (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (t : Semiterm L Empty k) :
    (Rew.embSubsts w t).val b f = t.valb (val b f ∘ w)

name: val_lMap
statement:
lemma val_lMap (φ : L₁ →ᵥ L₂) (s₂ : Structure L₂ M) (b : Fin n → M) (f : ξ → M) {t : Semiterm L₁ ξ n} :
    (t.lMap φ).val (s := s₂) b f = t.val (s := s₂.lMap φ) b f
proof:
:= by
  induction t <;> simp [*, val_func, Semiterm.lMap_func, Function.comp_def]

name: val_shift
statement:
lemma val_shift (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.shift t).val b f = t.val b (f ∘ Nat.succ)

name: val_free
statement:
lemma val_free (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L (n + 1)) :
    (Rew.free t).val b (a :>ₙ f) = t.val (b <: a) f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [val_rew]
  congr; exact funext <| Fin.lastCases (by simp) (by simp)

name: val_fix
statement:
lemma val_fix (a : M) (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) :
    (Rew.fix t).val (b <: a) f = t.val b (a :>ₙ f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [val_rew]; congr
  · simp [Function.comp_def]
  · simpa [Function.comp_def] using funext (Nat.cases (by simp) (by simp))

name: val_eq_of_funEqOn
statement:
lemma val_eq_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn t.FVar? f f') :
    t.val b f = t.val b f'
proof:
:= by
  induction t
  case bvar => simp
  case fvar x =>
    exact h x (by simp [FVar?])
  case func k f v ih =>
    simp only [val_func, Function.comp_def]
    congr; funext i; exact ih i (by intro x hx; exact h x (by simpa using ⟨i, hx⟩))

name: val_toEmpty
statement: lemma val_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (t : Semiterm L ξ n) (h : t.freeVariables = ∅) : t.val b f = (t.toEmpty h).valb b
proof:
:= by
  induction t
  case bvar => simp [Semiterm.toEmpty]
  case fvar => simp at h
  case func k f v ih =>
    simp only [val_func]
    have : ∀ i, (v i).freeVariables = ∅ := by
      simpa [Semiterm.freeVariables_func, Finset.biUnion_eq_empty] using h
    congr 1; funext i
    exact ih i (this i)

name: ofEquiv_func
statement:
lemma ofEquiv_func (f : L.Func k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (ofEquiv Θ).func f v = Θ (func f (Θ.symm ∘ v))

name: ofEquiv_val
statement:
lemma ofEquiv_val (b : Fin n → N) (f : ξ → N) (t : Semiterm L ξ n) :
    t.val (s := ofEquiv Θ) b f = Θ (t.val (Θ.symm ∘ b) (Θ.symm ∘ f))
proof:
:= by
  induction t <;> simp [*, Semiterm.val_func, ofEquiv_func Θ, Function.comp_def]

name: EvalAux_neg
statement:
@[simp] lemma EvalAux_neg (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    EvalAux s f b (∼φ) = ¬EvalAux s f b φ
proof:
:=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*, EvalAux, or_iff_not_imp_left]

name: Eval.of_eq
statement:
lemma Eval.of_eq {b e' : Fin n → M} {f f' : ξ → M}
    {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (h : Eval b f φ) (he : b = e') (hf : f = f') : Eval e' f' φ

name: eval_rel
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_rel {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    Eval b f (rel r v) ↔ s.rel r (Semiterm.val b f ∘ v)

name: eval_rel'
statement:
lemma eval_rel' {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    Eval b f (rel r v) ↔ s.rel r fun i ↦ (v i).val b f

name: eval_nrel
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_nrel {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    Eval b f (nrel r v) ↔ ¬s.rel r (Semiterm.val b f ∘ v)

name: eval_nrel'
statement:
lemma eval_nrel' {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    Eval b f (nrel r v) ↔ ¬s.rel r fun i ↦ (v i).val b f

name: eval_all
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_all {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} :
    Eval b f (∀¹ φ) ↔ ∀ x : M, Eval (x :> b) f φ

name: eval_ex
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_ex {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} :
    Eval b f (∃¹ φ) ↔ ∃ x : M, Eval (x :> b) f φ

name: eval_ball
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_ball {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} :
    Eval b f (∀¹[φ] ψ) ↔ ∀ x : M, Eval (x :> b) f φ → Eval (x :> b) f ψ

name: eval_bexs
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_bexs {φ ψ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)} :
    Eval b f (∃¹[φ] ψ) ↔ ∃ x : M, Eval (x :> b) f φ ⋏ Eval (x :> b) f ψ

name: eval_allClosure
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_allClosure {b} {φ : Semiformula L ξ k} :
    Eval b f (∀¹* φ) ↔ ∀ e', Eval e' f φ
proof:
:=
  match k with
  |     0 => by simp [eq_finZeroElim]
  | k + 1 => by simpa [allClosure_succ, eval_allClosure (k := k), Matrix.vecForall_iff] using forall_comm

name: eval_exsClosure
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_exsClosure {b} {φ : Semiformula L ξ k} :
    Eval b f (∃¹* φ) ↔ ∃ e', Eval e' f φ
proof:
:=
  match k with
  |     0 => by simp [eq_finZeroElim]
  | k + 1 => by simpa [exsClosure_succ, eval_exsClosure (k := k), Matrix.vecExists_iff] using exists_comm

name: eval_allItr
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_allItr {b} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)} :
    Eval b f (∀¹^[k] φ) ↔ ∀ e', Eval (Matrix.appendr e' b) f φ
proof:
:=
  match k with
  |     0 => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
  | k + 1 => by simpa [allItr_succ, eval_allItr (k := k), Matrix.vecForall_iff] using forall_comm

name: eval_exsItr
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_exsItr {b} {φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + k)} :
    Eval b f (∃¹^[k] φ) ↔ ∃ e', Eval (Matrix.appendr e' b) f φ
proof:
:=
  match k with
  |     0 => by simp [Matrix.empty_eq]
  | k + 1 => by simpa [exsItr_succ, eval_exsItr (k := k), Matrix.vecExists_iff] using exists_comm

name: eval_rew
statement:
lemma eval_rew {n₁ n₂ b₂ f₂} (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    Eval b₂ f₂ (ω ▹ φ) ↔ Eval (Semiterm.val (s := s) b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ Semiterm.bvar) (Semiterm.val (s := s) b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ Semiterm.fvar) φ
proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  | .rel r v | .nrel r v =>
    simp only [rew_rel_eq_comp, eval_rel, eval_nrel]; apply iff_of_eq
    congr; funext i
    simp [Semiterm.val_rew]
  | ⊤ | ⊥ => simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ | φ ⋎ ψ => simp [eval_rew ω φ, eval_rew ω ψ]
  | ∀¹ φ =>
    simpa [Function.comp_def, eval_rew ω.q φ] using
      iff_of_eq <| forall_congr fun x ↦ by congr; funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp
  | ∃¹ φ =>
    simpa [Function.comp_def, eval_rew ω.q φ] using
      exists_congr fun x ↦ iff_of_eq $ by congr; funext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: eval_rew_q
statement:
lemma eval_rew_q {f₂ : ξ₂ → M} (ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1)) :
    Eval (x :> b₂) f₂ (ω.q ▹ φ) ↔
    Eval
      (x :> Semiterm.val b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ Semiterm.bvar)
      (Semiterm.val b₂ f₂ ∘ ω ∘ Semiterm.fvar) φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Rew.q_fvar, Semiterm.val_bShift]
  apply iff_of_eq; congr 2
  · funext x
    cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: eval_map
statement:
lemma eval_map (θ : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂) (η : ξ₁ → ξ₂) (b : Fin n₂ → M) (f : ξ₂ → M) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁) :
    Eval b f ((Rew.map (L := L) θ η) ▹ φ) ↔ Eval (b ∘ θ) (f ∘ η) φ

name: eval_rewrite
statement:
lemma eval_rewrite (f : ξ₁ → Semiterm L ξ₂ n) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n) :
    Eval b f₂ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) ↔ Eval b (fun x ↦ (f x).val b f₂) φ

name: eval_rewriteMap
statement:
lemma eval_rewriteMap (f : ξ₁ → ξ₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n) :
    Eval b f₂ (Rew.rewriteMap (L := L) (n := n) f ▹ φ) ↔ Eval b (fun x ↦ f₂ (f x)) φ

name: eval_castLE
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_castLE (h : n₁ ≤ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L ξ n₁) :
    Eval b₂ f (@Rew.castLE L ξ _ _ h ▹ φ) ↔ Eval (fun x ↦ b₂ (x.castLE h)) f φ

name: eval_bShift
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_bShift (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    Eval (x :> b) f (@Rew.bShift L ξ n ▹ φ) ↔ Eval b f φ

name: eval_bShift'
statement:
lemma eval_bShift' (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) :
    Eval e' f (@Rew.bShift L ξ n ▹ φ) ↔ Eval (e' ·.succ) f φ

name: eval_substs
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_substs {k} (w : Fin k → Semiterm L ξ n) (φ : Semiformula L ξ k) :
    Eval b f (φ ⇜ w) ↔ φ.Eval (Semiterm.val b f ∘ w) f

name: eval_insert1
statement:
lemma eval_insert1 {n} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 1)) (u w : M) (e : Fin n → M) :
    Eval (u :> w :> e) f (φ ⇜ (#0 :> (#·.succ.succ))) ↔ Eval (u :> e) f φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_substs]
  exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun c => Eval c f φ)
    (funext fun i => by induction i using Fin.cases <;> simp))

name: eval_insert2
statement:
lemma eval_insert2 {n} (φ : Semiformula L ξ (n + 2)) (u x w : M) (e : Fin n → M) :
    Eval (u :> x :> w :> e) f (φ ⇜ (#0 :> #1 :> (#·.succ.succ.succ))) ↔ Eval (u :> x :> e) f φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_substs, Function.comp_def]
  exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun c => Eval c f φ)
    (Fin.funext_two (by simp) (by simp) fun i => by simp))

@[simp] lemma eval_empty [h : IsEmpty o] (φ : Formula L o) :

@[simp] lemma eval_free (φ : Semiproposition L (n + 1)) :
    Eval b (a :>ₙ f) (@Rew.free L n ▹ φ) ↔ Eval (b <: a) f φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_rew, Function.comp_def, Rew.free_fvar, Semiterm.val_fvar, Nat.cases_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

name: eval_iff_of_funEqOn
statement:
lemma eval_iff_of_funEqOn [DecidableEq ξ] {n b} (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) (h : Function.funEqOn φ.FVar? f f') :
    Eval b f φ ↔ Eval b f' φ
proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  |  .rel r v =>
    simp only [eval_rel]; apply iff_of_eq; congr 1
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.val_eq_of_funEqOn (v i) (fun x hx ↦ h x (fvar?_rel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩))
  | .nrel r v =>
    simp only [eval_nrel]; apply iff_of_eq; congr 2
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.val_eq_of_funEqOn (v i) (fun x hx ↦ h x (fvar?_nrel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩))
  | ⊤ | ⊥ => simp
  |     φ ⋏ ψ =>
    suffices Eval b f φ ∧ Eval b f ψ ↔ Eval b f' φ ∧ Eval b f' ψ by simpa
    apply and_congr
    · exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
    · exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn ψ fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
  |     φ ⋎ ψ =>
    suffices Eval b f φ ∨ Eval b f ψ ↔ Eval b f' φ ∨ Eval b f' ψ by simpa
    apply or_congr
    · exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
    · exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn ψ fun x hx ↦ h x (by simp [hx])
  |      ∀¹ φ =>
    suffices (∀ x, Eval (x :> b) f φ) ↔ (∀ x, Eval (x :> b) f' φ) by simpa
    apply forall_congr'; intro x
    exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ fun x hx ↦ h _ (by simpa [FVar?])
  |      ∃¹ φ =>
    suffices (∃ x, Eval (x :> b) f φ) ↔ (∃ x, Eval (x :> b) f' φ) by simpa
    apply exists_congr; intro x
    exact eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ fun x hx ↦ h _ (by simpa [FVar?])

name: eval_toEmpty
statement: lemma eval_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] {n} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} (hp : φ.freeVariables = ∅) {b} : Eval b f φ ↔ Evalb b (φ.toEmpty hp)
proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  |  .rel r v =>
    simp only [eval_rel]
    apply iff_of_eq; congr 2; funext i
    simpa [Semiterm.val_toEmpty] using Semiterm.val_toEmpty _ ?_
  | .nrel r v =>
    apply iff_of_eq; congr; funext i
    rw [Semiterm.val_toEmpty]
  | ⊤ | ⊥ => simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ | φ ⋎ ψ =>
    simp [eval_toEmpty (φ := φ) (by simp [by simpa [Finset.union_eq_empty] using hp]),
      eval_toEmpty (φ := ψ) (by simp [by simpa [Finset.union_eq_empty] using hp])]
  | ∀¹ φ =>
    have : ∀ x, Eval (x :> b) f φ ↔ Evalb (x :> b) (φ.toEmpty hp) :=
      fun x ↦ eval_toEmpty (φ := φ) (b := (x :> b)) (by simpa using hp)
    simp [this]
  | ∃¹ φ =>
    have : ∀ x, Eval (x :> b) f φ ↔ Evalb (x :> b) (φ.toEmpty hp) :=
      fun x ↦ eval_toEmpty (φ := φ) (b := (x :> b)) (by simpa using hp)
    simp [this]

name: eval_univCl'
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_univCl' {f : ℕ → M} (φ : Proposition L) :
    Evalf f φ.univCl' ↔ ∀ g : ℕ → M, Evalf g φ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [univCl', eval_allClosure, eval_rew, Matrix.empty_eq, Function.comp_def]
  constructor
  · intro h g
    refine (eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ ?_).mp (h (fun x ↦ g x))
    intro x hx; simp [Rew.fixitr_fvar, lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hx]
  · intro h g
    refine (eval_iff_of_funEqOn φ ?_).mp (h (fun x ↦ if hx : x < φ.fvSup then g ⟨x, by simp [hx]⟩ else f 0))
    intro x hx; simp [Rew.fixitr_fvar, lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hx]

name: eval_univCl
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_univCl [Nonempty M] (φ : Proposition L) :
    Realize M φ.univCl ↔ ∀ f : ℕ → M, Evalf f φ
proof:
:= by
  have : Inhabited M := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty inferInstance
  simp [Semiformula.univCl, ←eval_toEmpty (f := default)]

name: eval_enumerateFVar_idxOfFVar_eq_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_enumerateFVar_idxOfFVar_eq_id [DecidableEq M] [Inhabited M] (φ : Semiformula L M n) (v) :
    φ.Eval v (fun x ↦ φ.enumerateFVar (φ.idxOfFVar x)) ↔ φ.Eval v id
proof:
:=
  Semiformula.eval_iff_of_funEqOn _ <| by
    intro x hx; simp [Semiformula.enumerateFVar_idxOfFVar (Semiformula.mem_fvarList_iff_fvar?.mpr hx)]

name: ofEquiv_rel
statement:
lemma ofEquiv_rel (r : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → N) :
    (Structure.ofEquiv Θ).rel r v ↔ Structure.rel r (Θ.symm ∘ v)

name: eval_ofEquiv_iff
statement:
lemma eval_ofEquiv_iff {b : Fin n → N} {f : ξ → N} {φ : Semiformula L ξ n} :
    Eval (s := ofEquiv Θ) b f φ ↔ Eval (Θ.symm ∘ b) (Θ.symm ∘ f) φ
proof:
:=
  match φ with
  | .rel r v | .nrel r v => by simp [Function.comp_def, ofEquiv_rel Θ, Structure.ofEquiv_val Θ]
  | ⊤ | ⊥ => by simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ | φ ⋎ ψ => by simp [eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := φ), eval_ofEquiv_iff (φ := ψ)]
  | ∀¹ φ =>
    ⟨fun h x ↦ by have h' := eval_ofEquiv_iff.mp (h (Θ x)); simp only [Matrix.comp_vecCons'', Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h'; exact h',
     fun h x ↦ eval_ofEquiv_iff.mpr (by simp only [Matrix.comp_vecCons'']; exact h (Θ.symm x))⟩
  | ∃¹ φ =>
    ⟨by rintro ⟨x, h⟩; exists Θ.symm x; have h' := eval_ofEquiv_iff.mp h; simp only [Matrix.comp_vecCons''] at h'; exact h',
     by rintro ⟨x, h⟩; exists Θ x; apply eval_ofEquiv_iff.mpr; simp only [Matrix.comp_vecCons'', Equiv.symm_apply_apply]; exact h⟩

name: evalf_ofEquiv_iff
statement:
lemma evalf_ofEquiv_iff {f : ξ → N} {φ : Formula L ξ} :
    Evalf (s := ofEquiv Θ) f φ ↔ Evalf (s := s) (Θ.symm ∘ f) φ
proof: := by simpa using eval_ofEquiv_iff (Θ := Θ) (f := f) (φ := φ) (b := ![])

statement:
lemma consequence_iff {φ} :

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ _ hT ↦ h hT, fun h s hT ↦ h s.Dom hT⟩

statement:

    T ⊨[Struc.{v, u} L] φ ↔ (∀ (M : Type v) [Nonempty M] [Structure L M] [M↓[L] ⊧* T], M↓[L] ⊧ φ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ s _ ↦ Semantics.consequence_iff'.mp h s.toStruc,
   fun h s hs ↦ @h s.Dom s.nonempty s.struc hs⟩

statement:
lemma satisfiable_iff :
    Semantics.Satisfiable (Struc.{v, u} L) T ↔ ∃ (M : Type v) (_ : Nonempty M) (_ : Structure L M), M↓[L] ⊧* T
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨s, hs⟩; exact ⟨s.Dom, s.nonempty, s.struc, hs⟩, by rintro ⟨M, i, s, hT⟩; exact ⟨s.toStruc, hT⟩⟩

name: consequence_iff_unsatisfiable
statement:
lemma consequence_iff_unsatisfiable {σ : Sentence L} :
    T ⊨[Struc.{v, u} L] σ ↔ ¬Semantics.Satisfiable (Struc.{v, u} L) (insert (∼σ) T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply unsatisfiable_iff.mpr
    intro M _ s; simp only [Semantics.ModelsSet.insert_iff, models_iff, not_and']
    intro hT; simpa using models_iff.mp (h hT)
  · intro h; apply consequence_iff.mpr
    intro M _ s hT
    have : σ.Realize M := by
      have := by simpa only [Semantics.ModelsSet.insert_iff, not_and', models_iff] using unsatisfiable_iff.mp h M inferInstance s
      simpa using this hT
    apply models_iff.mpr (by simpa using this)

name: lt_fvSup_of_fvar
statement: lemma lt_fvSup_of_fvar? {φ : Semiproposition L n} : φ.FVar? m → m < φ.fvSup
proof:
:= by
  unfold fvSup FVar?
  intro hm
  have : ∃ s : ℕ, φ.freeVariables.max = s := Finset.max_of_mem hm
  rcases this with ⟨s, hs⟩
  have : m ≤ s := by
    have : (m : WithBot ℕ) ≤ ↑s := by simpa [hs, -Nat.cast_le] using Finset.le_max hm
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp this
  simpa [hs, WithBot.recBotCoe] using Nat.lt_add_one_of_le this

name: map_inj
statement:
private lemma map_inj {b : Fin n₁ → Fin n₂} {f : ξ₁ → ξ₂}
    (hb : Function.Injective b) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective fun φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁ ↦ @Rew.map L ξ₁ ξ₂ n₁ n₂ b f ▹ φ
  | rel r v => fun φ ↦
    match φ with
    | rel s w => by
      simp only [rew_rel, rel.injEq, and_imp]
      rintro rfl; simp only [heq_eq_eq, true_and]; rintro rfl h; simp only [true_and]
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
    | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => by simp
  | nrel r v => fun φ ↦
    match φ with
    | nrel s w => by
      simp only [rew_nrel, nrel.injEq, and_imp]
      rintro rfl; simp only [heq_eq_eq, true_and]; rintro rfl h; simp only [true_and]
      funext i; exact Rew.map_inj hb hf (congr_fun h i)
     | rel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => by simp
  | ⊤ => by intro φ; cases φ using cases' <;> simp
  | ⊥ => by intro φ; cases φ using cases' <;> simp
  | φ ⋏ ψ => fun χ ↦
    match χ with
    | _ ⋏ _ => by
      simp only [LogicalConnective.HomClass.map_and, and_inj, and_imp]
      intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
    | rel _ _ | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => by simp
  | φ ⋎ ψ => fun χ ↦
    match χ with
    | _ ⋎ _ => by
      simp only [LogicalConnective.HomClass.map_or, or_inj, and_imp]
      intro hp hq; exact ⟨map_inj hb hf hp, map_inj hb hf hq⟩
    | rel _ _ | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => by simp
  | ∀¹ φ => fun ψ ↦
    match ψ with
    | ∀¹ _ => by
      simp only [Rewriting.app_all, Rew.q_map, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, all_inj]
      exact fun h ↦ map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
        (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
    | rel _ _ | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∃¹ _ => by simp
  | ∃¹ φ => fun ψ ↦
    match ψ with
    | ∃¹ _ => by
      simp only [Rewriting.app_exs, Rew.q_map, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, exs_inj]
      exact fun h ↦ map_inj (b := 0 :> Fin.succ ∘ b)
        (Matrix.injective_vecCons ((Fin.succ_injective _).comp hb) (fun _ ↦ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm)) hf h
    | rel _ _ | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ => by simp

name: eq_rel_iff
statement:
lemma eq_rel_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
    ω ▹ φ = Semiformula.rel r v ↔ ∃ v', ω ∘ v' = v ∧ φ = Semiformula.rel r v'
proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  | rel (arity := k') r' v' =>
    simp only [rew_rel, rel.injEq]
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]
  | nrel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => simp

proof:
:= by
  match φ with
  | nrel (arity := k') r' v' =>
    simp only [rew_nrel]
    by_cases hk : k' = k <;> simp [hk]; rcases hk with rfl; simp
    by_cases hr : r' = r <;> simp [hr, funext_iff]
  | rel _ _ | ⊤ | ⊥ | _ ⋏ _ | _ ⋎ _ | ∀¹ _ | ∃¹ _ => simp

name: eq_neg_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma eq_neg_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ n₂} :
    ω ▹ φ = ψ₁ 🡒 ψ₂ ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁, ω ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = φ₁ 🡒 φ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [imp_eq, eq_or_iff, exists_and_left]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, hp₁, ψ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨∼φ₁, by simp [hp₁]⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; exact ⟨∼φ₁, by simp, φ₂, by simp⟩

name: eq_ball_iff
statement:
lemma eq_ball_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    (ω ▹ φ = ∀¹[ψ₁] ψ₂) ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω.q ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = ∀¹[φ₁] φ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ball, eq_all_iff, eq_neg_iff, exists_and_left]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ', ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; simp

name: eq_bexs_iff
statement:
lemma eq_bexs_iff {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₂ (n₂ + 1)} :
    (ω ▹ φ = ∃¹[ψ₁] ψ₂) ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂ : Semiformula L ξ₁ (n₁ + 1), ω.q ▹ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ ω.q ▹ φ₂ = ψ₂ ∧ φ = ∃¹[φ₁] φ₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bexs, eq_exs_iff, eq_and_iff, exists_and_left]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ', ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ₁, rfl, φ₂, rfl, rfl⟩; simp

name: coe_rel
statement:
lemma coe_rel [IsEmpty ο] {k : ℕ} (R : L.Rel k) (v : Fin k → Semiterm L ο n) :

name: fvar
statement:
lemma fvar?_rew [DecidableEq ξ₁] [DecidableEq ξ₂]
    {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ n₁} {ω : Rew L ξ₁ n₁ ξ₂ n₂}
    {x} (h : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x) :
    (∃ i : Fin n₁, (ω #i).FVar? x) ∨ (∃ z : ξ₁, φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x)
proof:
:= by
  induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂
  case hverum => simp [FVar?] at h
  case hfalsum => simp [FVar?] at h
  case hrel n k r v =>
    have : ∃ i, (ω (v i)).FVar? x := by simpa [rew_rel, fvar?_rel] using h
    rcases this with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases Semiterm.fvar?_rew hi with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨z, by simpa using ⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩
  case hnrel n k r v =>
    have : ∃ i, (ω (v i)).FVar? x := by simpa [rew_nrel, fvar?_rel] using h
    rcases this with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases Semiterm.fvar?_rew hi with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
    · left; exact h
    · right; exact ⟨z, by simpa using ⟨i, hi⟩, hz⟩
  case hand n φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    have : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x ∨ (ω ▹ ψ).FVar? x := by simpa using h
    rcases this with (h | h)
    · rcases ihp h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
    · rcases ihq h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
  case hor n φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    have : (ω ▹ φ).FVar? x ∨ (ω ▹ ψ).FVar? x := by simpa using h
    rcases this with (h | h)
    · rcases ihp h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
    · rcases ihq h with (h | ⟨z, hi, hz⟩)
      · exact .inl h
      · exact .inr ⟨z, by simp [hi], hz⟩
  case hall n φ ihp =>
    have : (Rew.bind (#0 :> fun i ↦ Rew.bShift (ω #i)) (fun z ↦ Rew.bShift (ω &z)) ▹ φ).FVar? x := h
    rcases ihp this with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩)
    · cases z using Fin.cases
      case zero => simp at hz
      case succ i =>
        have : (ω #i).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
        exact .inl ⟨i, this⟩
    · have : φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
      exact .inr ⟨z, this⟩
  case hexs n φ ihp =>
    have : (Rew.bind (#0 :> fun i ↦ Rew.bShift (ω #i)) (fun z ↦ Rew.bShift (ω &z)) ▹ φ).FVar? x := h
    rcases ihp this with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩)
    · cases z using Fin.cases
      case zero => simp at hz
      case succ i =>
        have : (ω #i).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
        left; exact ⟨i, this⟩
    · have : φ.FVar? z ∧ (ω &z).FVar? x := by simpa using hz
      right; exact ⟨z, this⟩

name: freeVariables_emb
statement:
@[simp] lemma freeVariables_emb [DecidableEq ξ] {ο : Type*} [IsEmpty ο] (φ : Semiformula L ο n) :
    (Rewriting.emb φ : Semiformula L ξ n).freeVariables = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  suffices x ∉ (Rewriting.emb φ : Semiformula L ξ n).freeVariables by simpa using this
  intro hx
  rcases fvar?_rew hx with (⟨i, hi⟩ | ⟨z, _⟩)
  · simp at hi
  · exact IsEmpty.elim inferInstance z

name: rew_eq_of_funEqOn
proof:
:= by
  induction φ using rec' generalizing n₂
  case hverum => simp
  case hfalsum => simp
  case hrel =>
    simp only [rew_rel, rel.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.rew_eq_of_funEqOn _ _ _ hb
      (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ fvar?_rel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
  case hnrel =>
    simp only [rew_nrel, nrel.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    funext i
    exact Semiterm.rew_eq_of_funEqOn _ _ _ hb
      (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ fvar?_nrel.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
  case hand ihp ihq =>
    simp only [LogicalConnective.HomClass.map_and, and_inj]
    exact ⟨ihp hb (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ by simp [hx]), ihq hb (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ by simp [hx])⟩
  case hor ihp ihq =>
    simp only [LogicalConnective.HomClass.map_or, or_inj]
    exact ⟨ihp hb (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ by simp [hx]), ihq hb (hf.of_subset fun x hx ↦ by simp [hx])⟩
  case hall ih =>
    simp only [Rewriting.app_all, all_inj]
    exact ih (fun x ↦ by cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb]) (fun x hx ↦ by simpa using congr_arg _ (hf x hx))
  case hexs ih =>
    simp only [Rewriting.app_exs, exs_inj]
    exact ih (fun x ↦ by cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp [hb]) (fun x hx ↦ by simpa using congr_arg _ (hf x hx))

name: rew_eq_of_funEqOn
statement:
lemma rew_eq_of_funEqOn₀ [DecidableEq ξ₁] {ω₁ ω₂ : Rew L ξ₁ 0 ξ₂ n₂} {φ : Semiformula L ξ₁ 0}
    (hf : Function.funEqOn (φ.FVar?) (ω₁ ∘ Semiterm.fvar) (ω₂ ∘ Semiterm.fvar)) : ω₁ ▹ φ = ω₂ ▹ φ

name: rew_eq_self_of
proof:
:= by
  suffices ω ▹ φ = Rew.id ▹ φ by rwa [ReflectiveRewriting.id_app] at this
  apply rew_eq_of_funEqOn
  · intro x; simpa using hb x
  · intro x hx; simp [hf x hx]

name: ex_ne_subst
statement: @[simp] lemma ex_ne_subst (φ : Semiformula L ξ 1) (t) : φ/[t] ≠ ∃¹ φ

name: fvSup_sentence
statement: @[simp] lemma fvSup_sentence (σ : Semisentence L n) : (Rewriting.emb σ).fvSup = 0
proof:
:= by
    induction σ using rec' <;> simp [fvSup, -rew_rel_eq_comp, -rew_nrel_eq_comp]

name: not_fvar
statement: private lemma not_fvar?_fixitr_fvSup (φ : Proposition L) : ¬(Rew.fixitr 0 φ.fvSup ▹ φ).FVar? x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rew.eq_bind (Rew.fixitr 0 φ.fvSup)]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Rew.fixitr_bvar, Rew.fixitr_fvar, Fin.natAdd_mk, zero_add]
  intro h
  rcases fvar?_rew h with (⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz, hx⟩)
  · simp at hz
  · have : z < φ.fvSup := lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hz
    simp [this] at hx

name: subst_comp_fixitr_eq_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_comp_fixitr_eq_map (φ : Proposition L) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) :
    (Rew.fixitr 0 φ.fvSup ▹ φ)⇜(fun x ↦ f x) = Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold Rewriting.subst; rw [← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]
  apply rew_eq_of_funEqOn
  · simp
  · intro x hx
    simp [Rew.comp_app, Rew.fixitr_fvar, Semiformula.lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hx]

name: subst_comp_fixitr
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_comp_fixitr (φ : Proposition L) :
    (Rew.fixitr 0 φ.fvSup ▹ φ)⇜(fun x ↦ (&x : SyntacticTerm L)) = φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold Rewriting.subst; rw [← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]
  apply rew_eq_self_of
  · simp
  · intro x hx
    simp [Rew.comp_app, Rew.fixitr_fvar, Semiformula.lt_fvSup_of_fvar? hx]

name: rew_univCl'
statement:
@[simp] lemma rew_univCl' (φ : Proposition L) (ω : SyntacticRew L 0 0) :

name: univCl'_eq_self_of
statement: lemma univCl'_eq_self_of (φ : Proposition L) (h : φ.freeVariables = ∅) : φ.univCl' = φ
proof:

  simp only [univCl']; rw [this]; simp

  simpa [univCl'] using not_fvar?_fixitr_fvSup φ

name: emb_toEmpty
statement: @[simp] lemma emb_toEmpty [DecidableEq ξ] (φ : Semiformula L ξ n) (hp : φ.freeVariables = ∅) : Rewriting.emb (φ.toEmpty hp) = φ
proof:
:= by
  induction φ using rec' with
  | hall φ ih => simp only [toEmpty, Rewriting.app_all, Rew.q_emb]; congr 1; exact ih hp
  | hexs φ ih => simp only [toEmpty, Rewriting.app_exs, Rew.q_emb]; congr 1; exact ih hp
  | _ => simp [toEmpty, Function.comp_def, *]

name: toEmpty_emb

statement:
lemma lMap_bind (b : Fin n₁ → Semiterm L₁ ξ₂ n₂) (e : ξ₁ → Semiterm L₁ ξ₂ n₂) (φ : Semiformula L₁ ξ₁ n₁) :
    lMap Φ (Rew.bind b e ▹ φ) = Rew.bind (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ b) (Semiterm.lMap Φ ∘ e) ▹ (lMap Φ φ)
proof:
:= by
  induction φ using rec' generalizing ξ₂ n₂ <;>
  simp [*, lMap_rel, lMap_nrel, Semiterm.lMap_bind, Rew.q_bind, Matrix.comp_vecCons', Semiterm.lMap_bShift, Function.comp_def]

name: isFunc_quote_quote
statement: lemma isFunc_quote_quote {k x : ℕ} : L.IsFunc (V := V) k x ↔ ∃ f : L.Func k, Encodable.encode f = x
proof:
:=
  have : V ⊧/![k, x] L.isFunc.val ↔ ℕ ⊧/![k, x] L.isFunc.val := by
    simpa [Matrix.comp_vecCons', Matrix.constant_eq_singleton]
      using models_iff_of_Sigma0 (V := V) (σ := L.isFunc.val) (by simp) (e := ![k, x])
  Iff.trans this <| Iff.trans L.iff_isFunc.symm <| by simp

name: _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Language.ORing.of_mem_range_encode_func
statement:
lemma _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Language.ORing.of_mem_range_encode_func {k f : ℕ} :
    f ∈ Set.range (Encodable.encode : FirstOrder.Language.Func ℒₒᵣ k → ℕ) ↔
    (k = 0 ∧ f = 0) ∨ (k = 0 ∧ f = 1) ∨ (k = 2 ∧ f = 0) ∨ (k = 2 ∧ f = 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    match k, f with
    | 0, Language.ORing.Func.zero => simp; rfl
    | 0, Language.ORing.Func.one => simp; rfl
    | 2, Language.ORing.Func.add => simp; rfl
    | 2, Language.ORing.Func.mul => simp; rfl
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Func.zero, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Func.one, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Func.add, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Func.mul, rfl⟩

name: _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Language.ORing.of_mem_range_encode_rel
statement:
lemma _root_.FFL.FirstOrder.Language.ORing.of_mem_range_encode_rel {k r : ℕ} :
    r ∈ Set.range (Encodable.encode : FirstOrder.Language.Rel ℒₒᵣ k → ℕ) ↔
    (k = 2 ∧ r = 0) ∨ (k = 2 ∧ r = 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    match k, r with
    | 2, Language.ORing.Rel.eq => simp; rfl
    | 2, Language.ORing.Rel.lt => simp; rfl
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Rel.eq, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Language.ORing.Rel.lt, rfl⟩

name: LOR_func_zeroIndex
statement: @[simp] lemma LOR_func_zeroIndex : (ℒₒᵣ).IsFunc 0 (zeroIndex : V)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! codeIn_func_quote (V := V) (L := ℒₒᵣ) Language.Zero.zero

name: LOR_func_oneIndex
statement: @[simp] lemma LOR_func_oneIndex : (ℒₒᵣ).IsFunc 0 (oneIndex : V)
proof:
:= by

name: isFunc_iff_LOR
statement:
lemma isFunc_iff_LOR {k f : V} :
    (ℒₒᵣ).IsFunc k f ↔
    (k = 0 ∧ f = ⌜(Language.Zero.zero : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 0)⌝) ∨
    (k = 0 ∧ f = ⌜(Language.One.one : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 0)⌝) ∨
    (k = 2 ∧ f = ⌜(Language.Add.add : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 2)⌝) ∨
    (k = 2 ∧ f = ⌜(Language.Mul.mul : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 2)⌝)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isFunc_def (L := ℒₒᵣ), func_def_LOR]
  suffices
    k = 0 ∧ f = 0 ∨ k = 0 ∧ f = 1 ∨ k = 2 ∧ f = 0 ∨ k = 2 ∧ f = 1 ↔ _ by simpa
  apply iff_of_eq
  congr
  · calc
      (1 : V) = (1 : ℕ) := by simp
      _       = ⌜(Language.One.one : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 0)⌝ := by rfl
  · calc
      (1 : V) = (1 : ℕ) := by simp
      _       = ⌜(Language.Mul.mul : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 2)⌝ := by rfl

name: isRel_iff_LOR
statement:
lemma isRel_iff_LOR {k R : V} :
    (ℒₒᵣ).IsRel k R ↔
    (k = 2 ∧ R = ⌜(Language.Eq.eq : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2)⌝) ∨
    (k = 2 ∧ R = ⌜(Language.LT.lt : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2)⌝)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRel_def (L := ℒₒᵣ), rel_def_LOR]
  suffices
    k = 2 ∧ R = 0 ∨ k = 2 ∧ R = 1 ↔ _ by simpa
  apply iff_of_eq
  congr
  · calc (1 : V) = (1 : ℕ) := by simp

    Primrec fun k : ℕ ↦ encode (weight k : Semiformula L ξ n)
proof:
:= by
  have step : Primrec₂ fun _ r : ℕ ↦
      Nat.pair 4 (Nat.pair (encode (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)) r) + 1 :=
    Primrec.nat_add.comp
      (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.const 4)
        (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.const (encode (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n))) Primrec.snd))
      (Primrec.const 1);
  refine (Primrec.nat_rec₁ (encode (⊤ : Semiformula L ξ n)) step).of_eq ?_;

  induction k with
  | zero => simp [weight]
  | succ k ih => simp [encode_weight_succ, ih]

name: quote_eq_qqAnd_iff
statement:
lemma quote_eq_qqAnd_iff {φ : Proposition L} {p q : ℕ} :
    (⌜φ⌝ : ℕ) = p ^⋏ q ↔ ∃ φ₁ φ₂, φ = φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ ∧ p = ⌜φ₁⌝ ∧ q = ⌜φ₂⌝
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . intro h
    cases φ with
    | rel | nrel => simp [qqRel, qqNRel, qqAnd] at h
    | verum =>
      change qqVerum = p ^⋏ q at h;
      simp [qqVerum, qqAnd] at h
    | falsum =>
      change qqFalsum = p ^⋏ q at h;
      simp [qqFalsum, qqAnd] at h
    | or φ₁ φ₂ =>
      change ⌜φ₁⌝ ^⋎ ⌜φ₂⌝ = p ^⋏ q at h;
      simp [qqOr, qqAnd] at h
    | all φ =>
      change ^∀ ⌜φ⌝ = p ^⋏ q at h;
      simp [qqAll, qqAnd] at h
    | exs φ =>
      change ^∃ ⌜φ⌝ = p ^⋏ q at h
      simp [qqExs, qqAnd] at h
    | and φ₁ φ₂ =>
      rcases (qqAnd_inj _ _ _ _).mp h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨φ₁, φ₂, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  . rintro ⟨φ₁, φ₂, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩;
    rfl

name: quote_weight
statement: lemma quote_weight (k : ℕ) : (⌜(Semiformula.weight k : Proposition L)⌝ : V) = qqVerums (k : V)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Semiformula.weight]
  | succ k ih =>
    change ⌜(⊤ : Proposition L) ⋏ Semiformula.weight k⌝ = _
    simp [ih]

name: quote_eq_qqVerums
statement: lemma quote_eq_qqVerums {χ : Proposition L} {s : ℕ} : (⌜χ⌝ : ℕ) = qqVerums (s : ℕ) → χ = Semiformula.weight s

name: Theory.isCraigAxiom_quote_iff
statement:
lemma Theory.isCraigAxiom_quote_iff {T : Theory L} [T.RE] (φ : Proposition L) :
    T.IsCraigAxiom (⌜φ⌝ : ℕ) ↔ ∃ ρ ∈ T.craig, φ = ρ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  . rintro ⟨s, p, hφ, hT⟩
    rcases quote_eq_qqAnd_iff.mp hφ with ⟨φ₁, φ₂, hφ, hp, hs⟩
    have hφ₂ : φ₂ = Semiformula.weight s := quote_eq_qqVerums hs.symm
    have h₁ : ℕ ⊧/![p] T.reCh.val := (Theory.reWitness_spec T ℕ ![p]).mpr ⟨s, hT⟩
    rcases T.exists_mem_of_reCh φ₁ (by simpa [hp] using h₁) with ⟨ρ, hρ, hρ'⟩
    use ρ.padding s
    and_intros
    . use ρ, s
      and_intros
      . simpa [hp, hρ', Sentence.quote_def] using hT
      . rfl
    . rw [Semiformula.rew_padding]
      simpa [Semiformula.padding, Semiformula.weight, hρ', hφ₂] using hφ
  . rintro ⟨ρ, ⟨σ, s, hT, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    use s, ⌜σ⌝
    and_intros
    . simpa [Sentence.quote_def] using Sentence.quote_padding (V := ℕ) σ s
    . exact hT

name: mem_craig_codes_iff
statement:
lemma mem_craig_codes_iff (n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ Encodable.encode '' T.craig ↔
      ∃ s < n, ∃ m < n, (decode₂ (Sentence L) m).isSome ∧
        n = Nat.pair 4 (Nat.pair m
          (encode (Semiformula.weight s : Sentence L))) + 1 ∧
        ℕ ⊧/![s, m] T.reWitness.val

name: primrecPred_craig_core
statement:
lemma primrecPred_craig_core : PrimrecPred fun p : ℕ × (ℕ × ℕ) ↦
    (decode₂ (Sentence L) p.1).isSome ∧
      p.2.1 = Nat.pair 4 (Nat.pair p.1 (encode (Semiformula.weight p.2.2 : Sentence L))) + 1 ∧
      ℕ ⊧/![p.2.2, p.1] T.reWitness.val

name: primrecPred_craig_codes
statement: lemma primrecPred_craig_codes : PrimrecPred (· ∈ Encodable.encode '' T.craig)
proof:
:= by
  refine PrimrecPred.of_eq ?_ fun n ↦ (mem_craig_codes_iff n).symm;
  have hinner : PrimrecPred fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦
      ∃ m < p.1, (decode₂ (Sentence L) m).isSome ∧
        p.1 = Nat.pair 4 (Nat.pair m (encode (Semiformula.weight p.2 : Sentence L))) + 1 ∧
        ℕ ⊧/![p.2, m] T.reWitness.val :=
    ((PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list (primrecPred_craig_core (T := T)).primrecRel).comp
      (Primrec.list_range.comp Primrec.fst) Primrec.id).of_eq (by simp);
  exact ((PrimrecRel.exists_mem_list
      (hinner.comp (Primrec.pair Primrec.snd Primrec.fst)).primrecRel).comp
    Primrec.list_range Primrec.id).of_eq (by simp);

name: vec2_eq

proof:
:=
  nth_ext' 2 (by simp [one_add_one_eq_two]) h (by
    intro i hi
    have : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp (lt_two_iff_le_one.mp hi)

name: term_replace_aux
statement:
lemma term_replace_aux (t : V) :
    IsSemiterm ℒₒᵣ 1 t →
    Provable T (^∀ ^∀ imp ℒₒᵣ (^#1 ^= ^#0) (termSubst ℒₒᵣ (^#1 ∷ 0) t ^= termSubst ℒₒᵣ (^#0 ∷ 0) t))
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.sigma1_induction
  · definability
  case hfunc =>
    intro k F v hF hv ih
    rcases isFunc_iff_LOR.mp hF with (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rcases show v = 0 by simpa using hv
      suffices
          T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ((typedNumeral 0).subst ![#'1] ≐ (typedNumeral 0).subst ![#'0])) by
        have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this
        simpa [-subst_numeral, val_all, Bootstrapping.Arithmetic.coe_zero_eq] using this
      suffices
        T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (typedNumeral 0 ≐ typedNumeral 0)) by simpa
      suffices T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 (typedNumeral 0 ≐ typedNumeral 0) by
        apply TProof.all₂!; simpa [Semiformula.free]
      apply Entailment.dhyp (eq_refl _ _)
    · rcases show v = 0 by simpa using hv
      suffices
          T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ((typedNumeral 1).subst ![#'1] ≐ (typedNumeral 1).subst ![#'0])) by
        have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this
        simpa [-subst_numeral, val_all, Bootstrapping.Arithmetic.coe_one_eq] using this
      suffices
        T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (typedNumeral 1 ≐ typedNumeral 1)) by simpa
      suffices T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 (typedNumeral 1 ≐ typedNumeral 1) by
        apply TProof.all₂!; simpa [Semiformula.free]
      apply Entailment.dhyp (eq_refl _ _)
    · let t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨v.[0], by simpa using hv.nth (by simp)⟩
      let u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨v.[1], by simpa using hv.nth (by simp)⟩

          T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ((t + u).subst ![#'1] ≐ (t + u).subst ![#'0])) by

        rw [veq]
        simpa [-subst_add, val_all] using! this
      let Γ : List (Formula V ℒₒᵣ) := [&'1 ≐ &'0]
      suffices
          Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] + u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] + u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] by
        apply TProof.all₂!; simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiterm.shift_substs, Semiterm.substs_substs]
      have iht : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (t.subst ![#'1] ≐ t.subst ![#'0])) := by
        apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
        simpa [t] using ih 0 (by simp)
      have ihu : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (u.subst ![#'1] ≐ u.subst ![#'0])) := by
        apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
        simpa [u] using ih 1 (by simp)
      have iht : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0]) := by
        have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! iht &'0 &'1
        simpa [Semiterm.shift_substs, Semiterm.substs_substs] using! this
      have ihu : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0]) := by
        have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihu &'0 &'1
        simpa [Semiterm.shift_substs, Semiterm.substs_substs] using! this
      have := subst_add_eq_add T (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1]) (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0])
        (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1]) (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0])
      exact of' this ⨀ iht ⨀ ihu
    · let t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨v.[0], by simpa using hv.nth (by simp)⟩
      let u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨v.[1], by simpa using hv.nth (by simp)⟩
      have veq : v = ?[t.val, u.val] := by simp [t, u, vec2_eq hv.lh]
      suffices
          T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ((t * u).subst ![#'1] ≐ (t * u).subst ![#'0])) by
        have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this
        rw [veq]
        simpa [-subst_mul, val_all] using! this
      let Γ : List (Formula V ℒₒᵣ) := [&'1 ≐ &'0]
      suffices
          Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] * u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] * u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] by

      have iht : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (t.subst ![#'1] ≐ t.subst ![#'0])) := by
        apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
        simpa [t] using ih 0 (by simp)
      have ihu : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (u.subst ![#'1] ≐ u.subst ![#'0])) := by
        apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
        simpa [u] using ih 1 (by simp)
      have iht : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0]) := by
        have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! iht &'0 &'1
        simpa [Semiterm.shift_substs, Semiterm.substs_substs] using! this
      have ihu : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0]) := by
        have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihu &'0 &'1
        simpa [Semiterm.shift_substs, Semiterm.substs_substs] using! this
      have := subst_mul_eq_mul T (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1]) (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0])
        (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1]) (u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0])
      exact of' this ⨀ iht ⨀ ihu
  case hbvar =>
    intro z hz
    have : z = 0 := lt_one_iff_eq_zero.mp hz
    rcases this with rfl
    suffices T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (#'1 ≐ #'0)) by
      have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this

    have : T ⊢ “∀ x y, (x = y → x = y)” := complete.{0} T _ fun (M : Type) _ _ ↦ by simp [models_iff]
    simpa using internal_provable_of_outer_provable this (V := V)

    apply TProof.all₂!

  let Γ : List (Formula V ℒₒᵣ) := [t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1], &'1 ≐ &'0]
  suffices
      Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] ≐ u⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] by

    apply deduct
    exact this
  have hh : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ u⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] :=
    by_axm₀
  have ht : Γ ⊢[T.internalize V] t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1] ≐ t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0] :=

    (subst_eq T (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'1]) (t⇞⇞.subst ![&'0])

name: replace_aux
statement:
lemma replace_aux (φ : V) :
    IsSemiformula ℒₒᵣ 1 φ →
    Provable T (^∀ ^∀ imp ℒₒᵣ (^#1 ^= ^#0) (imp ℒₒᵣ (subst ℒₒᵣ (^#1 ∷ 0) φ) (subst ℒₒᵣ (^#0 ∷ 0) φ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFormula.sigma1_structural_induction₂_ss
  · definability
  case hand =>
    intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    let φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨p, by simpa using hp⟩
    let ψ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨q, by simpa using hq⟩
    suffices T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (φ ⋏ ψ).subst ![#'1] 🡒 (φ ⋏ ψ).subst ![#'0]) by
      have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this
      simpa [-Semiformula.substs_and, -substs_and, φ, ψ] using this
    suffices
        T.internalize V ⊢
          (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] ⋏ ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] ⋏ ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] by
      apply TProof.all₂!
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs]
    have ihφ : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 φ.subst ![#'1] 🡒 φ.subst ![#'0]) := by
      apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
      simpa using ihp
    have ihψ : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ψ.subst ![#'1] 🡒 ψ.subst ![#'0]) := by
      apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
      simpa using ihq
    have ihφ :
        T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] := by
      have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihφ &'0 &'1
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs] using this
    have ihψ :
        T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] := by
      have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihψ &'0 &'1
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs] using this
    cl_prover [ihφ, ihψ]
  case hor =>
    intro p q hp hq ihp ihq
    let φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨p, by simpa using hp⟩
    let ψ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ 1 := ⟨q, by simpa using hq⟩
    suffices T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 (φ ⋎ ψ).subst ![#'1] 🡒 (φ ⋎ ψ).subst ![#'0]) by
      have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this
      simpa [-Semiformula.substs_or, -substs_or, φ, ψ] using this
    suffices
        T.internalize V ⊢
          (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] ⋎ ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] ⋎ ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] by
      apply TProof.all₂!
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs]
    have ihφ : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 φ.subst ![#'1] 🡒 φ.subst ![#'0]) := by
      apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
      simpa using ihp
    have ihψ : T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ψ.subst ![#'1] 🡒 ψ.subst ![#'0]) := by
      apply (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mpr
      simpa using ihq
    have ihφ :
        T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 φ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] := by
      have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihφ &'0 &'1
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs] using this
    have ihψ :
        T.internalize V ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'1] 🡒 ψ⤉⤉.subst ![&'0] := by
      have := TProof.specialize₂_shift! ihψ &'0 &'1
      simpa [Semiformula.free, SemitermVec.q, Semiformula.shift_substs, Semiformula.substs_substs] using this
    cl_prover [ihφ, ihψ]
  case hverum =>
    suffices T.internalize V ⊢ ∀¹ ∀¹ ((#'1 ≐ #'0) 🡒 ⊤ 🡒 ⊤) by
      have := (tprovable_iff_provable (T := T)).mp this

    suffices Theory.internalize V T ⊢ (&'1 ≐ &'0) 🡒 ⊤ 🡒 ⊤ by

  case hfalsum =>
