statement:
lemma termSubstVec_cons {k t ts : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    termSubstVec L (k + 1) w (t ∷ ts) = termSubst L w t ∷ termSubstVec L k w ts

name: termSubstVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termSubstVec_cons₁ {t : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) :
    termSubstVec L 1 w ?[t] = ?[termSubst L w t]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 : V) = 0 + 1  by simp, termSubstVec_cons] <;> simp [*]

name: termSubstVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termSubstVec_cons₂ {t₁ t₂ : V} (ht₁ : IsUTerm L t₁) (ht₂ : IsUTerm L t₂) :
    termSubstVec L 2 w ?[t₁, t₂] = ?[termSubst L w t₁, termSubst L w t₂]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : V) = 0 + 1 + 1  by simp [one_add_one_eq_two], termSubstVec_cons] <;> simp [*]

name: IsSemitermVec.termSubst
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.termSubst {t} (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : IsSemiterm L m (termSubst L w t)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simpa using hw.nth hz
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hkf hv ih
    simp only [hkf, hv.isUTerm, termSubst_func, IsSemiterm.func, true_and]
    exact IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
      ⟨by simp [hv.isUTerm], fun i hi ↦ by rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi]; exact ih i hi⟩

name: IsUTermVec.termSubst
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUTermVec.termSubst {t} (hw : IsUTermVec L n w) (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : IsUTerm L (termSubst L w t)

name: IsSemitermVec.termSubstVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.termSubstVec {k n m v} (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) (hv : IsSemitermVec L k n v) :
    IsSemitermVec L k m (termSubstVec L k w v)
proof:
:= IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
  ⟨by simp [hv.isUTerm], fun i hi ↦ by rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi]; exact hw.termSubst (hv.nth hi)⟩

name: substs_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma substs_nil {t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L 0 t) : termSubst L 0 t = t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    simp only [hf, hv.isUTerm, termSubst_func, qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k (by simp [hv.isUTerm]) (by simp [hv.lh])
    intro i hi
    simp [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: termSubst_termSubst
statement:
lemma termSubst_termSubst {l n w v t : V} (hv : IsSemitermVec L l n v) (ht : IsSemiterm L l t) :
    termSubst L w (termSubst L v t) = termSubst L (termSubstVec L l w v) t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz
    rw [termSubst_bvar z, termSubst_bvar z, nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f ts hf hts ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hts.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf hts.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k (by rw [len_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm]) (by rw [len_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi, nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: termSubst_eq_self
statement:
lemma termSubst_eq_self {n w t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) (H : ∀ i < n, w.[i] = ^#i) :
    termSubst L w t = t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp [hz, H]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm]) (by simp [hv.lh])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: termShift_bvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termShift_bvar (z : V) :
    termShift L ^#z = ^#z

name: termShift_fvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termShift_fvar (x : V) :
    termShift L ^&x = ^&(x + 1)

name: termShift_func
statement:
@[simp] lemma termShift_func {k f v : V} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    termShift L (^func k f v) = ^func k f (termShiftVec L k v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [termShift, construction, hkf, hv]; rfl

name: len_termShiftVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma len_termShiftVec {k ts : V} (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    len (termShiftVec L k ts) = k

name: nth_termShiftVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma nth_termShiftVec {k ts i : V} (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) (hi : i < k) :
    (termShiftVec L k ts).[i] = termShift L ts.[i]

name: termShiftVec_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma termShiftVec_nil : termShiftVec (V := V) L 0 0 = 0

name: termShiftVec_cons
statement:
lemma termShiftVec_cons {k t ts : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    termShiftVec L (k + 1) (t ∷ ts) = termShift L t ∷ termShiftVec L k ts

name: termShiftVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termShiftVec_cons₁ {t₁ : V} (ht₁ : IsUTerm L t₁) :
    termShiftVec L 1 (?[t₁] : V) = ?[termShift L t₁]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 : V) = 0 + 1  by simp, termShiftVec_cons] <;> simp [*]

name: termShiftVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termShiftVec_cons₂ {t₁ t₂ : V} (ht₁ : IsUTerm L t₁) (ht₂ : IsUTerm L t₂) :
    termShiftVec L 2 (?[t₁, t₂] : V) = ?[termShift L t₁, termShift L t₂]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : V) = 0 + 1 + 1  by simp [one_add_one_eq_two], termShiftVec_cons] <;> simp [ht₁, ht₂]

name: IsUTerm.termShift
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUTerm.termShift {t} (ht : IsUTerm L t) : IsUTerm L (termShift L t : V)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hkf hv ih;
    simp only [hkf, hv, termShift_func, func_iff, true_and]
    exact ⟨by simp [hv], by intro i hi; rw [nth_termShiftVec hv hi]; exact ih i hi⟩

name: IsSemiterm.termShift
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemiterm.termShift {t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : IsSemiterm L n (termShift L t)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp [hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hkf hv ih;
    simp only [hkf, hv.isUTerm, termShift_func, func, true_and]
    refine IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [termShiftVec, hv.isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi

name: IsUTermVec.termShiftVec
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUTermVec.termShiftVec {k v : V} (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) : IsUTermVec L k (termShiftVec L k v)
proof:
:=
    ⟨by simp [hv], fun i hi ↦ by rw [nth_termShiftVec hv hi]; exact (hv.nth hi).termShift⟩

name: IsSemitermVec.termShiftVec
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.termShiftVec {k n v : V} (hv : IsSemitermVec L k n v) : IsSemitermVec L k n (termShiftVec L k v)
proof:
:=
  IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
    ⟨by simp [hv.isUTerm], fun i hi ↦ by
      rw [nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi]; exact (hv.nth hi).termShift⟩

name: IsUTerm.termBVtermShift
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUTerm.termBVtermShift {t : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) : termBV L (Bootstrapping.termShift L t) = termBV L t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hf hv,
      termBV_func hf hv.termShiftVec,
      termBV_func hf hv]
    congr 1
    apply nth_ext' k (by simp [*]) (by simp [*])
    intro i hi
    simp [*]

name: IsUTermVec.termBVVectermShiftVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsUTermVec.termBVVectermShiftVec {v : V} (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    termBVVec L k (Bootstrapping.termShiftVec L k v) = termBVVec L k v
proof:
:= by
  apply nth_ext' k (by simp [*]) (by simp [*])
  intro i hi
  simp [*, IsUTerm.termBVtermShift (hv.nth hi)]

name: termBShift_bvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBShift_bvar (z : V) :
    termBShift L ^#z = ^#(z + 1)

name: termBShift_fvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBShift_fvar (x : V) :
    termBShift L ^&x = ^&x

name: termBShift_func
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBShift_func {k f v : V} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    termBShift L (^func k f v) = ^func k f (termBShiftVec L k v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [termBShift, construction, hkf, hv]; rfl

name: len_termBShiftVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma len_termBShiftVec {k ts : V} (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    len (termBShiftVec L k ts) = k

name: nth_termBShiftVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma nth_termBShiftVec {k ts i : V} (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) (hi : i < k) :
    (termBShiftVec L k ts).[i] = termBShift L ts.[i]

name: termBShiftVec_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma termBShiftVec_nil : termBShiftVec (V := V) L 0 0 = 0

name: termBShiftVec_cons
statement:
lemma termBShiftVec_cons {k t ts : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    termBShiftVec L (k + 1) (t ∷ ts) = termBShift L t ∷ termBShiftVec L k ts

name: termBShiftVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBShiftVec_cons₁ {t₁ : V} (ht₁ : IsUTerm L t₁) :
    termBShiftVec L 1 (?[t₁] : V) = ?[termBShift L t₁]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 : V) = 0 + 1  by simp, termBShiftVec_cons] <;> simp [*]

name: termBShiftVec_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBShiftVec_cons₂ {t₁ t₂ : V} (ht₁ : IsUTerm L t₁) (ht₂ : IsUTerm L t₂) :
    termBShiftVec L 2 (?[t₁, t₂] : V) = ?[termBShift L t₁, termBShift L t₂]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : V) = 0 + 1 + 1  by simp [one_add_one_eq_two], termBShiftVec_cons] <;> simp [*]

name: IsSemiterm.termBShift
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemiterm.termBShift {t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : IsSemiterm L (n + 1) (termBShift L t)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp [hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hkf hv ih;
    simp only [hkf, hv.isUTerm, termBShift_func, func, true_and]
    refine IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hv.isUTerm]
    · intro i hi
      rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi]
      exact ih i hi

name: IsSemitermVec.termBShiftVec
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.termBShiftVec {k n v : V} (hv : IsSemitermVec L k n v) : IsSemitermVec L k (n + 1) (termBShiftVec L k v)
proof:
:=
  IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr
  ⟨by simp [hv.isUTerm], fun i hi ↦ by
    rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi]; exact (hv.nth hi).termBShift⟩

name: termBShift_termShift
statement: lemma termBShift_termShift {t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : termBShift L (termShift L t) = termShift L (termBShift L t)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hkf hv ih
    rw [termShift_func hkf hv.isUTerm,
      termBShift_func hkf hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm,
      termBShift_func hkf hv.isUTerm,
      termShift_func hkf hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termBShiftVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]) (by rw [len_termShiftVec hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termBShiftVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi, nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termShiftVec hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm hi, nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: termFreeAt_bvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termFreeAt_bvar (m z : V) :
    termFreeAt L m ^#z = if z < m then ^#z else ^&0

name: termFreeAt_fvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termFreeAt_fvar (m x : V) :
    termFreeAt L m ^&x = ^&(x + 1)

name: termFreeAt_func
statement:
@[simp] lemma termFreeAt_func {m k f v : V} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    termFreeAt L m (^func k f v) = ^func k f (termFreeAtVec L m k v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [termFreeAt, construction, hkf, hv]; rfl

name: termFreeAt.defined
statement: lemma termFreeAt.defined : 𝚺₁-Function₂[V] termFreeAt L via termFreeAtGraph L
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  simpa [termFreeAtGraph, termFreeAt, Matrix.constant_eq_singleton, Matrix.comp_vecCons']
    using construction.result_defined (L := L) ![v 0, v 2, v 1]

name: len_qVec
statement: @[simp] lemma len_qVec {k w : V} (h : IsUTermVec L k w) : len (qVec L w) = k + 1

name: IsSemitermVec.qVec
statement: lemma IsSemitermVec.qVec {k n w : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L k n w) : IsSemitermVec L (k + 1) (n + 1) (qVec L w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h.lh
  refine IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [h.isUTerm, Bootstrapping.qVec]
  · intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp [Bootstrapping.qVec]
    · simpa [Bootstrapping.qVec, nth_termBShiftVec h.isUTerm (by simpa using hi)] using
        h.nth (by simpa using hi) |>.termBShift

name: substs_cons_bShift
statement:
lemma substs_cons_bShift {u t w : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) :
    termSubst L (u ∷ w) (termBShift L t) = termSubst L w t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    rw [termBShift_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm])
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      ih i hi]

name: termShift_termSubsts
statement:
lemma termShift_termSubsts {n m w t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    termShift L (termSubst L w t) = termSubst L (termShiftVec L n w) (termShift L t)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp [nth_termShiftVec hw.isUTerm hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termShift_func hf (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      termShift_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm])
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: bShift_substs
statement:
lemma bShift_substs {n m w t : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    termBShift L (termSubst L w t) = termSubst L (termBShiftVec L n w) t
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiterm.induction 𝚺 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z hz; simp [nth_termBShiftVec hw.isUTerm hz]
  · intro x; simp
  · intro k f v hf hv ih
    rw [termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm,
      termBShift_func hf (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      termSubst_func hf hv.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqFunc_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termBShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm])
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    simp [nth_termBShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi, nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi, ih i hi]

name: substs_qVec_bShift
statement:
lemma substs_qVec_bShift {n t m w : V} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    termSubst L (qVec L w) (termBShift L t) = termBShift L (termSubst L w t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hw.lh
  simp [qVec, substs_cons_bShift ht, bShift_substs ht hw]

name: termSubstVec_qVec_qVec
statement:
lemma termSubstVec_qVec_qVec {l n m : V} (hv : IsSemitermVec L l n v) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    termSubstVec L (l + 1) (qVec L w) (qVec L v) = qVec L (termSubstVec L l w v)
proof:
:= by
  apply nth_ext' (len v + 1)
    (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.qVec.isUTerm, hv.lh])
    (by rw [len_qVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm, hv.lh])
  intro i hi
  unfold qVec
  rcases hv.lh; rcases hw.lh
  rw [(hw.termSubstVec hv).lh]
  rw [termSubstVec_cons (by simp) (by rcases hv.lh; exact hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm)]
  rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · have hi : i < len v := by simpa using hi
    simp [nth_termSubstVec hv.termBShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termBShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termBShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      substs_cons_bShift (hv.nth hi),
      bShift_substs (hv.nth hi) hw]

name: termShift_qVec
statement:
lemma termShift_qVec {n m w : V} (hw : IsSemitermVec L n m w) :
    termShiftVec L (n + 1) (qVec L w) = qVec L (termShiftVec L n w)
proof:
:= by
  apply nth_ext' (n + 1)
    (by rw [len_termShiftVec hw.qVec.isUTerm])
    (by rw [len_qVec hw.termShiftVec.isUTerm])
  intro i hi
  rw [nth_termShiftVec hw.qVec.isUTerm hi]
  unfold qVec
  rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · rcases hw.lh
    rw [nth_adjoin_succ, nth_adjoin_succ,
      nth_termBShiftVec hw.isUTerm (by simpa using hi),
      nth_termBShiftVec (by simp [hw.isUTerm]) (by simpa [hw.isUTerm] using hi),
      nth_termShiftVec hw.isUTerm (by simpa using hi),
      termBShift_termShift (hw.nth (by simpa using hi))]

name: IsTermFVFree.bvar
statement: @[simp] lemma IsTermFVFree.bvar (x : V) : IsTermFVFree L n ^#x ↔ x < n

name: IsTermFVFree.fvar
statement: @[simp] lemma IsTermFVFree.fvar (x : V) : ¬IsTermFVFree L n ^&x

name: lt_qqAdd_left
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_qqAdd_left (x y : V) : x < x ^+ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! nth_lt_qqFunc_of_lt (i := 0) (k := 2) (f := (addIndex : V)) (v := ?[x, y]) (by simp)

name: lt_qqAdd_right
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_qqAdd_right (x y : V) : y < x ^+ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! nth_lt_qqFunc_of_lt (i := 1) (k := 2) (f := (addIndex : V)) (v := ?[x, y]) (by simp)

name: lt_qqMul_left
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_qqMul_left (x y : V) : x < x ^* y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! nth_lt_qqFunc_of_lt (i := 0) (k := 2) (f := (mulIndex : V)) (v := ?[x, y]) (by simp)

name: lt_qqMul_right
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_qqMul_right (x y : V) : y < x ^* y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! nth_lt_qqFunc_of_lt (i := 1) (k := 2) (f := (mulIndex : V)) (v := ?[x, y]) (by simp)

name: qqFunc_absolute
statement: lemma qqFunc_absolute (k f v : ℕ) : ((^func k f v : ℕ) : V) = ^func (k : V) (f : V) (v : V)

name: zero_semiterm
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_semiterm : IsSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n (𝟎 : V)

name: one_semiterm
statement: @[simp] lemma one_semiterm : IsSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n (𝟏 : V)

name: coe_zero_eq
statement: lemma coe_zero_eq : (𝟎 : V) = (^func 0 ⌜(Language.Zero.zero : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 0)⌝ 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Arithmetic.zero, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc, qqFunc, nat_cast_pair]; rfl

name: coe_one_eq
statement: lemma coe_one_eq : (𝟏 : V) = (^func 0 ⌜(Language.One.one : (ℒₒᵣ).Func 0)⌝ 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc, qqFunc, nat_cast_pair]; rfl

name: numeralAux_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma numeralAux_zero : numeralAux (0 : V) = 𝟏

name: numeralAux_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma numeralAux_succ (x : V) : numeralAux (x + 1) = numeralAux x ^+ 𝟏

name: lt_numeralAux_self
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_numeralAux_self (n : V) : n < numeralAux n
proof:
:= by
    induction n using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
    · definability
    case zero => simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
    case succ n ih =>
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le ((add_lt_add_iff_right 1).mpr ih) (by simp [succ_le_iff_lt])

name: numeralAux_semiterm
statement: @[simp] lemma numeralAux_semiterm (n x : V) : IsSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n (numeralAux x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp
  case succ x ih => simp [qqAdd, ih]

name: numeral_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_zero : numeral (0 : V) = 𝟎

name: numeral_one
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_one : numeral (1 : V) = 𝟏

name: numeral_add_two
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_add_two : numeral (n + 1 + 1 : V) = numeral (n + 1) ^+ 𝟏

name: numeral_succ_pos
statement: lemma numeral_succ_pos (pos : 0 < n) : numeral (n + 1 : V) = numeral n ^+ 𝟏
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ n with (rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
  · simp at pos
  simp [numeral]

name: numeral_semiterm
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_semiterm (n x : V) : IsSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n (numeral x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> simp [hx, numeral]

name: numeral_uterm
statement: @[simp] lemma numeral_uterm (x : V) : IsUTerm ℒₒᵣ (numeral x)

name: le_numeral_self
statement: @[simp] lemma le_numeral_self (n : V) : n ≤ numeral n
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ n with (rfl | ⟨n, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · simp [numeral, succ_le_iff_lt]

name: numeral_substs
statement:
@[simp] lemma numeral_substs {w : V} (_ : IsSemitermVec ℒₒᵣ n m w) (x : V) :
    termSubst ℒₒᵣ w (numeral x) = numeral x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp [Arithmetic.zero, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
  case succ x ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    · simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
    · simp only [numeral_add_two, qqAdd]
      rw [termSubst_func (L := ℒₒᵣ) (by simp) (by simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc])]
      simp [ih, Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]

name: numeral_shift
statement:
@[simp] lemma numeral_shift (x : V) :
    termShift ℒₒᵣ (numeral x) = numeral x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  case zero => simp [Arithmetic.zero, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
  case succ x ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    · simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
    · simp only [numeral_add_two, qqAdd]
      rw [termShift_func (L := ℒₒᵣ) (by simp) (by simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc])]
      simp [ih, Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]

  · definability
  case zero => simp [Arithmetic.zero, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
  case succ x ih =>
    rcases zero_or_succ x with (rfl | ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    · simp [Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
    · simp [qqAdd, ih, Arithmetic.one, qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]

proof:

name: typed_quote_numeral_eq_numeral
statement:
@[simp] lemma typed_quote_numeral_eq_numeral (k : ℕ) :
    (⌜(↑k : SyntacticSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n)⌝ : Bootstrapping.Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) = typedNumeral ↑k
proof:
:= by
  match k with
  |         0 =>
    simp [Bootstrapping.Arithmetic.typedNumeral,
      Bootstrapping.Arithmetic.zero, Bootstrapping.Arithmetic.qqFunc_absolute, qqFuncN_eq_qqFunc]
    rfl
  |         1 => simp [typed_quote_numeral_eq_numeral_one]
  | k + 1 + 1 =>
    calc (⌜(↑(k + 1 + 1) : SyntacticSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n)⌝ : Bootstrapping.Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n)
      _ = ⌜(↑(k + 1) : SyntacticSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n)⌝ + ⌜((1 : ℕ) : SyntacticSemiterm ℒₒᵣ n)⌝ := rfl
      _ = typedNumeral ↑(k + 1) + typedNumeral 1 := by simp [typed_quote_numeral_eq_numeral (k + 1), typed_quote_numeral_eq_numeral_one]
      _ = typedNumeral (↑k + 1 + 1)              := by simp

name: typed_quote_inj
statement: lemma typed_quote_inj {t u : SyntacticSemiterm L n} : (⌜t⌝ : Bootstrapping.Semiterm V L n) = ⌜u⌝ → t = u
proof:
:=
  match t, u with
  |         #x,         #y => by simp
  |         &x,         &y => by simp
  | func f₁ v₁, func f₂ v₂ => by
    simp only [typed_quote_func, Bootstrapping.Semiterm.func, Semiterm.mk.injEq, qqFunc_inj,
      Nat.cast_inj, func.injEq, and_imp]
    rintro rfl
    simp only [quote_func_inj, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    rintro rfl
    suffices ((fun i ↦ ⌜v₁ i⌝) = fun i ↦ ⌜v₂ i⌝) → v₁ = v₂ by
      simpa [←SemitermVec.val_inj]
    intro h
    ext i
    exact typed_quote_inj (congr_fun h i)
  |         #_,         &_
  |         #_,   func _ _
  |         &_,         #_
  |         &_,   func _ _
  |   func _ _,         #_
  |   func _ _,         &_ => by simp [Bootstrapping.Semiterm.bvar, Bootstrapping.Semiterm.fvar, Bootstrapping.Semiterm.func, qqBvar, qqFvar, qqFunc]

name: quote_eq_encode'_aux
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k ih =>
    suffices
        (⌜v 0⌝ : Bootstrapping.Semiterm V L n).val = encode ↑(v 0) ∧
        SemitermVec.val (fun i ↦ ⌜v i.succ⌝) = ↑(Matrix.vecToNat fun i ↦ encode (v i.succ) : V) by
      simpa [Matrix.vecToNat, coe_pair_eq_pair_coe, adjoin_def, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_def]
    constructor
    · exact H 0
    · exact ih (fun i ↦ v i.succ) (fun i ↦ by simpa using H i.succ)

name: quote_eq_encode
statement: lemma quote_eq_encode (t : SyntacticSemiterm L n) : (⌜t⌝ : V) = ↑(encode t)
proof:
:= by
  match t with
  |       #x => simp [quote_def, encode_eq_toNat, toNat, qqBvar, coe_pair_eq_pair_coe]
  |       &x => simp [quote_def, encode_eq_toNat, toNat, qqFvar, coe_pair_eq_pair_coe]
  | func f v =>
    suffices (⌜f⌝ : V) = ↑(encode f) ∧ (SemitermVec.val (V := V) fun i ↦ ⌜v i⌝) = ↑(Matrix.vecToNat fun i ↦ encode (v i)) by
      simpa [quote_def, encode_eq_toNat, toNat, Bootstrapping.Semiterm.func, qqFunc, coe_pair_eq_pair_coe]
    constructor
    · rfl
    · exact quote_eq_encode'_aux _ fun i ↦ quote_eq_encode (v i)

proof:
:= by
  induction s using Nat.binaryRec generalizing x
  case zero => simp
  case bit b s ih =>
    cases b <;> simp
    · cases' x with x <;> simp [ih]
    · cases' x with x <;> simp [ih]

name: IsSemiterm.sound
statement: lemma IsSemiterm.sound {n t : ℕ} (ht : IsSemiterm L n t) : ∃ T : FirstOrder.SyntacticSemiterm L n, ⌜T⌝ = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using Nat.strongRec
  case ind t ih =>
    rcases ht.case with (⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, hf, hv, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨#⟨z, hz⟩, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨&x, by simp [Semiterm.quote_fvar]⟩
    · have : ∀ i : Fin k, ∃ t : FirstOrder.SyntacticSemiterm L n, ⌜t⌝ = v.[i] := fun i ↦
        ih v.[i] (nth_lt_qqFunc_of_lt (by simp [hv.lh])) (hv.nth i.prop)
      choose v' hv' using this
      have : ∃ F, encode F = f := isFunc_quote_quote (V := ℕ) (L := L) (x := f) (k := k) |>.mp (by simp [hf])
      rcases this with ⟨f, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨FirstOrder.Semiterm.func f v', ?_⟩
      suffices SemitermVec.val (fun i ↦ ⌜v' i⌝) = v by simpa [Semiterm.quote_func, quote_func_def]
      apply nth_ext' k (by simp) (by simp [hv.lh])
      intro i hik
      let j : Fin k := ⟨i, hik⟩
      calc
        (SemitermVec.val fun i ↦ ⌜v' i⌝).[i] = (SemitermVec.val fun i ↦ ⌜v' i⌝).[↑j] := rfl
        _                                    = ⌜v' j⌝ := by
          simpa [Semiterm.quote_def] using SemitermVec.val_nth_eq (fun i ↦ (⌜v' i⌝ : Bootstrapping.Semiterm ℕ L n)) j
        _                                    = v.[i] := hv' j

name: qqFunc_graph
statement:
private lemma qqFunc_graph {x k f v : V} :
    x = ^func k f v ↔ ∃ fv < x, fv = ⟪f, v⟫ ∧ ∃ kfv < x, kfv = ⟪k, fv⟫ ∧ ∃ x' < x, x' = ⟪2, kfv⟫ ∧ x = x' + 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl
      exact ⟨⟪f, v⟫, lt_succ_iff_le.mpr <| le_trans (le_pair_right _ _) (le_pair_right _ _), rfl,
        ⟪k, f, v⟫, lt_succ_iff_le.mpr <| by simp, rfl,
        ⟪2, k, f, v⟫, by simp [qqFunc], rfl, rfl⟩,
   by rintro ⟨_, _, rfl, _, _, rfl, _, _, rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

name: phi_iff
statement:
private lemma phi_iff (C : V) (t : V) :
    Phi L {x | x ∈ C} t ↔
    (∃ z < t, t = ^#z) ∨
    (∃ x < t, t = ^&x) ∨
    (∃ k < t, ∃ f < t, ∃ v < t, L.IsFunc k f ∧ k = len v ∧ (∀ i < k, v.[i] ∈ C) ∧ t = ^func k f v) where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro (⟨z, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, hkf, hk, hv, rfl⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨z, lt_succ_iff_le.mpr <| by simp, rfl⟩
    · right; left
      exact ⟨x, lt_succ_iff_le.mpr <| by simp, rfl⟩
    · right; right
      exact ⟨k, by simp, f, by simp, v, by simp, hkf, hk, hv, rfl⟩
  mpr := by
    unfold Phi
    rintro (⟨z, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, _, f, _, v, _, hkf, hk, hv, rfl⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · right; left; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · right; right; exact ⟨k, f, v, hkf, hk, hv, rfl⟩

name: two_iff
statement: lemma two_iff {v : V} : IsUTermVec L 2 v ↔ ∃ t₁ t₂, IsUTerm L t₁ ∧ IsUTerm L t₂ ∧ v = ?[t₁, t₂]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases eq_doubleton_of_len_eq_two.mp h.lh.symm with ⟨t₁, t₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t₁, t₂, by simpa using h.nth (show 0 < 2 by simp), by simpa using h.nth (show 1 < 2 by simp), rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t₁, t₂, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩; exact ⟨by simp [one_add_one_eq_two], by simp [lt_two_iff_le_one, le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_one, h₁, h₂]⟩

    · simpa

proof:
:= by

  · intro h; exact ⟨by simpa using h.nth (i := 0) (by simp), by simpa using h.nth (i := 1) (by simp)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: func_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma func_iff {k f v : V} :
    IsUTerm L (^func k f v) ↔ L.IsFunc k f ∧ IsUTermVec L k v
proof:
:=
  ⟨by intro h
      rcases h.case with (⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨x, h⟩ | ⟨k', f', w, hkf, ⟨hk, hv⟩, h⟩)
      · simp [qqFunc, qqBvar] at h
      · simp [qqFunc, qqFvar] at h
      · rcases (show k = k' ∧ f = f' ∧ v = w by simpa [qqFunc] using h) with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hkf, hk, hv⟩,
   by rintro ⟨hkf, hk, hv⟩; exact mk <| Or.inr <| Or.inr ⟨k, f, v, hkf, ⟨hk, hv⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: induction
statement:
lemma induction (Γ) {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
    (hbvar : ∀ z, P (^#z)) (hfvar : ∀ x, P (^&x))
    (hfunc : ∀ k f v, L.IsFunc k f → IsUTermVec L k v → (∀ i < k, P v.[i]) → P (^func k f v)) :
    ∀ t, IsUTerm L t → P t
proof:
:=
  (construction L).induction (v := ![]) hP (by
    rintro C hC x (⟨z, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, hkf, hk, h, rfl⟩)
    · exact hbvar z
    · exact hfvar x
    · exact hfunc k f v hkf ⟨hk, fun i hi ↦ hC _ (h i hi) |>.1⟩ (fun i hi ↦ hC _ (h i hi) |>.2))

name: seq_bound
statement:
lemma seq_bound {k s m : V} (Ss : Seq s) (hk : k = lh s) (hs : ∀ i z, ⟪i, z⟫ ∈ s → z < m) :
    s < Exp.exp ((k + m + 1)^2)
proof:
:= lt_exp_iff.mpr <| fun p hp ↦ by
  have : p < ⟪k, m⟫ := by
    simpa [hk] using
      pair_lt_pair (Ss.lt_lh_of_mem (show ⟪π₁ p, π₂ p⟫ ∈ s by simpa using hp)) (hs (π₁ p) (π₂ p) (by simpa using hp))
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (by simp)

name: phi_iff
statement:
private lemma phi_iff (param : Fin arity → V) (C pr : V) :
    c.Phi L param {x | x ∈ C} pr ↔
    ∃ t ≤ pr, ∃ y ≤ pr, pr = ⟪t, y⟫ ∧ IsUTerm L t ∧
    ( (∃ z < t, t = ^#z ∧ y = c.bvar param z) ∨
      (∃ x < t, t = ^&x ∧ y = c.fvar param x) ∨
      (∃ k < t, ∃ f < t, ∃ v < t, ∃ w ≤ repeatVec C k,
        (k = len w ∧ ∀ i < k, ⟪v.[i], w.[i]⟫ ∈ C) ∧
        t = ^func k f v ∧ y = c.func param k f v w) )
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht, H⟩
    refine ⟨π₁ pr, by simp, π₂ pr, by simp, by simp, ht, ?_⟩
    rcases H with (⟨z, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, w, ⟨hk, hw⟩, hk, rfl⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨z, by simp⟩
    · right; left; exact ⟨x, by simp⟩
    · right; right
      refine ⟨k, by simp, f, by simp, v, by simp, w, ?_, ⟨hk, hw⟩, by simp⟩
      · rcases hk; apply len_repeatVec_of_nth_le (fun i hi ↦ le_of_lt <| lt_of_mem_rng <| hw i hi)
  · rintro ⟨t, _, y, _, rfl, ht, H⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using ht, ?_⟩
    rcases H with (⟨z, _, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, _, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, _, f, _, v, _, w, _, ⟨hk, hw⟩, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · right; left; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · right; right
      exact ⟨k, f, v, w, ⟨hk, fun i hi ↦ hw i hi⟩, rfl⟩

name: cons_app_9
statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_9 {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 9 = s 8

name: cons_app_10
statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_10 {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 10 = s 9

name: cons_app_11
statement: @[simp] lemma cons_app_11 {n : ℕ} (a : α) (s : Fin n.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ.succ → α) : (a :> s) 11 = s 10

name: Graph.case_iff
statement:
lemma Graph.case_iff {t y : V} :
    c.Graph L param t y ↔
    IsUTerm L t ∧
    ( (∃ z, t = ^#z ∧ y = c.bvar param z) ∨
      (∃ x, t = ^&x ∧ y = c.fvar param x) ∨
      (∃ k f v w, (k = len w ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param v.[i] w.[i]) ∧
      t = ^func k f v ∧ y = c.func param k f v w) )
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans (c.construction L).case (by apply and_congr (by simp); simp; rfl)

name: graph_defined
statement: lemma graph_defined : 𝚺₁.Defined (fun v ↦ c.Graph L (v ·.succ.succ) (v 0) (v 1)) (β.graph L)
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.graph, (c.construction L).fixpoint_defined.iff, Graph]

name: eval_graphDef
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_graphDef (v : Fin (arity + 2) → V) :
    (β.graph L).val.Evalb v ↔ c.Graph L (v ·.succ.succ) (v 0) (v 1)

name: graph_dom_isUTerm
statement:
lemma graph_dom_isUTerm {t y} :
    c.Graph L param t y → IsUTerm L t

name: graph_bvar_iff
statement:
lemma graph_bvar_iff {z} :
    c.Graph L param ^#z y ↔ y = c.bvar param z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    rcases Graph.case_iff.mp H with ⟨_, (⟨_, h, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, h, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, _, h, _⟩)⟩
    · rcases (by simpa using h); rfl
    · simp [qqBvar, qqFvar] at h
    · simp [qqBvar, qqFunc] at h
  · rintro rfl; exact Graph.case_iff.mpr ⟨by simp, Or.inl ⟨z, by simp⟩⟩

name: graph_fvar_iff
statement:
lemma graph_fvar_iff (x) :
    c.Graph L param ^&x y ↔ y = c.fvar param x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    rcases Graph.case_iff.mp H with ⟨_, (⟨_, h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, _, h, _⟩)⟩
    · simp [qqFvar, qqBvar] at h
    · rcases (by simpa using h); rfl
    · simp [qqFvar, qqFunc] at h
  · rintro rfl; exact Graph.case_iff.mpr ⟨by simp, Or.inr <| Or.inl ⟨x, by simp⟩⟩

name: graph_func
statement:
lemma graph_func {k f v w} (hkr : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v)
    (hkw : k = len w) (hw : ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param v.[i] w.[i]) :
    c.Graph L param (^func k f v) (c.func param k f v w)
proof:
:= by
  exact Graph.case_iff.mpr ⟨by simp [hkr, hv], Or.inr <| Or.inr ⟨k, f, v, w, ⟨hkw, hw⟩, by simp⟩⟩

name: graph_func_inv
statement:
lemma graph_func_inv {k f v y} :
    c.Graph L param (^func k f v) y → ∃ w,
      (k = len w ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param v.[i] w.[i]) ∧
      y = c.func param k f v w
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  rcases Graph.case_iff.mp H with ⟨_, (⟨_, h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ | ⟨k', f', v', w, hw, h, rfl⟩)⟩
  · simp [qqFunc, qqBvar] at h
  · simp [qqFunc, qqFvar] at h
  · rcases show k = k' ∧ f = f' ∧ v = v' by simpa [qqFunc, qqFunc] using h with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w, hw, by rfl⟩

name: graph_exists
statement: lemma graph_exists {t : V} : IsUTerm L t → ∃ y, c.Graph L param t y
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚺 (P := fun t ↦ ∃ y, c.Graph L param t y) (by definability)
  case hbvar =>
    intro z; exact ⟨c.bvar param z, by simp [c.graph_bvar_iff]⟩
  case hfvar =>
    intro x; exact ⟨c.fvar param x, by simp [c.graph_fvar_iff]⟩
  case hfunc =>
    intro k f v hkf hv ih
    have : ∃ w, len w = k ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param v.[i] w.[i] := sigmaOne_skolem_vec (by definability) ih
    rcases this with ⟨w, hwk, hvw⟩
    exact ⟨c.func param k f v w, c.graph_func hkf hv (Eq.symm hwk) hvw⟩

name: graph_unique
statement: lemma graph_unique {t y₁ y₂ : V} : c.Graph L param t y₁ → c.Graph L param t y₂ → y₁ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  revert y₁ y₂
  suffices IsUTerm L t → ∀ y₁ y₂, c.Graph L param t y₁ → c.Graph L param t y₂ → y₁ = y₂
  by intro u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂; exact this (c.graph_dom_isUTerm h₁) u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂
  intro ht
  apply IsUTerm.induction 𝚷 ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · definability
  · intro z; simp [c.graph_bvar_iff]
  · intro x; simp [c.graph_fvar_iff]
  · intro k f v _ _ ih y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂
    rcases c.graph_func_inv h₁ with ⟨w₁, ⟨hk₁, hv₁⟩, rfl⟩
    rcases c.graph_func_inv h₂ with ⟨w₂, ⟨hk₂, hv₂⟩, rfl⟩
    have : w₁ = w₂ :=
      nth_ext (by simp [←hk₁, ←hk₂]) (fun i hi ↦
        ih i (by simpa [hk₁] using hi) _ _
          (hv₁ i (by simpa [hk₁] using hi)) (hv₂ i (by simpa [hk₁] using hi)))
    rw [this]

name: graph_existsUnique
statement: lemma graph_existsUnique {t : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) : ∃! y, c.Graph L param t y
proof:
:= by
  rcases graph_exists param ht with ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ExistsUnique.intro y hy (fun y' h' ↦ graph_unique param h' hy)

name: graph_existsUnique_total
statement:
lemma graph_existsUnique_total (t : V) : ∃! y,
    (IsUTerm L t → c.Graph L param t y) ∧ (¬IsUTerm L t → y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : IsUTerm L t <;> simp [ht, c.graph_existsUnique L param]

name: result_prop
statement: theorem result_prop {t : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) : c.Graph L param t (c.result L param t)

name: result_prop_not
statement: theorem result_prop_not {t : V} (ht : ¬IsUTerm L t) : c.result L param t = 0

name: result_eq_of_graph
statement:
lemma result_eq_of_graph {t y} (ht : IsUTerm L t) (h : c.Graph L param t y) :
    c.result L param t = y
proof: := Eq.symm <| Classical.choose_uniq (c.graph_existsUnique_total L param t) (by simp [h, ht])

name: result_bvar
statement: @[simp] lemma result_bvar (z) : c.result L param (^#z) = c.bvar param z

name: result_fvar
statement: @[simp] lemma result_fvar (x) : c.result L param (^&x) = c.fvar param x

name: result_func
statement:
lemma result_func {k f v w} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v)
    (hkw : k = len w) (hw : ∀ i < k, c.result L param v.[i] = w.[i]) :
    c.result L param (^func k f v) = c.func param k f v w
proof:
:=
  c.result_eq_of_graph (by simp [hkf, hv]) (c.graph_func hkf hv hkw (fun i hi ↦ by
    simpa [hw i hi] using c.result_prop L param (hv.nth hi)))

name: graph_existsUnique_vec
statement:
lemma graph_existsUnique_vec {k w : V} (hw : IsUTermVec L k w) :
    ∃! w' : V, k = len w' ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param w.[i] w'.[i]
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ i < k, ∃ y, c.Graph L param w.[i] y := by
    intro i hi; exact ⟨c.result L param w.[i], c.result_prop L param (hw.nth hi)⟩
  rcases sigmaOne_skolem_vec (by definability) this
    with ⟨w', hw'k, hw'⟩
  refine ExistsUnique.intro w' ⟨hw'k.symm, hw'⟩ ?_
  intro w'' ⟨hkw'', hw''⟩
  refine nth_ext (by simp [hw'k, ←hkw'']) (by
    intro i hi;
    exact c.graph_unique param (hw'' i (by simpa [hkw''] using hi)) (hw' i (by simpa [hkw''] using hi)))

name: graph_existsUnique_vec_total
statement:
lemma graph_existsUnique_vec_total (k w : V) : ∃! w',
    (IsUTermVec L k w → k = len w' ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param w.[i] w'.[i]) ∧
    (¬IsUTermVec L k w → w' = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsUTermVec L k w <;> simp [h, c.graph_existsUnique_vec]

name: resultVec_lh
statement: @[simp] lemma resultVec_lh {k w : V} (hw : IsUTermVec L k w) : len (c.resultVec L param k w) = k
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| Classical.choose!_spec (c.graph_existsUnique_vec_total L param k w) |>.1 hw |>.1

name: graph_of_mem_resultVec
statement:
lemma graph_of_mem_resultVec {k w : V} (hw : IsUTermVec L k w) {i : V} (hi : i < k) :
    c.Graph L param w.[i] (c.resultVec L param k w).[i]
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose!_spec (c.graph_existsUnique_vec_total L param k w) |>.1 hw |>.2 i hi

name: nth_resultVec
statement:
lemma nth_resultVec {k w i : V} (hw : IsUTermVec L k w) (hi : i < k) :
    (c.resultVec L param k w).[i] = c.result L param w.[i]
proof:
:=
  c.result_eq_of_graph (hw.nth hi) (c.graph_of_mem_resultVec L param hw hi) |>.symm

name: resultVec_of_not
statement: @[simp] theorem resultVec_of_not {k w : V} (hw : ¬IsUTermVec L k w) : c.resultVec L param k w = 0
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose!_spec (c.graph_existsUnique_vec_total L param k w) |>.2 hw

name: resultVec_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma resultVec_nil :
    c.resultVec L param 0 0 = 0

name: resultVec_cons
statement:
lemma resultVec_cons {k w t : V} (hw : IsUTermVec L k w) (ht : IsUTerm L t) :
    c.resultVec L param (k + 1) (t ∷ w) = c.result L param t ∷ c.resultVec L param k w
proof:
:=
  nth_ext (by simp [hw, hw.adjoin ht]) (by
    intro i hi
    have hi : i < k + 1 := by simpa [hw.adjoin ht, resultVec_lh] using hi
    rw [c.nth_resultVec L param (hw.adjoin ht) hi]
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp
    · simp [c.nth_resultVec L param hw (by simpa using hi)])

name: result_func'
statement:
@[simp] lemma result_func' {k f v} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    c.result L param (^func k f v) = c.func param k f v (c.resultVec L param k v)
proof:
:=
  c.result_func hkf hv (by simp [hv]) (fun i hi ↦ c.nth_resultVec L param hv hi |>.symm)

name: result_defined
statement: lemma result_defined : 𝚺₁.DefinedFunction (fun v ↦ c.result L (v ·.succ) (v 0)) (β.result L)
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  simp [Blueprint.result, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, IsUTerm.defined.proper.iff',
    c.eval_graphDef, result, Classical.choose!_eq_iff_right]

name: result_graphDef
statement:
@[simp] lemma result_graphDef (v : Fin (arity + 2) → V) :
    (β.result L).val.Evalb v ↔ v 0 = c.result L (v ·.succ.succ) (v 1)

name: resultVec_graph
statement:
private lemma resultVec_graph {w' k w} :
    w' = c.resultVec L param k w ↔
    ( (IsUTermVec L k w → k = len w' ∧ ∀ i < k, c.Graph L param w.[i] w'.[i]) ∧
      (¬IsUTermVec L k w → w' = 0) )

name: resultVec_defined
statement: lemma resultVec_defined : 𝚺₁.DefinedFunction (fun v ↦ c.resultVec L (v ·.succ.succ) (v 0) (v 1)) (β.resultVec L)
proof:
:= .mk fun v ↦ by
  symm
  simpa [Blueprint.resultVec, HierarchySymbol.Semiformula.val_sigma, IsUTermVec.defined.proper.iff',
    c.eval_graphDef] using c.resultVec_graph

name: eval_resultVec
statement:
lemma eval_resultVec (v : Fin (arity + 3) → V) :
    (β.resultVec L).val.Evalb v ↔ v 0 = c.resultVec L (v ·.succ.succ.succ) (v 1) (v 2)

name: termBV_bvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBV_bvar (z : V) :
    termBV L ^#z = z + 1

name: termBV_fvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBV_fvar (x : V) :
    termBV L ^&x = 0

name: termBV_func
statement:
@[simp] lemma termBV_func {k f v : V} (hkf : L.IsFunc k f) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    termBV L (^func k f v) = listMax (termBVVec L k v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [termBV, construction, hkf, hv]; rfl

name: len_termBVVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma len_termBVVec {v : V} (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    len (termBVVec L k v) = k

name: nth_termBVVec
statement:
@[simp] lemma nth_termBVVec {v : V} (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) {i} (hi : i < k) :
    (termBVVec L k v).[i] = termBV L v.[i]

name: termBVVec_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma termBVVec_nil : termBVVec L 0 0 = 0

name: termBVVec_cons
statement:
lemma termBVVec_cons {k t ts : V} (ht : IsUTerm L t) (hts : IsUTermVec L k ts) :
    termBVVec L (k + 1) (t ∷ ts) = termBV L t ∷ termBVVec L k ts

name: IsSemiterm.def
statement: lemma IsSemiterm.def {n} {t : V} : IsSemiterm L n t ↔ IsUTerm L t ∧ termBV L t ≤ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h, bv⟩; exact ⟨h, bv⟩, by rintro ⟨h, bv⟩; exact ⟨h, bv⟩⟩

name: IsSemitermVec.def
statement: lemma IsSemitermVec.def {n} {v : V} : IsSemitermVec L k n v ↔ IsUTermVec L k v ∧ ∀ i < k, termBV (V := V) L v.[i] ≤ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨h, bv⟩; exact ⟨h, fun _ ↦ bv⟩, by rintro ⟨h, bv⟩; exact ⟨h, bv _⟩⟩

name: IsSemitermVec.isUTerm
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.isUTerm {k n v : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L k n v) : IsUTermVec L k v

name: IsSemitermVec.lh
statement: lemma IsSemitermVec.lh {k n v : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L k n v) : len v = k

name: IsSemitermVec.nth
statement:
lemma IsSemitermVec.nth {k n v : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L k n v) {i} (hi : i < k) :
    IsSemiterm L n v.[i]

name: IsUTerm.isSemiterm
statement: lemma IsUTerm.isSemiterm {t : V} (h : IsUTerm L t) : IsSemiterm L (termBV L t) t

name: IsUTermVec.isSemitermVec
statement: lemma IsUTermVec.isSemitermVec {k v : V} (h : IsUTermVec L k v) : IsSemitermVec L k (listMax (termBVVec L k v)) v
proof:
:=
  ⟨h, fun {i} hi ↦ le_trans (by rw [nth_termBVVec h hi]) (nth_le_listMax (i := i) (by simp [h, hi]))⟩

name: IsSemitermVec.iff
statement: lemma IsSemitermVec.iff {k n v : V} : IsSemitermVec L k n v ↔ (len v = k ∧ ∀ i < k, IsSemiterm L n v.[i])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h.lh, fun i hi ↦ h.nth hi⟩
  · intro ⟨hk, h⟩; exact ⟨⟨hk.symm, fun i hi ↦ h i hi |>.isUTerm⟩, fun hi ↦ h _ hi |>.bv⟩

name: IsSemiterm.bvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiterm.bvar {n z : V} :
    IsSemiterm L n ^#z ↔ z < n

name: IsSemiterm.fvar
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiterm.fvar (n x : V) :
    IsSemiterm L n ^&x

name: IsSemiterm.func
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiterm.func {n k f v : V} :
    IsSemiterm L n (^func k f v) ↔ L.IsFunc k f ∧ IsSemitermVec L k n v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsSemiterm.def, IsUTerm.func_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hf, hbv⟩, hv⟩
    exact ⟨hf, hbv, by
      intro i hi
      have : listMax (termBVVec L k v) ≤ n := by simpa [termBV_func, hf, hbv] using hv
      simpa [hbv, hi] using listMaxss_le_iff.mp this i (by simp [hbv, hi])⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, h⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hf, h.isUTerm⟩, by
      simp only [hf, h.isUTerm, termBV_func]
      apply listMaxss_le_iff.mpr
      intro i hi
      have hi : i < k := by simpa [hf, h.isUTerm] using hi
      simpa [hf, h.isUTerm, hi] using (h.nth hi).bv⟩

name: IsSemitermVec.empty
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.empty (n : V) : IsSemitermVec L 0 n 0

name: IsSemitermVec.empty_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.empty_iff {n : V} : IsSemitermVec L 0 n v ↔ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact len_zero_iff_eq_nil.mp h.lh
  · rintro rfl; simp

name: IsSemitermVec.cons_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.cons_iff {n w t : V} :
    IsSemitermVec L (k + 1) n (t ∷ w) ↔ IsSemiterm L n t ∧ IsSemitermVec L k n w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa using h.nth (i := 0) (by simp),
      IsSemitermVec.iff.mpr ⟨by simpa using h.lh, fun i hi ↦ by simpa using h.nth (show i + 1 < k + 1 by simp [hi])⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, hw⟩
    exact ⟨hw.isUTerm.adjoin ht.isUTerm, by
    intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp [ht.bv]
    · simpa using hw.nth (by simpa using hi) |>.bv⟩

name: SemitermVec.adjoin
statement: lemma SemitermVec.adjoin {n m w t : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L n m w) (ht : IsSemiterm L m t) : IsSemitermVec L (n + 1) m (t ∷ w)

name: IsSemitermVec.singleton
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.singleton {n t : V} :
    IsSemitermVec L 1 n ?[t] ↔ IsSemiterm L n t
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (1 : V) = 0 + 1 by simp, IsSemitermVec.cons_iff]; simp

name: IsSemitermVec.doubleton
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.doubleton {n t₁ t₂ : V} :
    IsSemitermVec L 2 n ?[t₁, t₂] ↔ IsSemiterm L n t₁ ∧ IsSemiterm L n t₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (2 : V) = 1 + 1 by simp [one_add_one_eq_two], IsSemitermVec.cons_iff]; simp

name: IsSemiterm.case_iff
statement:
lemma IsSemiterm.case_iff {n t : V} :
    IsSemiterm L n t ↔
    (∃ z < n, t = ^#z) ∨
    (∃ x, t = ^&x) ∨
    (∃ k f v : V, L.IsFunc k f ∧ IsSemitermVec L k n v ∧ t = ^func k f v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h.isUTerm.case with (⟨z, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, hf, _, rfl⟩)
    · left; exact ⟨z, by simpa [succ_le_iff_lt] using h.bv, rfl⟩
    · right; left; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · right; right; exact ⟨k, f, v, hf, by simp_all, rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, f, v, hf, hv, rfl⟩)
    · simp [hz]
    · simp
    · simp [hf, hv]

name: IsSemiterm.induction
statement:
lemma IsSemiterm.induction (Γ) {P : V → Prop} (hP : Γ-[1]-Predicate P)
    (hbvar : ∀ z < n, P (^#z)) (hfvar : ∀ x, P (^&x))
    (hfunc : ∀ k f v, L.IsFunc k f → IsSemitermVec L k n v → (∀ i < k, P v.[i]) → P (^func k f v)) :
    ∀ t, IsSemiterm L n t → P t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  suffices IsSemiterm L n t → P t by exact this ht
  apply IsUTerm.induction Γ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht.isUTerm
  · definability
  · intro z; simp only [bvar]; exact hbvar z
  · intro x _; exact hfvar x
  · intro k f v hf _ ih h
    have hv : IsSemitermVec L k n v := by simp_all
    exact hfunc k f v hf hv (fun i hi ↦ ih i hi (hv.nth hi))

name: IsSemitermVec.nil

name: IsSemitermVec.adjoin
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemitermVec.adjoin {k n w t : V} (h : IsSemitermVec L n k w) (ht : IsSemiterm L k t) : IsSemitermVec L (n + 1) k (t ∷ w)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.isUTerm.adjoin ht.isUTerm, by
    intro i hi
    rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · simp [ht.bv]
    · simp [h.bv (by simpa using hi)]⟩

  simpa using congr_arg Semiterm.val <| H i

@[simp] lemma Fvfree.and {φ ψ : Semiformula V L n} :
    (φ ⋏ ψ).FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree ∧ ψ.FVFree

name: Fvfree.or
statement: @[simp] lemma Fvfree.or {φ ψ : Semiformula V L n} : (φ ⋎ ψ).FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree ∧ ψ.FVFree

name: Fvfree.neg
statement: @[simp] lemma Fvfree.neg {φ : Semiformula V L n} : (∼φ).FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree

name: Fvfree.all
statement: @[simp] lemma Fvfree.all {φ : Semiformula V L (n + 1)} : ∀¹ φ.FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree

name: Fvfree.exs
statement: @[simp] lemma Fvfree.exs {φ : Semiformula V L (n + 1)} : ∃¹ φ.FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree

name: Fvfree.imp
statement: @[simp] lemma Fvfree.imp {φ ψ : Semiformula V L n} : (φ 🡒 ψ).FVFree ↔ φ.FVFree ∧ ψ.FVFree

name: rel_eq_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma rel_eq_eq (v : Fin 2 → Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    Semiformula.rel (Language.Eq.eq : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2) v = (v 0 ≐ v 1)

name: nrel_eq_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma nrel_eq_eq (v : Fin 2 → Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    Semiformula.nrel (Language.Eq.eq : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2) v = (v 0 ≉ v 1)

name: rel_lt_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma rel_lt_eq (v : Fin 2 → Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    Semiformula.rel (Language.LT.lt : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2) v = (v 0 <' v 1)

name: nrel_lt_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma nrel_lt_eq (v : Fin 2 → Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    Semiformula.nrel (Language.LT.lt : (ℒₒᵣ).Rel 2) v = (v 0 ≮' v 1)

name: val_equals
statement: @[simp] lemma val_equals (t u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) : (t ≐ u).val = t.val ^= u.val

name: val_notEquals
statement: @[simp] lemma val_notEquals (t u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) : (t ≉ u).val = t.val ^≠ u.val

name: val_lessThan
statement: @[simp] lemma val_lessThan (t u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) : (t <' u).val = t.val ^< u.val

name: val_notLessThan
statement: @[simp] lemma val_notLessThan (t u : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) : (t ≮' u).val = t.val ^≮ u.val

name: equals_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma equals_iff {t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n} :
    (t₁ ≐ u₁) = (t₂ ≐ u₂) ↔ t₁ = t₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂

name: notequals_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma notequals_iff {t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n} :
    (t₁ ≉ u₁) = (t₂ ≉ u₂) ↔ t₁ = t₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂

name: lessThan_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma lessThan_iff {t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n} :
    (t₁ <' u₁) = (t₂ <' u₂) ↔ t₁ = t₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂

name: notLessThan_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma notLessThan_iff {t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n} :
    (t₁ ≮' u₁) = (t₂ ≮' u₂) ↔ t₁ = t₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂

name: neg_equals
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_equals (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    ∼(t₁ ≐ t₂) = (t₁ ≉ t₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.equals, Semiterm.notEquals, qqEQ, qqNEQ]

name: neg_notEquals
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_notEquals (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    ∼(t₁ ≉ t₂) = (t₁ ≐ t₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.equals, Semiterm.notEquals, qqEQ, qqNEQ]

name: neg_lessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_lessThan (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    ∼(t₁ <' t₂) = (t₁ ≮' t₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.lessThan, Semiterm.notLessThan, qqLT, qqNLT]

name: neg_notLessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_notLessThan (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    ∼(t₁ ≮' t₂) = (t₁ <' t₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.lessThan, Semiterm.notLessThan, qqLT, qqNLT]

name: shift_equals
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_equals (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≐ t₂).shift = (t₁.shift ≐ t₂.shift)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.equals, Semiterm.shift, Semiformula.shift, qqEQ]

name: shift_notEquals
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_notEquals (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≉ t₂).shift = (t₁.shift ≉ t₂.shift)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.notEquals, Semiterm.shift, Semiformula.shift, qqNEQ]

name: shift_lessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_lessThan (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ <' t₂).shift = (t₁.shift <' t₂.shift)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.lessThan, Semiterm.shift, Semiformula.shift, qqLT]

name: shift_notLessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_notLessThan (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≮' t₂).shift = (t₁.shift ≮' t₂.shift)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.notLessThan, Semiterm.shift, Semiformula.shift, qqNLT]

name: substs_equals
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_equals (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≐ t₂).subst w = (t₁.subst w ≐ t₂.subst w)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.equals, Semiterm.subst, Semiformula.subst, qqEQ]

name: substs_notEquals
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_notEquals (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≉ t₂).subst w = (t₁.subst w ≉ t₂.subst w)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.notEquals, Semiterm.subst, Semiformula.subst, qqNEQ]

name: substs_lessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_lessThan (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ <' t₂).subst w = (t₁.subst w <' t₂.subst w)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.lessThan, Semiterm.subst, Semiformula.subst, qqLT]

name: substs_notLessThan
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_notLessThan (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t₁ t₂ : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) :
    (t₁ ≮' t₂).subst w = (t₁.subst w ≮' t₂.subst w)
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [Semiterm.notLessThan, Semiterm.subst, Semiformula.subst, qqNLT]

name: val_ball
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_ball (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.ball t).val = ^∀ (^#0 ^≮ termBShift ℒₒᵣ t.val) ^⋎ φ.val

name: val_bexs
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_bexs (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.bexs t).val = ^∃ (^#0 ^< termBShift ℒₒᵣ t.val) ^⋏ φ.val

name: neg_ball
statement:
lemma neg_ball (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    ∼(φ.ball t) = (∼φ).bexs t
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [neg_all, neg_or, qqNLT, qqLT, t.isSemiterm.termBShift.isUTerm]

name: neg_bexs
statement:
lemma neg_bexs (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    ∼(φ.bexs t) = (∼φ).ball t
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [neg_ex, neg_and, qqNLT, qqLT, t.isSemiterm.termBShift.isUTerm]

name: shifts_ball
statement:
@[simp] lemma shifts_ball (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.ball t).shift = φ.shift.ball t.shift

name: shifts_bexs
statement:
@[simp] lemma shifts_bexs (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.bexs t).shift = φ.shift.bexs t.shift

name: substs_ball
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_ball (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.ball t).subst w = (φ.subst w.q).ball (t.subst w)

name: substs_bexs
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_bexs (w : SemitermVec V ℒₒᵣ n m) (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    (φ.bexs t).subst w = (φ.subst w.q).bexs (t.subst w)

name: Semiformula.ball_eqss_imp
statement:
lemma Semiformula.ball_eqss_imp (t : Semiterm V ℒₒᵣ n) (φ : Semiformula V ℒₒᵣ (n + 1)) :
    φ.ball t = ∀¹ ((Semiterm.bvar 0 <' t.bShift) 🡒 φ)

name: neg_rel
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_rel {k R v : V} (hR : L.IsRel k R) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    neg L (^rel k R v) = ^nrel k R v

name: neg_nrel
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_nrel {k R v : V} (hR : L.IsRel k R) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    neg L (^nrel k R v) = ^rel k R v

name: neg_verum
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_verum :
    neg L (^⊤ : V) = ^⊥

name: neg_falsum
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_falsum :
    neg L (^⊥ : V) = ^⊤

name: neg_and
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_and {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    neg L (p ^⋏ q) = neg L p ^⋎ neg L q

name: neg_or
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_or {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    neg L (p ^⋎ q) = neg L p ^⋏ neg L q

name: neg_all
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_all {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    neg L (^∀ p) = ^∃ (neg L p)

name: neg_ex
statement:
@[simp] lemma neg_ex {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    neg L (^∃ p) = ^∀ (neg L p)

name: neg_not_uformula
statement:
lemma neg_not_uformula {x : V} (h : ¬IsUFormula L x) :
    neg L x = 0

name: IsUFormula.neg
statement: lemma IsUFormula.neg {p : V} : IsUFormula L p → IsUFormula L (neg L p)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp]

name: IsUFormula.bv_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUFormula.bv_neg {p : V} : IsUFormula L p → bv L (Bootstrapping.neg L p) = bv L p
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  · intro k R v hR hv; simp [*]
  · intro k R v hR hv; simp [*]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, hp.neg, hq.neg, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, hp.neg, hq.neg, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, hp.neg, ihp]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, hp.neg, ihp]

name: IsUFormula.neg_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUFormula.neg_neg {p : V} : IsUFormula L p → Bootstrapping.neg L (Bootstrapping.neg L p) = p
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, hp.neg, hq.neg, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, hp.neg, hq.neg, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, hp.neg, ihp]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, hp.neg, ihp]

name: IsUFormula.neg_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUFormula.neg_iff {p : V} : IsUFormula L (Bootstrapping.neg L p) ↔ IsUFormula L p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; by_contra hp
    have Hp : IsUFormula L p := by by_contra hp; simp [neg_not_uformula hp] at h
    contradiction
  · exact IsUFormula.neg

name: IsSemiformula.neg_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemiformula.neg_iff {p : V} : IsSemiformula L n (neg L p) ↔ IsSemiformula L n p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; by_contra hp
    have Hp : IsUFormula L p := by by_contra hp; simp [neg_not_uformula hp] at h
    have : IsSemiformula L n p := ⟨Hp, by simpa [Hp.bv_neg] using h.bv_le⟩
    contradiction
  · intro h; exact ⟨by simp [h.isUFormula], by simpa [h.isUFormula] using h.bv_le⟩

name: neg_inj_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma neg_inj_iff {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) : neg L p = neg L q ↔ p = q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa [hp.neg_neg, hq.neg_neg] using congrArg (neg L) h
  · rintro rfl; rfl

name: IsUFormula.imp
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsUFormula.imp {p q : V} :
    IsUFormula L (imp L p q) ↔ IsUFormula L p ∧ IsUFormula L q

name: IsSemiformula.imp
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiformula.imp {n p q : V} :
    IsSemiformula L n (imp L p q) ↔ IsSemiformula L n p ∧ IsSemiformula L n q

name: IsUFormula.iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsUFormula.iff {p q : V} :
    IsUFormula L (iff L p q) ↔ IsUFormula L p ∧ IsUFormula L q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Bootstrapping.iff, and, imp, and_iff_left_iff_imp, and_imp]
  intros; simp_all

name: IsSemiformula.iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiformula.iff {n p q : V} :
    IsSemiformula L n (iff L p q) ↔ IsSemiformula L n p ∧ IsSemiformula L n q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Bootstrapping.iff, and, imp, and_iff_left_iff_imp, and_imp]
  intros; simp_all

name: lt_iff_left
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_iff_left (p q : V) : p < iff L p q

name: lt_iff_right
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_iff_right (p q : V) : q < iff L p q

name: shift_rel
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_rel {k R v : V} (hR : L.IsRel k R) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    shift L (^relk R v) = ^relk R (termShiftVec L k v)

name: shift_nrel
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_nrel {k R v : V} (hR : L.IsRel k R) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    shift L (^nrelk R v) = ^nrelk R (termShiftVec L k v)

name: shift_verum
statement: @[simp] lemma shift_verum : shift L (^⊤ : V) = ^⊤

name: shift_falsum
statement: @[simp] lemma shift_falsum : shift L (^⊥ : V) = ^⊥

name: shift_and
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_and {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    shift L (p ^⋏ q) = shift L p ^⋏ shift L q

name: shift_or
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_or {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    shift L (p ^⋎ q) = shift L p ^⋎ shift L q

name: shift_all
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_all {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    shift L (^∀ p) = ^∀ (shift L p)

name: shift_exs
statement:
@[simp] lemma shift_exs {p : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    shift L (^∃ p) = ^∃ (shift L p)

name: shift_not_uformula
statement:
lemma shift_not_uformula {x : V} (h : ¬IsUFormula L x) :
    shift L x = 0

name: IsUFormula.shift
statement: lemma IsUFormula.shift {p : V} : IsUFormula L p → IsUFormula L (shift L p)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp]

name: IsUFormula.bv_shift
statement: lemma IsUFormula.bv_shift {p : V} : IsUFormula L p → bv L (Bootstrapping.shift L p) = bv L p
proof:
:= by
  apply IsUFormula.ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
  · definability
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · intro k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq, hp.shift, hq.shift]
  · intro p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp, hq, ihp, ihq, hp.shift, hq.shift]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp, hp.shift]
  · intro p hp ihp; simp [hp, ihp, hp.shift]

name: IsSemiformula.shift
statement: lemma IsSemiformula.shift {p : V} : IsSemiformula L n p → IsSemiformula L n (shift L p)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiformula.sigma1_structural_induction
  · definability
  · intro n k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv.isUTerm]
  · intro n k r v hr hv; simp [hr, hv.isUTerm]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, ihp, ihq]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, ihp, ihq]
  · intro n p hp ihp; simp [hp.isUFormula, ihp]
  · intro n p hp ihp; simp [hp.isUFormula, ihp]

name: IsUFormula.shift_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma IsUFormula.shift_iff {p : V} : IsUFormula L (Bootstrapping.shift L p) ↔ IsUFormula L p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; by_contra hp
    have Hp : IsUFormula L p := by by_contra hp; simp [shift_not_uformula hp] at h
    contradiction
  · exact IsUFormula.shift

name: IsSemiformula.shift_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma IsSemiformula.shift_iff {p : V} : IsSemiformula L n (Bootstrapping.shift L p) ↔ IsSemiformula L n p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by
    have : IsUFormula L p := by by_contra hp; simp [shift_not_uformula hp] at h
    exact ⟨this, by simpa [this.bv_shift] using h.bv_le⟩,
    IsSemiformula.shift⟩

name: shift_neg
statement: lemma shift_neg {p : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) : shift L (neg L p) = neg L (shift L p)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSemiformula.sigma1_structural_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro n k R v hR hv; simp [hR, hv.isUTerm, hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]
  · intro n k R v hR hv; simp [hR, hv.isUTerm, hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, hp.shift.isUFormula, hq.shift.isUFormula, ihp, ihq]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq; simp [hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, hp.shift.isUFormula, hq.shift.isUFormula, ihp, ihq]
  · intro n p hp ih; simp [hp.isUFormula, hp.shift.isUFormula, ih]
  · intro n p hp ih; simp [hp.isUFormula, hp.shift.isUFormula, ih]

name: substs_rel
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_rel {k R v : V} (hR : L.IsRel k R) (hv : IsUTermVec L k v) :
    subst L w (^relk R v) = ^rel k R (termSubstVec L k w v)

name: substs_nrel
statement:

name: substs_verum
statement: @[simp] lemma substs_verum (w : V) : subst L w ^⊤ = ^⊤

name: substs_falsum
statement: @[simp] lemma substs_falsum (w : V) : subst L w ^⊥ = ^⊥

name: substs_and
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_and {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    subst L w (p ^⋏ q) = subst L w p ^⋏ subst L w q

name: substs_or
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_or {p q : V} (hp : IsUFormula L p) (hq : IsUFormula L q) :
    subst L w (p ^⋎ q) = subst L w p ^⋎ subst L w q

name: substs_all
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_all {p} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    subst L w (^∀ p) = ^∀ (subst L (qVec L w) p)

name: substs_ex
statement:
@[simp] lemma substs_ex {p} (hp : IsUFormula L p) :
    subst L w (^∃ p) = ^∃ (subst L (qVec L w) p)

name: isUFormula_subst_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction
statement:
lemma isUFormula_subst_ISigma1.sigma1_succ_induction {P : V → V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation₃ P)
    (hRel : ∀ w k R v, L.IsRel k R → IsUTermVec L k v → P w (^relk R v) (^rel k R (termSubstVec L k w v)))
    (hNRel : ∀ w k R v, L.IsRel k R → IsUTermVec L k v → P w (^nrelk R v) (^nrel k R (termSubstVec L k w v)))
    (hverum : ∀ w, P w ^⊤ ^⊤)
    (hfalsum : ∀ w, P w ^⊥ ^⊥)
    (hand : ∀ w p q, IsUFormula L p → IsUFormula L q →
      P w p (subst L w p) → P w q (subst L w q) → P w (p ^⋏ q) (subst L w p ^⋏ subst L w q))
    (hor : ∀ w p q, IsUFormula L p → IsUFormula L q →
      P w p (subst L w p) → P w q (subst L w q) → P w (p ^⋎ q) (subst L w p ^⋎ subst L w q))
    (hall : ∀ w p, IsUFormula L p → P (qVec L w) p (subst L (qVec L w) p) → P w (^∀ p) (^∀ (subst L (qVec L w) p)))
    (hexs : ∀ w p, IsUFormula L p → P (qVec L w) p (subst L (qVec L w) p) → P w (^∃ p) (^∃ (subst L (qVec L w) p))) :
    ∀ {w p}, IsUFormula L p → P w p (subst L w p)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ param p, IsUFormula L p → P param p ((construction L).result L param p) by
    intro w p hp; simpa using! this w p hp
  apply (construction L).uformula_result_induction (P := fun param p y ↦ P param p y)
  · definability
  · intro param k R v hkR hv; simpa using! hRel param k R v hkR hv
  · intro param k R v hkR hv; simpa using! hNRel param k R v hkR hv
  · intro param; simpa using! hverum param
  · intro param; simpa using! hfalsum param
  · intro param p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simpa [subst] using!
      hand param p q hp hq (by simpa [subst] using ihp) (by simpa [subst] using ihq)
  · intro param p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simpa [subst] using!
      hor param p q hp hq (by simpa [subst] using ihp) (by simpa [subst] using ihq)
  · intro param p hp ihp
    simpa using! hall param p hp (by simpa [construction] using! ihp)
  · intro param p hp ihp
    simpa using! hexs param p hp (by simpa [construction] using! ihp)

name: semiformula_subst_induction
statement:
lemma semiformula_subst_induction {P : V → V → V → V → Prop} (hP : 𝚺₁-Relation₄ P)
    (hRel : ∀ n w k R v, L.IsRel k R → IsSemitermVec L k n v → P n w (^relk R v) (^rel k R (termSubstVec L k w v)))
    (hNRel : ∀ n w k R v, L.IsRel k R → IsSemitermVec L k n v → P n w (^nrelk R v) (^nrel k R (termSubstVec L k w v)))
    (hverum : ∀ n w, P n w ^⊤ ^⊤)
    (hfalsum : ∀ n w, P n w ^⊥ ^⊥)
    (hand : ∀ n w p q, IsSemiformula L n p → IsSemiformula L n q →
      P n w p (subst L w p) → P n w q (subst L w q) → P n w (p ^⋏ q) (subst L w p ^⋏ subst L w q))
    (hor : ∀ n w p q, IsSemiformula L n p → IsSemiformula L n q →
      P n w p (subst L w p) → P n w q (subst L w q) → P n w (p ^⋎ q) (subst L w p ^⋎ subst L w q))
    (hall : ∀ n w p, IsSemiformula L (n + 1) p →
      P (n + 1) (qVec L w) p (subst L (qVec L w) p) → P n w (^∀ p) (^∀ (subst L (qVec L w) p)))
    (hexs : ∀ n w p, IsSemiformula L (n + 1) p →
      P (n + 1) (qVec L w) p (subst L (qVec L w) p) → P n w (^∃ p) (^∃ (subst L (qVec L w) p))) :
    ∀ {n p w}, IsSemiformula L n p → P n w p (subst L w p)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ param n p, IsSemiformula L n p → P n param p ((construction L).result L param p) by
    intro n p w hp; simpa using! this w n p hp
  apply (construction L).semiformula_result_induction (P := fun param n p y ↦ P n param p y)
  · definability
  · intro n param k R v hkR hv; simpa using! hRel n param k R v hkR hv
  · intro n param k R v hkR hv; simpa using! hNRel n param k R v hkR hv
  · intro n param; simpa using! hverum n param
  · intro n param; simpa using! hfalsum n param
  · intro n param p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simpa [subst] using!
      hand n param p q hp hq (by simpa [subst] using ihp) (by simpa [subst] using ihq)
  · intro n param p q hp hq ihp ihq
    simpa [subst] using!
      hor n param p q hp hq (by simpa [subst] using ihp) (by simpa [subst] using ihq)
  · intro n param p hp ihp
    simpa using! hall n param p hp (by simpa [construction] using! ihp)
  · intro n param p hp ihp
    simpa using! hexs n param p hp (by simpa [construction] using! ihp)

name: IsSemiformula.subst
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsSemiformula.subst {n p m w : V} :
    IsSemiformula L n p → IsSemitermVec L n m w → IsSemiformula L m (subst L w p)
proof:
:= by
  let fw : V → V → V → V → V := fun _ w _ _ ↦ Max.max w (qVec L w)
  have hfw : 𝚺₁-Function₄ fw := by definability
  let fn : V → V → V → V → V := fun _ _ n _ ↦ n + 1
  have hfn : 𝚺₁-Function₄ fn := by definability
  let fm : V → V → V → V → V := fun _ _ _ m ↦ m + 1
  have hfm : 𝚺₁-Function₄ fm := by definability
  apply bounded_all_sigma1_order_induction₃ hfw hfn hfm ?_ ?_ p w n m
  · definability
  intro p w n m ih hp hw
  rcases IsSemiformula.case_iff.mp hp with
    (⟨k, R, v, hR, hv, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, R, v, hR, hv, rfl⟩ | rfl | rfl | ⟨p₁, p₂, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₁, p₂, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₁, h₁, rfl⟩ | ⟨p₁, h₁, rfl⟩)
  · simp [hR, hv.isUTerm, hw.termSubstVec hv]
  · simp [hR, hv.isUTerm, hw.termSubstVec hv]
  · simp
  · simp
  · have ih₁ : IsSemiformula L m (Bootstrapping.subst L w p₁) := ih p₁ (by simp) w (by simp [fw]) n (by simp [fn]) m (by simp [fm]) h₁ hw
    have ih₂ : IsSemiformula L m (Bootstrapping.subst L w p₂) := ih p₂ (by simp) w (by simp [fw]) n (by simp [fn]) m (by simp [fm]) h₂ hw
    simp [h₁.isUFormula, h₂.isUFormula, ih₁, ih₂]
  · have ih₁ : IsSemiformula L m (Bootstrapping.subst L w p₁) := ih p₁ (by simp) w (by simp [fw]) n (by simp [fn]) m (by simp [fm]) h₁ hw
    have ih₂ : IsSemiformula L m (Bootstrapping.subst L w p₂) := ih p₂ (by simp) w (by simp [fw]) n (by simp [fn]) m (by simp [fm]) h₂ hw
    simp [h₁.isUFormula, h₂.isUFormula, ih₁, ih₂]
  · simpa [h₁.isUFormula] using ih p₁ (by simp) (qVec L w) (by simp [fw]) (n + 1) (by simp [fn]) (m + 1) (by simp [fm]) h₁ hw.qVec
  · simpa [h₁.isUFormula] using ih p₁ (by simp) (qVec L w) (by simp [fw]) (n + 1) (by simp [fn]) (m + 1) (by simp [fm]) h₁ hw.qVec

name: substs_not_uformula
statement:
lemma substs_not_uformula {w x : V} (h : ¬IsUFormula L x) :
    subst L w x = 0

name: substs_neg
statement:
lemma substs_neg {p} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) :
    IsSemitermVec L n m w → subst L w (neg L p) = neg L (subst L w p)
proof:
:= by
  revert m w
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intros n k R v hR hv m w hw
    rw [neg_rel hR hv.isUTerm, substs_nrel hR hv.isUTerm, substs_rel hR hv.isUTerm, neg_rel hR (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm]
  · intros n k R v hR hv m w hw
    rw [neg_nrel hR hv.isUTerm, substs_rel hR hv.isUTerm, substs_nrel hR hv.isUTerm, neg_nrel hR (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm]
  · intros; simp [*]
  · intros; simp [*]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m w hw
    rw [neg_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_or hp.neg.isUFormula hq.neg.isUFormula,
      substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      neg_and (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      ihp hw, ihq hw]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m w hw
    rw [neg_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_and hp.neg.isUFormula hq.neg.isUFormula,
      substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      neg_or (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      ihp hw, ihq hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m w hw
    rw [neg_all hp.isUFormula, substs_ex hp.neg.isUFormula,
      substs_all hp.isUFormula, neg_all (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula, ih hw.qVec]
  · intro n p hp ih m w hw
    rw [neg_ex hp.isUFormula, substs_all hp.neg.isUFormula,
      substs_ex hp.isUFormula, neg_ex (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula, ih hw.qVec]

name: shift_substs
statement:
lemma shift_substs {p} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) :
    IsSemitermVec L n m w → shift L (subst L w p) = subst L (termShiftVec L n w) (shift L p)
proof:
:= by
  revert m w
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro n k R v hR hv m w hw
    rw [substs_rel hR hv.isUTerm,
      shift_rel hR (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      shift_rel hR hv.isUTerm,
      substs_rel hR hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqRel_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm])
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      termShift_termSubsts (hv.nth hi) hw]
  · intro n k R v hR hv m w hw
    rw [substs_nrel hR hv.isUTerm,
      shift_nrel hR (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm,
      shift_nrel hR hv.isUTerm,
      substs_nrel hR hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqNRel_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k
      (by rw [len_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm])
      (by rw [len_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termShiftVec (hw.termSubstVec hv).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hv.termShiftVec.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termShiftVec hv.isUTerm hi,
      termShift_termSubsts (hv.nth hi) hw]
  · intro n w hw; simp
  · intro n w hw; simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m w hw
    rw [substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      shift_and (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      shift_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_and hp.shift.isUFormula hq.shift.isUFormula,
      ihp hw, ihq hw]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq m w hw
    rw [substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      shift_or (hp.subst hw).isUFormula (hq.subst hw).isUFormula,
      shift_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_or hp.shift.isUFormula hq.shift.isUFormula,
      ihp hw, ihq hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m w hw
    rw [substs_all hp.isUFormula,
      shift_all (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      shift_all hp.isUFormula,
      substs_all hp.shift.isUFormula,
      ih hw.qVec,
      termShift_qVec hw]
  · intro n p hp ih m w hw
    rw [substs_ex hp.isUFormula,
      shift_exs (hp.subst hw.qVec).isUFormula,
      shift_exs hp.isUFormula,
      substs_ex hp.shift.isUFormula,
      ih hw.qVec,
      termShift_qVec hw]

name: substs_substs
statement:
lemma substs_substs {p} (hp : IsSemiformula L l p) :
    IsSemitermVec L n m w → IsSemitermVec L l n v → subst L w (subst L v p) = subst L (termSubstVec L l w v) p
proof:
:= by
  revert m w n v
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro l k R ts hR hts m w n v _ hv
    rw [substs_rel hR hts.isUTerm,
      substs_rel hR (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm,
      substs_rel hR hts.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqRel_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k (by rw [len_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm]) (by rw [len_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi,
      termSubst_termSubst hv (hts.nth hi)]
  · intro l k R ts hR hts m w n v _ hv
    rw [substs_nrel hR hts.isUTerm,
      substs_nrel hR (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm,
      substs_nrel hR hts.isUTerm]
    simp only [qqNRel_inj, true_and]
    apply nth_ext' k (by rw [len_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm]) (by rw [len_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec (hv.termSubstVec hts).isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi,
      nth_termSubstVec hts.isUTerm hi,
      termSubst_termSubst hv (hts.nth hi)]
  · intros; simp
  · intros; simp
  · intro l p q hp hq ihp ihq m w n v hw hv
    rw [substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_and (hp.subst hv).isUFormula (hq.subst hv).isUFormula,
      substs_and hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      ihp hw hv, ihq hw hv]
  · intro l p q hp hq ihp ihq m w n v hw hv
    rw [substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      substs_or (hp.subst hv).isUFormula (hq.subst hv).isUFormula,
      substs_or hp.isUFormula hq.isUFormula,
      ihp hw hv, ihq hw hv]
  · intro l p hp ih m w n v hw hv
    rw [substs_all hp.isUFormula,
      substs_all (hp.subst hv.qVec).isUFormula,
      substs_all hp.isUFormula,
      ih hw.qVec hv.qVec,
      termSubstVec_qVec_qVec hv hw]
  · intro l p hp ih m w n v hw hv
    rw [substs_ex hp.isUFormula,
      substs_ex (hp.subst hv.qVec).isUFormula,
      substs_ex hp.isUFormula,
      ih hw.qVec hv.qVec,
      termSubstVec_qVec_qVec hv hw]

name: subst_eq_self
statement:
lemma subst_eq_self {n w : V} (hp : IsSemiformula L n p) (hw : IsSemitermVec L n n w) (H : ∀ i < n, w.[i] = ^#i) :
    subst L w p = p
proof:
:= by
  revert w
  apply IsSemiformula.pi1_structural_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hp
  · definability
  · intro n k R v hR hv w _ H
    simp only [substs_rel, qqRel_inj, true_and, hR, hv.isUTerm]
    apply nth_ext' k (by simp [*, hv.isUTerm]) (by simp [hv.lh])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi, termSubst_eq_self (hv.nth hi) H]
  · intro n k R v hR hv w _ H
    simp only [substs_nrel, qqNRel_inj, true_and, hR, hv.isUTerm]
    apply nth_ext' k (by simp [*, hv.isUTerm]) (by simp [hv.lh])
    intro i hi
    rw [nth_termSubstVec hv.isUTerm hi, termSubst_eq_self (hv.nth hi) H]
  · intro n w _ _; simp
  · intro n w _ _; simp
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq w hw H
    simp [*, hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, ihp hw H, ihq hw H]
  · intro n p q hp hq ihp ihq w hw H
    simp [*, hp.isUFormula, hq.isUFormula, ihp hw H, ihq hw H]
  · intro n p hp ih w hw H
    have H : ∀ i < n + 1, (qVec L w).[i] = ^#i := by
      intro i hi
      rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · simp [qVec]
      · have hi : i < n := by simpa using hi
        simp only [qVec, nth_adjoin_succ]
        rw [nth_termBShiftVec (by simpa [hw.lh] using hw.isUTerm) (by simp [hw.lh, hi])]
        simp [H i hi]
    simp [*, hp.isUFormula, ih hw.qVec H]
  · intro n p hp ih w hw H
    have H : ∀ i < n + 1, (qVec L w).[i] = ^#i := by
      intro i hi
      rcases zero_or_succ i with (rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      · simp [qVec]
      · have hi : i < n := by simpa using hi
        simp only [qVec, nth_adjoin_succ]
        rw [nth_termBShiftVec (by simpa [hw.lh] using hw.isUTerm) (by simp [hw.lh, hi])]
        simp [H i hi]
    simp [*, hp.isUFormula, ih hw.qVec H]
