name: monotone_of_succ_monotone
statement:
lemma monotone_of_succ_monotone {r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (rfx : Std.Refl r) (tr : IsTrans ℕ r)
    (succ : ∀ n, r n (n + 1)) : n ≤ m → r n m
proof:
:= by
  revert n m
  suffices ∀ n d, r n (n + d) by
    intro n m hnm
    have := this n (m - n)
    grind
  intro n d
  induction d
  case zero => simp [rfx.refl n]
  case succ d ih =>
    simpa using! tr.trans _ _ _ ih (succ (n + d))

name: vector_le
statement:
private lemma vector_le (tr : IsTrans α r) {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (h : DirectedOn r s) (v : Fin n → α) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ s) :
    ∃ z ∈ s, ∀ i, r (v i) z
proof:
:=
  match n with
  | 0     => by
    rcases hs with ⟨x, hx⟩; exact ⟨x, hx, fun i ↦ IsEmpty.elim inferInstance i⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    have : ∃ z ∈ s, ∀ i : Fin n, r (v i.succ) z := h.vector_le tr hs (n := n) (fun i ↦ v i.succ) fun i ↦ hv i.succ
    rcases this with ⟨x, hx, hr⟩
    have : ∃ z ∈ s, r x z ∧ r (v 0) z := h x hx (v 0) (hv 0)
    rcases this with ⟨z, hz, hrxz, hrz⟩
    refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
    intro i
    cases i using Fin.cases
    case zero => assumption
    case succ i =>
      exact tr.trans _ _ _ (hr i) hrxz

name: fintype_colimit
statement:
lemma fintype_colimit [Fintype ι] (tr : IsTrans α r)
    {s : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (h : DirectedOn r s) (v : ι → α) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ s) :
    ∃ z ∈ s, ∀ i, r (v i) z
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin (Fintype.card ι) → α := fun x ↦ v ((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm x)
  rcases DirectedOn.vector_le tr hs h f (by intro; simp [f, hv]) with ⟨z, hzs, hz⟩
  exact ⟨z, hzs, fun i ↦ by simpa [f] using hz ((Fintype.equivFin ι) i)⟩

name: exists_genericFilter_of_countable
statement:
theorem exists_genericFilter_of_countable
    (𝓓 : Set (DenseSet α)) (ctb : Set.Countable 𝓓) (a : α) :
    ∃ G : PFilter α, G.IsGeneric 𝓓 ∧ a ∈ G
proof:
:= by
  by_cases emp : 𝓓.Nonempty
  case neg =>
    exact ⟨principal a, by simp [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp emp], by simp⟩
  have : ∃ D : ℕ → 𝓓, Function.Surjective D := ctb.exists_surjective emp
  rcases this with ⟨D, hD⟩
  let s (n : ℕ) : α := n.rec a fun i ↦ (D i).val.choose
  have hs : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → s i ≥ s j := fun i j hij ↦
    Nat.monotone_of_succ_monotone (r := fun i j ↦ s i ≥ s j)
      ⟨fun _ ↦ le_refl _⟩
      ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ ge_trans⟩
      (by simp [s]) hij
  refine ⟨ofDescendingChain s hs, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro d hd
    rcases show ∃ i, D i = ⟨d, hd⟩ from hD ⟨d, hd⟩ with ⟨i, hi⟩
    refine ⟨s (i + 1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [mem_descendingChain_iff]
      exact ⟨i + 1, by rfl⟩
    · simp [s, hi]
  · suffices ∃ i, s i ≤ a by simpa
    refine ⟨0, by simp [s]⟩

name: himp_himp_inf_himp_inf_le
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
lemma himp_himp_inf_himp_inf_le (a b c : α) : (a ⇨ b ⇨ c) ⊓ (a ⇨ b) ⊓ a ≤ c
proof:
:= calc
  (a ⇨ b ⇨ c) ⊓ (a ⇨ b) ⊓ a = (a ⇨ b ⇨ c) ⊓ b ⊓ a := by simp only [inf_assoc, himp_inf_self]
  _                         = (a ⇨ b ⇨ c) ⊓ a ⊓ b := by simp only [inf_assoc, inf_comm a b]
  _                         ≤ (b ⇨ c) ⊓ b         := by simp only [himp_inf_self a (b ⇨ c), le_inf_iff]
                                                        constructor
                                                        · simp only [inf_assoc, inf_le_left]
                                                        · exact inf_le_right
  _                         ≤ c                   := by simp

name: himp_inf_himp_inf_sup_le
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
lemma himp_inf_himp_inf_sup_le (a b c : α) : (a ⇨ c) ⊓ (b ⇨ c) ⊓ (a ⊔ b) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ≤ (a ⇨ c) ⊓ (b ⇨ c) ⇨ c := by
    simp only [le_himp_iff, ← inf_assoc, inf_himp]
    refine inf_le_of_left_le (by simp)
  have hb : b ≤ (a ⇨ c) ⊓ (b ⇨ c) ⇨ c := by
    simp only [le_himp_iff, inf_comm (a ⇨ c) (b ⇨ c), ← inf_assoc, inf_himp]
    refine inf_le_of_left_le (by simp)
  have : a ⊔ b ≤ (a ⇨ c) ⊓ (b ⇨ c) ⇨ c := sup_le_iff.mpr ⟨ha, hb⟩
  simpa only [GeneralizedHeytingAlgebra.le_himp_iff, inf_comm (a ⊔ b)] using this

name: forall_le_vec_iff_forall_le_forall_vec
statement:
lemma forall_le_vec_iff_forall_le_forall_vec [LE α] {P : (Fin (k + 1) → α) → Prop} {f : Fin (k + 1) → α} :
    (∀ v ≤ f, P v) ↔ ∀ x ≤ f 0, ∀ v ≤ (f ·.succ), P (x :> v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx v hv
    refine h (x :> v) ?_
    intro i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i
    · exact hx
    · exact hv i
  · intro h v hv
    simpa using h (v 0) (hv 0) (v ·.succ) (hv ·.succ)

name: forall_vec_iff_forall_forall_vec
statement:
lemma forall_vec_iff_forall_forall_vec {P : (Fin (k + 1) → α) → Prop} :
    (∀ v : Fin (k + 1) → α, P v) ↔ ∀ x, ∀ v : Fin k → α, P (x :> v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x v; exact h _
  · intro h v; simpa using h (v 0) (v ·.succ)

name: exists_vec_iff_exists_exists_vec
statement:
lemma exists_vec_iff_exists_exists_vec {P : (Fin (k + 1) → α) → Prop} :
    (∃ v : Fin (k + 1) → α, P v) ↔ ∃ x, ∃ v : Fin k → α, P (x :> v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, h⟩; exact ⟨v 0, (v ·.succ), by simpa using h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, v, h⟩; exact ⟨_, h⟩

name: exists_le_vec_iff_exists_le_exists_vec
statement:
lemma exists_le_vec_iff_exists_le_exists_vec [LE α] {P : (Fin (k + 1) → α) → Prop} {f : Fin (k + 1) → α} :
    (∃ v ≤ f, P v) ↔ ∃ x ≤ f 0, ∃ v ≤ (f ·.succ), P (x :> v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, h⟩
    exact ⟨w 0, hw 0, (w ·.succ), fun i ↦ hw i.succ, by simpa using h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, v, hv, h⟩
    refine ⟨x :> v, ?_, h⟩
    intro i; cases' i using Fin.cases with i
    · exact hx
    · exact hv i

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h 0, fun i ↦ h i.succ⟩, by
    rintro ⟨hz, hs⟩ i
    cases' i using Fin.cases with i

name: exists_fin_iff_zero_or_exists_succ

proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      cases i using Fin.cases
      · left; exact hi
      · right; exact ⟨_, hi⟩,
   by rintro (hz | ⟨i, h⟩)
      · exact ⟨0, hz⟩
      · exact ⟨_, h⟩⟩

name: biUnion_eq_empty
statement:
lemma biUnion_eq_empty [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Finset β} :
    s.biUnion f = ∅ ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha; ext b
    have := by simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem h) b
    simpa using this a ha
  · intro h; ext b
    suffices ∀ x ∈ s, b ∉ f x by simpa
    intro a ha; simpa using congrFun (congrArg Membership.mem (h a ha)) b

name: natToVec_vecToNat
statement: @[simp] lemma natToVec_vecToNat (v : Fin n → ℕ) : (vecToNat v).natToVec n = some v
proof:
:= by
  induction n
  · simp [*, Nat.natToVec, vecToNat, Matrix.empty_eq]
  case succ _ ih =>
    suffices v 0 :> v ∘ Fin.succ = v by
      simp only [vecToNat, foldr_succ, natToVec, unpair_pair, Option.map_eq_some_iff]
      use vecTail v
      simpa using! ih (vecTail v)
    exact funext (fun i ↦ i.cases (by simp) (by simp))

name: lt_of_eq_natToVec
statement: lemma lt_of_eq_natToVec {e : ℕ} {v : Fin n → ℕ} (h : e.natToVec n = some v) (i : Fin n) : v i < e
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih generalizing e
  · exact i.elim0
  · cases' e with e
    · simp [natToVec] at h
    · simp only [natToVec, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
      rcases h with ⟨v, hnv, rfl⟩
      cases' i using Fin.cases with i
      · simp [Nat.lt_succ_iff, unpair_left_le]
      · simp only [cons_val_succ]
        exact lt_trans (ih hnv i) (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr <| unpair_right_le e)

name: natToVec_eq_some_iff
statement:
lemma natToVec_eq_some_iff {e k : ℕ} {v : Fin k → ℕ} :
    e.natToVec k = some v ↔ natToList e = List.ofFn v
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing e with
  | zero =>
    cases e with
    | zero => simp [natToVec, natToList, Matrix.empty_eq]
    | succ e => simp [natToVec, natToList]
  | succ k ih =>
    cases e with
    | zero => simp [natToVec, natToList]
    | succ e =>
      rw [natToVec, natToList, List.ofFn_succ]
      constructor
      · rintro h
        rw [Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
        obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := h
        rw [ih.mp hw]
        simp
      · rintro h
        rw [List.cons.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨h0, hl⟩ := h
        refine Option.map_eq_some_iff.mpr ⟨fun i ↦ v i.succ, ih.mpr hl, ?_⟩
        exact funext fun i ↦ i.cases (by simp [h0]) (by simp)

name: natToVec_eq_none_of_length
statement:
lemma natToVec_eq_none_of_length {e k : ℕ} (h : (natToList e).length ≠ k) :
    e.natToVec k = none
proof:
:= by
  rcases hv : e.natToVec k with _ | v
  · rfl
  · exact absurd (by rw [natToVec_eq_some_iff.mp hv]; simp) h

name: natToVec_isSome_of_length
statement:
lemma natToVec_isSome_of_length {e k : ℕ} (h : (natToList e).length = k) :
    ∃ v : Fin k → ℕ, e.natToVec k = some v
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ (natToList e).get i, natToVec_eq_some_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  exact (List.ofFn_get _).symm

name: rec_eq
statement:
lemma rec_eq {α : Sort*} (a : α) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → α → α) (n : ℕ) (H : ∀ m < n, ∀ a, f₁ m a = f₂ m a) :
    (n.rec a f₁ : α) = n.rec a f₂
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih <;> simp
  · have : (n.rec a f₁ : α) = n.rec a f₂ := ih (fun m hm a =>  H m (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hm) a)
    simpa [this] using H n (Nat.lt_add_one n) (n.rec a f₂)

proof:

  induction' n using Nat.strongRec with n ih
  by_cases H : ∃ m < n, P m
  · rcases H with ⟨m, hm, hPm⟩
    exact ih m hm hPm
  · exact ⟨n, hn, by simpa using H⟩

statement: lemma pair_le_pair_of_le {a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℕ} (ha : a₁ ≤ a₂) (hb : b₁ ≤ b₂) : a₁.pair b₁ ≤ a₂.pair b₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha with (ha | rfl) <;> rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with (hb | rfl)
  · exact le_of_lt (lt_trans (Nat.pair_lt_pair_left b₁ ha) (Nat.pair_lt_pair_right a₂ hb))
  · exact le_of_lt (Nat.pair_lt_pair_left b₁ ha)
  · exact le_of_lt (Nat.pair_lt_pair_right a₁ hb)
  · rfl

proof:
:= by
  induction' l with n ns ih
  case nil => simp at h
  case cons m =>
    suffices m < n + 1 ∨ m < ns.upper by simpa
    rcases show m = n ∨ m ∈ ns by simpa using h with (rfl | h)
    · exact Or.inl (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    · exact Or.inr (ih h)

proof:
:= by
  induction' l with a l ih
  · simp
  case cons _ b =>
    intro h
    rcases show b = a ∨ b ∈ l by simpa using h with (rfl | h)
    · simp
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right (ih h)

name: sup_ofFn
statement: lemma sup_ofFn (f : Fin n → α) : (ofFn f).sup = Finset.sup Finset.univ f
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih
  · simp
  · have h₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) = insert 0 ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).image Fin.succ) := by
      ext i; simp
    have h₂ : Finset.sup Finset.univ (fun i ↦ f (Fin.succ i)) = Finset.sup {0}ᶜ f := by
      simpa [Function.comp] using! Eq.symm <| Finset.sup_image (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) Fin.succ f
    calc
      (ofFn f).sup = (f 0 ⊔ Finset.univ.sup fun i : Fin _ ↦ f i.succ) := by simp [ih]
      _            = f 0 ⊔ Finset.sup {0}ᶜ f                          := by rw [h₂]
      _            = Finset.univ.sup f                                := by rw [h₁, Finset.sup_insert]; simp

name: ofFn_get_eq_map_cast
statement:
lemma ofFn_get_eq_map_cast {n} (g : α → β) (as : List α) {h} :
    ofFn (fun i => g (as.get (i.cast h)) : Fin n → β) = as.map g
proof:
:= by
  ext i b; simp
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · simp [hi, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (h ▸ hi)]
  · simp [hi, List.getElem?_eq_none (le_of_not_gt $ h ▸ hi)]

proof:
:=
  match l₁ with
  |      [] => by simp
  | a :: l₁ => by
    intro h
    by_cases h₁₂ : l₁ <:+ l₂
    · exact ⟨l₁, a, by simp_all⟩
    · rcases exists_of_not_suffix l₁ l₂ h₁₂ with ⟨l, b, hb, hll₂, nh⟩
      exact ⟨l, b, suffix_cons_of hb, hll₂, nh⟩

name: IsSuffix.eq_or_cons_suffix
statement: lemma IsSuffix.eq_or_cons_suffix : l₁ <:+ l₂ → l₁ = l₂ ∨ ∃ a, a :: l₁ <:+ l₂
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
  rcases eq_nil_or_concat' l with (rfl | ⟨l, a, rfl⟩)
  · simp
  · right; exact ⟨a, l, by simp⟩

name: suffix_trichotomy
statement: lemma suffix_trichotomy {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h₁₂ : ¬l₁ <:+ l₂) (h₂₁ : ¬l₂ <:+ l₁) : ∃ l a b, a ≠ b ∧ a :: l <:+ l₁ ∧ b :: l <:+ l₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_of_not_suffix _ _ h₁₂ with ⟨l, a, ha, hkl, _⟩
  have : ∃ b, b :: l <:+ l₂ := by
    rcases hkl.eq_or_cons_suffix with (rfl | h)
    · have : l <:+ l₁ := suffix_of_cons_suffix ha
      contradiction
    exact h
  rcases this with ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact ⟨l, a, b, by rintro rfl; contradiction, ha, hb⟩

name: get_mk_eq_get
statement: lemma get_mk_eq_get {n} (l : List α) (h : l.length = n) (i : Fin n) : List.Vector.get (⟨l, h⟩ : List.Vector α n) i = l.get (i.cast h.symm)

name: get_one
statement: lemma get_one {α : Type*} {n} (v : Vector α (n + 2)) : v.get 1 = v.tail.head

name: ofFn_vecCons
statement:
lemma ofFn_vecCons (a : α) (v : Fin n → α) :
    ofFn (a :> v) = a ::ᵥ ofFn v
proof:
:= by
  ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: cons_get
statement: lemma cons_get (a : α) (v : List.Vector α k) : (a ::ᵥ v).get = a :> v.get

statement: lemma exists_of_not_nil (hl : l ≠ []) : ∃ a, a ∈ l

name: iff_nil_forall
statement: lemma iff_nil_forall : (l = []) ↔ (∀ a ∈ l, a ∈ [])

name: nodup_iff_get_ne_get
statement: lemma nodup_iff_get_ne_get : l.Nodup ↔ ∀ i j : Fin l.length, i < j → l[i] ≠ l[j]

name: Nodup.infinite_of_infinite
statement: lemma Nodup.infinite_of_infinite : Infinite {l : List α // l.Nodup} → Infinite α

name: exists_of_range
statement: lemma exists_of_range (h : a ∈ List.map f (List.range n)) : ∃ i < n, a = f i

name: single_suffix_uniq
statement: lemma single_suffix_uniq {l : List α} (ha : [a] <:+ l) (hb : [b] <:+ l) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha with ⟨la, rfl⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨lb, e⟩
  exact Eq.symm (List.concat_inj.mp <| by { simpa using e }).2

name: doubleton_subset
statement: lemma doubleton_subset : ({a, b} : Set α) ⊆ s ↔ a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s

name: iff_subset_insert_subset_diff
statement: lemma iff_subset_insert_subset_diff : s ⊆ insert a t ↔ s \ {a} ⊆ t

name: ssubset_of_subset_ne
statement: lemma ssubset_of_subset_ne (h : s ⊆ t) (hne : s ≠ t) : s ⊂ t

name: infinitely_finset_approximate
statement:
lemma infinitely_finset_approximate (count : s.Countable) (inf : s.Infinite) (ha : a ∈ s) :
  ∃ f : ℕ → Finset α, ((f 0) = {a}) ∧ (∀ i, f i ⊂ f (i + 1)) ∧ (∀ i, ↑(f i) ⊆ s) ∧ (∀ b ∈ s, ∃ i, b ∈ f i)
proof:
:= by
  let X' := s \ {a}
  have count' : Countable X' := (count.mono Set.sdiff_subset).to_subtype
  have inf' : Infinite X' := (inf.sdiff (Set.finite_singleton a)).to_subtype
  obtain ⟨eq⟩ : Nonempty (Nat ≃ X') := nonempty_equiv_of_countable
  refine ⟨
    fun n => Finset.cons a ((Finset.range n).map
    (eq.toEmbedding.trans (Function.Embedding.subtype _))) ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_
  ⟩
  · suffices ∀ x < n, ¬↑(eq x) = a by simpa;
    intro x _
    exact (eq x).prop.right
  · rfl
  · simp [Finset.ssubset_def]
  · suffices ∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Iio i ⊆ (fun a ↦ ↑(eq a)) ⁻¹' s by simpa [Set.insert_subset_iff, ha]
    intro i x _;
    exact (eq x).prop.left
  · intro b hb
    by_cases hba : b = a
    · exact ⟨0, by simp [hba]⟩
    · refine ⟨eq.symm ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ + 1, ?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_cons_of_mem;
      suffices ∃ a_1 < eq.symm ⟨b, _⟩ + 1, ↑(eq _) = b by simpa;
      exact ⟨eq.symm ⟨b, hb, hba⟩, by simp⟩

name: subset_mem_chain_of_finite
statement:
lemma subset_mem_chain_of_finite (c : Set (Set α)) (hc : Set.Nonempty c) (hchain : IsChain (· ⊆ ·) c)
    {s} (hfin : Set.Finite s) : s ⊆ ⋃₀ c → ∃ t ∈ c, s ⊆ t
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.induction_on s hfin
    (by rcases hc with ⟨t, ht⟩; intro; exact ⟨t, ht, by simp⟩)
    (by intro a s _ _ ih h
        have : ∃ t ∈ c, s ⊆ t := ih (subset_trans (Set.subset_insert a s) h)
        rcases this with ⟨t, htc, ht⟩
        have : ∃ u ∈ c, a ∈ u := by
          have : (∃ t ∈ c, a ∈ t) ∧ s ⊆ ⋃₀ c := by simpa [Set.insert_subset_iff] using h
          exact this.1
        rcases this with ⟨u, huc, hu⟩
        have : ∃ z ∈ c, t ⊆ z ∧ u ⊆ z := IsChain.directedOn hchain t htc u huc
        rcases this with ⟨z, hzc, htz, huz⟩
        exact ⟨z, hzc, Set.insert_subset (huz hu) (Set.Subset.trans ht htz)⟩)

name: eq_insertRep_self
statement: lemma eq_insertRep_self (x a : γ) : x = (x ⊓ a) ⊔ (x ⊓ aᶜ)

name: sup_insertRep
statement:
lemma sup_insertRep (y₁ z₁ y₂ z₂ a : γ) :
    ((y₁ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₁ ⊓ aᶜ)) ⊔ ((y₂ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₂ ⊓ aᶜ)) = ((y₁ ⊔ y₂) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z₁ ⊔ z₂) ⊓ aᶜ)

name: inf_insertRep
statement:
lemma inf_insertRep (y₁ z₁ y₂ z₂ a : γ) :
    ((y₁ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₁ ⊓ aᶜ)) ⊓ ((y₂ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₂ ⊓ aᶜ)) = ((y₁ ⊓ y₂) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z₁ ⊓ z₂) ⊓ aᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : y₁ ⊓ a ⊓ (z₂ ⊓ aᶜ) = ⊥ := by
    calc y₁ ⊓ a ⊓ (z₂ ⊓ aᶜ) = (y₁ ⊓ z₂) ⊓ (a ⊓ aᶜ) := by ac_rfl
    _ = ⊥ := by simp
  have h₂ : z₁ ⊓ aᶜ ⊓ (y₂ ⊓ a) = ⊥ := by
    calc z₁ ⊓ aᶜ ⊓ (y₂ ⊓ a) = (z₁ ⊓ y₂) ⊓ (a ⊓ aᶜ) := by ac_rfl
    _ = ⊥ := by simp
  rw [inf_sup_right, inf_sup_left, inf_sup_left, h₁, h₂]
  simp only [sup_bot_eq, bot_sup_eq]
  congr 1 <;> ac_rfl

name: mem_closure_insert
statement:
theorem mem_closure_insert :
    x ∈ closure (insert a (A : Set α)) ↔
      ∃ y ∈ A, ∃ z ∈ A, x = (y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx => closure_le (L := insertRep A a) |>.2 ?_ hx, ?_⟩
  · rintro w (rfl | hw)
    · exact ⟨⊤, top_mem, ⊥, bot_mem, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨w, hw, w, hw, BooleanAlgebra.eq_insertRep_self ..⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩
    have ha : a ∈ closure (insert a (A : Set α)) := subset_closure (Set.mem_insert ..)
    have hy' : y ∈ closure (insert a (A : Set α)) := subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hy)
    have hz' : z ∈ closure (insert a (A : Set α)) := subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hz)
    exact sup_mem (inf_mem hy' ha) (inf_mem hz' (compl_mem ha))

name: closure_insert_finite
statement:
lemma closure_insert_finite (hA : (A : Set α).Finite) (a : α) :
    ((closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α) : Set α).Finite
proof:
:=
  Set.Finite.subset (hA.biUnion fun y _ => hA.biUnion fun z _ =>
      Set.finite_singleton ((y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ))) <| by
    rintro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := mem_closure_insert.mp hx
    exact Set.mem_biUnion hy (Set.mem_biUnion hz rfl)

name: le_closure_insert
statement: lemma le_closure_insert : A ≤ closure (insert a (A : Set α))

name: self_mem_closure_insert
statement: lemma self_mem_closure_insert : a ∈ closure (insert a (A : Set α))

name: exists_insertRepPair
statement:
lemma exists_insertRepPair (u : (closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α)) :
    ∃ p : A × A, (u : α) = ((p.1 : α) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((p.2 : α) ⊓ aᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hu⟩ := mem_closure_insert.mp u.2
  exact ⟨(⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨z, hz⟩), hu⟩

name: insertRepPair_spec
statement:
lemma insertRepPair_spec (u : (closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α)) :
    (u : α) = (((insertRepPair u).1 : α) ⊓ a) ⊔ (((insertRepPair u).2 : α) ⊓ aᶜ)

name: val_eq_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma val_eq_bot {L : BooleanSubalgebra α} {x : L} : (x : α) = ⊥ ↔ x = ⊥

name: val_map_eq_bot
statement: lemma val_map_eq_bot (e : A ≃o B) (p : A) : (e p : β) = ⊥ ↔ (p : α) = ⊥

name: val_map_inf_eq_bot
statement:
lemma val_map_inf_eq_bot (e : A ≃o B) {p q : A} (h : p ⊓ q = ⊥) :
    (e p : β) ⊓ (e q : β) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have : (e p ⊓ e q : B) = ⊥ := by rw [← e.map_inf, h, e.map_bot]
  simpa using congrArg Subtype.val this

name: val_map_finsetSup
statement:
lemma val_map_finsetSup (e : A ≃o B) (s : Finset A) :
    ((e (s.sup id) : B) : β) = s.sup fun p => (e p : β)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert p s _ ih => simp only [Finset.sup_insert, id_eq, e.map_sup, val_sup, ih]

name: IsCompanion.symm
statement: lemma IsCompanion.symm (h : IsCompanion e a b) : IsCompanion e.symm b a
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  have := h (e.symm v)
  rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] at this
  exact ⟨this.1.symm, this.2.symm⟩

name: exists_companionPiece
statement:
lemma exists_companionPiece [DenselyOrdered β] (e : A ≃o B) (a : α) (p : A) :
    ∃ c : β, c ≤ (e p : β) ∧ (c = ⊥ ↔ (p : α) ⊓ a = ⊥) ∧ (c = (e p : β) ↔ (p : α) ≤ a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : (p : α) ⊓ a = ⊥
  · refine ⟨⊥, bot_le, iff_of_true rfl h₁, ?_⟩
    rw [eq_comm, val_map_eq_bot]
    exact ⟨fun h => le_of_eq_of_le h bot_le, fun h => by rw [← h₁, inf_eq_left.2 h]⟩
  · by_cases h₂ : (p : α) ≤ a
    · exact ⟨(e p : β), le_rfl,
        ⟨fun h => by rw [val_map_eq_bot] at h; simp [h], fun h => absurd h h₁⟩, iff_of_true rfl h₂⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, hc₁, hc₂⟩ :=
        exists_between (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 fun h => h₁ (by rw [(val_map_eq_bot e p).1 h]; simp))
      exact ⟨c, hc₂.le, iff_of_false hc₁.ne' h₁, iff_of_false hc₂.ne h₂⟩

name: exists_isCompanion
statement:
theorem exists_isCompanion [Nontrivial β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    (hA : (A : Set α).Finite) (e : A ≃o B) (a : α) :
    ∃ b : β, IsCompanion e a b
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite A := hA.to_subtype
  let := Fintype.ofFinite A
  have hmemw : ∀ {w p : A}, p ∈ BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow w ↔ IsAtom p ∧ p ≤ w := by
    intro w p; simp [BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow]
  choose bp hs₁ hs₂ hs₃ using exists_companionPiece e a
  obtain ⟨atoms, hmem⟩ : ∃ s : Finset A, ∀ p, p ∈ s ↔ IsAtom p :=
    ⟨BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow ⊤, fun p => by simp [hmemw]⟩
  have hX : ∀ p ∈ atoms, (e p : β) ⊓ atoms.sup bp = bp p := fun p hp => by
    rw [Finset.sup_inf_distrib_left]
    refine le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le fun q hq => ?_) ?_
    · rcases eq_or_ne q p with rfl | hqp
      · exact inf_le_right
      · calc (e p : β) ⊓ bp q ≤ (e p : β) ⊓ (e q : β) := inf_le_inf_left _ (hs₁ q)
          _ = ⊥ := val_map_inf_eq_bot e (disjoint_iff.mp
            (((hmem p).1 hp).disjoint_of_ne ((hmem q).1 hq) hqp.symm))
          _ ≤ bp p := bot_le
    · calc bp p = (e p : β) ⊓ bp p := (inf_eq_right.2 (hs₁ p)).symm
        _ ≤ atoms.sup fun q => (e p : β) ⊓ bp q :=
          Finset.le_sup (f := fun q => (e p : β) ⊓ bp q) hp
  refine ⟨atoms.sup bp, fun w => ?_⟩
  have hsub : ∀ p ∈ BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow w, p ∈ atoms := fun _ hp =>
    (hmem _).2 (hmemw.1 hp).1
  have hvalw : (w : α) = (BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow w).sup fun p => (p : α) := by
    rw [← val_finsetSup, BooleanAlgebra.sup_atomsBelow_eq]
  have hvalew : (e w : β) = (BooleanAlgebra.atomsBelow w).sup fun p => (e p : β) := by
    rw [← val_map_finsetSup e, BooleanAlgebra.sup_atomsBelow_eq]
  refine ⟨⟨fun hw => ?_, fun hw => ?_⟩, fun hw => ?_, fun hw => ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.sup_inf_distrib_left, Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff]
    intro p hp
    rcases BooleanAlgebra.IsAtom.le_or_disjoint ((hmem p).1 hp) w with hle | hdis
    · rw [(hs₂ p).2 (le_bot_iff.1 ((inf_le_inf_right a (show (p : α) ≤ (w : α) from hle)).trans_eq
        hw)), inf_bot_eq]
    · exact le_bot_iff.1 <| (inf_le_inf_left _ (hs₁ p)).trans_eq
        (val_map_inf_eq_bot e (by rwa [inf_comm] at hdis))
  · rw [hvalw, Finset.sup_inf_distrib_right, Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff]
    intro p hp
    refine (hs₂ p).1 (le_bot_iff.1 ?_)
    calc bp p = (e p : β) ⊓ atoms.sup bp := (hX p (hsub p hp)).symm
      _ ≤ (e w : β) ⊓ atoms.sup bp :=
        inf_le_inf_right _ (show (e p : β) ≤ (e w : β) from e.monotone (hmemw.1 hp).2)
      _ = ⊥ := hw
  · rw [hvalew]
    refine Finset.sup_le fun p hp => ?_
    rw [← (hs₃ p).2 (le_trans (show (p : α) ≤ (w : α) from (hmemw.1 hp).2) hw)]
    exact Finset.le_sup (hsub p hp)
  · rw [hvalw]
    refine Finset.sup_le fun p hp => (hs₃ p).1 ?_
    rw [← hX p (hsub p hp), inf_eq_left]
    exact le_trans (show (e p : β) ≤ (e w : β) from e.monotone (hmemw.1 hp).2) hw

name: IsCompanion.map_le_map
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := BooleanAlgebra.insertRep_le_insertRep_iff.mp hle
  rw [← val_sdiff] at h₁
  rw [← sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq_bot_iff, ← val_sdiff] at h₂
  refine BooleanAlgebra.insertRep_le_insertRep_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← val_sdiff, ← map_sdiff' e]
    exact (h (y₁ \ y₂)).1.mp h₁
  · rw [← val_sdiff, ← map_sdiff' e, ← sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq_bot_iff]
    exact (h (z₁ \ z₂)).2.mp h₂

name: IsCompanion.val_mapRep
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsCompanion.val_mapRep (h : IsCompanion e a b) : (h.mapRep u : β) =
    ((e (insertRepPair u).1 : β) ⊓ b) ⊔ ((e (insertRepPair u).2 : β) ⊓ bᶜ)

name: IsCompanion.mapRep_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.val_mapRep]
  exact le_antisymm (h.map_le_map (by rw [← insertRepPair_spec u, hu]))
    (h.map_le_map (by rw [← hu, insertRepPair_spec u]))

name: IsCompanion.mapRep_mono
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.mapRep_mono (h : IsCompanion e a b) (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) :
    h.mapRep u₁ ≤ h.mapRep u₂
proof:
:= by
  show (h.mapRep u₁ : β) ≤ (h.mapRep u₂ : β)
  rw [h.val_mapRep, h.val_mapRep]
  exact h.map_le_map (by rw [← insertRepPair_spec u₁, ← insertRepPair_spec u₂]; exact hu)

name: IsCompanion.mapRep_mapRep
statement: lemma IsCompanion.mapRep_mapRep (h : IsCompanion e a b) : h.symm.mapRep (h.mapRep u) = u
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  rw [h.symm.mapRep_eq (y := e (insertRepPair u).1) (z := e (insertRepPair u).2) h.val_mapRep,
    OrderIso.symm_apply_apply, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
  exact (insertRepPair_spec u).symm

name: IsCompanion.extend_spec
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_spec (h : IsCompanion e a b)
    (x : (closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α)) :
    ∃ y z : A, (x : α) = ((y : α) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z : α) ⊓ aᶜ) ∧
      (h.extend x : β) = ((e y : β) ⊓ b) ⊔ ((e z : β) ⊓ bᶜ)

name: IsCompanion.extend_coe
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_coe (h : IsCompanion e a b) (x : A) :
    (h.extend ⟨x, le_closure_insert x.2⟩ : β) = e x
proof:
:= by
  show (h.mapRep ⟨x, le_closure_insert x.2⟩ : β) = e x
  rw [h.mapRep_eq (y := x) (z := x) (BooleanAlgebra.eq_insertRep_self ..)]
  exact (BooleanAlgebra.eq_insertRep_self ..).symm

name: IsCompanion.extend_self
statement:
lemma IsCompanion.extend_self (h : IsCompanion e a b) :
    (h.extend ⟨a, self_mem_closure_insert⟩ : β) = b
proof:
:= by
  show (h.mapRep ⟨a, self_mem_closure_insert⟩ : β) = b
  rw [h.mapRep_eq (y := ⊤) (z := ⊥) (by simp)]
  simp [e.map_top, e.map_bot]

name: inf_le_iff_sdiff_disjoint
statement: lemma inf_le_iff_sdiff_disjoint : y₁ ⊓ a ≤ y₂ ⊓ a ↔ (y₁ \ y₂) ⊓ a = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_eq_bot_iff,
    show (y₁ ⊓ a) \ (y₂ ⊓ a) = y₁ \ y₂ ⊓ a by
      rw [sdiff_eq, sdiff_eq, compl_inf, inf_sup_left]; simp [inf_left_comm, inf_comm]]

name: insertRep_le_insertRep_iff
statement:
lemma insertRep_le_insertRep_iff :
    (y₁ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₁ ⊓ aᶜ) ≤ (y₂ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z₂ ⊓ aᶜ) ↔
      (y₁ \ y₂) ⊓ a = ⊥ ∧ (z₁ \ z₂) ⊓ aᶜ = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : y₁ ⊓ a ≤ y₂ ⊓ a ⊔ z₂ ⊓ aᶜ ↔ y₁ ⊓ a ≤ y₂ ⊓ a :=
    ⟨fun h => by simpa [inf_sup_right, inf_assoc] using inf_le_inf_right a h,
      fun h => h.trans le_sup_left⟩
  have h₂ : z₁ ⊓ aᶜ ≤ y₂ ⊓ a ⊔ z₂ ⊓ aᶜ ↔ z₁ ⊓ aᶜ ≤ z₂ ⊓ aᶜ :=
    ⟨fun h => by simpa [inf_sup_right, inf_assoc] using inf_le_inf_right aᶜ h,
      fun h => h.trans le_sup_right⟩
  rw [sup_le_iff, h₁, h₂, inf_le_iff_sdiff_disjoint, inf_le_iff_sdiff_disjoint]

name: compl_insertRep
statement: lemma compl_insertRep (y z a : γ) : ((y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ))ᶜ = (yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (y ⊓ a) ⊔ (yᶜ ⊓ a) = a := by rw [← inf_sup_right, sup_compl_eq_top, top_inf_eq]
  have e2 : (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ) = aᶜ := by rw [← inf_sup_right, sup_compl_eq_top, top_inf_eq]
  have hsup : (y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ ((yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ)) = ⊤ :=
    calc (y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ ((yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ))
        = (y ⊓ a) ⊔ (yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ)) := by ac_rfl
      _ = a ⊔ aᶜ := by rw [e1, e2]
      _ = ⊤ := sup_compl_eq_top
  have hac : aᶜ ⊓ a = ⊥ := by rw [inf_comm]; exact inf_compl_eq_bot
  have h1 : (y ⊓ a) ⊓ (yᶜ ⊓ a) = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.mp <| (inf_le_inf inf_le_left inf_le_left).trans_eq inf_compl_eq_bot
  have h2 : (y ⊓ a) ⊓ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ) = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.mp <| (inf_le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_right).trans_eq inf_compl_eq_bot
  have h3 : (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊓ (yᶜ ⊓ a) = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.mp <| (inf_le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_right).trans_eq hac
  have h4 : (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊓ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ) = ⊥ :=
    le_bot_iff.mp <| (inf_le_inf inf_le_left inf_le_left).trans_eq inf_compl_eq_bot
  have hinf : ((y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ)) ⊓ ((yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ)) = ⊥ :=
    calc ((y ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ)) ⊓ ((yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ))
        = (y ⊓ a) ⊓ (yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (y ⊓ a) ⊓ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔
            ((z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊓ (yᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (z ⊓ aᶜ) ⊓ (zᶜ ⊓ aᶜ)) := by
          rw [inf_sup_right, inf_sup_left, inf_sup_left]
      _ = ⊥ := by rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]; simp
  exact (IsCompl.mk (disjoint_iff.mpr hinf) (codisjoint_iff.mpr hsup)).compl_eq

name: sup_atomsBelow_eq
statement:
lemma sup_atomsBelow_eq [Fintype γ] (w : γ) :
    (atomsBelow w).sup id = w
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ p, p ∈ atomsBelow w ↔ IsAtom p ∧ p ≤ w := fun p => by simp [atomsBelow]
  refine le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le fun p hp => (hmem p).mp hp |>.2) ?_
  by_contra hlt
  have hd : w \ (atomsBelow w).sup id ≠ ⊥ := fun h => hlt (sdiff_eq_bot_iff.mp h)
  obtain hd0 | ⟨p, hp, hple⟩ := (isAtomic_iff γ).mp Finite.to_isAtomic
    (w \ (atomsBelow w).sup id)
  · exact hd hd0
  · have hpw : p ≤ w := hple.trans sdiff_le
    have hple' : p ≤ (atomsBelow w).sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) ((hmem p).mpr ⟨hp, hpw⟩)
    have hdc : p ≤ ((atomsBelow w).sup id)ᶜ := hple.trans (by rw [sdiff_eq]; exact inf_le_right)
    exact hp.1 (le_bot_iff.mp ((le_inf hple' hdc).trans_eq inf_compl_eq_bot))

proof:
:= by
  rw [← disjoint_iff]
  conv_lhs => rw [← sup_atomsBelow_eq w]
  rw [Finset.disjoint_sup_left]
  simp only [id, disjoint_iff]

name: cod_le_of_le
statement: lemma cod_le_of_le (hfg : f ≤ g) : f.codSubalg ≤ g.codSubalg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hval⟩ := hfg
  intro v hv
  have h : (g.iso ⟨f.iso.symm ⟨v, hv⟩, hA (f.iso.symm ⟨v, hv⟩).2⟩ : β) = v := by
    rw [hval, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  exact h ▸ (g.iso _).2

name: symm_agree_of_le
statement:
lemma symm_agree_of_le (hfg : f ≤ g) (v : f.codSubalg) :
    (g.iso.symm ⟨v, cod_le_of_le hfg v.2⟩ : α) = f.iso.symm v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hval⟩ := id hfg
  have h : g.iso ⟨f.iso.symm v, hA (f.iso.symm v).2⟩ = ⟨v, cod_le_of_le hfg v.2⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext (by rw [hval, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply])
  rw [← h, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]

proof:

name: exists_le_mem_dom
statement:
theorem exists_le_mem_dom [Nontrivial β] [DenselyOrdered β]
    (f : PartialIso α β) (a : α) : ∃ g : PartialIso α β, f ≤ g ∧ a ∈ g.domSubalg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, h⟩ := exists_isCompanion f.finite_dom f.iso a
  exact ⟨⟨_, _, closure_insert_finite f.finite_dom a, closure_insert_finite f.finite_cod b,
    IsCompanion.extend h⟩, ⟨le_closure_insert, IsCompanion.extend_coe h⟩, self_mem_closure_insert⟩

name: iso_of_countable_atomless
statement:
theorem iso_of_countable_atomless
    [Countable α] [Nontrivial α] [DenselyOrdered α]
    [Countable β] [Nontrivial β] [DenselyOrdered β] :
    Nonempty (α ≃o β)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_encodable α
  cases nonempty_encodable β
  let toCofinal : α ⊕ β → Order.Cofinal (PartialIso α β) := fun p ↦
    Sum.recOn p definedAtLeft definedAtRight
  let I : Order.Ideal (PartialIso α β) := Order.idealOfCofinals default toCofinal
  have hF : ∀ a : α, ∃ b : β, ∃ f ∈ I, ∃ h : a ∈ f.domSubalg, (f.iso ⟨a, h⟩ : β) = b := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨f, hmem, hI⟩ := Order.cofinal_meets_idealOfCofinals default toCofinal (Sum.inl a)
    exact ⟨f.iso ⟨a, hmem⟩, f, hI, hmem, rfl⟩
  have hG : ∀ b : β, ∃ a : α, ∃ f ∈ I, ∃ h : b ∈ f.codSubalg, (f.iso.symm ⟨b, h⟩ : α) = a := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨f, hmem, hI⟩ := Order.cofinal_meets_idealOfCofinals default toCofinal (Sum.inr b)
    exact ⟨f.iso.symm ⟨b, hmem⟩, f, hI, hmem, rfl⟩
  choose F hFspec using hF
  choose G hGspec using hG
  have hleft : ∀ a, G (F a) = a := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨f, hfI, haf, hfa⟩ := hFspec a
    obtain ⟨g, hgI, hb, hgb⟩ := hGspec (F a)
    have hbf : F a ∈ f.codSubalg := hfa ▸ (f.iso ⟨a, haf⟩).2
    have h : (f.iso.symm ⟨F a, hbf⟩ : α) = G (F a) := by
      rw [symm_eval_eq_of_mem_of_mem hfI hgI hbf hb, hgb]
    rw [← h, show (⟨F a, hbf⟩ : f.codSubalg) = f.iso ⟨a, haf⟩ from Subtype.ext hfa.symm,
      OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
  have hright : ∀ b, F (G b) = b := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨g, hgI, hbg, hgb⟩ := hGspec b
    obtain ⟨f, hfI, ha, hfa⟩ := hFspec (G b)
    have hag : G b ∈ g.domSubalg := hgb ▸ (g.iso.symm ⟨b, hbg⟩).2
    rw [← hfa, eval_eq_of_mem_of_mem hfI hgI ha hag,
      show (⟨G b, hag⟩ : g.domSubalg) = g.iso.symm ⟨b, hbg⟩ from Subtype.ext hgb.symm,
      OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  have hrel : ∀ a₁ a₂ : α, F a₁ ≤ F a₂ ↔ a₁ ≤ a₂ := by
    intro a₁ a₂
    obtain ⟨f, hfI, h₁, hf₁⟩ := hFspec a₁
    obtain ⟨g, hgI, h₂, hf₂⟩ := hFspec a₂
    obtain ⟨m, hmI, ⟨hfm, _⟩, ⟨hgm, _⟩⟩ := I.directed f hfI g hgI
    rw [← hf₁, ← hf₂, eval_eq_of_mem_of_mem hfI hmI h₁ (hfm h₁),
      eval_eq_of_mem_of_mem hgI hmI h₂ (hgm h₂), Subtype.coe_le_coe, m.iso.le_iff_le,
      Subtype.mk_le_mk]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨F, G, hleft, hright⟩, hrel _ _⟩⟩

name: sound
statement: theorem sound : T ⟹ Γ → T ⊨[Valuation α] Γ.disj
proof:
:= by
  intro d v hv
  induction d
  case axL Γ a =>
    simp
    by_cases v a <;> simp [*]
  case verum => simp
  case and Γ φ ψ _ _ ihp ihq =>
    by_cases hv : v ⊧ Γ.disj
    · simp [hv]
    · have : v ⊧ φ := by simpa [hv] using ihp
      have : v ⊧ ψ := by simpa [hv] using ihq
      simp [*]
  case or Γ φ ψ d ih =>
    simpa [or_assoc] using ih
  case wk Γ Ξ _ ss ih =>
    have : ∃ φ ∈ Γ, v ⊧ φ := by simpa [List.map_disj] using ih
    rcases this with ⟨φ, hp, hvp⟩
    simpa using ⟨φ, ss hp, hvp⟩
  case cut Γ φ _ _ ihp ihn =>
    by_cases hv : v ⊧ Γ.disj
    · simp [hv]
    · have : v ⊧ φ := by simpa [hv] using ihp
      have : ¬v ⊧ φ := by simpa [hv] using ihn
      contradiction
  case axm φ h =>
    have : v ⊧* T := by simpa [Semantics.models] using hv
    simpa using Semantics.modelsSet_iff.mp hv h

name: exists_maximal_consistent_theory
statement:
lemma exists_maximal_consistent_theory (consisT : Entailment.Consistent T) :
    ∃ Z, Consistent Z ∧ T ⊆ Z ∧ ∀ U, Consistent U → Z ⊆ U → U = Z
proof:
:=
  have : ∃ Z : Theory α, T ⊆ Z ∧ Maximal Consistent Z :=
    zorn_subset_nonempty { U : Theory α | Consistent U }
      ( fun c hc chain hnc ↦ ⟨⋃₀ c, by
          haveI : DecidableEq α := Classical.typeDecidableEq α
          by_contra A
          rcases Entailment.inconsistent_compact.mp (Entailment.not_consistent_iff_inconsistent.mp A) with ⟨𝓕, h𝓕, fin, 𝓕_consis⟩
          rcases Set.subset_mem_chain_of_finite c hnc chain (s := 𝓕) fin h𝓕 with ⟨U, hUc, hsU⟩
          have : Consistent U := hc hUc
          have : ¬Consistent U := (𝓕_consis.of_supset hsU).not_con
          contradiction,
        fun s a => Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem a⟩) T consisT
  by rcases this with ⟨Z, ss, con, hZ⟩
     exact ⟨Z, con, ss, by intro U conU ssU; exact Set.Subset.antisymm (hZ conU ssU) ssU⟩

name: mem_or_neg_mem_maximalConsistentTheory
statement:
lemma mem_or_neg_mem_maximalConsistentTheory {consisT : Entailment.Consistent T} (φ) :
    φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ∨ ∼φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT
proof:
:= by
  haveI : DecidableEq α := Classical.typeDecidableEq α
  by_contra A
  have hp : φ ∉ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ∧ ∼φ ∉ maximalConsistentTheory consisT := by simpa [not_or] using A
  have : Consistent (insert φ (maximalConsistentTheory consisT)) :=
    Derivation.consistent_iff_unprovable.mpr
      (show ∼φ ∉ theory (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) from by simpa using hp.2)
  have : insert φ (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) ≠ maximalConsistentTheory consisT := by
    simp [hp]
  have : insert φ (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) = maximalConsistentTheory consisT :=
    maximalConsistentTheory_maximal _ (by assumption) (by simp)
  contradiction

name: mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff
statement:
lemma mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff :
    φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ↔ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ⊢ φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨Entailment.byAxm h⟩, fun h ↦ by have : φ ∈ theory (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) := h; simpa using this⟩

name: maximalConsistentTheory_consistent'
statement:
lemma maximalConsistentTheory_consistent' {φ} :
    φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT → ∼φ ∉ maximalConsistentTheory consisT
proof:
:= by
  intro h hn
  have : Inconsistent (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) :=
    Entailment.inconsistent_iff_provable_bot.mpr
      (neg_mdp! (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp hn) (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp h))
  have := this.not_con
  simp_all

name: not_mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff
statement:
lemma not_mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff :
    φ ∉ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ↔ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ⊢ ∼φ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT <;> simp [hp]
  · intro bnp
    have : Inconsistent (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) :=
      Entailment.inconsistent_of_provable (neg_mdp! bnp (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp hp))
    have := this.not_con
    simp_all
  · exact mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp
      (by simpa [hp] using mem_or_neg_mem_maximalConsistentTheory (consisT := consisT) φ)

name: mem_maximalConsistentTheory_and
statement:
lemma mem_maximalConsistentTheory_and {φ ψ} (h : φ ⋏ ψ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT) :
    φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ∧ ψ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT
proof:
:= by
  have : maximalConsistentTheory consisT ⊢ φ ⋏ ψ := mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp h
  exact ⟨mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mpr (K!_left this),
         mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mpr (K!_right this)⟩

name: mem_maximalConsistentTheory_or
statement:
lemma mem_maximalConsistentTheory_or {φ ψ} (h : φ ⋎ ψ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT) :
    φ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ∨ ψ ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT
proof:
:= by
  by_contra A
  have b : maximalConsistentTheory consisT ⊢ ∼φ ∧ maximalConsistentTheory consisT ⊢ ∼ψ := by
    simpa [not_or, not_mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff] using A
  have : Inconsistent (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) :=
    Entailment.inconsistent_of_provable
      (of_C!_of_C!_of_A! (N!_iff_CO!.mp b.1) (N!_iff_CO!.mp b.2) (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_iff.mp h))
  have := this.not_con
  simp_all

name: maximalConsistentTheory_satisfiable
statement:
lemma maximalConsistentTheory_satisfiable :
    (NNFormula.atom · ∈ maximalConsistentTheory consisT) ⊧* maximalConsistentTheory consisT
proof:
:= ⟨by
  intro φ hp
  induction φ using NNFormula.rec' <;> simp
  case hatom => simpa
  case hnatom =>
    simpa using maximalConsistentTheory_consistent' hp
  case hfalsum =>
    have : Inconsistent (maximalConsistentTheory consisT) := Entailment.inconsistent_of_provable ⟨Entailment.byAxm hp⟩
    have := this.not_con
    simp_all
  case hand φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    exact ⟨ihp (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_and hp).1, ihq (mem_maximalConsistentTheory_and hp).2⟩
  case hor φ ψ ihp ihq =>
    rcases mem_maximalConsistentTheory_or hp with (hp | hq)
    · left; exact ihp hp
    · right; exact ihq hq⟩

name: completeness
statement: theorem completeness! : T ⊨[Valuation α] φ → T ⊢ φ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : DecidableEq α := Classical.typeDecidableEq α
  suffices Consistent (insert (∼φ) T) → Semantics.Satisfiable (Valuation α) (insert (∼φ) T) by
    contrapose
    intro hp hs
    have : Semantics.Satisfiable (Valuation α) (insert (∼φ) T) :=
      this (Derivation.consistent_iff_unprovable.mpr $ by simpa)
    rcases this with ⟨v, hv⟩
    have : v ⊧* T := Semantics.ModelsSet.of_subset hv (by simp)
    have : v ⊧ φ := hs this
    have : ¬v ⊧ φ := by
      simpa using hv.models v (Set.mem_insert (∼φ) T)
    contradiction
  intro consis
  exact satisfiable_of_consistent consis

name: complexity_and
statement: @[simp] lemma complexity_and (φ ψ : NNFormula α) : complexity (φ ⋏ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

name: complexity_and'
statement: @[simp] lemma complexity_and' (φ ψ : NNFormula α) : complexity (and φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

name: complexity_or
statement: @[simp] lemma complexity_or (φ ψ : NNFormula α) : complexity (φ ⋎ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

name: complexity_or'
statement: @[simp] lemma complexity_or' (φ ψ : NNFormula α) : complexity (or φ ψ) = max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1

name: complexity_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : NNFormula α) : complexity (∼φ) = complexity φ
proof:
:=
  by induction φ using rec' <;> simp [*]

name: ne_of_ne_complexity
statement: lemma ne_of_ne_complexity {φ ψ : NNFormula α} (h : φ.complexity ≠ ψ.complexity) : φ ≠ ψ

name: falsum
statement: @[simp] lemma falsum {w c V} : ¬⟦w | c⟧⊩[V] (⊥ : Formula α)

name: atom
statement: @[simp] lemma atom {w c V} {a : α} : (⟦w | c⟧⊩[V] .atom a) ↔ V a

name: and_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma and_left {φ ψ : Formula α} {V θ π} :
    ⟦θ | .inl π⟧⊩[V] φ ⋏ ψ ↔ ⟦θ.1 | π⟧⊩[V] φ

name: and_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma and_right {φ ψ : Formula α} {V θ π} :
    ⟦θ | .inr π⟧⊩[V] φ ⋏ ψ ↔ ⟦θ.2 | π⟧⊩[V] ψ

name: or_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma or_left {φ ψ : Formula α} {V θ π} :
    ⟦.inl θ | π⟧⊩[V] φ ⋎ ψ ↔ ⟦θ | π.1⟧⊩[V] φ

name: or_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma or_right {φ ψ : Formula α} {V θ π} :
    ⟦.inr θ | π⟧⊩[V] φ ⋎ ψ ↔ ⟦θ | π.2⟧⊩[V] ψ

name: imply
statement:
@[simp] lemma imply {φ ψ : Formula α} {V f π} :
    ⟦f | π⟧⊩[V] φ 🡒 ψ ↔ (⟦π.1 | f.2 π.1 π.2⟧⊩[V] φ → ⟦f.1 π.1 | π.2⟧⊩[V] ψ)

name: verum
statement: @[simp] lemma verum {w c V} : ⟦w | c⟧⊩[V] (⊤ : Formula α)

name: not
statement: @[simp] lemma not {φ : Formula α} {V θ f} : ⟦f | θ⟧⊩[V] ∼φ ↔ ¬⟦θ.1 | f.2 θ.1 θ.2⟧⊩[V] φ

name: Valid.refl
statement: protected lemma Valid.refl (φ : Formula α) : ⊩ φ 🡒 φ
proof: := ⟨⟨id, fun _ π ↦ π⟩, by rintro V ⟨θ, π⟩; simp⟩

name: NotValid.em
statement: lemma NotValid.em (a : α) : ⊮ atom a ⋎ ∼atom a
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨⟨⟩⟩ | ⟨f⟩)
  · refine ⟨fun _ ↦ False, ⟨(), (), ()⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Realizable.or_left]; simp
  · rcases f with ⟨f₁, f₂⟩
    have : f₁ = id := rfl
    rcases this
    have : f₂ = fun _ _ ↦ () := rfl
    rcases this
    refine ⟨fun _ ↦ true, ⟨(), (), ()⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Realizable.or_right]; simp

name: height_cast
statement: @[simp] lemma height_cast (d : ⊢ᴸᴷ⁰ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : height (Derivation.cast d e) = height d
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with rfl; simp [Derivation.cast]

name: def_eq
statement: lemma def_eq (φ : NNFormula α) : (𝐋𝐊⁰ ⊢! φ) = (⊢ᴸᴷ⁰ ⦃φ⦄)
